articles.title: Ancient Humans May Have Hunted Hippos With Poisoned Spear Tips on the Arabian Peninsula 125,000 Years Ago

paras.en: Today, southern Saudi Arabia is a hot, dry desert, with sand dunes as far as the eye can see. But 125,000 years ago, it was home to a lush, freshwater lake that supported animals like hippopotamuses, buffalo, ostriches, camels, gazelles and oryx.
paras.zh: 如今，沙特阿拉伯南部是一片炎热干燥的沙漠，沙丘绵延至视野尽头。但12.5万年前，这里曾有一个郁郁葱葱的淡水湖，为河马、水牛、鸵鸟、骆驼、瞪羚和叉角羚等动物提供了栖息地。

paras.en: A new study, published November 12 in the journal Science, suggests that ancient humans took advantage of this rich biodiversity—and may even have created poisoned weapons to take down their prey.
paras.zh: 11月12日发表在《科学》杂志上的一项新研究表明，古人类利用了这种丰富的生物多样性，甚至可能制造了有毒武器来猎杀猎物。

paras.en: Researchers conducted excavations at a Middle Paleolithic site known as Uruq Aljelibah, which means “sand dunes of a watering hole.” It’s located in the Empty Quarter, or Rub' al-Khali, a vast desert region spanning southern Saudi Arabia, as well as parts of Yemen, Oman and the United Arab Emirates. The evidence suggests the site was once home to a 131-square-mile lake that measured nearly 100 feet deep and was surrounded by palms, reeds, trees, shrubs and other plants, per a statement.
paras.zh: 研究人员在一处名为Uruq Aljelibah的中旧石器时代遗址进行了发掘，该地名的意思是“水塘边的沙丘”。该遗址位于鲁卜哈利沙漠（又称“空旷地带”），这是一片广阔的沙漠区域，横跨沙特阿拉伯南部以及也门、阿曼和阿拉伯联合酋长国的部分地区。据一份声明称，有证据表明，该遗址曾有一个面积达131平方英里、深度近100英尺的湖泊，周围环绕着棕榈树、芦苇、树木、灌木和其他植物。

paras.en: While investigating the site, archaeologists discovered more than 500 fossilized animal remains and more than 5,500 stone tools and artifacts, including stone points they think may have been dipped in poison to paralyze or kill big game.
paras.zh: 在对该遗址进行调查时，考古学家发现了500多具动物化石遗骸和5500多件石器和文物，其中包括他们认为可能曾蘸过毒液的石尖，用于麻痹或猎杀大型猎物。

paras.en: The weapons were clustered near animal bones, which suggests the lakeshore was used for hunting and processing game. They also showed damage consistent with striking large animals, and some still had microscopic traces of animal tissue near their tips. Several also had chemical biomarkers associated with the arrow-poison tree (Acokanthera schimperi), a plant that contains cardiac glycosides, naturally occurring compounds that can affect heart rate.
paras.zh: 这些武器集中在动物骨骼附近，这表明湖岸曾被用于狩猎和处理猎物。这些武器还显示出与击打大型动物相符的损伤，有些武器的尖端附近仍有动物组织的微小痕迹。几件石器上还带有与箭毒树（Acokanthera schimperi）相关的化学生物标志物。箭毒树是一种含有强心苷的植物，强心苷是天然存在的化合物，可以影响心率。

paras.en: The researchers also found hints of resin and fibers at the bases of the stone points, which suggests they were “hafted”—composite weapons made from multiple materials, rather than simple handheld tools.
paras.zh: 研究人员还在石尖的底部发现了树脂和纤维的痕迹，这表明它们是“柄装”的——由多种材料制成的复合武器，而不是简单的手持工具。

paras.en: “Hafting is often inferred indirectly, based on size and shape of stone tools, for instance,” study co-author Huw Groucutt, an archaeologist at the University of Malta, tells Haaretz’s Ruth Schuster. “What we have done is find direct evidence in the form of residues showing how the tools were hafted and used, at a scale that is rarely applied in archaeology, and certainly not at sites like this, open air sites in arid regions.”
paras.zh: “柄装通常是通过间接方式推断出来的，例如根据石器的尺寸和形状，”研究论文的合著者、马耳他大学的考古学家Huw Groucutt对《国土报》的Ruth Schuster表示。“我们所做的是以残留物的形式找到直接证据，表明工具是如何装柄和使用的，其规模在考古学中很少见，在像这样的干旱地区露天遗址中更是罕见。”

paras.en: The scientists also discovered evidence of cutting, scraping and fiber processing, which suggests the people living here were exploiting plant resources for food, tools and binding materials.
paras.zh: 科学家们还发现了切割、刮削和纤维加工的证据，这表明这里的人们正在利用植物资源来获取食物、工具和捆绑材料。

paras.en: “Early humans were far more technologically sophisticated than the surviving archaeological record often suggests,” lead author Chris Clarkson, an archaeologist at Griffith University, tells Gizmodo’s Gayoung Lee. “We’re only beginning to understand just how complex their lives were.”
paras.zh: 格里菲斯大学的考古学家、第一作者克里斯·克拉克森（Chris Clarkson）在接受Gizmodo记者盖永·李（Gayoung Lee）采访时表示：“早期人类的技术水平远比现存考古记录所显示的高得多。” “我们才刚刚开始了解他们的生活有多么复杂。”

paras.en: It’s rare for archaeologists to find stone tools and animal bones at the same site on the Arabian Peninsula. This one, however, has “thousands of artifacts on an old lakeshore alongside hippo, buffalo and ostrich, and some of the flakes fit back together, so the tools were made on the spot,” Jeffrey Rose, an archaeologist at the University of Algarve who was not involved with the research, tells Live Science’s Charles Q. Choi. “It’s valuable new data.”
paras.zh: 考古学家在阿拉伯半岛的同一处遗址发现石器和动物骨骼的情况十分罕见。然而，在这一处遗址，“古湖岸边有数以千计的文物，旁边还有河马、水牛和鸵鸟的遗骸，其中一些石片可以拼合在一起，因此这些工具是在现场制作的。”阿尔加维大学的考古学家杰弗里·罗斯（Jeffrey Rose）在接受《直播科学》记者查尔斯·Q·崔（Charles Q. Choi）采访时表示。杰弗里·罗斯并未参与这项研究。“这是宝贵的新数据。”

paras.en: The site itself has been dated to 125,000 years ago; however, researchers haven’t definitively dated the stone points. That’s because they found all of the stone artifacts on the surface, not in layers of sediment that can be dated. They also don’t know whether the poison was effective, or how it was prepared.
paras.zh: 该遗址本身的年代可追溯至12.5万年前；然而，研究人员尚未确定石器的年代。这是因为他们发现所有石器都在地表，而不是在可以测定年代的沉积层中。他们也不知道毒药是否有效，以及是如何制备的。

paras.en: Last year, researchers in northern Saudi Arabia’s Nefud Desert discovered 130 life-size engravings of animals likely dating to between 11,400 and 12,800 years ago. The animals depicted include camels, ibex, wild donkeys, gazelles and aurochs, an extinct ancestor of cattle.
paras.zh: 去年，研究人员在沙特阿拉伯北部奈富德沙漠发现了130幅与实物大小相仿的动物岩画，其年代可能可追溯至11400年至12800年前。所描绘的动物包括骆驼、岩羊、野驴、瞪羚和原牛（牛的已灭绝祖先）。

paras.en: But if the stone points are confirmed to be 125,000 years old, they would be the oldest poisoned hunting weapons ever identified by a considerable margin. The oldest discovered so far date to around 60,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 但如果这些石尖的年代确实可以追溯到12.5万年前，那么它们将是迄今为止已发现的最古老的带毒狩猎武器，且年代要早得多。迄今为止发现的最古老的此类武器可追溯至约6万年前。

paras.en: The archaeologists did not find any human remains at the site, though they suspect it was inhabited by Homo sapiens.
paras.zh: 考古学家在该遗址没有发现任何人类遗骸，但他们怀疑这里曾有人类居住。

paras.en: Located between Africa and the rest of Asia, the Arabian Peninsula likely served as an important migration corridor for modern humans, especially during wetter climactic periods. The new study suggests ancient humans weren’t “just passing through,” Clarkson tells Live Science. They were settling in and exploiting green areas “in quite sophisticated ways, using a range of technologies and resources.”
paras.zh: 阿拉伯半岛位于非洲和亚洲其他地区之间，很可能曾是现代人类的重要迁徙走廊，特别是在气候较为湿润的时期。克拉克森在接受《Live Science》采访时表示，这项新研究表明，古人类并非“只是路过”。他们“以相当复杂的方式，利用各种技术和资源”，定居下来并开发绿地。

articles.title: The U.S. Has Lost Its Measles Elimination Status, Which It's Held for 26 Years. Cases Have Now Surged to the Highest Levels in Decades

paras.en: The United States has lost its measles elimination status as cases surge to the highest levels in decades.
paras.zh: 随着麻疹病例激增至数十年来的最高水平，美国已经失去了消除麻疹的地位。

paras.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), an international public health agency for the Americas, has concluded that the U.S. no longer meets the criteria for measles elimination, according to the Wall Street Journal’s Liz Essley Whyte and Jennifer Calfas.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》的莉兹·埃斯利·怀特 (Liz Essley Whyte) 和詹妮弗·卡尔法斯 (Jennifer Calfas) 报道，美洲国际公共卫生机构泛美卫生组织 (PAHO) 得出结论，美国不再符合消除麻疹的标准。

paras.en: “Measles elimination is a vital sign for our public health system,” Demetre Daskalakis, a former director of the National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), tells CNN’s Brenda Goodman. “It shows cracks in our foundation. Losing elimination status means that we are less prepared as a nation to address infectious and noninfectious disease challenges.”
paras.zh: “消除麻疹是我们公共卫生系统的一个重要标志，”美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 国家免疫和呼吸系统疾病中心前主任德米特·达斯卡拉基斯 (Demetre Daskalakis) 告诉 CNN 的布伦达·古德曼 (Brenda Goodman)。 “这表明我们的基础存在裂缝。失去消除地位意味着我们作为一个国家在应对传染病和非传染病挑战方面准备不足。”

paras.en: Measles was declared eliminated in the U.S. in 2000, meaning there had been no continuous spread of the disease for more than 12 months. However, in recent years, the highly contagious viral disease has made a comeback.
paras.zh: 2000年，美国宣布麻疹已消除，这意味着该疾病已连续12个月以上未出现持续传播。然而，近年来，这种传染性极强的病毒性疾病又死灰复燃。

paras.en: So far this year, the CDC has confirmed more than 5,400 measles cases—the highest annual total since 1991—and 43 outbreaks. According to CDC data, 96 percent of those cases involved individuals who were not vaccinated or whose vaccination status was unknown. At least ten individuals have died from the disease this year, with deaths occurring in Pennsylvania, New York and Wisconsin.
paras.zh: 今年迄今为止，美国疾控中心已确诊超过5,400例麻疹病例（这是1991年以来的最高年度总数）和43起麻疹疫情。根据疾控中心的数据，这些病例中96%涉及未接种疫苗或接种疫苗情况不明的个体。今年已有至少十人死于该疾病，死亡病例发生在宾夕法尼亚州、纽约州和威斯康星州。

paras.en: “Runaway measles outbreaks in the United States, as well as the needless deaths, are all due to low measles vaccination coverage,” Noel Brewer, a public health researcher at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and chair of a committee that reports on U.S. measles activity to the PAHO, tells the Wall Street Journal. “We’ve gotten comfortable letting children be stopped by a deadly disease and die from it.”
paras.zh: “Runaway measles outbreaks in the United States, as well as the needless deaths, are all due to low measles vaccination coverage,” Noel Brewer, a public health researcher at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and chair of a committee that reports on U.S. measles activity to the PAHO, tells the Wall Street Journal. “我们已经习惯了让孩子们被一种致命的疾病阻止并死于它。”

paras.en: Measles is a highly contagious viral disease that spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, sneezes or breathes. It typically causes a high fever, cough, runny nose and distinctive rash, but it can also lead to serious complications, including pneumonia, blindness, brain swelling and, in some cases, death. The first measles vaccine was authorized for public use in 1963.
paras.zh: 麻疹是一种高度传染性的病毒性疾病，当感染者咳嗽、打喷嚏或呼吸时，病毒会通过空气传播。麻疹通常会导致高烧、咳嗽、流鼻涕和 характерная皮疹，但也可能引发严重的并发症，包括肺炎、失明、脑肿胀，在某些情况下还会导致死亡。第一款麻疹疫苗于1963年获准投入公共使用。

paras.en: The CDC recommends children receive two doses of the measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine, which is 97 percent effective at thwarting measles. At least 95 percent of the population needs to be vaccinated to prevent the disease from spreading. However, vaccination rates have fallen in recent years. During the 2025-2026 school year, 92.4 percent of kindergartners had received the MMR vaccine, down from 95.2 percent in 2019-2020, according to CDC data.
paras.zh: CDC 建议儿童接种两剂麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹 (MMR) 疫苗，该疫苗对麻疹的预防有效率达 97%。至少 95% 的人口需要接种疫苗以防止疾病传播。然而，近年来疫苗接种率有所下降。根据 CDC 数据，2025-2026 学年，92.4% 的幼儿园儿童接种了 MMR 疫苗，低于 2019-2020 年的 95.2%。

paras.en: Quick fact: Changes to childhood vaccine schedule
paras.zh: 事实速览：儿童疫苗接种时间表的变化

paras.en: In January, the CDC overhauled the U.S.’s childhood immunization schedule, reducing the number of diseases it recommends that all American children should be vaccinated against to 11, down from 17 a month earlier. The MMR vaccine was still suggested for all kids.
paras.zh: 一月份，疾病预防控制中心彻底修改了美国的儿童免疫接种计划，将建议所有美国儿童接种疫苗的疾病数量从一个月前的 17 种减少到 11 种。仍然建议所有儿童接种 MMR 疫苗。

paras.en: “It’s a very sad moment,” Anne Schuchat, an epidemiologist and a former deputy director of the CDC, tells KFF Health News’ Amy Maxmen. “Measles causes so much unnecessary suffering, everything from a high fever and missed work and school to long-term complications like progressive degenerative nerve disease and death.”
paras.zh: “It’s a very sad moment,” Anne Schuchat, an epidemiologist and a former deputy director of the CDC, tells KFF Health News’ Amy Maxmen. “麻疹会造成很多不必要的痛苦，从高烧、缺勤、缺课到进行性退行性神经疾病和死亡等长期并发症。”

paras.en: As viruses spread and replicate, small genetic differences accumulate, creating subtle variations in their genetic makeup. By comparing the genetic sequences of viruses collected during an outbreak, researchers can trace the relationships between different outbreaks and assess whether they likely stemmed from the same chain of transmission.
paras.zh: 随着病毒的传播和复制，微小的遗传差异不断积累，导致其遗传构成出现细微变化。通过比较在疫情爆发期间采集的病毒的基因序列，研究人员可以追溯不同疫情之间的关系，并评估它们是否可能源自同一条传播链。

paras.en: According to Nextstrain, a public database that tracks pathogen evolution, an outbreak that started in Texas in 2025 spread to Utah and Arizona, where the virus continued circulating for more than a year.
paras.zh: 根据跟踪病原体进化的公共数据库 Nextstrain 的数据，2025 年在德克萨斯州爆发的疫情蔓延到犹他州和亚利桑那州，病毒在那里持续传播了一年多。

paras.en: “There’s a general pattern of outbreaks seeding other outbreaks,” J.T. McCrone, an evolutionary biologist at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center who helps oversee Nextstrain, tells the New York Times’ Apoorva Mandavilli. “Measles is very contagious; it spreads very easily. We have a lot of connected communities in the U.S., and so you can hop from population to population and maintain a transmission chain.”
paras.zh: 弗雷德·哈钦森癌症中心的进化生物学家J.T. McCrone协助监督Nextstrain的工作，他告诉《纽约时报》的Apoorva Mandavilli：“存在一种普遍的模式，即疫情爆发会引发其他疫情爆发。” “麻疹的传染性很强，传播非常容易。美国有很多相互关联的社区，因此病毒可以从一个群体传播到另一个群体，从而维持传播链。”

paras.en: Measles has re-emerged as a public health challenge around the world. Canada lost its measles-elimination status in November 2025, followed by the United Kingdom in January 2026. Spain, Austria, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan also lost their status.
paras.zh: 麻疹已再次成为全球公共卫生挑战。加拿大于2025年11月失去了麻疹消除地位，随后英国于2026年1月也失去了这一地位。西班牙、奥地利、亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆和乌兹别克斯坦也失去了这一地位。

paras.en: To regain its measles elimination designation, the U.S. must stop the continuous spread of the disease for at least 12 months. Doing so will require “stronger surveillance, speedy outbreak response and increased vaccination rates,” writes Katrine L. Wallace, an epidemiologist at the University of Illinois Chicago, for the Conversation.
paras.zh: 为了重新获得麻疹消除认证，美国必须至少12个月内阻止该疾病的持续传播。伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的流行病学家Katrine L. Wallace在《对话》上撰文指出，要做到这一点，需要“加强监测、迅速应对疫情爆发并提高接种率”。

paras.en: Other countries have successfully regained their measles-free status, such as Brazil, which recovered the designation in 2024 after losing it in 2019.
paras.zh: 其他国家已成功恢复无麻疹状态，例如巴西，该国在2019年失去该称号后，于2024年重新获得。

paras.en: Erica Schwartz, director of the CDC, told Reuters’ Yasmeen Abutaleb last week that the CDC would not alter its measles response if the U.S. lost its elimination status.
paras.zh: 美国疾控中心主任Erica Schwartz上周对路透社记者Yasmeen Abutaleb表示，即使美国失去麻疹消除国的地位，疾控中心也不会改变其麻疹应对措施。

paras.en: “We’re going to be doing the same exact thing that we’ve been doing today, which is working with the states,” Schwartz said. The CDC will make sure “we are leaning in to help them provide awareness about measles, emphasizing, re-emphasizing that the number one way to prevent measles is the MMR vaccine.”
paras.zh: “我们将继续开展与今天完全相同的工作，即与各州合作，”施瓦茨表示。疾控中心将确保“我们积极协助各州提高对麻疹的认识，强调并再次强调预防麻疹的首要方法是接种MMR疫苗。”

articles.title: SpaceX Catches the Upper Stage of Its Starship for the First Time, Making the Company One Step Closer to a Reusable Rocket

paras.en: On November 14, SpaceX successfully caught the separated upper section of its massive Starship rocket as it returned from Earth orbit, marking a historic step toward the development of reusable rockets.
paras.zh: 11 月 14 日，SpaceX 成功捕获了从地球轨道返回的大型 Starship 火箭的分离上部，标志着可重复使用火箭的发展迈出了历史性的一步。

paras.en: “That was the missing link,” SpaceX spokesperson Dan Huot said during a livestream of the landing, reports Mike Wall at Space.com. “That was the holy grail of spaceflight, plummeting through fire to be snatched out of the air by steel. We caught a Starship, and now everything changes.”
paras.zh: 据 Space.com 的迈克·沃尔 (Mike Wall) 报道，SpaceX 发言人丹·霍特 (Dan Huot) 在着陆直播中表示：“这就是缺失的环节。” “那是太空飞行的圣杯，从火中坠落，然后被钢铁从空中夺走。我们抓住了一艘星舰，现在一切都改变了。”

paras.en: The 407-foot rocket launched for its 15th test flight from the company’s Starbase site in southern Texas on November 13. The lower stage, called the Super Heavy booster, separated during the ascent after providing the thrust needed for takeoff. The upper stage, called the Starship spacecraft, went on to complete a roughly 22.5-hour journey, which involved 14 laps around Earth and the deployment of 26 Starlink satellites.
paras.zh: 这枚 407 英尺长的火箭于 11 月 13 日从该公司位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 基地发射升空，进行第 15 次试飞。下级称为超重型助推器，在提供起飞所需的推力后在上升过程中分离。上层被称为“星舰”飞船，继续完成大约 22.5 小时的旅程，其中包括绕地球 14 圈，并部署了 26 颗星链卫星。

paras.en: After that, the spacecraft navigated back to Starbase, where a giant pair of robotic, chopstick-like arms captured it.
paras.zh: 之后，飞船返回星际基地，在那里一对巨大的筷子状机器人手臂捕获了它。

paras.en: “Can you believe it?” Huot said during the livestream, reports Marcia Dunn for the Associated Press. “Look at her! Baby, she’s back!”
paras.zh: “你能相信吗？”据美联社玛西娅·邓恩报道，霍特在直播中说道。 “快看她！宝贝，她回来了！”

paras.en: Mechazilla catches Starship! Congratulations to the entire SpaceX team on this incredible achievement! https://t.co/YJzmGUZb2B
paras.zh: 机甲齐拉抓住星舰！祝贺整个 SpaceX 团队取得这一令人难以置信的成就！ https://t.co/YJzmGUZb2B

paras.en: Not everything happened as planned, however. The company had also hoped to catch Super Heavy, which it has previously done three times, per the AP. This time around, the booster had to be diverted to a splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico because of low fuel. SpaceX is investigating what triggered the issue, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 然而，并非一切都按计划发生。据美联社报道，该公司还曾希望赶上“超级重型”，此前该公司已经做到了三次。这一次，由于燃料不足，助推器不得不转移到墨西哥湾溅落。一份声明称，SpaceX 正在调查引发该问题的原因。

paras.en: Still, snatching the upper stage is harder than grabbing the booster, since the Starship spacecraft travels higher and faster than the lower stage, according to Space.com. The historic catch brings SpaceX closer to its goal of building a fully reusable rocket. The company wants to build a rocket system that can travel to space and back with minimal refurbishments needed between launches.
paras.zh: 不过，据 Space.com 称，抢夺上一级比抢助推器更难，因为星舰飞船比下一级飞行得更高、速度更快。这一历史性的捕获使 SpaceX 更接近其建造完全可重复使用火箭的目标。该公司希望建造一个可以往返太空的火箭系统，并且在发射之间只需最少的翻新。

paras.en: “If every time you drove somewhere you had to throw away the car, you’d be [like] ‘wow, that’s a crazy car where you have to throw away after every time you drive it.’ But that’s how it works for rockets,” said SpaceX CEO Elon Musk at the X Takeover 2025 event, reports Matthew Glasser at ABC News.
paras.zh: “如果每次开车去某个地方都要把车扔掉，你就会觉得‘哇，这辆车太疯狂了，每次开完都要扔掉’。但火箭就是这样运作的。”SpaceX首席执行官埃隆·马斯克在X Takeover 2025活动上表示，据ABC新闻的马修·格拉瑟报道。

paras.en: Being able to reuse rockets would drastically cut down the cost of launching objects into space, says Casey Dreier, chief of space policy for the Planetary Society, to the outlet. It also “allows you to increase the amount of stuff you can send into space, which SpaceX has really been leaning into.”
paras.zh: 行星协会太空政策负责人凯西·德雷尔向媒体表示，能够重复使用火箭将大大降低将物体发射到太空的成本。它还“允许你增加可以发送到太空的东西的数量，这正是 SpaceX 一直以来真正关注的领域。”

paras.en: Quick fact: Starship’s first time in Earth orbit
paras.zh: 小知识：星际飞船首次进入地球轨道

paras.en: Starship only recently reached Earth orbit. It passed the milestone on September 28, during a test flight in which the spacecraft looped around the planet twice. However, it returned sooner than planned because one of its engines had shut down.
paras.zh: 星际飞船最近才进入地球轨道。它在9月28日的一次试飞中达到了这一里程碑，当时该飞船绕地球飞行了两圈。然而，由于其中一台发动机熄火，它比计划提前返回。

paras.en: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman took to social media to congratulate the company on its feat, writing “it was almost like magic.” The space agency will test Starship during the Artemis 3 mission, slated for mid-2027, when SpaceX and aerospace company Blue Origin compete to provide the lunar lander NASA will use to take humans back to the moon, planned for the following year.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼在社交媒体上祝贺该公司的壮举，并写道“这几乎就像魔术一样”。美国宇航局将在定于 2027 年中期执行的阿耳忒弥斯 3 号任务期间测试 Starship，届时 SpaceX 和航空航天公司蓝色起源将竞争提供月球着陆器，NASA 计划于次年使用该着陆器将人类带回月球。

paras.en: However, significant technical challenges remain. SpaceX still needs to demonstrate in-orbit fuel transfers—something that has never been done before—since Starship is too heavy to launch with the fuel needed to reach the moon.
paras.zh: 然而，重大的技术挑战仍然存在。 SpaceX 仍然需要演示在轨燃料传输——这是以前从未做过的事情——因为星际飞船太重，无法携带到达月球所需的燃料发射。

paras.en: Mission teams have already started gathering data for next steps, reports Jackie Wattles for CNN. Now, the company’s analysts and engineers can look at how the rocket held up during its journey—and importantly, how the heat shield fared during its scorching re-entry into the atmosphere—and find ways to improve its performance. A SpaceX spokesperson told the outlet earlier last week that the company intends to be reliably reusing Starship vehicles by the time astronauts return to the lunar surface.

articles.title: Walmart Promo Codes: 20% Off for November 2026

Rows and rows of fluorescent lights highlighted any and every product needed for your house in one place. Screw the mom-and-pop bodega—I missed this level of convenience. If by chance Walmart doesn’t have what you need in-store, there’s even more online, with pickup and delivery available. Be sure to check out a Walmart coupon or Walmart promo code below to save.

paras.en: Score Big: 50% Off Walmart Black Friday Deals
paras.zh: 赚大钱：沃尔玛黑色星期五优惠 50% 折扣

paras.en: Walmart essentially invented Black Friday. During the Walmart Black Friday sale, you can expect 20% off beauty, 40% off household appliances, 30% off holiday decor, 25% off tech, and more.

paras.en: Walmart has thousands of flash deals that change weekly, with up to 65% off tech, appliances, end-of-season, and holiday items. Be sure to check often to find the best rotating deals. If you’re like me, you’re always searching for the best tech deals without breaking the bank. Whether you’re looking to purchase a new 17-piece non-stick cookware set, a Dyson cordless vacuum cleaner, or this season’s latest clothing trends for men, women, or children—Walmart is your one-stop shop for it all.
paras.zh: 沃尔玛有数千种每周更换的限时优惠，科技产品、家电、季末和节日商品最高可享受 65% 的折扣。请务必经常检查以找到最佳的轮换优惠。如果你像我一样，你总是在不花太多钱的情况下寻找最好的技术交易。无论您是想购买全新 17 件套不粘炊具套装、戴森无绳吸尘器，还是本季最新的男装、女装或儿童服装趋势，沃尔玛都是您的一站式商店。

paras.en: You can also enjoy great benefits with Walmart+, a paid membership that gives early access to promotions and events like Walmart Black Friday deals, free delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, savings on fuel, streaming with Paramount+, and more. You can pay monthly or annually, and you’ll get a free 30-day trial of Walmart+. Walmart+ Assist helps qualifying government aid recipients get a membership at a lower cost.
paras.zh: 您还可以享受 Walmart+ 的巨大优惠，这是一种付费会员资格，可以提前享受沃尔玛黑色星期五优惠等促销和活动、免费送货、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油、通过 Paramount+ 进行流媒体播放等。您可以按月或按年付费，并且可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天。 Walmart+ Assist 帮助符合条件的政府援助接受者以较低的成本获得会员资格。

paras.en: Did you know Walmart has its own Amazon Prime-like membership plan? It's called Walmart+, and it's a great option for frequent Walmart shoppers. It offers free grocery delivery, free shipping with no order minimum, fuel savings, and early access to promotions and events. Plus, you can try Walmart+ free for 30 days to see if the service is right for you or your family. The annual plan is $98 (roughly $8 per month) after the trial, meaning you’ll get $57 in savings annually.
paras.zh: 您知道沃尔玛有自己的类似亚马逊 Prime 的会员计划吗？它被称为沃尔玛+，对于经常在沃尔玛购物的人来说是一个不错的选择。它提供免费杂货配送、无最低订单限制的免费送货、节省燃油以及提前参与促销和活动。另外，您可以免费试用 Walmart+ 30 天，看看该服务是否适合您或您的家人。试用后，年度计划为 98 美元（每月约 8 美元），这意味着您每年将节省 57 美元。

paras.en: If you don’t want to leave your home, Walmart offers fast delivery in as little as an hour! You’ll just need to book a time slot through the site to get your favorites and essentials right to your door. This even includes delivery of important refrigerated prescriptions, like insulin, GLP-1s, antibiotics, and more. Plus, it’s great when you’re sick and need cold/flu remedies like DayQuil, Theraflu, tea, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您不想出门，沃尔玛可提供最快一小时内的送货服务！您只需通过网站预订一个时段，即可将您喜爱的商品和必需品送到家门口。这甚至包括运送重要的冷藏处方药，如胰岛素、GLP-1、抗生素等。另外，当您生病并需要 DayQuil、Theraflu、茶等感冒/流感药物时，它会非常有用。

paras.en: The OnePay Walmart Spend Card is a Walmart-exclusive credit card, meaning it can only be used at Walmart and Walmart.com. If you don’t qualify for the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard (and have poor credit scores), this is a great way to build credit history—but you won’t get the cash-back rewards of the CashRewards card. This card not only helps you build credit but also doesn’t require an annual fee. When you apply for a OnePay Card, you’ll first be considered for the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard. If you don’t qualify, you’ll be considered for a OnePay Walmart Spend Card. Interested applicants can apply online at Walmart.com, in the Walmart app, or in-store.
paras.zh: OnePay 沃尔玛消费卡是沃尔玛专用信用卡，这意味着它只能在 Walmart 和 Walmart.com 上使用。如果您不符合 OnePay CashRewards 万事达卡的资格（并且信用评分较差），这是建立信用记录的好方法，但您将无法获得 CashRewards 卡的现金返还奖励。这张卡不仅可以帮助您建立信用，而且不需要年费。当您申请 OnePay 卡时，您将首先被考虑使用 OnePay CashRewards Mastercard。如果您不符合资格，我们将考虑您申请 OnePay 沃尔玛消费卡。有兴趣的申请人可以在 Walmart.com、沃尔玛应用程序或店内进行在线申请。

paras.en: Being a student usually means sleep deprivation, caffeine overconsumption, and being broke. When students shop at Walmart, they can stretch their limited funds even further with 50% off Walmart+ memberships for students. That means a student Walmart+ membership is $6.47 per month or $49 per year. Plus, you can get a free 30-day trial to decide if the service is right for you! To get this deal, verify your eligibility, then choose your discounted plan—either monthly or annual. Either option is still 50%. With the free trial, you’ll get perks like free delivery on orders over $35, free shipping, and either a free Paramount+ or Peacock streaming service (that amounts to up to $109 per year in video streaming savings!).
paras.zh: 作为一名学生通常意味着睡眠不足、咖啡因摄入过量和破产。当学生在沃尔玛购物时，他们可以进一步利用有限的资金，为学生提供 50% 的 Walmart+ 会员资格折扣。这意味着 Walmart+ 学生会员的费用为每月 6.47 美元或每年 49 美元。此外，您还可以获得 30 天免费试用，以确定该服务是否适合您！要获得此优惠，请验证您的资格，然后选择您的折扣计划 - 每月或每年。任一选项仍然是 50%。通过免费试用，您将获得一些福利，例如订单超过 35 美元的免费送货、免费送货以及免费的 Paramount+ 或 Peacock 流媒体服务（每年最多可节省 109 美元的视频流媒体费用！）。

paras.en: Get 5% Cashback at Walmart as a Walmart+ Member
paras.zh: 成为Walmart+会员，在沃尔玛购物可享5%返现

paras.en: Being a Walmart+ member comes with many perks, including 5% cash back when you shop at Walmart with Plus and 1.5% cash back on all other purchases, with zero annual fees. When you open a OnePay Card and spend over $75 on that card within 30 days, you’ll get an extra $35 in cash back. To get these rewards, all you need to do is pay with your OnePay CashRewards Card at Walmart (or anywhere Mastercard is accepted), earn OnePay points on your purchases, and redeem them for cash or a statement credit into a OnePay Cash Account.
paras.zh: 成为 Walmart+ 会员可享受许多福利，包括使用 Plus 在 Walmart 购物时可享受 5% 的现金返还，所有其他购物可享受 1.5% 的现金返还，且年费为零。当您开立 OnePay 卡并在 30 天内在该卡上消费超过 75 美元时，您将获得额外 35 美元的现金返还。要获得这些奖励，您只需在沃尔玛（或接受万事达卡的任何地方）使用 OnePay CashRewards 卡付款，在购买时赚取 OnePay 积分，然后将其兑换成现金或将积分存入 OnePay 现金账户。

paras.en: Managing a medical condition like diabetes can be anxiety-inducing, and it can also be extremely expensive. (Thanks, USA, for not having universal healthcare!) Walmart knows your health is a priority and wants to make medically necessary items more affordable for folks with diabetes. Walmart has a dedicated online section for (often) discounted diabetes essentials to take the headache and guesswork out of shopping. You can get up to 35% off items like glucose monitors, insulin coolers, test strips, and medical bags. Plus, diabetic supplies and wearables like socks, footwear, and mobility aids are available for fast shipping, and most are FSA/HSA eligible.
paras.zh: 治疗糖尿病等疾病可能会引起焦虑，而且费用也可能非常昂贵。 （感谢美国没有全民医疗保健！）沃尔玛知道您的健康是首要任务，并希望为糖尿病患者提供更实惠的医疗必需品。沃尔玛有一个专门的在线专区，出售（通常）打折的糖尿病必需品，以消除购物时的头痛和猜测。血糖监测仪、胰岛素冷却器、试纸和医疗包等商品可享受高达 35% 的折扣。此外，糖尿病用品和可穿戴设备（如袜子、鞋类和助行器）可快速发货，而且大多数都符合 FSA/HSA 资格。

articles.title: Columbia Promo Codes: 15% Off | November 2026

paras.en: When I decided to take a last-minute ski trip, despite never having skied before, I went straight to Columbia. Was I shredding the slopes? Absolutely not, but at least I was warm, thanks to my Snowy Summit Insulated Jacket and Bugaboo II Pants. Here at WIRED, we’re fans of Columbia. The brand makes reliable, well-priced outdoor gear for skiing, hiking, hunting, or just a day at the beach. Plus, there’s almost always a deal to be found.

paras.en: WIRED reviewer Chris Haslam loves the Columbia Konos Trillium ATR as a value-packed all-around trail-running shoe for faster hikes, day trips, and mixed-terrain excursions. For hiking boots, he recommends the Tellurix Titanium OutDry, which are waterproof, provide serious traction on wet rock and mud, and are surprisingly lightweight at 1.6 pounds per pair.
paras.zh: 《连线》评论员 Chris Haslam 非常喜欢 Columbia Konos Trillium ATR，它是一款物超所值的全能越野跑鞋，适合快速徒步、一日游和混合地形远足。柔软的缓冲垫和 8 毫米的落差非常适合在堆积的泥土、砾石和林地路径上行走。对于登山靴，他推荐 Tellurix Titanium OutDry，这种靴子防水，在潮湿的岩石和泥土上提供强大的牵引力，而且重量惊人，每双重 1.6 磅。

paras.en: With summer approaching, now’s the time to prepare for outings. If you’re eyeing snow gear, the off-season is when prices hit their lowest. I’ve gathered the latest Columbia promo codes to sweeten the deal.
paras.zh: 夏季将至，又到了外出游玩的准备时间。如果您正在寻找雪具，淡季就是价格最低的时候。我收集了最新的哥伦比亚促销代码来增加交易的吸引力。

paras.en: Loop earplugs are among the best reusable earplugs you can buy. I keep a pair attached to my car keys at all times. As a live music enthusiast who frequently travels to some of the loudest music festivals on the planet, I take earplugs seriously. paras.en: Loop earplugs come with multiple ear tip sizes so you can find the best fit, plus a handy carrying case that’ll keep them clean and easy to find between uses. I also really like how they look in your ears. They’re almost like jewelry. They stay comfortable and secure—I’ve worn mine for over twelve hours at a time, and I love them so much that I’ve purchased them with my own money (even without a Loop earplugs promo code). paras.en: Turn Down the Noise: 25% Off Loop Black Friday Sale
paras.zh: 降低噪音：Loop 黑色星期五促销 25% 折扣

paras.en: If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your ear protection or get ready for future concerts, sporting events, or monster truck rallies, it’s smart to have some trusty earplugs on hand. Be sure to take advantage of the Loop Earplugs Black Friday Sale to stock up on essentials at a discount. Be sure to make or sign in to your Loop rewards account to get Black Friday early access, including 25% off.
paras.zh: 如果您一直想升级您的耳朵保护装置或为未来的音乐会、体育赛事或巨型卡车拉力赛做好准备，最好准备一些值得信赖的耳塞。请务必利用 Loop 耳塞黑色星期五特卖，以折扣价购买必需品。请务必创建或登录您的 Loop 奖励帐户，以便提前获得黑色星期五的体验，包括 25% 的折扣。

paras.en: If you’re an avid concertgoer or, like me, just need absolute peace and quiet to fall asleep, you’ll want to grab a couple of pairs of Loop earplugs. Having a few pairs handy is ideal, so you can keep one in your car, one in your room, and one in your purse or bag to make sure you have protection on hand when you least expect it. Plus, they’re great to give to the people you’re with who don’t have protection at loud events like concerts or Monster Truck rallies. You can save 10, 15, or 20 percent on Loop earplug bundle deals, which include the good night bundle for enhanced sleep protection, the full coverage bundle for a myriad of needs, the daily calm bundle, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您是一位狂热的音乐会爱好者，或者像我一样，只需要绝对的平静和安静才能入睡，那么您会想要买几对 Loop 耳塞。手边备有几双是理想的选择，因此您可以在车里放一双，在房间里放一双，在钱包或包里放一双，以确保您在最意想不到的时候得到保护。另外，它们非常适合送给那些在音乐会或怪物卡车集会等喧闹活动中没有保护的人。您可以在 Loop 耳塞捆绑包优惠中节省 10%、15% 或 20%，其中包括增强睡眠保护的晚安捆绑包、满足各种需求的全覆盖捆绑包、日常平静捆绑包等。

Loop Circle is the Loop rewards program, where members earn points on purchases to unlock member-only rewards when you shop. If you go to concerts often or are a professional musician who needs multiple pairs of earplugs, joining Loop Circle is a great way to earn even more rewards.
paras.zh: 与许多其他品牌一样，Loop 有一个内部计划，可以奖励您已经计划进行的购买。 Loop Circle 是 Loop 奖励计划，会员可以通过购买赚取积分，以便在购物时解锁会员专属奖励。如果您经常去音乐会或者是需要多副耳塞的专业音乐家，加入 Loop Circle 是获得更多奖励的好方法。

paras.en: Loop Earplugs Quiet 2 Deals: Protect Your Ears and Reduce Noise
paras.zh: Loop 耳塞安静 2 优惠：保护您的耳朵并减少噪音

paras.en: The Quiet 2 are the best Loop earplugs for sleep. They can block up to 27 dB of noise, and they’re made of soft silicone, so they’ll stay comfortable even if you’re a side sleeper. They’re snug, secure, and small-ear-friendly. We also appreciate that they come in multiple colors and are easy to clean with soap and water.
paras.zh: Quiet 2 是最适合睡眠的循环耳塞。它们可以阻挡高达 27 分贝的噪音，并且由柔软的硅胶制成，因此即使您侧睡也能保持舒适。它们舒适、安全且适合小耳朵。我们还欣赏它们有多种颜色，并且易于用肥皂和水清洁。

paras.en: This Daily Calm bundle is perfect for everyday noise reduction. You’ll get the Loop Engage 2 Plus, which are essentially noise-canceling headphones for your day-to-day life. articles.title: A tropical Chinese city is half-empty and ready for the summit.
articles.author: Keith Bradsher

paras.en: The leaders of China and Russia met in China ahead of President Trump’s arrival there on Wednesday, a display of solidarity between two authoritarian leaders aligned against Western influence.
paras.zh: 在特朗普总统周三抵达中国之前，中国和俄罗斯领导人在中国举行了会晤，这体现了两位反对西方影响的独裁领导人之间的团结。

paras.en: The talks between the Chinese leader, Xi Jinping, and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia in the Chinese city of Shenzhen came a day ahead of their meeting with Mr. Trump — the first-ever three-way gathering of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia.
paras.zh: 中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京(Vladimir V. Putin)在中国深圳举行会谈，就在他们与特朗普会面的前一天，这是美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人的首次三方聚会。

paras.en: The trilateral summit is expected to cap Mr. Trump’s whirlwind trip to Asia, which has been shadowed by the Nvidia scandal, trade conflicts and critical infrastructure breakdowns at home.
paras.zh: 三边峰会预计将为特朗普旋风般的亚洲之行画上句号，此次亚洲之行因英伟达丑闻、贸易冲突和国内关键基础设施故障而蒙上阴影。

paras.en: Mr. Trump left Manila on Wednesday afternoon for Shenzhen, a center of China’s artificial intelligence and robotics industries, for a meeting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, a group of 21 member economies known as APEC. The ultramodern metropolis is almost spotless this week, its streets bedecked with pastel banners but mostly emptied of the crowds typical of many cities in China.
paras.zh: 周三下午，特朗普离开马尼拉前往中国人工智能和机器人产业中心深圳，参加亚太经济合作论坛(APEC) 会议，该论坛由 21 个成员经济体组成。本周，这座超现代化的大都市几乎一尘不染，街道上挂满了柔和的横幅，但基本上没有中国许多城市特有的人群。

paras.en: The APEC meeting, set to focus on digital trade, artificial intelligence and cross-border e-commerce, is expected to highlight how much economic ties along the Pacific Rim have been transformed since Mr. Trump first took office nearly a decade ago. The orthodoxy of free trade that once animated APEC has given way to Mr. Trump’s protectionist tariff policies as he attempts to unravel the move toward globalization of recent decades.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织会议将重点讨论数字贸易、人工智能和跨境电子商务，预计将凸显自特朗普近十年前首次上任以来环太平洋地区经济联系发生了多大变化。当特朗普试图瓦解近几十年来的全球化进程时，曾经为亚太经合组织注入活力的自由贸易正统观念已经让位于特朗普的保护主义关税政策。

paras.en: Even as Mr. Trump has been on the road, his administration was grappling with computer breakdowns involving the technology, airline and banking industries. On Wednesday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is traveling with the president, said there was no evidence that the failures were related. He said the rush to patch systems before they are hacked by new A.I. capabilities may be contributing to the failures.
paras.zh: 就在特朗普出差期间，他的政府仍在努力解决涉及科技、航空和银行业的计算机故障问题。周三，与总统同行的国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，没有证据表明这些故障之间存在关联。他说，在系统被新人工智能攻击之前急于修补系统。能力可能是导致失败的原因。

paras.en: For Mr. Trump, it will be his third personal encounter of the year with Mr. Xi. Mr. Trump visited Beijing in May, then hosted Mr. Xi for a lavish state dinner at the White House in September. Although Mr. Trump once regularly lashed out at China over its trade practices, this year he has become more intent on forging friendly ties between the world’s two largest economies.
paras.zh: 对特朗普来说，这将是他今年第三次与习近平会面。特朗普于 5 月访问了北京，随后于 9 月在白宫招待习近平举行了豪华国宴。尽管特朗普曾经经常批评中国的贸易行为，但今年他更加致力于在世界最大的两个经济体之间建立友好关系。

paras.en: The visit, however, may have a see-no-evil, hear-no-evil quality because Mr. Trump has said he does not intend to raise issues of Chinese interference in American affairs. Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was forced to resign following revelations about an extramarital affair with a businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence determined was spying for China, but Mr. Trump has said he will not discuss the matter with Mr. Xi.
paras.zh: 不过，这次访问可能具有非礼勿视、非礼勿听的性质，因为特朗普已表示，他无意提出中国干涉美国事务的问题。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因与一名女商人的婚外情被曝光而被迫辞职，美国情报部门认定该女商人为中国从事间谍活动，但特朗普表示，他不会与习近平讨论此事。

paras.en: That follows a pattern of Mr. Trump avoiding direct confrontation with his Chinese counterpart over questions involving American security. Even after he made a prime-time address to the nation in July accusing China of hacking or purchasing U.S. voting files, he did not raise the matter in public when he hosted Mr. Xi in September, nor is he expected to this week.
paras.zh: 这遵循了特朗普避免在涉及美国安全的问题上与中国同行直接对抗的模式。即使他7月在黄金时段向全国发表讲话，指责中国窃取或购买美国投票文件，但他在9月接待习近平时并没有公开提及此事，预计本周也不会这样做。

paras.en: - Manila stop: Mr. Trump’s China visit will be the second stop on a lightning-fast trip to Asia. He stopped first in Manila, where he joined a meeting of another international group, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, or ASEAN.
paras.zh: - 马尼拉站：特朗普先生的中国之行将是他闪电般的亚洲之行的第二站。他首先在马尼拉停留，在那里参加了另一个国际组织东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）的会议。

paras.en: - North Korea: Mr. Putin could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit, Russian state news agencies reported, citing the Kremlin’s spokesman. It was not clear whether Mr. Kim would attend the summit.
paras.zh: - 朝鲜：俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人的话说，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩也前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，普京可能会见金正恩。目前尚不清楚金正恩是否会出席峰会。

paras.en: - Ukraine: Mr. Trump also said he would talk about Ukraine, on which Mr. Putin’s aides are engaging in talks with the U.S. and Ukrainian officials, but also renewing demands that NATO pull back its troops to where they were before the alliance expanded toward Russia.
paras.zh: - 乌克兰：特朗普还表示，他将谈论乌克兰问题，普京的助手正在与美国和乌克兰官员就乌克兰问题进行会谈，但他还再次要求北约将其部队撤回到该联盟向俄罗斯扩张之前的位置。

paras.en: China warned on Tuesday that it could hit back if the Trump administration restricts China’s access to advanced A.I. chips, previewing what experts said is likely to be a central point of economic contention between Xi and Trump when they meet.
paras.zh: 中国周二警告称，如果特朗普政府限制中国获得先进人工智能，中国可能会予以反击。芯片，预览专家所说的可能是习近平和特朗普会面时经济争论的中心点。

paras.en: Shortly before Trump’s Asia trip, his administration proposed a rule that would limit China’s access to advanced chips through data centers outside its borders. China’s ministry of commerce said the rule went against the terms that China and the United States had agreed to in a fragile truce that expires in two months. “If the US persists, China will take countermeasures,” a spokesman for the ministry said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在特朗普亚洲之行前不久，他的政府提出了一项规则，限制中国通过境外数据中心获取先进芯片。中国商务部表示，这一规定违反了中美两国在两个月后到期的脆弱休战协议中商定的条款。 “如果美方一意孤行，中方将采取反制措施，”中国外交部发言人周二表示。

paras.en: In a sign of Putin’s importance to Xi, the Russian leader was greeted at the airport in Shenzhen on Wednesday by Cai Qi, one of the seven members of the elite Politburo Standing Committee. That appears to make Cai the highest-ranking official to greet a foreign leader at APEC so far ahead of Trump’s arrival, according to a review of Chinese state media.
paras.zh: 周三，俄罗斯领导人在深圳机场受到了政治局常委七名成员之一的蔡奇的迎接，这表明了普京对习近平的重要性。据中国官方媒体报道，这似乎使蔡成为迄今为止在特朗普抵达之前在亚太经合组织迎接外国领导人的最高级别官员。

paras.en: Cai is considered one of the most influential figures in Xi’s inner circle, having served as a deputy to the Chinese leader when he was a provincial official. He accompanied Xi to Washington in September.
paras.zh: 蔡被认为是习近平核心圈子中最有影响力的人物之一，在担任省级官员时曾担任中国领导人的副手。 9月，他陪同习近平访问华盛顿。

paras.en: This is not the first time Cai has welcomed a foreign leader on the tarmac. Last year, he and Wang Yi, China’s top diplomat, greeted North Korea’s Kim Jong-un when he landed in Beijing.
paras.zh: 这并不是蔡第一次在停机坪上欢迎外国领导人。去年，当朝鲜领导人金正恩抵达北京时，他和中国最高外交官王毅进行了会面。

paras.en: Putin and Xi are expected to tour the campus that Moscow State University, Russia’s top university, set up in Shenzhen with the Beijing Institute of Technology. The leaders agreed to establish it a decade ago. The Shenzhen outpost looks like a mini version of the Moscow university, complete with a replica of its Stalin-era tower.
paras.zh: 普京和习近平预计将参观俄罗斯顶尖大学莫斯科国立大学与北京理工大学在深圳设立的校园。领导人十年前就同意建立它。深圳前哨站看起来就像莫斯科大学的迷你版，配有斯大林时代塔楼的复制品。

paras.en: Putin and his team held talks with Xi followed by a smaller working breakfast. They have met dozens of times; this is at least their fourth in-person meeting this year. The talks lasted more than two hours, according to the Russian state news agency Tass.
paras.zh: 普京及其团队与习近平举行了会谈，随后举行了小型工作早餐会。他们已经见过几十次面了；这至少是他们今年第四次面对面的会议。据俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道，会谈持续了两个多小时。

paras.en: By meeting before Trump arrives in China, Xi and Putin will have an opportunity to set some of the terms of the historic meeting between the three leaders, which is scheduled for Thursday.
paras.zh: 通过在特朗普抵达中国之前举行会晤，习近平和普京将有机会确定三位领导人定于周四举行的历史性会晤的一些条款。

paras.en: Xi and Putin will likely want to align on nuclear arms control, a topic that Trump has said he is eager to discuss. Xi is reluctant to broach the subject, unwilling to place limits on China’s arsenal because it remains much smaller than those of the United States and Russia.
paras.zh: 习近平和普京可能希望在核军备控制问题上保持一致，特朗普曾表示他渴望讨论这个话题。习近平不愿提及这个话题，也不愿意限制中国的核武库，因为中国的核武库仍然比美国和俄罗斯小得多。

paras.en: Putin arrived in Shenzhen alongside a major show of force. Russian strategic nuclear bombers landed in Vietnam close to when Putin landed in China, according to satellite footage, marking the first publicly documented arrival of such warplanes in Vietnam since the Soviet era.
paras.zh: 普京抵达深圳并进行了大规模武力展示。卫星镜头显示，俄罗斯战略核轰炸机在普京登陆中国的时间附近降落在越南，这是自苏联时代以来首次有公开记录的此类战机抵达越南。

paras.en: Russia and Vietnam have deep ties dating back to the Soviet era, and Russia supplies much of Vietnam’s military hardware. But Vietnam has also deepened ties with the United States in recent years, as it looks to bolster its defenses amid concern about China.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和越南的深厚联系可以追溯到苏联时代，俄罗斯为越南提供大部分军事装备。但近年来，越南也加深了与美国的关系，因为出于对中国的担忧，越南希望加强防御。

paras.en: Putin’s decision to deploy the nuclear bombers to Vietnam alongside his arrival in China sends a clear message ahead of the trilateral talks with the United States and China: Russia remains the world’s largest nuclear power and has global reach.
paras.zh: 普京决定在抵达中国的同时向越南部署核轰炸机，这在与美国和中国的三边会谈之前发出了一个明确的信息：俄罗斯仍然是世界上最大的核国家，并具有全球影响力。

paras.en: Shenzhen is remarkably calm despite all the world leaders descending on the city. When Putin arrived at the airport early Wednesday morning, he was greeted by a Chinese group waving Russian flags and pom-poms. He is expected to meet with Xi today as well as Thai and Vietnamese leaders.
paras.zh: 尽管世界各国领导人齐聚深圳，但深圳却异常平静。当普京周三清晨抵达机场时，一群挥舞着俄罗斯国旗和绒球的中国团体迎接他。预计他今天将与习近平以及泰国和越南领导人会面。

paras.en: World leaders coming to Shenzhen this week are arriving in an almost spotless, ultramodern metropolis, its streets bedecked with pastel banners but mostly emptied of the crowds typical of many Chinese cities.
paras.zh: 本周来到深圳的世界领导人来到了这座几乎一尘不染的超现代化大都市，街道上挂满了柔和的横幅，但大多空无一人，这是许多中国城市特有的人群。

paras.en: Shenzhen lies slightly closer to the Equator than Havana, providing a balmy venue for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation gathering. Under sunny skies with mild temperatures, a festive mood prevails in the city, which bears a strong resemblance to Miami — only much larger and with taller, newer high-rises.
paras.zh: 深圳比哈瓦那距离赤道稍近，为亚太经合组织会议提供了一个温暖的场地。晴朗的天空和温和的气温，这座城市弥漫着节日气氛，它与迈阿密非常相似——只是面积更大，高层建筑更高、更新。

paras.en: Schools in Shenzhen have closed this week, many residents have left town and local authorities have instructed companies to allow those employees who are still here to work from home. The result has been a holiday atmosphere of sorts in a city with a tech sector known for its punishing “996” work schedules: 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week.
paras.zh: 深圳的学校本周已关闭，许多居民已离开城镇，地方当局已指示公司允许仍在深圳的员工在家工作。其结果是，这座科技行业以严酷的“996”工作时间（每周六天，上午 9 点至晚上 9 点）而闻名的城市，营造出了一种度假氛围。

paras.en: Youthful volunteers — mainly students at local universities — stand on street corners wearing bright red vests, having been offered academic credit in exchange for being trained as guides. Thousands of gawkers have been promenading past the large conference center that will host heads of state from across the Asia Pacific region, taking photos of themselves in front of the flower gardens inside the fence.
paras.zh: 年轻的志愿者——主要是当地大学的学生——穿着鲜红色背心站在街角，接受导游培训，以换取学分。数千名围观者走过将接待亚太地区国家元首的大型会议中心，在围墙内的花园前拍照留念。

paras.en: Among the crowds walking outside the high steel fences around the conference center was a local resident who had brought her parents and her dog. The resident said that workers had been planting flowers for a year ahead of the summit, and added that a community worker had given her a big package of napkins as a gift after she agreed not to drive her car in the coming week. Shenzhen has halved fares this week on its extensive subway system to help clear the roads for summit buses.
paras.zh: 在会议中心周围高高的钢栅栏外行走的人群中，有一位当地居民带着她的父母和她的狗。这位居民说，在峰会之前，工作人员已经在种花一年了，并补充说，在她同意下周不再开车后，一名社区工作人员送给她一大包餐巾纸作为礼物。深圳本周将其广泛的地铁系统票价减半，以帮助为峰会巴士清理道路。

paras.en: At the same time, however, residents are aware of occasional hassles. “Many friends who live around here plan to travel outside the city because of the inconvenience of transportation — many roads will be closed to traffic,” said the resident, who gave only her family name, Zhang. As is common at high-profile and high-security events in China, she was wary of giving her full name, which can be risky for Chinese citizens.
paras.zh: 但与此同时，居民们也意识到偶尔会出现一些麻烦。 “很多住在这附近的朋友都打算出城旅游，因为交通不方便，很多路都会封路。”这位只透露姓张的居民说。正如在中国备受瞩目和高度安全的活动中常见的那样，她对透露自己的全名持谨慎态度，这对中国公民来说可能存在风险。

paras.en: Few dare to express any misgivings, however, accepting the disruption with resignation. “Even if we’re unhappy about it, we can’t really say so,” said a resident surnamed Wang. “The government wouldn’t welcome our dissatisfaction.”
paras.zh: 然而，很少有人敢于表达任何疑虑，只能无奈地接受这种干扰。 “即使我们心里不高兴，但也不能直接说出来。”王姓居民说。 “政府不会欢迎我们的不满。”

paras.en: While gatherings of world leaders always prompt extensive security, China’s efforts in Shenzhen are particularly intensive. Surveillance cameras are ubiquitous along streets in China and not noticeably more common this week in Shenzhen, but there are other, unobtrusive signs of the elaborate security effort underway.
paras.zh: 虽然世界领导人的聚会总是需要广泛的安全保障，但中国在深圳的努力尤其密集。监控摄像头在中国的街道上随处可见，本周在深圳也没有明显增加，但还有其他不引人注目的迹象表明正在采取精心的安全措施。

paras.en: Xiangmei Road, located near the main summit venue and lined with some of China’s costliest condominium towers, was much quieter than usual on Monday. A cleaner outside one of the towers who gave only her family name, Li, said that the family employing her has simply left town this week.
paras.zh: 香梅路位于峰会主会场附近，两旁是中国一些最昂贵的公寓楼，周一比平时安静得多。其中一座塔楼外的一名只透露姓李的清洁工表示，雇用她的家庭本周刚刚离开了这座城市。

paras.en: Police have been stationed in apartments on upper floors facing the conference center, drones have been prohibited and the remaining residents have received social media messages urging them to support the gathering, Ms. Li said.
paras.zh: 李女士说，会议中心对面的高层公寓里驻扎了警察，禁止使用无人机，其余居民也收到了社交媒体信息，敦促他们支持这次集会。

paras.en: “This place is usually very crowded,” she said, “but look how quiet it is now.”
paras.zh: “这个地方平时很拥挤，”她说，“但看看现在多安静。”

paras.en: Ruoxin Zhang and Siyi Zhao contributed research.
paras.zh: 张若新和赵思怡做出了研究贡献。

paras.en: While President Trump and President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr of the Philippines met in Manila, President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia was speaking to business leaders in Shenzhen, China, at the APEC CEO summit. Putin said his coming meeting with Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping had “great potential benefits.”
paras.zh: 当特朗普总统和菲律宾总统小费迪南德·R·马科斯在马尼拉会面时，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京正在中国深圳的亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上与商界领袖发表讲话。普京表示，他即将与特朗普和中国领导人习近平的会面具有“巨大的潜在好处”。

paras.en: When China’s then-paramount leader, Deng Xiaoping, toured Shenzhen in 1992, he used the southern Chinese city to signal an embrace of open markets, setting off decades of rapid growth that would make his country the world’s factory floor.
paras.zh: 1992年，当时的中国最高领导人邓小平视察深圳，他用这座中国南方城市发出了拥抱开放市场的信号，开启了数十年的快速增长，使中国成为世界工厂。

paras.en: Since then, Shenzhen has grown from a sleepy town into a gleaming metropolis that dwarfs its more established neighbor, Hong Kong. Apple’s main assembler, Foxconn, runs a sprawling campus there, and Walmart manages its China business from the city. It is home to many Chinese brands like Huawei, BYD and the drone maker DJI.
paras.zh: 从那时起，深圳从一个沉睡的小镇发展成为一个闪闪发光的大都市，令其更成熟的邻国香港相形见绌。苹果的主要组装商富士康在那里运营着一个庞大的园区，沃尔玛则在该市管理其中国业务。它是华为、比亚迪和无人机制造商大疆等许多中国品牌的所在地。

paras.en: This week, China’s leader, Xi Jinping, is hosting a regional economic summit in the same city, using it to make the case that China’s growth can benefit the world. Shenzhen has been primped for the occasion, with bus shelters plastered with the slogan: “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together.”
paras.zh: 本周，中国领导人习近平将在同一城市举办区域经济峰会，借此证明中国的增长可以造福世界。深圳已为这一盛事做好了准备，公交候车亭贴满了口号：“构建亚太共同体，共同繁荣”。

paras.en: But some of that message may be difficult to square for many of China’s trading partners. To them, Shenzhen also embodies much of what makes the world uneasy about China today: a flood of cheap exports; tech giants that pose security risks; and a Communist Party that has traded Mr. Deng’s freewheeling experimentation for more state control.
paras.zh: 但其中一些信息可能很难被中国的许多贸易伙伴接受。对他们来说，深圳也体现了当今世界对中国感到不安的许多因素：大量廉价出口产品；带来安全风险的科技巨头；共产党用邓小平的随心所欲的实验换取了更多的国家控制。

paras.en: Mr. Xi’s moment in the spotlight at the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum will also be clouded by allegations of a Chinese spy scandal at the American chip giant, Nvidia, that has already prompted Washington to tighten Chinese access to advanced American chips.
paras.zh: 习近平在亚太经济合作论坛上成为众人瞩目的时刻，也将因美国芯片巨头英伟达(Nvidia)的中国间谍丑闻的指控而蒙上阴影，该丑闻已经促使华盛顿收紧中国对美国先进芯片的准入。

paras.en: And he is set to meet for the first time with President Trump and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, a gathering that could unsettle smaller powers like Ukraine. (Mr. Trump has also suggested that he might see the North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un while in China.)
paras.zh: 他还将首次与特朗普总统和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京会面，这次聚会可能会让乌克兰等小国感到不安。 （特朗普先生还表示，他可能会在中国会见朝鲜独裁者金正恩。）

paras.en: Here’s what is on China’s agenda when Mr. Xi takes center stage in Shenzhen:
paras.zh: 当习近平在深圳登上舞台中心时，中国的议程如下：

paras.en: In some ways, the setting itself could be read as a statement of defiance.
paras.zh: 在某些方面，这个场景本身可以被解读为一种反抗的声明。

paras.en: Shenzhen is home to companies Washington has labeled national security risks, like Huawei and ZTE, as well as Chinese artificial intelligence labs racing to close the gap with American rivals. Many of the companies have been subjected to American sanctions and blacklists.
paras.zh: 深圳是华为和中兴等被华盛顿列为国家安全风险的公司的所在地，也是竞相缩小与美国竞争对手差距的中国人工智能实验室的所在地。许多公司都受到了美国的制裁和黑名单。

paras.en: Mr. Xi wants to show that “China can do well despite America’s all-out effort to kill it” with those trade restrictions, said Minxin Pei, a professor at Claremont McKenna College who studies Chinese leadership politics.
paras.zh: 研究中国领导层政治的克莱蒙特·麦肯纳学院教授裴敏欣表示，习近平希望表明，“尽管美国竭尽全力通过这些贸易限制来扼杀中国，但中国仍然可以做得很好”。

paras.en: That is an image that Beijing has tried to cultivate after Washington began restricting direct sales of advanced chips to China in 2022, pointing to Huawei’s homegrown processors and DeepSeek’s and other Chinese labs’ breakthrough A.I. models as proof that U.S. restrictions have failed.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿于 2022 年开始限制向中国直接销售先进芯片后，北京试图塑造这样的形象，并指出华为的国产处理器以及 DeepSeek 和其他中国实验室的突破性人工智能技术。模型作为美国限制措施失败的证据。

paras.en: Beijing is also casting itself as a partner to other countries in technological advancement, offering Chinese cooperation and know-how on A.I., an approach that competes with the United States’ attempts to unite partners around A.I. supply chains independent of China.
paras.zh: 北京还把自己打造成其他国家在技术进步方面的合作伙伴，提供中国在人工智能方面的合作和专业知识，这种做法与美国围绕人工智能团结合作伙伴的做法形成了竞争。供应链独立于中国。

paras.en: For China, the news had threatened to distract from the upcoming summit. Less than three weeks before the gathering, The New York Times reported that a Chinese businesswoman who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, was found to be passing intelligence to Beijing. In the days since, Mr. Huang has stepped down and the company’s board has said it would conduct an investigation.
paras.zh: 对于中国来说，这一消息可能会分散人们对即将举行的峰会的注意力。聚会前不到三周，《纽约时报》报道称，一名与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人被发现向北京传递情报。此后几天，黄先生辞职，公司董事会表示将进行调查。

paras.en: The allegations, which China has denied, could have scuttled talks with Mr. Trump and put the countries’ fragile trade truce at risk. The claim of such a bold espionage plot was also a potential source of embarrassment for a country hosting business and government leaders at a major event.
paras.zh: 中国否认的这些指控可能会破坏与特朗普的谈判，并使两国脆弱的贸易休战面临风险。对于一个在重大活动中接待企业和政府领导人的国家来说，如此大胆的间谍阴谋的指控也是一个潜在的尴尬来源。

paras.en: China has carried on as if it were business as usual. And in a way, Beijing has already scored a win: The controversy has failed to derail the scheduled talks between Mr. Xi and Mr. Trump, who has downplayed the alleged spy plot.
paras.zh: 中国一切如常。从某种程度上来说，北京已经取得了胜利：这场争议未能破坏习近平和特朗普之间预定的会谈，特朗普淡化了所谓的间谍阴谋。

paras.en: Rather than declaring that he would confront China about the Nvidia scandal, Mr. Trump has said he does not intend to bring it up. “I don’t think you want to insult China just before you get there,” he told reporters outside the White House on Monday when asked about divisions within his administration about how tough to be on China.
paras.zh: 特朗普没有宣称他将就英伟达丑闻与中国对峙，而是表示他不打算提起此事。当被问及他的政府内部关于对中国有多强硬的分歧时，他周一在白宫外对记者说：“我认为你不想在到达那里之前侮辱中国。”

paras.en: But the scandal is already costing China. On Monday, the Trump administration issued a rule to stop Chinese companies from accessing advanced Nvidia chips through data centers in third countries, and to require licenses for chip exports to companies in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil.
paras.zh: 但这一丑闻已经让中国付出了代价。周一，特朗​​普政府发布了一项规则，禁止中国公司通过第三国的数据中心获取先进的英伟达芯片，并要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西的公司出口芯片需要许可证。

paras.en: China’s export machinery is practically unbeatable. This month, China reported that its exports exceeded its imports by more than $1 trillion in the first 10 months of this year, putting it on track to eclipse last year’s record.
paras.zh: 中国的出口机械几乎是无与伦比的。本月，中国报告称，今年前 10 个月，其出口额超过进口额超过 1 万亿美元，有望超越去年的纪录。

paras.en: But as its factories have churned out solar panels, electric cars and other goods for consumers globally, China has faced pushback not only from the United States but from around the world. It needs to head off efforts by trading partners like the European Union to block its exports.
paras.zh: 但随着中国工厂为全球消费者生产太阳能电池板、电动汽车和其他商品，中国不仅面临来自美国的抵制，还面临来自世界各地的抵制。它需要阻止欧盟等贸易伙伴阻止其出口的努力。

paras.en: That’s why China is billing the event as an opportunity for the region to champion free trade and oppose protectionism.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么中国将此次活动视为该地区倡导自由贸易、反对保护主义的机会。

paras.en: In reality, China has been turning inward. Beijing has sought to squeeze out foreign technology, electronics and auto brands in favor of Chinese firms. The Communist Party, which under Mr. Xi has tightened its grip on the economy, vowed last month to expand its presence inside internet companies. Shen Weizhong, a former policy planner with China’s Foreign Ministry, called the approach “manageable openness,” in which security weighs as heavily as growth.
paras.zh: 事实上，中国一直在转向内向。北京一直试图排挤外国技术、电子和汽车品牌，转而支持中国企业。在习近平的领导下，共产党加强了对经济的控制，上个月誓言要扩大其在互联网公司内部的影响力。中国外交部前政策规划师沉伟忠称这种做法是“可控的开放”，其中安全与增长同等重要。

paras.en: Mr. Xi’s willingness to turn the world’s dependence on Chinese goods into leverage has also alienated other countries.
paras.zh: 习近平愿意将世界对中国商品的依赖转化为杠杆，这也疏远了其他国家。

paras.en: Beijing imposed controls on exports of rare earths last year, and it has recently moved to restrict the exports of dozens of technologies, including drones, artificial intelligence models and agents, and know-how about advanced medicines and solar panels. China says these measures are a response to U.S. blacklists and export restrictions.
paras.zh: 北京去年对稀土出口实施了控制，最近又限制了数十项技术的出口，包括无人机、人工智能模型和代理，以及先进药物和太阳能电池板的专有技术。中国表示，这些措施是对美国黑名单和出口限制的回应。

paras.en: “Chinese leaders recognize that the golden era of globalization is over, and geoeconomic competition has become the new normal,” said Yuen Yuen Ang, a professor of political economy at Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学政治经济学教授洪元元表示：“中国领导人认识到全球化的黄金时代已经结束，地缘经济竞争已成为新常态。”

paras.en: Mr. Xi is expected to sit down with Mr. Trump and Mr. Putin on Thursday, a meeting that is without precedent. China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday called the meeting one “of groundbreaking significance.”
paras.zh: 预计习近平将于周四与特朗普和普京坐下来，这次会面史无前例。中国外交部周一称这次会议“具有开创性意义”。

paras.en: For Beijing, the gathering casts China as a power broker that can bring Washington and Moscow to the same table. Mr. Xi wants to show the world, and especially his own people, that China under his leadership is “consequential, influential and highly respected, with enormous convening power,” said Mr. Pei of Claremont McKenna.
paras.zh: 对于北京来说，这次聚会将中国视为一个可以让华盛顿和莫斯科坐在同一张桌子上的权力掮客。克莱蒙特麦肯纳公司的贝聿铭表示，习近平希望向世界，特别是向他自己的人民展示，在他领导下的中国“具有影响力、影响力和高度尊重，拥有巨大的号召力”。

paras.en: Mr. Trump said on Monday that he planned to discuss the war in Ukraine in Shenzhen. Beijing is reluctant to take the lead on peace talks, said Zhao Long, a senior research fellow at the Shanghai Institutes for International Studies, lest it create “the wrong impression” that “major powers are dividing up the interests of other countries.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周一表示，他计划在深圳讨论乌克兰战争。上海国际问题研究院高级研究员赵龙表示，北京不愿主导和谈，以免给人留下“大国正在瓜分其他国家利益”的“错误印象”。

paras.en: And Mr. Trump has raised the possibility of another guest: the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong-un. He told reporters on Monday as he left the White House: “And we may meet with Kim Jong Un, also. So, that’ll be good. We could — we have a chance to accomplish a lot.”
paras.zh: 特朗普还提出了另一位客人的可能性：朝鲜独裁者金正恩。周一，他在离开白宫时告诉记者：“我们也可能会见金正恩。所以，那很好。我们可以——我们有机会取得很多成就。”

paras.en: A spokesman for China’s foreign ministry, Guo Jiakun, asked on Tuesday if Mr. Kim would be attending, said: “I do not have information on this.” Russian state news agencies reported that Mr. Putin could meet with Mr. Kim if the North Korean leader travels to China, citing Dmitri S. Peskov, the Kremlin’s spokesman.
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人郭家坤周二在被问及金正恩是否出席时表示：“我没有这方面的信息。”俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·S·佩斯科夫(Dmitri S. Peskov)的话说，如果朝鲜领导人访问中国，普京可能会会见金正恩。

paras.en: Berry Wang, Keith Bradsher, Ruoxin Zhang and Siyi Zhao contributed reporting and research.
paras.zh: Berry Wang、Keith Bradsher、张若新和赵思怡贡献了报告和研究。

paras.en: When China’s leader, Xi Jinping, met with President Trump at the White House earlier this fall, the two leaders toasted to friendly relations.
paras.zh: 今年秋天早些时候，当中国领导人习近平在白宫会见特朗普总统时，两国领导人为友好关系干杯。

paras.en: But in private, Mr. Xi offered Mr. Trump a stark warning about Japan, a U.S. ally, according to two officials briefed on the talks, who requested anonymity to discuss private conversations. Mr. Xi told Mr. Trump that Japan’s recent military buildup threatened to destabilize Asia, the officials said, and that Mr. Trump should be cautious about working with Japan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, describing her as a “militarist.”
paras.zh: 但据两名了解此次会谈情况的官员透露，习近平在私下向特朗普提出了有关美国盟友日本的严厉警告。这两位官员要求匿名讨论私人谈话。官员们表示，习近平告诉特朗普，日本最近的军事集结可能会破坏亚洲的稳定，特朗普在与日本首相高市早苗合作时应谨慎行事，并将她描述为“军国主义者”。

paras.en: The warning from Mr. Xi was part of a broader effort by China to isolate and undermine Japan after Ms. Takaichi said last year that Japan could be forced to defend Taiwan in case of a Chinese invasion. China considers Taiwan, a self-governed democracy that lies just 69 miles from Japan’s westernmost island, part of its territory.
paras.zh: 习近平的警告是中国孤立和削弱日本的更广泛努力的一部分，此前高市女士去年表示，如果中国入侵，日本可能被迫保卫台湾。中国认为距离日本最西端岛屿仅 69 英里的自治民主国家台湾是其领土的一部分。

paras.en: Since the comments, Mr. Xi has overseen a campaign involving propaganda and diplomacy to target Japan, according to interviews with officials and scholars, and an analysis by The New York Times of Chinese Foreign Ministry briefings and state media. It is all part of a push, analysts say, to persuade the world that Japan is a resurgent aggressor.
paras.zh: 根据对官员和学者的采访以及《纽约时报》对中国外交部简报和官方媒体的分析，自发表上述言论以来，习近平一直在监督针对日本的宣传和外交活动。分析人士表示，这一切都是为了让世界相信日本是一个卷土重来的侵略者。

paras.en: - China has deployed words and images to portray Japan as a World War II-era enemy, using phrases like “remilitarization” and “neo-militarism,” and videos that compare Japan to a “rampaging gray rhino.”
paras.zh: - 中国使用“重新军事化”和“新军国主义”等措辞和视频，利用文字和图像将日本描绘成二战时期的敌人，并在视频中将日本比作“狂暴的灰犀牛”。

paras.en: - Chinese officials have repeatedly sought to belittle Ms. Takaichi, Japan’s first female prime minister, omitting her title in official briefings, breaking with longstanding practice. State media has depicted Ms. Takaichi in short skirts and a nurse’s uniform in cartoons, and described her as “Abe’s girl,” referring to Shinzo Abe, the former Japanese prime minister and Ms. Takaichi’s mentor.
paras.zh: - 中国官员一再试图贬低日本首位女首相高市女士，在官方通报中省略了她的头衔，这打破了长期以来的惯例。官方媒体用漫画描绘高市女士穿着短裙和护士服，并将她描述为“安倍的女儿”，指的是日本前首相、高市女士的导师安倍晋三。

paras.en: - In private conversations with Western scholars, Chinese academics have recently pushed the narrative that Japan is the “Israel of East Asia,” poised to lead the United States into conflict and destabilize the region.
paras.zh: - 在与西方学者的私下对话中，中国学者最近提出日本是“东亚的以色列”的说法，准备带领美国陷入冲突并破坏该地区的稳定。

paras.en: - Russia has helped amplify China’s talking points, branding Japan as a threat. Moscow has echoed Beijing in describing Japan as an “enemy state” that is not to be trusted, invoking a World War II-era designation used against former Axis powers.
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯帮助放大了中国的论点，将日本视为威胁。莫斯科呼应北京的说法，将日本描述为一个不可信任的“敌国”，援引了二战时期针对前轴心国的称呼。

paras.en: Mr. Xi and Ms. Takaichi will cross paths this week at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit meeting in Shenzhen, China. The encounter is expected to be frosty; Mr. Xi might try to use the summit as an opportunity to alienate Ms. Takaichi from Japan’s allies, experts say.
paras.zh: 习近平和高市女士将于本周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会上相遇。预计这次遭遇会是冷冰冰的；专家表示，习近平可能会试图利用这次峰会作为疏远高市女士与日本盟友的机会。

paras.en: The analysis covered Chinese state-run and Communist Party-run outlets, including China Central Television, the Xinhua news agency, Global Times and People’s Liberation Army Daily.
paras.zh: 该分析涵盖了中国国有和共产党的媒体，包括中央电视台、新华社、环球时报和解放军报。

paras.en: China has long been at odds with Japan. But the current scale and coordination of its campaign have little modern precedent, experts said.
paras.zh: 中国与日本长期不和。但专家表示，目前其活动的规模和协调几乎没有现代先例。

paras.en: “Anti-Japan propaganda is just absolutely everywhere now,” said David Bandurski, executive director of the China Media Project, an independent research group. “It’s a far more focused use of anti-Japanese framing than we’ve seen at any point.”
paras.zh: “反日宣传现在绝对无处不在，”独立研究机构中国媒体项目执行董事戴维·班志远 (David Bandurski) 表示。 “这是对反日框架的集中使用，比我们在任何时候都见过。”

paras.en: Ms. Takaichi told Japan’s Parliament on Nov. 7, 2025, that any attempt by China to blockade or seize Taiwan could constitute a “survival-threatening situation” for Japan, implying a potential military response. Her comments reflected a long-held Japanese view, but one that has rarely been verbalized.
paras.zh: 高市女士于 2025 年 11 月 7 日向日本国会表示，中国封锁或占领台湾的任何企图都可能对日本构成“威胁生存的局面”，这意味着可能会采取军事回应。她的评论反映了日本人长期以来的观点，但很少被口头表达出来。

paras.en: China reacted furiously. The government urged millions of tourists to avoid Japan, limited the export of some critical minerals, restricted Japanese seafood imports and increased patrols in disputed waters.
paras.zh: 中国反应强烈。政府敦促数百万游客避开日本，限制一些关键矿物的出口，限制日本海鲜进口，并增加在争议水域的巡逻。

paras.en: Mr. Xi appears to be concerned that Ms. Takaichi, a close American ally who has been a critic of China, could get in the way of China’s military and economic expansion in Asia. Analysts said that he is seeking to drive a wedge between Japan and the United States, as well as countries like Australia, South Korea, India and Britain.
paras.zh: 习近平似乎担心，一直批评中国的美国亲密盟友高市可能会阻碍中国在亚洲的军事和经济扩张。分析人士表示，他正在寻求离间日本和美国以及澳大利亚、韩国、印度和英国等国家之间的关系。

paras.en: Ms. Takaichi has accelerated a military buildup to counter China, raising military spending to 2 percent of gross domestic product two years ahead of schedule and loosening postwar rules that restricted the export of weapons. She is expected to push for even more military spending next month as part of a new national security strategy.
paras.zh: 高市女士加速了军备建设以对抗中国，提前两年将军费开支提高到国内生产总值的2%，并放宽了战后限制武器出口的规定。预计她将在下个月推动增加军费开支，作为新国家安全战略的一部分。

paras.en: In the year since Ms. Takaichi’s comments on Taiwan, China has sharply escalated its rhetorical attacks on Japan, according to the Times’s analysis, and there has been a surge in propaganda aimed at both domestic and global audiences.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》分析，自高市女士对台湾发表评论以来，中国急剧升级了对日本的言论攻击，针对国内和全球受众的宣传也大幅增加。

paras.en: Since last November, the Chinese Foreign Ministry has publicly accused Tokyo of “remilitarization” or “neo-militarism” at more than 60 briefings, the analysis found. People’s Daily, the Communist Party mouthpiece, cited Japanese “neo-militarism” in 65 articles, and warnings of Japanese “militarism” surged across the outlets we analyzed.
paras.zh: 分析发现，自去年11月以来，中国外交部在60多次通报会上公开指责东京“重新军事化”或“新军国主义”。共产党喉舌《人民日报》在 65 篇文章中引用了日本的“新军国主义”，我们分析的各媒体对日本“军国主义”的警告激增。

paras.en: Chinese officials have repeatedly invoked the image of a “gray rhino,” a phrase used in Chinese to describe a looming threat, to characterize Japan. One video that circulated on Chinese news sites, generated by artificial intelligence, shows a rhino, draped in a rising sun flag, wreaking havoc across land and sea.
paras.zh: 中国官员多次援引“灰犀牛”的形象来形容日本。“灰犀牛”在中文中用来描述迫在眉睫的威胁。中国新闻网站上流传的一段由人工智能生成的视频显示，一头披着旭日旗的犀牛正在陆地和海洋上造成严重破坏。

paras.en: China Daily, a state-controlled news organization aimed at an international audience, published a cartoon in May showing Ms. Takaichi dressed in samurai armor and carrying a sword. A People’s Daily cartoon describes Japan’s military ambitions as “sugarcoated poison,” showing Ms. Takaichi wrapping skulls to give to children.
paras.zh: 面向国际受众的国家控制新闻机构《中国日报》5月份发表了一幅漫画，展示高市女士身着武士盔甲、手持剑。 《人民日报》的一幅漫画将日本的军事野心描述为“糖衣毒药”，画中高市女士包裹着头骨送给孩子们。

paras.en: The Times parsed more than 20,000 transcripts from the Chinese Foreign Ministry’s briefings since 2013; nearly 400,000 articles in People’s Daily; more than 100,000 items from Guangming Daily, P.L.A. Daily, Global Times and Xinhua; and thousands of published readouts of Chinese leaders’ meetings, state broadcasts, ministry releases and social media trends.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》解析了2013年以来中国外交部通报的2万多份文字记录；人民日报近40万篇文章；光明日报、解放军10万余条信息日报、环球时报、新华社；以及数以千计的中国领导人会议、国家广播、部委发布和社交媒体趋势的公开报道。

paras.en: The analysis found that Chinese media has helped amplify official messaging. When interest in China’s feud with Japan faded from April to June and questions from foreign news outlets fell, reporters from state-controlled media in China tried to keep the story alive by asking about Japan at a far higher rate than before.
paras.zh: 分析发现，中国媒体帮助放大了官方信息。从四月到六月，当人们对中日不和的兴趣逐渐消退，外国新闻媒体的提问也减少时，中国官方媒体的记者试图以比以前高得多的频率询问有关日本的问题，以维持故事的活力。

paras.en: In December, a TV reporter from Shenzhen noted that scholars across the region were warning of Japan’s “remilitarization,” prompting a spokesman for the Chinese Foreign Ministry to answer with a list of Japan’s wartime atrocities. In August, on the anniversary of the bombing of Hiroshima, a Xinhua reporter said at a news briefing that “81 years later, Japan’s right-wing forces are stirring, plotting to restore militarism.”
paras.zh: 去年12月，深圳电视台记者指出，该地区的学者对日本的“重新军事化”发出警告，促使中国外交部发言人列出日本战时暴行的清单来回应。今年8月，广岛原子弹爆炸周年纪念日，新华社记者在新闻发布会上表示，“81年后，日本右翼势力蠢蠢欲动，密谋复辟军国主义”。

paras.en: The propaganda has sometimes spilled into the policy arena. When China’s Commerce Ministry placed 80 Japanese industrial, defense and research listings on export control blacklists and watch lists this year, a stated goal was to curb “remilitarization” and “neo-militarism.”
paras.zh: 宣传有时会蔓延到政策领域。今年，中国商务部将 80 个日本工业、国防和研究企业列入出口管制黑名单和观察名单，明确目标是遏制“再军事化”和“新军国主义”。

paras.en: Mr. Xi’s government has made a point of singling out Ms. Takaichi. A year after taking office, she is still relatively popular at home and has been a vocal supporter of Taiwan throughout her career. She has also built a warm relationship with Mr. Trump.
paras.zh: 习近平政府特意点名了高市女士。上任一年后，她在国内仍然比较受欢迎，并且在整个职业生涯中一直是台湾的坚定支持者。她还与特朗普先生建立了友好的关系。

paras.en: One tactic used by the Chinese government is to omit Ms. Takaichi’s title, a pointed break with diplomatic protocol. From July through September, officials dropped “prime minister” in six of seven mentions of Ms. Takaichi.
paras.zh: 中国政府使用的一种策略是省略高市女士的头衔，这明显违反了外交礼仪。从七月到九月，官员们在七次提到高市女士时，有六次都省略了“首相”这个词。

paras.en: On Weibo, a popular Chinese social media site that is heavily curated by the government, hashtags that mocked Ms. Takaichi’s wardrobe, emotions, voice or hugging style trended at least 30 times over the past year, the analysis found.
paras.zh: 分析发现，在政府精心策划的中国热门社交媒体网站微博上，嘲笑高市女士的衣着、情绪、声音或拥抱风格的标签在过去一年里出现了至少 30 次。

paras.en: China also appears to be working to foment opposition to Ms. Takaichi inside Japan’s political system. Chinese officials have tried to persuade visiting delegations of Japanese lawmakers and executives recently that Ms. Takaichi does not understand the economic risks of her tough approach to China, and that they should stand up to her, according to two people briefed on the conversations.
paras.zh: 中国似乎也在日本政治体系内煽动对高市女士的反对。据两名知情人士透露，中国官员最近试图说服来访的日本议员和高管代表团，让他们相信高市女士不了解她对中国采取强硬态度所带来的经济风险，并且他们应该勇敢地面对她。

paras.en: After one such meeting in September, Wang Yi, China’s foreign minister, said that it was time for Japan to “correct the erroneous words and deeds” of its leader.
paras.zh: 在9月份的一次此类会议之后，中国外交部长王毅表示，日本是时候“纠正”其领导人的错误言行了。

paras.en: In trying to stir concern about Japan, Chinese scholars have told their counterparts in the West that Ms. Takaichi’s Japan is becoming the “Israel of East Asia.” A delegation of Chinese scholars in South Korea used the phrase during a recent meeting with American scholars, according to David Sacks, an expert on China at the Council on Foreign Relations who took part in the meeting.
paras.zh: 为了引起人们对日本的担忧，中国学者告诉西方同行，高市女士领导下的日本正在成为“东亚的以色列”。参加会议的美国外交关系委员会中国问题专家大卫·萨克斯表示，一个在韩国的中国学者代表团最近在与美国学者的一次会议上使用了这句话。

paras.en: Mr. Sacks said his Chinese counterparts repeatedly raised concerns about Japanese militarism. They told the Americans that they feared Japan was seeking to become the most powerful country in East Asia and could draw the United States into conflict.
paras.zh: 萨克斯表示，中国同行多次对日本军国主义表示担忧。他们告诉美国人，他们担心日本正在寻求成为东亚最强大的国家，并可能将美国拖入冲突。

paras.en: The aim, Mr. Sacks said, was to push Mr. Trump to “rein in Japan.”
paras.zh: 萨克斯说，其目的是推动特朗普“控制日本”。

paras.en: “They want the United States to tell its ally to knock it off and to de-escalate with Beijing,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他们希望美国告诉其盟友停止这种冲突，并缓和与北京的紧张关系。”

paras.en: During his visit to the White House earlier this year, Mr. Xi suggested that Mr. Trump should join China’s efforts to counter Japan. Mr. Xi invoked World War II to highlight friendship between Beijing and Washington and cited Japan as a common enemy. He described Imperial Japan as “fascist” and “militarist” aggressors.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候访问白宫期间，习近平建议特朗普应加入中国对抗日本的行列。习近平援引第二次世界大战来强调北京和华盛顿之间的友谊，并将日本视为共同的敌人。他将日本帝国描述为“法西斯”和“军国主义”侵略者。

paras.en: China and Russia have increasingly reinforced each other’s attacks on Japan, the analysis shows, using common terms like “remilitarization.”
paras.zh: 分析显示，中国和俄罗斯越来越多地加强彼此对日本的攻击，使用“重新军事化”等常见术语。

paras.en: Analysts say it is all part of President Vladimir V. Putin’s recent pressure campaign against Japan. In August, he made his first-ever visit to islands claimed by both Moscow and Tokyo. Last month, Russia detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. And in recent days, Mr. Putin has seized Russian assets of Japan Tobacco.
paras.zh: 分析人士称，这都是普京总统最近对日本施压的一部分。八月，他首次访问莫斯科和东京都声称拥有主权的岛屿。上个月，俄罗斯以间谍罪名拘留了一名日本记者。最近几天，普京没收了日本烟草公司的俄罗斯资产。

paras.en: During a visit to Beijing in May, Mr. Putin signed a statement with Mr. Xi that included a lengthy section devoted to denouncing Japan’s military moves. The statement said, “Japan’s current acceleration of ‘remilitarization’ poses a serious threat to regional peace and stability.” The statement added that Japan should “resist ‘new militarism’ and ‘remilitarization.’”
paras.zh: 在五月份访问北京期间，普京与习近平签署了一份声明，其中有一个冗长的部分专门谴责日本的军事行动。声明称，“日本当前加速‘重新军事化’，对地区和平稳定构成严重威胁。”声明还说，日本应该“抵制‘新军国主义’和‘再军事化’”。

paras.en: During an appearance in Moscow last month, Mr. Putin said that he wanted good relations with Japan. But he added, “We are concerned by Japan’s plans for militarization.”
paras.zh: 普京上个月在莫斯科露面时表示，他希望与日本建立良好关系。但他补充说，“我们对日本的军事化计划感到担忧。”

paras.en: The Times collected hundreds of thousands of documents from multiple official Chinese sources: China’s Foreign Ministry briefings, articles from People’s Daily, P.L.A. Daily, Guangming Daily, Global Times, China Daily and Xinhua, as well as Chinese military, ministry, broadcast and social media records. Most sources were downloaded from official websites, and the rest from public digital archives, like the Internet Archive. To quantify the appearance of terms like “remilitarization,” “rearmament” and “neo-militarism” in Foreign Ministry briefings, we used A.I. models developed by Anthropic and Google, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Carbon, to strip out reporters’ questions and measure phrase frequencies per 1,000 Chinese characters. We also used A.I. to separate official statements from third-party quotes, generate initial translations, and classify the topic of news stories, briefing questions and social media trends.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》从多个中国官方来源收集了数十万份文件：中国外交部的简报、《人民日报》、《中国人民解放军》的文章。日报、光明日报、环球时报、中国日报和新华社，以及中国军方、部委、广播和社交媒体记录。大多数来源是从官方网站下载的，其余是从公共数字档案馆（例如互联网档案馆）下载的。为了量化外交部简报中出现的“重新军事化”、“重新武装”和“新军国主义”等术语，我们使用了人工智能。 Anthropic 和 Google 开发的模型 Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Carbon 可以剔除记者的问题并测量每 1000 个汉字的短语频率。我们还使用了 A.I.将官方声明与第三方引用分开，生成初步翻译，并对新闻报道主题、简报问题和社交媒体趋势进行分类。

paras.en: Every quote and translation used in the story was verified against the original Chinese records.
paras.zh: 故事中使用的每一个引述和翻译都与中国原始记录进行了核实。

paras.en: Murphy Zhao contributed reporting from Hong Kong, and Kiuko Notoya from Tokyo.
paras.zh: Murphy Zhao 和 Kiuko Notoya 分别来自香港和东京。

paras.en: President Trump’s trip to Asia this week will largely be seen as a test of American power in the main region where the United States and China compete for influence.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统本周的亚洲之行将在很大程度上被视为对美国在美国和中国争夺影响力的主要地区的实力的考验。

paras.en: His meetings in Manila and Shenzhen, China, will be scrutinized for shifts on trade and security. Deals he might strike with Beijing — plus a gathering with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia — will put the world’s great-power contest on display, as all three seek to show strength.
paras.zh: 他在马尼拉和中国深圳举行的会议将受到密切关注，以了解贸易和安全方面的变化。他可能与北京达成的协议，加上与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京的会面，将使世界大国的竞争得以展现，因为这三个国家都在寻求展示实力。

paras.en: But Asia is not just a theater of competition. Many countries in the region have become wealthier, more technologically advanced and increasingly interconnected. Especially now, as China’s military becomes more threatening and the United States less reliable, they are hedging against greatness and relying more on neighbors.
paras.zh: 但亚洲不仅仅是竞争的舞台。该地区许多国家变得更加富裕、技术更加先进、相互联系日益紧密。尤其是现在，随着中国的军事威胁越来越大，美国越来越不可靠，他们正在对冲大国，更多地依赖邻国。

paras.en: Asian students and workers are moving to neighboring states. Countries with expanding defense industries are selling weapons to new partners. Nations that compete for high-tech investment are even making plans to cooperate on energy and cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 亚洲学生和工人正在迁移到邻国。国防工业不断扩张的国家正在向新伙伴出售武器。争夺高科技投资的国家甚至正在制定能源和网络安全合作计划。

paras.en: “They’re all looking at what more they can do together when the great powers are behaving so badly,” said Ted Osius, a former U.S. ambassador to Vietnam and adjunct professor of geopolitics at Fulbright University in Ho Chi Minh City. “If you’re a middle power, you’re thinking ‘I need more options.’”
paras.zh: 美国前驻越南大使、胡志明市富布赖特大学地缘政治学兼职教授特德·奥修斯表示：“当大国表现如此恶劣时，他们都在考虑可以共同做些什么。” “如果你是中等强国，你会想‘我需要更多选择。’”

paras.en: Here are a few numbers that provide a sense of what the region contributes to the global economy, and how its nations are becoming more bound together to shape the world.
paras.zh: 以下一些数字可以让我们了解该地区对全球经济的贡献，以及该地区各国如何更加紧密地联系在一起来塑造世界。

paras.en: The population of the 11 nations that make up the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, a regional grouping that is holding its annual summit in Manila. ASEAN approved a digital framework agreement on Saturday that aims to create a multilateral digital market. If it rolls out smoothly next year, a small business in Vietnam could sell and ship products to Singapore with invoices, payment and customs handled through a regional online system.
paras.zh: 东南亚国家联盟由 11 个国家组成，该区域组织正在马尼拉举行年度峰会。东盟周六批准了一项数字框架协议，旨在创建多边数字市场。如果明年顺利推出，越南的一家小企业可以将产品销售并运送到新加坡，并通过区域在线系统处理发票、付款和海关事宜。

paras.en: The value of the Asia-Pacific market for medical tourism — the world’s largest. With portable insurance and medical visas, it’s becoming common to travel for better or more affordable cancer care, orthopedics, dentistry or cosmetic surgery. Life expectancy in high-income countries (like Japan) is around 84, compared with 79.8 in the United States, where health care costs are roughly twice as high.
paras.zh: 亚太地区医疗旅游市场的价值是全球最大的。有了便携式保险和医疗签证，前往寻求更好或更实惠的癌症护理、骨科、牙科或整容手术变得越来越普遍。高收入国家（如日本）的预期寿命约为 84 岁，而美国的预期寿命为 79.8 岁，而美国的医疗保健费用大约是美国的两倍。

paras.en: The share of the world’s semiconductor chips that are manufactured in Asia. Without China, about 55 to 60 percent are made in Asia, led by South Korea and Taiwan, which makes more than 90 percent of the world’s high-end chips. The global market is worth roughly $1.5 trillion.
paras.zh: 亚洲制造的全球半导体芯片所占份额。如果没有中国，大约 55% 到 60% 的芯片是在亚洲制造的，其中以韩国和台湾为首，这两个国家生产了全球 90% 以上的高端芯片。全球市场价值约为 1.5 万亿美元。

paras.en: The number of top-grossing musical acts in Asia that were K-pop performers from August 2025 to July 2026. The top four earners for live shows in Asia were all K-pop stars, with Seventeen topping the list. Lady Gaga ranked fifth in the region.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月至 2026 年 7 月，亚洲收入最高的音乐表演中韩国流行音乐表演者的数量。亚洲现场表演收入最高的四位都是韩国流行音乐明星，其中“Seventeen”位居榜首。 Lady Gaga 在该地区排名第五。

paras.en: The number of universities in the Asia-Pacific region in the QS global top 100. Among them are 11 in mainland China and Hong Kong, plus nine in Australia. There are 37 in Europe and 26 in the United States.
paras.zh: 亚太地区进入QS全球前100名的大学数量。其中中国大陆和香港地区有11所大学，澳大利亚有9所大学。欧洲有 37 个，美国有 26 个。

paras.en: The number of airline passenger journeys across the Asia-Pacific, excluding China, in 2024. Driven by booming demand in India and Southeast Asia, regional traffic is projected to more than double to 4.1 billion passengers over the next two decades.
paras.zh: 2024 年跨亚太地区（不包括中国）的航空客运量。在印度和东南亚需求旺盛的推动下，未来二十年区域交通量预计将增加一倍以上，达到 41 亿人次。

paras.en: The approximate cost of Indonesia’s recent deal to buy India’s BrahMos supersonic missile systems for coastal defense. India has inked similar deals with Vietnam and the Philippines, as the region seeks alternatives to expensive Western weapons systems.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚最近购买印度布拉莫斯超音速导弹系统用于海岸防御的交易的大致成本。印度已与越南和菲律宾签署了类似协议，该地区正在寻求昂贵的西方武器系统的替代品。

paras.en: The total number of Uniqlo stores worldwide, up from 1,795 in 2016. Even as its retail footprint in China has declined, growth in Southeast Asia, India and Australia has continued. The Japanese fashion brand is now one of the world’s fastest growing clothing retailers.
paras.zh: 优衣库全球门店总数较 2016 年的 1,795 家有所增加。尽管其在中国的零售足迹有所下降，但在东南亚、印度和澳大利亚的增长仍在持续。这个日本时尚品牌现在是世界上增长最快的服装零售商之一。

paras.en: The number of Japanese visits to South Korea in 2025 — a record for two countries that have been gradually overcoming a long history of resentment. The curiosity goes both ways: Koreans also set a record for trips to Japan last year, with 9.46 million visits.
paras.zh: 2025 年日本访问韩国的次数创下了两个逐渐克服长期恩怨的国家的记录。人们的好奇心是双向的：去年韩国人还创下了前往日本旅游的记录，达 946 万人次。
