paras.en: The number of cross-border energy projects planned among ASEAN countries. With high-voltage lines on land and plans for some of the longest power cables ever to be placed underwater, the goal is to more than double transmission capacity and to pave the way for a multilateral power market that is more reliant on renewable energy, like hydropower.
paras.zh: 东盟国家之间规划的跨境能源项目数量。通过陆地上的高压线路，并计划将一些最长的电力电缆铺设在水下，目标是将输电容量增加一倍以上，并为更加依赖水电等可再生能源的多边电力市场铺平道路。

articles.title: Kevin Parker’s Tame Impala Wins ARIA’s 2026 Global Impact Award
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Kevin Parker won’t go home empty handed from the 2026 ARIA Awards.
paras.zh: 凯文·帕克 (Kevin Parker) 不会在 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼上空手而归。

paras.en: The Western Australian singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and Tame Impala spearhead will receive the second annual ARIA Global Impact Award, announced ahead of the 40th annual ARIAs this Wednesday, Nov. 18.
paras.zh: 这位西澳大利亚歌手、词曲作者、多乐器演奏家和 Tame Impala 领军人物将获得第二届年度 ARIA 全球影响力奖，该奖项于本周三（11 月 18 日）第 40 届年度 ARIA 之前宣布。

paras.en: Presented by Spotify, the accolade recognizes Australian recording artists who’ve demonstrated outstanding breakthrough international success and cultural influence, and made an impact for Australian music “through artistry, innovation and global connection” over the previous 12 months.
paras.zh: 该奖项由 Spotify 颁发，旨在表彰在过去 12 个月中“通过艺术性、创新和全球联系”对澳大利亚音乐产生影响的澳大利亚唱片艺术家，他们在国际上取得了杰出的突破性成功和文化影响力。

paras.en: “I just found out I am this year’s recipient of the Global Impact Award at the ARIAs, which is huge, it’s such an honor, obviously,” enthuses Parker, whose career collection of ARIAs now lifts to 14. “I’m going to be at the ARIA Awards to receive it in person, so I’ll see you there. Thank you.”
paras.zh: “我刚刚发现我获得了今年 ARIA 颁发的全球影响力奖，这是一项巨大的荣誉，显然这是一种荣幸，”Parker 兴奋地说，他职业生涯中获得的 ARIA 收藏现已增至 14 个。“我将在 ARIA 颁奖典礼上亲自领取该奖项，所以到时见。谢谢。”

paras.en: Parker has “spent nearly 20 years making records that the rest of the world can’t stop playing. Rihanna has covered him, Lady Gaga and Dua Lipa have brought him into the studio and this year Dracula sank its teeth into the ARIA Top 10 for 18 weeks,” remarks ARIA CEO Annabelle Herd. “He’s shown a generation of Australian artists that a song made in a home studio in Perth can find its biggest audiences in America, Britain, Mexico and Brazil. Congratulations Kevin from all of us at ARIA.”
paras.zh: ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示，帕克“花了近 20 年的时间制作了世界其他地方无法停止播放的唱片。蕾哈娜 (Rihanna) 翻唱过他，Lady Gaga 和杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa) 将他带入录音室，今年《德古拉》(Dracula) 连续 18 周跻身 ARIA 排行榜前 10 名。” “他向一代澳大利亚艺术家表明，一首在珀斯家庭录音室制作的歌曲可以在美国、英国、墨西哥和巴西找到最大的听众。ARIA 的所有人都向凯文表示祝贺。”

paras.en: Dom Dolla was the inaugural recipient of the award, which is presented at the discretion of the ARIA board to an artist whose international efforts are said to exemplify Australia’s influence in contemporary music worldwide.
paras.zh: Dom Dolla 是该奖项的首届获奖者，该奖项由 ARIA 董事会酌情颁发给一位艺术家，据说他的国际努力体现了澳大利亚在全球当代音乐中的影响力。

paras.en: Parker will have many more chances to collect silverware on the night. Specifically, eight, which places him equal with Genesis Owusu at the top of the leaderboard. Ecca Vandal is close behind with seven nods.
paras.zh: 帕克将有更多机会在当晚收集奖杯。具体来说，是八，这使他与 Genesis Owusu 并列排行榜榜首。 Ecca Vandal 紧随其后，有 7 次点头。

paras.en: Spotify’s managing director AUNZ, Mikaela Lancaster, announced this year’s Global Impact recipient during the streaming platform’s Artist Party on Monday night (Nov. 16) in central Sydney, headlined by Owusu. Tame Impala amassed 4.5 billion streams on Spotify in the past 12 months, Lancaster explained. “It’s not just Australia, the U.S. and U.K., he’s growing his fans in Brazil, Mexico, Germany, to name a few.”
paras.zh: Spotify 董事总经理 AUNZ Mikaela Lancaster 于周一晚间（11 月 16 日）在悉尼市中心举行的流媒体平台艺术家派对上宣布了今年的全球影响力获奖者，该派对以 Owusu 为主角。 Lancaster 解释说，过去 12 个月，Tame Impala 在 Spotify 上的播放量达到了 45 亿次。 “不仅仅是澳大利亚、美国和英国，他还在巴西、墨西哥、德国等地增加了粉丝。”

paras.en: Fans worldwide added Tame Impala’s music to their own Spotify playlists more than 141 million times in the past year, and with “Dracula,” Parker enjoyed the biggest hit of his career, nabbing gold certification or better across 16 countries, and hitting the top 10 in 18 markets, including a No. 2 best in the U.K.
paras.zh: 去年，世界各地的歌迷将 Tame Impala 的音乐添加到自己的 Spotify 播放列表中的次数超过 1.41 亿次，而凭借《Dracula》，帕克享受了职业生涯中最热门的歌曲，在 16 个国家/地区获得了金奖或更好的认证，并在 18 个市场中进入了前十名，其中在英国排名第二。

paras.en: For the first time in ARIAs history, more than one million public votes were cast across Spotify and the ARIA website, with fans tipping their picks across four publicly decided categories: song of the year, best Australian live act, best video and most popular international artist.
paras.zh: ARIA 历史上首次通过 Spotify 和 ARIA 网站进行了超过 100 万公众投票，粉丝们在四个公开决定的类别中进行了投票：年度歌曲、最佳澳大利亚现场表演、最佳视频和最受欢迎的国际艺术家。

paras.en: The 2026 ARIA Awards will be presented at Sydney’s Hordern Pavilion. It’s supported by Destination NSW, in partnership with Spotify, and will be live on Paramount+ and broadcast on 10. Performances and moments will also be available on the @ARIA.official YouTube channel.
paras.zh: 2026 年 ARIA 奖将在悉尼 Hordern 展馆颁发。该活动得到了新南威尔士州旅游局 (Destination NSW) 与 Spotify 的合作支持，将在 Paramount+ 上现场直播并于 10 号播出。表演和精彩时刻也将在@ARIA.official YouTube 频道上播出。

articles.title: From the Olivias & Madonna to RAYE & Rosalía, Women Dominate 2027 Pop/Dance Grammy Nominations
articles.author: Katie Atkinson

paras.en: If you’re a pop singer/songwriter named Olivia, the 2027 Grammy nominations were kind to you.
paras.zh: 如果您是一位名叫 Olivia 的流行歌手/词曲作家，那么 2027 年格莱美提名对您来说是件好事。

paras.en: Olivias Rodrigo and Dean fared well during Monday’s announcement, with Rodrigo picking up seven nominations and Dean picking up six — including three Big Four nods for each. On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast, Katie & Keith are taking a closer look at those top prizes as well as the pop/dance categories, where RAYE, Rosalía, Madonna, Tinashe and Ariana Grande also lead the way. Listen to our full conversation below:
paras.zh: 奥利维亚斯·罗德里戈 (Olivias Rodrigo) 和迪恩 (Dean) 在周一的提名中表现出色，罗德里戈 (Rodrigo) 获得了七项提名，迪恩 (Dean) 获得了六项提名，其中各获得了 3 项四大提名。在新的 Billboard Pop Shop 播客中，Katie 和 Keith 正在仔细研究这些最高奖项以及流行/舞蹈类别，其中 RAYE、Rosalía、Madonna、Tinashe 和 Ariana Grande 也处于领先地位。请听下面我们的完整对话：

paras.en: Plus, Katie takes Keith (and listeners!) inside Saturday’s Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, where Cynthia Erivo and Travis Barker paid striking tribute to Phil Collins with “In the Air Tonight,” the Red Hot Chili Peppers donned full long white hair and beard wigs to honor Rick Rubin, and more highlights from a nearly five-hour show.
paras.zh: 此外，凯蒂带着基思（和听众！）参加周六的摇滚名人堂入会仪式，辛西娅·埃里沃和特拉维斯·巴克在“今夜空中”向菲尔·柯林斯致敬，红辣椒乐队戴上长长的白发和胡须假发向里克·鲁宾致敬，以及近五个小时演出的更多亮点。

paras.en: Also on the podcast, we’ve got chart news on Christmas songs surging on the Billboard Hot 100, with eight in the top 50 (including a debut from a very current superstar artist) and how one — or more — of them could jump into the top 10 next week. Plus, Rodrigo’s you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love captures a fifth week atop the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 此外，在播客中，我们还收到了有关圣诞节歌曲在 Billboard Hot 100 中飙升的排行榜新闻，其中有 8 首歌曲进入前 50 名（其中包括一位当前超级巨星艺术家的首张专辑），以及其中一首或多首歌曲如何在下周跻身前 10 名。另外，罗德里戈 (Rodrigo) 饰演的《你对于一个女孩来说似乎很悲伤，所以恋爱》连续第五周位居 Billboard 200 排行榜榜首。

paras.en: The Billboard Pop Shop Podcast is your one-stop shop for all things pop on Billboard‘s weekly charts. You can always count on a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear Billboard‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and Billboard’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast, which can be streamed on Billboard.com or downloaded in Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast provider. (Click here to listen to the previous edition of the show on Billboard.com.)
paras.zh: Billboard Pop Shop 播客是您一站式购买 Billboard 每周排行榜上所有流行内容的商店。您始终可以期待关于最新流行新闻、有趣的图表统计数据和故事、新音乐以及对音乐明星和流行界人士的客座采访的热烈讨论。休闲流行乐迷和图表迷每周都可以在播客中听到 Billboard 的执行数字总监 West Coast 的凯蒂·阿特金森 (Katie Atkinson) 和 Billboard 的图表和数据运营总经理 Keith Caulfield 的播客，该播客可以在 Billboard.com 上流式传输，也可以在 Apple Podcasts 或您最喜欢的播客提供商中下载。 （点击此处在 Billboard.com 上收听该节目的上一版本。）

articles.title: Wade Forster Dominates 2027 Golden Guitar Nominations
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: With 10 nominations, Wade Forster is in the fast lane heading into the 55th annual Golden Guitar Awards, Australia’s flagship country music awards ceremony.
paras.zh: 韦德·福斯特 (Wade Forster) 获得 10 项提名，正步入澳大利亚乡村音乐旗舰颁奖典礼第 55 届年度金吉他奖的快车道。

paras.en: Forster is coming off a career year during which he made his Grand Ole Opry debut, sold out a run of U.S. shows, released his third studio album The Aftermath (via Community Music), and completed a coast-to-coast Australian tour in support of it.
paras.zh: 福斯特即将迎来职业生涯的一年，在此期间，他在大奥普里 (Grand Ole Opry) 首次亮相，一系列美国演出的门票全部售罄，发行了他的第三张录音室专辑《The Aftermath》（通过 Community Music），并完成了澳大利亚从东海岸到西海岸的巡演以支持该专辑。

paras.en: The singer, songwriter and guitarist is in solid form having collected two Golden Guitar trophies earlier in 2026 (male artist of the year and new talent of the year), off the back of his sophomore 2025 release Gooseneck Party.
paras.zh: 这位歌手、词曲作者兼吉他手状态稳定，在 2025 年发行的第二张专辑《Gooseneck Party》之后，他于 2026 年初获得了两项金吉他奖杯（年度男歌手和年度新人）。

paras.en: In what is believed to be a first for the Golden Guitars, Forster has two albums nominated in separate categories for the 2026 event, to be presented in Tamworth, New South Wales, Australia’s home of country music; Gooseneck Party, produced by Simon Johnson, is up for alt country/Americana album of the year and album of the year, while The Aftermath, also produced by Johnson, is a chance for contemporary country album of the year and competes for album of the year.
paras.zh: 福斯特有两张专辑在不同类别中获得了 2026 年活动的提名，这被认为是金吉他乐队的首张专辑，将在澳大利亚乡村音乐之乡新南威尔士州塔姆沃思举行；由西蒙·约翰逊制作的《Gooseneck Party》有机会角逐年度另类乡村/美国专辑和年度最佳专辑，而同样由约翰逊制作的《The Aftermath》则有机会角逐年度最佳当代乡村专辑并角逐年度专辑。

paras.en: Nominations in 16 categories were called out Tuesday (Nov. 17) at a lunchtime party in central Sydney, part of the ARIA Awards week of events. Among the next best-placed artists are Brooke McClymont & Adam Eckersley and James Johnston, with six nominations, while Mack Geiger collected five.
paras.zh: 周二（11 月 17 日）在悉尼市中心举行的午餐派对上公布了 16 个类别的提名，这是 ARIA 颁奖周活动的一部分。接下来排名最高的艺术家是布鲁克·麦克莱蒙特、亚当·埃克斯利和詹姆斯·约翰斯顿，获得六项提名，而麦克·盖格则获得五项提名。

paras.en: Close behind is Catherine Britt, Dean Perrett, Felicity Urquhart & Josh Cunningham, Morgan Evans and William Alexander, all with nominations in four categories. Meanwhile, Beccy Cole, Sons of Atticus, Kingswood, The French Family Band and newcomer Tyla Rodrigues each scoop three nominations, while Fanny Lumsden leads a bunch of artists with two chances.
paras.zh: 紧随其后的是凯瑟琳·布里特、迪恩·佩雷特、费丽西蒂·厄克特和乔什·坎宁安、摩根·埃文斯和威廉·亚历山大，他们都获得了四个类别的提名。与此同时，贝西·科尔 (Beccy Cole)、阿提克斯之子 (Sons of Atticus)、金斯伍德 (Kingswood)、法国家庭乐队 (The French Family Band) 和新人泰拉·罗德里格斯 (Tyla Rodrigues) 各获得三项提名，而范妮·拉姆斯登 (Fanny Lumsden) 领先一众艺术家，获得两次提名。

paras.en: Guests at the launch function were treated to performances by Jake Whittaker, Zac and George, and opened with Beccy Cole and Duncan Toombs.
paras.zh: 出席发布会的嘉宾欣赏了杰克·惠特克 (Jake Whittaker)、扎克 (Zac) 和乔治 (George) 的表演，并由贝西·科尔 (Beccy Cole) 和邓肯·图姆斯 (Duncan Toombs) 开场。

paras.en: “The future of Australian country music is certainly in great hands, and the Golden Guitar Awards continue to celebrate the extraordinary talent, creativity and diversity that make our industry so special,” remarks awards executive producer Peter Ross who, along with CMAA chair Dobe Newton, was one of the guest speakers on the day.
paras.zh: “澳大利亚乡村音乐的未来肯定掌握在伟大的手中，金吉他奖将继续表彰使我们的行业如此特别的非凡才华、创造力和多样性，”奖项执行制作人彼得·罗斯 (Peter Ross) 说道，他和 CMAA 主席多比·牛顿 (Dobe Newton) 都是当天的演讲嘉宾之一。

paras.en: All told, 580 entries were accepted for awards, which will be presented Saturday, Jan. 23 during the Toyota 55th Tamworth Country Music Festival, which is expected to host some 30,000 country music fans on each of its 10 days.
paras.zh: 总共有 580 件作品入围，奖项将于 1 月 23 日星期六在丰田第 55 届塔姆沃斯乡村音乐节期间颁发，预计在为期 10 天的每一天都会接待约 30,000 名乡村音乐迷。

paras.en: Tamworth Country Music Festival is supported by the NSW government through its tourism and major events agency, Destination NSW. Tamworth Regional Council will present the ceremony, Australia’s longest-running music awards show, at the Tamworth Regional Entertainment and Conference Centre.
paras.zh: 塔姆沃思乡村音乐节得到了新南威尔士州政府通过其旅游和大型活动机构新南威尔士州旅游局的支持。塔姆沃思地区议会将在塔姆沃思地区娱乐和会议中心举办澳大利亚历史最悠久的音乐颁奖典礼。

articles.title: Ron Howard Cautions ‘Grinch’ Sequel With Jim Carrey Will Only Move Forward If “One Thing” Happens
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Ron Howard is opening up about the one thing that must be perfect for the How the Grinch Stole Christmas sequel to move forward with Jim Carrey.
paras.zh: 朗·霍华德公开了一件必须完美的事情，才能让《格林奇如何偷走圣诞节》续集与金·凯瑞一起推进。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter exclusively revealed earlier this year that the follow-up film was in development with Universal and Imagine Entertainment. But the Oscar-winning filmmaker recently told People that he and Carrey “aren’t gonna go forward unless we think we have a great script, and we don’t even have a script right now.”
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》今年早些时候独家透露，后续电影正在与环球影业和想象娱乐公司共同开发。但这位奥斯卡获奖电影制片人最近告诉《人物》杂志，他和凯瑞“除非我们认为我们有一个很棒的剧本，否则不会继续前进，而我们现在甚至还没有剧本。”

paras.en: Howard directed the beloved 2000 Christmas film, based on Dr. Seuss’ classic 1957 children’s book, starring Carrey as the Grinch and Taylor Momsen as Cindy Lou Who.
paras.zh: 霍华德执导了这部深受喜爱的 2000 年圣诞电影，改编自苏斯博士 1957 年的经典儿童读物，由凯瑞饰演格林奇，泰勒·莫森饰演辛迪·卢。

paras.en: The director added of the sequel, “We have really good writers and an idea that I’m excited about that I think is very much in keeping with the spirit of Dr. Seuss, his blend of comedy and fantasy. So I’m very pleased with what we have to work with, but I don’t wanna make any promises that it’s happening because Jim and I are aligned on one thing — we’re not gonna go forward unless we believe it has a chance to be great.”
paras.zh: 导演在谈到续集时补充道，“我们有非常优秀的编剧和一个让我感到兴奋的想法，我认为这非常符合苏斯博士的精神，他将喜剧和奇幻融为一体。所以我对我们必须合作的东西非常满意，但我不想做出任何承诺，因为吉姆和我在一件事上意见一致——除非我们相信它有机会变得伟大，否则我们不会继续前进。”

paras.en: Howard admitted that the first film’s legacy plays a part in his hesitation and wanting to wait until the script reaches his standards. THR previously reported that Alec Berg, Jeff Schaffer and David Mandel are working on the screenplay.
paras.zh: 霍华德承认，第一部电影的遗产在他的犹豫中发挥了一定作用，他想等到剧本达到他的标准。 THR 此前报道称，亚历克·伯格、杰夫·谢弗和大卫·曼德尔正在制作剧本。

paras.en: “We’re so proud of the original movie,” he said. “We feel so fortunate, because it takes a little bit of luck for a movie to come together and become an evergreen the way that film has. And the following, the fact that it’s become a tradition in a lot of households is something that means a great deal to all of us involved, Jim and I in particular.”
paras.zh: “我们对原版电影感到非常自豪，”他说。 “我们感到非常幸运，因为一部电影能够像电影一样成为常青树需要一点运气。接下来，它已经成为许多家庭的传统，这对我们所有参与者来说都意义重大，尤其是吉姆和我。”

paras.en: If the sequel comes to fruition, the Apollo 13 filmmaker said it “will still be a live-action physical comedy performance.” He also hopes to make the production process easier for Carrey this time around “because he found the contact lenses and some of the makeup to be literally claustrophobic” and “was literally breathing into a paper bag because he was having a panic attack in between takes” at times.
paras.zh: 这位阿波罗 13 号电影制片人表示，如果续集得以实现，它“仍将是一场真人喜剧表演”。 He also hopes to make the production process easier for Carrey this time around “because he found the contact lenses and some of the makeup to be literally claustrophobic” and “was literally breathing into a paper bag because he was having a panic attack in between takes” at times.

paras.en: “We’re gonna move cautiously but hopefully toward another movie because we both believe in the premise,” Howard added. “With a little luck, we’ll get to revisit that world.”
paras.zh: 霍华德补充道：“我们会谨慎地但充满希望地走向另一部电影，因为我们都相信这个前提。” “如果运气好的话，我们就能重温那个世界。”

articles.title: Emma Chamberlain Returning to YouTube With Original Series ‘What Are You Waiting For?’ (Exclusive)
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: One of YouTube‘s original superstars is planning a major comeback to the platform.
paras.zh: YouTube 的一位原创超级明星正计划在该平台上大举回归。

paras.en: Emma Chamberlain, whose vlogs on the platform propelled her to stardom (she has more than 12 million followers there), is launching a new show on YouTube next year, The Hollywood Reporter has learned.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，艾玛·张伯伦 (Emma Chamberlain) 将于明年在 YouTube 上推出新节目，该平台上的视频博客使她成为明星（她在该平台上拥有超过 1200 万粉丝）。

paras.en: Chamberlain will launch the docuseries What Are You Waiting For? in which she explores some of New York’s most popular lines, and the people waiting in them.
paras.zh: 张伯伦将推出系列纪录片《你在等什么？》她在其中探索了纽约一些最受欢迎的线路以及在这些线路中等候的人们。

paras.en: “What Are You Waiting For? on the surface is about people who voluntarily wait in lines for stuff set in New York City, a phenomenon that I personally don’t understand but seek to understand, and along the way I discover much more about humanity than I ever could have expected,” Chamberlain says. “The experience of making this was unlike anything I have ever done and has profoundly changed me as a person, talking to strangers all day, working with a crew of unbelievably talented people, and making something bigger than I have ever made before, I feel the next chapter of my life coming to fruition, and I am deeply inspired and grateful.”
paras.zh: “你在等什么？表面上讲的是人们自愿排队等候以纽约市为背景的东西，这种现象我个人不理解，但试图理解，一路上我对人性的发现比我预想的要多得多，”张伯伦说。 “制作这件作品的经历与我以前做过的任何事情都不同，它深刻地改变了我作为一个人，整天与陌生人交谈，与一群令人难以置信的才华横溢的人一起工作，并做出比我以前做过的更大的事情，我感觉我人生的下一个篇章即将实现，我深受启发和感激。”

paras.en: The show is being produced in partnership with Amplify Pictures, underscoring how content on YouTube is professionalizing and becoming more ambitious. In fact, Chamberlain is debuting the new concept at a YouTube Creator Premieres event in Los Angeles Tuesday evening, with Wesley Wang and Aryna Sabalenka also making appearances.
paras.zh: 该节目是与 Amplify Pictures 合作制作的，突显了 YouTube 上的内容如何专业化并变得更加雄心勃勃。事实上，张伯伦周二晚上在洛杉矶举行的 YouTube Creator Premieres 活动上首次展示了这一新概念，Wesley Wang 和 Aryna Sabalenka 也出席了活动。

paras.en: It’s also a coup for the platform, which has been trying to entice top creators to develop shows and programming primarily for itself at a moment when there are a number of competitors pursuing deals with top talent.
paras.zh: 这对于该平台来说也是一个妙招，该平台一直试图吸引顶级创作者主要为自己开发节目和节目，而目前有许多竞争对手正在寻求与顶级人才达成交易。

paras.en: “After deciding to take a hiatus from my podcast, I spent the next few months trying to figure out what I wanted to create next,” Chamberlain says. “The answer wasn’t obvious at first, but I knew for sure that I wanted to make something for YouTube. From entertaining me as a child to allowing me to build a career as an adult, it was a no-brainer that whatever I make next had to go on YouTube.”
paras.zh: “在决定暂停我的播客之后，我花了接下来的几个月时间试图弄清楚接下来我想创造什么，”张伯伦说。 “一开始答案并不明显，但我确信我想为 YouTube 制作一些东西。从小时候让我开心到让我在成年后建立自己的职业生涯，我接下来制作的任何内容都必须在 YouTube 上发布，这是理所当然的。”

paras.en: “Working with a TV studio to create YouTube content is a full 180 from what I have done in the past, producing everything myself with very little help, but I knew this was crucial,” she added. “I met with Joe Lewis and Amplify Pictures and explained a little idea I had for a docuseries. To my surprise, they loved it and wanted to make it with me.”
paras.zh: “与电视工作室合作制作 YouTube 内容与我过去所做的完全不同，我自己制作了所有内容，几乎没有任何帮助，但我知道这至关重要，”她补充道。 “我会见了乔·刘易斯和 Amplify Pictures，并向我解释了我对纪录片系列的一点想法。令我惊讶的是，他们很喜欢它，并想和我一起制作。”

articles.title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026: Celebrity Sightings, the Biggest Parties and Where to Watch, Stay, Shop and Dine (Updating)
articles.author: Melinda Sheckells

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Formula 1 has already crowned its 2026 world champion, Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli, but Las Vegas has another race in mind: seeing which famous faces turn up trackside and who throws the party everyone is talking about. When the fourth annual Las Vegas Grand Prix returns to the Strip Nov. 19 through 21, the competition for a place on the podium will share the spotlight with a packed calendar of designer pop-ups, caviar and Champagne-drenched viewing experiences, high-roller megasuites and A-list-hosted afterparties and concerts.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车已经将 2026 年世界冠军加冕为梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利，但拉斯维加斯还有另一场比赛：看看哪些名人出现在赛道边，以及谁举办了每个人都在谈论的派对。当第四届年度拉斯维加斯大奖赛于 11 月 19 日至 21 日重返拉斯维加斯大道时，领奖台上的争夺将与众多设计师快闪店、鱼子酱和香槟观赏体验、豪华豪华套房以及一线明星举办的余兴派对和音乐会等活动一起分享聚光灯。

paras.en: At Wynn, Charles Leclerc’s CL16 takes over Café Al Teatro with Café Leclerc (featuring a bag charm of Leo in a tuxedo in homage to his high-profile pooch), Lando Norris’ LN4 opens a vintage-lounge-inspired Clubhouse and Lewis Hamilton’s +44 returns with another limited-edition collection. The recently reimagined XS features the Chainsmokers headlining Sports Illustrated’s Circuit Series, Calvin Harris taking race night and Rüfüs Du Sol closing the weekend with a DJ set.
paras.zh: 在永利，Charles Leclerc 的 CL16 与 Café Leclerc 一起接管了 Café Al Teatro（包袋饰有身着燕尾服的 Leo 的包饰，以向他那只备受瞩目的狗狗致敬），Lando Norris 的 LN4 开设了一家复古酒廊风格的俱乐部会所，Lewis Hamilton 的 +44 则携另一款限量版系列回归。最近重新设计的 XS 包括 Chainsmokers 成为体育画报巡回系列赛的头条新闻、卡尔文·哈里斯 (Calvin Harris) 参加比赛之夜以及 Rüfüs Du Sol 的 DJ 表演为周末画上句号。

paras.en: Jay-Z hosts Roc Nation and Tao Group’s celebration at Omnia Dayclub & Skybar, Kacey Musgraves headlines Uber and Zoox’s invite-only Disco Rodeo party and the Backstreet Boys take the official post-race concert to Sphere. Dominique Crenn, Izu Ani, Tetsuya Wakuda, Tyler Florence and Guy Savoy lead the dining calendar, and the world’s best bars — including New York’s Double Chicken Please — pour the drinks.
paras.zh: Jay-Z 在 Omnia Dayclub 和 Skybar 举办 Roc Nation 和 Tao Group 的庆祝活动，Kacey Musgraves 成为 Uber 和 Zoox 仅限受邀者参加的迪斯科竞技派对的头条新闻，后街男孩 (Backstreet Boys) 在 Sphere 举办官方赛后音乐会。多米尼克·克林 (Dominique Crenn)、伊豆·阿尼 (Izu Ani)、Tetsuya Wakuda、泰勒·弗洛伦斯 (Tyler Florence) 和盖伊·萨沃伊 (Guy Savoy) 领衔餐饮日程，世界上最好的酒吧（包括纽约的 Double Chicken Please）为您提供饮品。

paras.en: The prize? Louis Vuitton has created a bespoke trophy trunk for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, handcrafted at its historic atelier in Asnières-sur-Seine, France. Its signature monogram canvas is crossed with colored Damier strips that form a V in white gold leaf for both “Victory” and “Vuitton” (and also perhaps V for Vegas), while a Victory patch will bear the winner’s initials. The season’s championship may be settled, but whose initials go on the Las Vegas trunk remains an open question.
paras.zh: 奖品？路易威登为拉斯维加斯大奖赛打造了一款定制奖杯箱，由其位于法国塞纳河畔阿涅勒历史悠久的工作室手工制作而成。其标志性的花押字帆布与彩色 Damier 条纹交叉，形成白金箔上的 V 形，代表“胜利”和“威登”（V 也可能代表维加斯），而胜利补丁上将印有获胜者的姓名首字母。本赛季的冠军可能已经尘埃落定，但拉斯维加斯行李箱上的名字缩写仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: Below, The Hollywood Reporter rounds up where to stay, dine, shop and watch, along with last-minute deals and the parties and performances worth planning around. Check back for celebrity sightings and updates as race week unfolds.
paras.zh: 下面，《好莱坞报道》总结了住宿、餐饮、购物和观看的地​​点，以及值得计划的最后一刻优惠以及派对和表演。随着比赛周的展开，请回来查看名人目击和更新。

paras.en: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026: Date, Start Time, Tickets
paras.zh: 2026 年拉斯维加斯大奖赛：日期、开始时间、门票

paras.en: The Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place Nov. 19 through 21 on the Las Vegas Strip Circuit, with the main race starting Saturday, Nov. 21, at 8 p.m. PT. Thursday brings the first two practice sessions, followed by Friday practice and qualifying.
paras.zh: 一级方程式拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于 11 月 19 日至 21 日在拉斯维加斯大道赛道举行，主赛将于 11 月 21 日星期六晚上 8 点开始。 PT。周四进行前两场练习赛，然后是周五练习赛和排位赛。

paras.en: Race tickets and hospitality packages are available through the Las Vegas Grand Prix website, with options varying by day and viewing area. The Heineken Silver Main Grandstand faces the start-finish line and pit lane, the Lewis Hamilton Grandstand overlooks the approach to the final turn along the Harmon Straight and the T-Mobile Zone at Sphere combines racing with nightly concerts.
paras.zh: 比赛门票和招待套餐可通过拉斯维加斯大奖赛网站购买，选项根据日期和观看区域而有所不同。喜力银牌主看台面向起终点线和维修区，刘易斯·汉密尔顿看台俯瞰哈蒙直道最后一个转弯处，而位于 Sphere 的 T-Mobile 区域则将赛车与夜间音乐会融为一体。

paras.en: For access beyond a grandstand seat, F1 Experiences offers packages that combine hospitality with pit-lane walks, a guided paddock tour and an optional hotel stay.
paras.zh: 对于除了看台座位之外的其他活动，F1 Experiences 还提供将热情好客与维修站通道漫步、带导游的围场之旅和可选酒店住宿相结合的套餐。

paras.en: Alternatively, some of the best ticket deals can be found on third-party resale platforms, including Ticket Network, Vivid Seats, StubHub, Ticket Liquidator, SeatGeek and Gametime. Plus, THR has exclusive promo codes for select sites (all listed below).
paras.zh: 另外，一些最优惠的门票交易可以在第三方转售平台上找到，包括 Ticket Network、Vivid Seats、StubHub、Ticket Liquidator、SeatGeek 和 Gametime。此外，THR 还针对特定网站（所有网站均在下面列出）提供独家促销代码。

paras.en: - Ticket Network: Get $150 off orders of $500 and up with promo code THR150.
paras.zh: - Ticket Network：订单满 500 美元即可立减 150 美元，使用促销代码 THR150。

paras.en: - Vivid Seats: Use code THR30 to save $30 on purchases of $300 and above.
paras.zh: - Vivid Seats：使用代码 THR30 购买 300 美元及以上可节省 30 美元。

paras.en: - SeatGeek: New customers can use promo code HOLLYWOOD10 to save $10 on purchases of $250 and up.
paras.zh: - SeatGeek：新客户可以使用促销代码 HOLLYWOOD10 购买 250 美元及以上可节省 10 美元。

paras.en: How to Watch the Las Vegas Grand Prix Free on Apple TV
paras.zh: 如何在 Apple TV 上免费观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛

paras.en: Apple TV, Formula 1’s U.S. streaming home, is making the entire Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend available free, with no subscription required. Watch all three practice sessions, qualifying and Saturday’s race through the Apple TV app or at tv.apple.com.
paras.zh: Apple TV（一级方程式赛车的美国流媒体之家）将免费提供整个拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，无需订阅。通过 Apple TV 应用程序或 tv.apple.com 观看全部三场练习赛、排位赛和周六的正赛。

paras.en: Pre-race coverage begins: 6:50 p.m. PT/9:50 p.m. ET
paras.zh: 赛前报道开始：下午 6:50太平洋时间/晚上 9:50 ET

paras.en: Grand Prix starts at 8 p.m. PT/11 p.m. ET. tv.apple.com
paras.zh: 大奖赛于晚上 8 点开始太平洋时间/晚上 11 点等。苹果电视网

paras.en: Where to Buy Plane Tickets for Las Vegas Grand Prix Weekend
paras.zh: 哪里可以购买拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末的机票

paras.en: Race-week travelers can compare scheduled flights into Harry Reid International Airport with private-terminal options connecting Los Angeles and Las Vegas. The following services offer alternatives for getting to town and navigating the weekend.
paras.zh: 参加比赛周的旅行者可以比较飞往哈利·里德国际机场的定期航班与连接洛杉矶和拉斯维加斯的私人航站楼选项。以下服务提供了前往城镇和周末出行的替代方案。

paras.en: Theos, the members-only aviation service, operated by Cirrus Aviation Services, offers seats aboard a Challenger 850 from Van Nuys to Las Vegas on Friday, Nov. 20, with return service Sunday, Nov. 22. Seats are quoted at $1,950 each way or $3,900 round trip, allowing travelers to book a place on the private aircraft without chartering the entire jet. Book or apply for membership at gotheos.com.
paras.zh: Theos 是一项仅限会员的航空服务，由西锐航空服务公司 (Cirrus Aviation Services) 运营，于 11 月 20 日星期五提供从范奈斯飞往拉斯维加斯的挑战者 850 航班，并于 11 月 22 日星期日提供返程服务。座位报价为单程 1,950 美元或往返 3,900 美元，允许旅客在私人飞机上预订座位，而无需包租整架飞机。在 gotheos.com 预订或申请会员资格。

paras.en: The Santa Monica-Las Vegas JSX route connects the Westside with Las Vegas using hangar departures. Travelers can arrive 20 minutes before their flight. Check race-week schedules and fares at jsx.com.
paras.zh: 圣莫尼卡 - 拉斯维加斯 JSX 航线通过机库出发连接西区和拉斯维加斯。旅客可以在航班起飞前 20 分钟抵达。在 jsx.com 上查看比赛周的时间表和票价。

paras.en: Zoox’s robotaxi service serves selected areas of Las Vegas, operating from 6 a.m. to 3 a.m. Check the Zoox app for available trips and pickup locations during race week, when circuit closures may affect access.
paras.zh: Zoox 的机器人出租车服务为拉斯维加斯的选定区域提供服务，运营时间为早上 6 点至凌晨 3 点。在比赛周期间，请检查 Zoox 应用程序以了解可用的行程和接送地点，届时电路封闭可能会影响通行。

paras.en: Waymo’s driverless service now includes Harry Reid International Airport, with pickups and drop-offs at designated autonomous vehicle zones on the Ground Zero level of Terminals 1 and 3. Las Vegas access is still rolling out to riders, so download the Waymo app and confirm eligibility, your destination and available pickup points at waymo.com.
paras.zh: Waymo 的无人驾驶服务现已覆盖哈里·里德国际机场，并在 1 号和 3 号航站楼归零地层的指定自动驾驶车辆区域提供接送服务。拉斯维加斯仍在向乘客开放，因此请下载 Waymo 应用程序并在 waymo.com 上确认资格、您的目的地和可用的接送点。

paras.en: Travelers picking up a rental car on Friday, Nov. 20, can meet Hertz Gold Squad, the four-legged welcome committee. Trained golden retrievers will greet visitors from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the Hertz rental-car area serving Harry Reid International Airport.
paras.zh: 11 月 20 日星期五提车的旅客可以见到赫兹黄金小队，即四足迎宾委员会。训练有素的金毛猎犬将于上午 11 点至下午 3 点迎接游客。位于哈利·里德国际机场的赫兹租车区。

paras.en: Where to Watch: Trackside Hospitality and Viewing Experiences
paras.zh: 观看地点：赛道旁的接待和观看体验

paras.en: Where F1 Paddock Club, overlooking Turns 1 and 2
paras.zh: F1 围场俱乐部所在地，俯瞰 1 号和 2 号弯

paras.en: What Wynn brings its hospitality trackside, with private terraces overlooking the opening corners, views of the start-finish action and elevated cuisine and cocktails. The suite gives guests a place to settle in between sessions, with Wynn’s service extending beyond the resort. On race night, Los Angeles-based DJ and Love Island USA cast member Bryce Alakai supplies the soundtrack.
paras.zh: 永利 (Wynn) 的赛道旁设有热情好客的设施，设有可俯瞰开场角的私人露台、始末比赛的景观以及高档美食和鸡尾酒。套房为客人在会议间隙提供休息的场所，永利的服务延伸至度假村之外。比赛之夜，洛杉矶 DJ 和 Love Island USA 演员布莱斯·阿拉凯 (Bryce Alakai) 提供配乐。

paras.en: Tickets Single-day tickets are sold out; contact Wynn Race Week for package availability.
paras.zh: 门票 单日票已售完；请联系 Wynn Race Week 了解套餐供应情况。

paras.en: Where Bellagio, overlooking the Strip straightaway and fountains
paras.zh: 贝拉吉奥 (Bellagio) 所在位置，可直接俯瞰拉斯维加斯大道和喷泉

paras.en: What Indoor and rooftop decks face cars exceeding 215 mph, while chefs personally prepare and serve dishes at culinary stations. The roster includes Che Fico’s David Nayfeld, Carbone’s Mario Carbone, José Andrés and David Chang, whose L.A. connections include San Laurel and Majordomo. The Cheese Store of Beverly Hills adds another hometown draw, alongside Gymkhana, Zuma, The Corner Store and cocktails from Shingo Gokan and New York’s Schmuck.
paras.zh: 室内和屋顶甲板面对时速超过 215 英里的汽车，而厨师则在烹饪站亲自准备和提供菜肴。名单中包括 Che Fico 的 David Nayfeld、Carbone 的 Mario Carbone、José Andrés 和 David Chang，他们在洛杉矶的关系包括 San Laurel 和 Majordomo。除了 Gymkhana、Zuma、The Corner Store 以及 Shingo Gokan 和纽约 Schmuck 的鸡尾酒之外，比佛利山庄的 Cheese Store 又增添了一道家乡风味。

paras.en: Tickets $8,400 for three nights, including taxes, fees and unlimited premium food and beverages; check availability through MGM Resorts.
paras.zh: 三晚门票 8,400 美元，含税费和无限量优质食品和饮料；通过米高梅度假村查看空房情况。

paras.en: What Tao brings its nightclub sensibility to the circuit with a trackside pop-up overlooking the Bellagio fountains. Chris Lake plays Friday and Kaz James takes Saturday, with dining, cocktails and VIP bottle service accompanying the racing. Lola Blankets provide a practical extra for November nights outdoors, while the DJ lineup gives guests a reason to stay after the on-track action.
paras.zh: What Tao 将其夜总会风格带到了赛道上，在赛道旁开设了一个俯瞰贝拉吉奥喷泉的快闪店。克里斯·莱克 (Chris Lake) 于周五参赛，卡兹·詹姆斯 (Kaz James) 于周六参赛，比赛期间提供餐饮、鸡尾酒和 VIP 瓶装服务。 Lola 毯子为 11 月的户外夜晚提供了额外的实用空间，而 DJ 阵容则为客人在赛道上的活动结束后提供了留下来的理由。

paras.en: Tickets Book Skydeck packages; guests must be 21 or older.
paras.zh: 门票 预订 Skydeck 套票；客人必须年满 21 岁。

paras.en: Trackside Tavern Presented by Paramount+
paras.zh: Paramount+ 出品的 Trackside Tavern

paras.en: Where Paddock Club rooftop, above pit lane
paras.zh: 地点：围场俱乐部屋顶，维修区上方

paras.en: What Streaming service Paramount+ is the presenting sponsor of this rooftop sports bar, where pit-lane views and oversized screens keep the race in sight. Premium food, beer, wine, spirits and handcrafted cocktails are included. Tickets also offer a pit-lane walk, first-come, first-served paddock and track tours, Paddock Club transportation and access to the Heineken Stage’s entertainment and driver interviews.
paras.zh: 流媒体服务 Paramount+ 是这家屋顶体育酒吧的赞助商，维修区的景色和超大屏幕让比赛尽收眼底。包括优质食品、啤酒、葡萄酒、烈酒和手工调制的鸡尾酒。门票还提供维修区步行、先到先得的围场和赛道之旅、围场俱乐部交通以及喜力舞台的娱乐和司机访谈。

paras.en: Tickets Check Las Vegas Grand Prix for remaining options — Saturday admission from $8,722, including taxes and fees.
paras.zh: 门票 请查看拉斯维加斯大奖赛的剩余选项 - 周六门票 8,722 美元起，含税费。

paras.en: What Watch drivers brake into Turn 12 before accelerating onto the Strip straight from Resorts World’s hospitality space, with unlimited food and beverages. The resort confirms trackside appearances by Stubborn Seed’s Jeremy Ford, chef and restaurateur Marcus Samuelsson, Dominique Crenn, Izu Ani and New York cocktail bar Double Chicken Please. Across the weekend, the visiting chefs and bartenders will prepare and serve signature dishes and drinks.
paras.zh: 观看内容 司机刹车进入 12 号弯，然后从名胜世界的酒店空间加速驶入拉斯维加斯大道，并提供无限量的食物和饮料。度假村确认了 Stubborn Seed 的 Jeremy Ford、主厨兼餐厅老板 Marcus Samuelsson、Dominique Crenn、Izu Ani 和纽约鸡尾酒吧 Double Chicken Please 出现在赛道旁。整个周末，来访的厨师和调酒师将准备并提供招牌菜肴和饮料。

paras.en: Tickets Reserved for hosted Genting Rewards members; contact a casino host about access.
paras.zh: 门票预留给云尊奖赏会员；联系赌场主持人了解访问权限。

paras.en: Where Above The Venetian’s outdoor canal, overlooking Turn 12
paras.zh: 威尼斯人户外运河上方，俯瞰 12 号弯

paras.en: What The Venetian’s invitation-only club pairs views of drivers exiting Turn 12 with a nightly culinary showcase drawn from the resort’s restaurant collection. Wolfgang Puck, Byron Lazaroff-Puck, Thomas Keller, Tetsuya Wakuda, Simon Kim and José Andrés are expected to participate. The elevated canal-side setting puts guests alongside the cars, heading straight onto the Strip.
paras.zh: 威尼斯人的仅限受邀嘉宾的俱乐部将司机驶出 12 号弯的景色与度假村餐厅系列中的夜间美食展示相结合。 Wolfgang Puck、Byron Lazaroff-Puck、Thomas Keller、Tetsuya Wakuda、Simon Kim 和 José Andrés 预计将参加。运河边的高架环境让客人可以沿着汽车直接前往拉斯维加斯大道。

paras.en: Where to Stay: Suites and Race-Weekend Packages
paras.zh: 住宿地点：套房和比赛周末套餐

paras.en: What Milano rolls out for special guests this weekend, introducing a 275-suite hotel within the hotel inspired by Milanese residences. Wimberly Interiors layers Italian millwork and textiles throughout accommodations ranging from 720 to 8,000 square feet. A dedicated entrance and private arrival lounge offer discretion, while the largest Signature Suites come with personal butlers. Dedicated concierges, nightly Milano Moments and a private Dolce&Gabbana pool with custom cabanas complete the experience.
paras.zh: What Milano rolls out for special guests this weekend, introducing a 275-suite hotel within the hotel inspired by Milanese residences. Wimberly Interiors 在 720 至 8,000 平方英尺的住宿空间内铺设了意大利木制品和纺织品。专门的入口和私人抵达休息室为您提供自由裁量权，而最大的特色套房则配有私人管家。专门的礼宾服务、每晚的米兰时刻以及带有定制小屋的杜嘉班纳 (Dolce&Gabbana) 私人泳池让您的体验更加完美。

paras.en: Reservations Invitation-only access during race weekend; public bookings are expected in March 2027.
paras.zh: 预订 比赛周末期间仅限受邀者进入；预计将于 2027 年 3 月开始公开预订。

paras.en: Wynn and Encore: Tower Suites, Villas and Race Packages
paras.zh: Wynn 和 Encore：塔楼套房、别墅和赛事套餐

paras.en: When Race weekend; F1 Experiences hotel stays Nov. 18-22
paras.zh: 当比赛周末； 11 月 18 日至 22 日入住 F1 体验酒店

paras.en: What Stay upstairs from the driver pop-ups and XS afterparties. The Tower Suites offer a private entrance, registration lobby and exclusive concierge. For more room to entertain, Wynn’s Fairway Villas offer butler service and private patios or balconies; select villas also include private pools. In-suite dining and spa services make it possible to recover from race night without leaving your accommodations.
paras.zh: 什么 留在楼上，远离驱动程序弹出窗口和 XS 余兴派对。塔楼套房设有私人入口、登记大厅和专属礼宾服务。为了获得更多的娱乐空间，永利的 Fairway Villas 提供管家服务和私人露台或阳台；部分别墅还设有私人泳池。套房内的餐饮和水疗服务让您无需离开住宿即可从比赛之夜恢复体力。

paras.en: Reservations Book the room-and-ticket Grand Fan Package through Wynn Race Week, or add four nights at Wynn to the F1 Experiences Paddock Club package. Request Tower Suites and villa availability separately.
paras.zh: 预订 通过永利赛车周预订含客房和门票的超级粉丝套餐，或在 F1 体验围场俱乐部套餐中添加永利酒店四晚住宿。单独询问塔楼套房和别墅的供应情况。

paras.en: What The Palazzo’s Racetrack View Suites make the room part of race viewing, overlooking sections of the circuit as it sweeps past Sphere and along the Strip. The resort’s all-suite accommodations, The Venetian’s restaurants and race-week shopping offer one of the most luxurious experiences at LVGP. Request the specific view category when booking: A Palazzo address alone does not guarantee a sightline to the racing.
paras.zh: Palazzo 的赛马场景观套房使房间成为观看比赛的一部分，可以俯瞰赛道横扫 Sphere 并沿拉斯维加斯大道行驶的部分区域。度假村的全套房住宿、威尼斯人酒店的餐厅和比赛周购物提供了 LVGP 最奢华的体验之一。预订时请注明具体的景观类别：仅凭 Palazzo 地址并不能保证能够看到赛车场。

paras.en: Where The Venetian Resort and T-Mobile Zone at Sphere
paras.zh: 位于 Sphere 的威尼斯度假村和 T-Mobile 区

paras.en: What The Venetian’s packages pair a three-night suite stay with three-day T-Mobile Zone grandstand or general-admission tickets, nightly entertainment and early shopping at the F1 Hub. Separate Vibee packages incorporate the Backstreet Boys’ official post-race concert. The resort’s direct connection to Sphere makes it especially convenient for guests moving from the circuit to “Into the Millennium” after Saturday’s checkered flag.
paras.zh: 威尼斯人的套餐包括三晚套房住宿、三天 T-Mobile 区看台或普通门票、夜间娱乐活动以及 F1 中心的提早购物。单独的 Vibee 套餐包含后街男孩的官方赛后音乐会。该度假村与 Sphere 直接相连，对于周六方格旗比赛结束后从赛道前往“进入千禧年”的客人来说特别方便。

paras.en: Reservations Race tickets, concert admission and hotel inclusions through The Venetian.
paras.zh: 通过威尼斯人预订赛事门票、音乐会入场券和酒店套餐。

paras.en: What Floor-to-ceiling windows in every room show off the mountains or Strip, while Fleur de Lis accommodations add VIP lounge check-in and custom Italian linens. At the top end, the four-bedroom, 10,000-square-foot Empire penthouse has a sauna, gym, wellness room, billiards table and butler service. Race-week guests can enjoy a Marc Anthony concert, LIV’s DJs and complimentary Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut and caviar at Collins from 4 to 5 p.m.
paras.zh: 每间客房的落地窗都可欣赏到山脉或拉斯维加斯大道的美景，而 Fleur de Lis 住宿则增设 VIP 休息室登记入住服务和定制意大利床单。位于顶层的帝国顶层公寓拥有四间卧室，面积达 10,000 平方英尺，设有桑拿浴室、健身房、健身室、台球桌和管家服务。比赛周的客人可以在下午 4 点至 5 点在 Collins 欣赏 Marc Anthony 音乐会、LIV 的 DJ 表演以及免费的 Moët & Chandon Impérial Brut 和鱼子酱。

paras.en: Reservations Race Club savings reach 35 percent for Rewards members and 20 percent for nonmembers on eligible accommodations; confirm suite exclusions through Fontainebleau Race Club.
paras.zh: 对于符合条件的住宿，Reservations Race Club 奖励会员可节省 35%，非会员可节省 20%；通过枫丹白露赛马俱乐部确认套房除外。

paras.en: Where Bellagio and the Scuderia Ferrari HP F1 Team Suite
paras.zh: 贝拉吉奥 (Bellagio) 和法拉利车队 (Scuderia Ferrari) HP F1 团队套件在此

paras.en: What Japanese luxury hotel brand ESPACIO, whose collection includes The Jewel of Waikiki in Honolulu, is an official partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP. Its package pairs access to the team’s exclusive suite at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit with a two-night stay in a Bellagio Two Queen Suite. For two adults, the experience includes race-day Paddock Club lunch, private hotel-to-circuit and airport transfers and an assistant to arrange guests’ preferences.
paras.zh: 日本豪华酒店品牌 ESPACIO 是 Scuderia Ferrari HP 的官方合作伙伴，旗下拥有檀香山的 The Jewel of Waikiki 酒店。其套餐包括使用球队在拉斯维加斯大道赛道的专属套房以及贝拉吉奥两张大号床套房的两晚住宿。对于两名成人来说，体验包括比赛日围场俱乐部午餐、私人酒店到赛道和机场的接送服务以及安排客人偏好的助理。

paras.en: Reservations $120,000 for two adults, subject to availability; inquire through ESPACIO.
paras.zh: 两名成人预订费用为 120,000 美元，视供应情况而定；通过ESPACIO查询。

paras.en: What Four Seasons offers a smoke-free, non-gaming retreat, with accommodations on floors 35 through 39 of Mandalay Bay and a 2,225-square-foot Presidential Strip-View Suite wrapped in floor-to-ceiling windows. Downstairs, Paul Oz’s motorsport art joins race-worn helmets and driving suits from the Hall of Fame Collection. At PRESS, the On the Podium menu pairs driver-inspired cocktails with bites such as smoked mini beef Wellington and potato pavé topped with caviar.
paras.zh: What Four Seasons 提供无烟、非博彩休闲场所，客房位于曼德勒湾 35 至 39 层，还有一间 2,225 平方英尺的总统大道景观套房，配有落地窗。楼下，保罗·奥兹 (Paul Oz) 的赛车运动艺术作品与名人堂收藏中的赛车头盔和驾驶服相结合。 PRESS 的 On the Podium 菜单将受司机启发的鸡尾酒与熏制惠灵顿迷你牛肉和鱼子酱土豆泥等小吃搭配。

paras.en: Reservations Book rooms and suites through Four Seasons Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 预订 通过拉斯维加斯四季酒店预订客房和套房。

paras.en: The Biggest Parties, Concerts and Celebrity Events
paras.zh: 最大型的派对、音乐会和名人活动

paras.en: Where Omnia Dayclub & Skybar, Caesars Palace
paras.zh: 地点 Omnia Dayclub & Skybar, 凯撒宫

paras.en: What Roc Nation and Tao Group bring Jay-Z to Omnia’s rooftop for a race-night celebration overlooking the Strip. High-resolution screens show the racing, while live DJs keep the party going late into the night. Premium Experience tickets include an open bar and chef-curated cuisine, making this a dinner, viewing party and nightlife reservation in one.
paras.zh: Roc Nation 和 Tao Group 将 Jay-Z 带到 Omnia 的屋顶，举办俯瞰拉斯维加斯大道的比赛之夜庆祝活动。高分辨率屏幕播放比赛，而现场 DJ 则让派对持续到深夜。高级体验门票包括开放式酒吧和厨师精心烹制的美食，使这里集晚餐、观影派对和夜生活预订于一体。

paras.en: Tickets Premium experiences and table reservations through Tao Group; 21 and older.
paras.zh: 通过Tao Group 购买高级体验门票和餐桌预订； 21 岁及以上。

paras.en: What Uber and Zoox transform the arena into Club Cowboy for a live rodeo experience and headline performance by Kacey Musgraves. The invitation-only Disco Rodeo celebrates Uber’s planned introduction of Zoox robotaxis to its platform, taking transportation from horse-and-carriage history to an autonomous future. Musgraves supplies the country soundtrack to one of race week’s more unexpected brand collaborations.
paras.zh: Uber 和 Zoox 将竞技场改造成牛仔俱乐部，提供现场牛仔竞技体验和 Kacey Musgraves 的精彩表演。仅限受邀人士参加的 Disco Rodeo 庆祝 Uber 计划在其平台上引入 Zoox 机器人出租车，将交通工具从马车历史带入自动驾驶未来。马斯格雷夫斯为比赛周最意想不到的品牌合作之一提供了乡村音乐。

paras.en: Where Poodle Room, Fontainebleau Las Vegas
paras.zh: 地点 贵宾犬室，枫丹白露拉斯维加斯

paras.en: What Corso Marketing Group, Race Service and Dorsia bring Vroom Room back to Poodle Room, Fontainebleau’s members-only club. Carlita plays back-to-back with OMRI, Elvis Guetta joins the lineup and Starino hosts. The invitation-only gathering runs until 3:30 a.m.
paras.zh: Corso Marketing Group、Race Service 和 Dorsia 将 Vroom Room 重新带回枫丹白露会员制俱乐部 Poodle Room。 Carlita 与 OMRI 背靠背比赛，Elvis Guetta 加入阵容，Starino 主持。仅限受邀人士参加的聚会将持续至凌晨 3:30。

paras.en: Tickets Invite only; table inquiries at access@corsomg.com.
paras.zh: 仅限受邀门票；表查询：access@corsomg.com。

paras.en: Backstreet Boys: F1 Afterparty at Sphere
paras.zh: 后街男孩：Sphere 的 F1 余兴派对

paras.en: What The Backstreet Boys bring their “Into the Millennium” production to the first official F1 Afterparty at Sphere. Concert tickets are available to the public without a race ticket, while existing Grand Prix ticket holders can purchase an add-on. Fans can also bundle the concert with three-day grandstand admission.
paras.zh: 内容 The Backstreet Boys 将他们的“Into the Millennium”作品带到 Sphere 举行的首届官方 F1 余兴派对上。音乐会门票无需比赛门票即可向公众出售，而现有的大奖赛门票持有者可以购买附加门票。歌迷还可以将音乐会与三天看台门票捆绑在一起。

paras.en: Tickets Start at $116; race-and-concert packages start at $1,479.
paras.zh: 票价 116 美元起；比赛和音乐会套餐起价为 1,479 美元。

paras.en: Where BleauLive Theater, Fontainebleau Las Vegas
paras.zh: 地点 拉斯维加斯枫丹白露 BeauLive 剧院

paras.en: What Marc Anthony returns for another run of “Vegas…My Way!,” his first Las Vegas residency. The four-time Grammy and eight-time Latin Grammy winner performs English- and Spanish-language hits spanning three decades as a solo artist. With two race-weekend dates, the residency adds a Latin music headliner to Fontainebleau’s entertainment calendar alongside LIV’s DJs and the private Vroom Room party.
paras.zh: 马克·安东尼再次回归“维加斯……我的路！”，这是他在拉斯维加斯的首次驻场表演。这位四届格莱美奖得主和八届拉丁格莱美奖得主以独唱艺术家的身份演奏了三十年来的英语和西班牙语热门歌曲。凭借两次比赛周末的日期，该驻场演出与 LIV 的 DJ 和私人 Vroom Room 派对一起，为枫丹白露的娱乐日历增添了拉丁音乐的头条新闻。

paras.en: Where Proper Eats and Easy’s Cocktail Lounge, ARIA
paras.zh: 适当饮食场所和 Easy’s 鸡尾酒酒廊，ARIA

paras.en: What Carlos Sainz’s viral rendition of Sade’s “Smooth Operator” inspires the returning takeover at Proper Eats, with custom apparel, signature cocktails and a scheduled appearance by Sainz. Adjacent, Easy’s becomes The FiftyFive Lounge with live music and a speakeasy setting.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯 (Carlos Sainz) 对萨德《Smooth Operator》的病毒演绎激发了 Proper Eats 的回归，并提供定制服装、招牌鸡尾酒和塞恩斯的预定露面。毗邻的 Easy’s 则成为 The FiftyFive Lounge，提供现场音乐和地下酒吧环境。

paras.en: Tickets Reservations and event information: easysvegas.com.
paras.zh: 门票预订和活动信息：easysvegas.com。

paras.en: What Beneath Sphere’s illuminated Exosphere, the T-Mobile Zone pairs trackside viewing with three nights of concerts and fan activations. Two Friends and Ja Rule perform Thursday, Disclosure and Gorgon City take Friday, and Sean Paul and Natasha Bedingfield play Saturday.
paras.zh: T-Mobile 区域位于 Sphere 的发光 Exosphere 下方，将赛道旁观看与三晚的音乐会和粉丝活动结合在一起。 《Two Friends》和 Ja Rule 将于周四演出，Disclosure 和 Gorgon City 于周五演出，Sean Paul 和 Natasha Bedingfield 于周六演出。

paras.en: Tickets Concert access is included with T-Mobile Zone grandstand and general-admission tickets.
paras.zh: 门票 T-Mobile 区看台和普通门票包含音乐会门票。

paras.en: When Race weekend; Grid performances Nov. 21
paras.zh: 当比赛周末； 11 月 21 日网格表演

paras.en: Where Las Vegas Strip Circuit and designated hospitality areas
paras.zh: 拉斯维加斯大道赛道和指定接待区

paras.en: What Steve Aoki performs before the race, Morten supplies the soundtrack leading into driver introductions and Jordin Sparks sings the national anthem. Inside Paddock Club, mentalist Colin Cloud joins the cast of “Now You See Me Live,” the illusion show inspired by Lionsgate’s film franchise. Wynn Grid Club adds a race-night set by Los Angeles DJ and “Love Island USA” cast member Bryce Alakai.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·青木 (Steve Aoki) 在赛前表演，莫滕 (Morten) 为车手介绍提供配乐，乔丁·斯帕克斯 (Jordin Sparks) 演唱国歌。在围场俱乐部内，心理学家科林·克劳德 (Colin Cloud) 加入了《Now You See Me Live》的演员阵容，这是一部受狮门影业电影系列启发的幻觉表演。 Wynn Grid Club 新增了由洛杉矶 DJ 和《Love Island USA》演员布莱斯·阿拉凯 (Bryce Alakai) 打造的比赛之夜。

paras.en: Tickets Grandstand and hospitality tickets offer views of Grid performances; Paddock Club and Wynn Grid Club programming require additional access.
paras.zh: 门票 主看台和接待门票可观看 Grid 表演； Paddock Club 和 Wynn Grid Club 节目需要额外的访问权限。

paras.en: What to Buy: Driver Pop-Ups, Fashion, Jewelry and Collectibles
paras.zh: 买什么：司机快闪店、时装、珠宝和收藏品

paras.en: What Charles Leclerc brings his CL16 world to Café Al Teatro with a takeover spanning pastries, drinks and merchandise.
paras.zh: Charles Leclerc 将他的 CL16 世界带入 Café Al Teatro，收购了糕点、饮料和商品。

paras.en: Where Awakening Theater lobby, Wynn Las Vegas
paras.zh: 地点 拉斯维加斯永利酒店觉醒剧院大厅

paras.en: What Lando Norris’ LN4 turns its race-week shop into a vintage-style members’ lounge, with the driver’s Vegas helmet on display and a collection inspired by it. The limited-edition Vegas 26 assortment uses black and gold and playing-card references, with pieces available only at the Clubhouse alongside a selection of LN4 favorites.
paras.zh: Lando Norris 的 LN4 将其比赛周商店变成了复古风格的会员休息室，展示了车手的 Vegas 头盔以及受其启发的系列。限量版 Vegas 26 系列采用黑色和金色以及扑克牌元素，其中的单品仅在 Clubhouse 出售，同时还有精选的 LN4 最爱。

paras.en: What Lewis Hamilton’s streetwear brand returns to Encore with a limited-edition collection. The temporary boutique gives fans a chance to shop +44 between race sessions, adding another driver-founded label to Wynn’s weeklong lineup of retail collaborations.
paras.zh: Lewis Hamilton 的街头服饰品牌以限量版系列回归 Encore。这家临时精品店为车迷们提供了在比赛间隙购买 +44 的机会，为永利为期一周的零售合作系列增添了另一个由车手创立的品牌。

paras.en: Apple TV Espresso Club, Fueled by GRINDIN
paras.zh: Apple TV Espresso Club，由 GRINDIN 推动

paras.en: When Nov. 20–21; menu 7 a.m.–11 p.m., sampling 8–9 a.m.
paras.zh: 11 月 20 日至 21 日；上午 7 点至晚上 11 点提供菜单，上午 8 点至上午 9 点取样

paras.en: What Pharrell Williams and Pusha T’s coffee brand joins Apple TV for P’s Way cold brew, T’s Way espresso and Patty Cake caramel latte with marshmallow foam. The first 100 special-menu customers daily receive a hat, pin and stickers, while supplies last.
paras.zh: What Pharrell Williams and Pusha T’s coffee brand joins Apple TV for P’s Way cold brew, T’s Way espresso and Patty Cake caramel latte with marshmallow foam.每天前 100 名特殊菜单顾客会收到帽子、别针和贴纸，送完即止。

paras.en: F1 Las Vegas Hub Presented by American Express
paras.zh: 由美国运通主办的 F1 拉斯维加斯中心

paras.en: When Through Nov. 29; race-week hours Nov. 18-22, 8 a.m.-9 p.m.
paras.zh: 截止 11 月 29 日；比赛周时间 11 月 18 日至 22 日，上午 8 点至晚上 9 点

paras.en: What Driver gear meets designer collaborations at the F1 Hub, with fashion and collectibles in one shop.
paras.zh: 车手装备与 F1 中心的设计师合作相结合，时尚和收藏品集中在一家商店。

paras.zh: - 淡季：Kristin Juszczyk 和 Emma Grede 的粉丝服装品牌带来了一件超大人造皮革赛车夹克、一件合身的女式人造皮革赛车夹克和一件图案 T 恤。

paras.zh: - Greg Yuna：这家珠宝商提供独一无二的珠宝和带有 Yunits 吊饰的定制站，包括特殊的 3D 打印设计和独特包装中的真正宝石。他的比赛周活动也延伸至 F1 围场。

paras.en: - Etai LA x Felipe Pantone: Los Angeles label Etai LA contributes specialty pieces and 3D-printed items, plus a hoodie and T-shirt collaboration with artist Felipe Pantone.

paras.en: - Disney, BAPE, LEGO and Hello Kitty: Shop Mickey & Friends, Pixar’s “Cars,” LEGO apparel and plush, BAPE racewear and Hello Kitty collaborations. See the Hello Kitty-wrapped F1 Academy car and customize headwear.
paras.zh: - 迪士尼、BAPE、乐高和 Hello Kitty：购买米奇和朋友们、皮克斯的“赛车总动员”、乐高服装和毛绒玩具、BAPE 赛车服和 Hello Kitty 合作款。参观 Hello Kitty 包裹的 F1 学院赛车并定制头饰。

paras.en: - Where to Buy Purchase on-site at the Hub; Greg Yuna’s Paddock location requires the appropriate credential. Eligible American Express cardmembers can enroll for a $20 statement credit after spending $100.
paras.zh: - 购买地点 在中心现场购买； Greg Yuna 的 Paddock 位置需要适当的凭证。符合条件的美国运通卡会员消费 100 美元后即可获得 20 美元的对账单积分。

paras.zh: 拉斯维加斯四季和 F1 围场俱乐部的所在地

paras.zh: Paul Oz 的汽车艺术构成了四季赛车运动月的一部分，而 Core Art Gallery 在 Paddock Club 展出了 Antoine Dufilho 创作的 12 件受 F1 启发的雕塑。

A wireless charging handgrip, matching thumb rest and branded rope strap complete the look.
paras.zh: 徕卡 Formula 1 版本将碳纤维组件和受方向盘启发的 Microvelour 与 43mm 镜头结合在一起。专用的F1图像设置可增加对比度和饱和度；全画幅传感器可拍摄 60、36 或 18 兆像素。无线充电手柄、配套的拇指托和品牌绳带使外观更加完美。

paras.zh: 其中永利和安可；东区休息室的迈凯伦休息室

Eastside Lounge becomes the McLaren Lounge, with golf simulators on the patio, while former racing driver and broadcaster Justin Bell records Drive to Wynn conversations with Formula 1 figures at Wynn’s SiriusXM studio.
paras.zh: 迪士尼和皮克斯的《玩具总动员》角色为保时捷 911 合作汽车提供了灵感，在度假村周围展示。 Eastside Lounge 变成了 McLaren Lounge，露台上设有高尔夫模拟器，前赛车手兼广播员 Justin Bell 在 Wynn 的 SiriusXM 工作室录制了 Drive to Wynn 与一级方程式赛车人物的对话。

paras.zh: What The Female Quotient 和 F1 Academy 在黛利拉举办了比赛周聚会，将赛车运动和商业领域的女性置于对话的中心。该计划考察赛道内外的可见性、包容性和机会。

paras.en: What Heather McMahan hosts a morning devoted to the business surrounding Formula 1, with announced speakers including Stefano Domenicali and Liberty Media’s Derek Chang. The program brings sport into the chat with entertainment, hospitality, fashion and investment as top-of-mind topics.
paras.zh: 希瑟·麦克马汉 (Heather McMahan) 主持了一个专门讨论一级方程式业务的上午活动，宣布的演讲者包括 Stefano Domenicali 和 Liberty Media 的 Derek Chang。该节目将体育带入聊天中，娱乐、酒店、时尚和投资成为首要话题。

articles.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition ahead of meeting with Trump, Xi

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — Russian President Vladimir Putin said the European Union was falling behind competition in a speech Wednesday at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation CEO Summit.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周三在亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会上发表讲话时表示，欧盟在竞争中落后。

paras.en: "The EU is now losing its industrial capacity and it's losing in the competition," Putin said, according to an official English translation.
paras.zh: 根据官方英文翻译，普京表示：“欧盟现在正在失去其工业能力，并且正在竞争中失败。”

paras.en: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country, from tech to economic development.
paras.zh: 普京在讲话中强调了俄罗斯在美国制裁下的经济韧性，并强调了该国为亚太经合组织成员提供的从科技到经济发展的机遇。

paras.en: He was the third APEC leader to speak at the summit, and followed remarks by Chinese President Xi Jinping and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.
paras.zh: 他是继中国国家主席习近平和马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣之后在峰会上发表讲话的第三位亚太经合组织领导人。

paras.en: In his speech, Putin highlighted the country's ability to withstand a sharp drop in its U.S. dollar- and euro-denominated transactions. He also urged members to support Russia in hosting APEC in 2035.
paras.zh: 普京在讲话中强调了该国承受美元和欧元计价交易大幅下滑的能力。他还敦促成员支持俄罗斯主办2035年APEC会议。

paras.en: The Russian leader is set to hold talks on Thursday with Xi and U.S. President Donald Trump in a historic meeting that could see a wide range of issues being discussed, including nuclear non-proliferation and also possibly Russia's war with Ukraine. He met with Xi on Wednesday, according to Chinese state media.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯领导人将于周四与习近平和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普举行历史性会议，会议可能会讨论广泛的问题，包括核不扩散，也可能包括俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。据中国官方媒体报道，他于周三会见了习近平。

paras.en: Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov said last week the meeting in Shenzhen would continue the efforts aimed at reaching a negotiated settlement to the Ukraine war, according to state-controlled local media Russia Today.
paras.zh: 据国家控制的当地媒体《今日俄罗斯》报道，俄罗斯总统助手尤里·乌沙科夫上周表示，深圳会议将继续努力通过谈判解决乌克兰战争。

paras.en: The summit will likely yield little concrete result, but presents an "almost 100% photo op" that lifts China's status and power at the top table, David Roche, strategist at Quantum Strategy, told CNBC's "Access Middle East" earlier this week.
paras.zh: Quantum Strategy策略师戴维·罗奇(David Roche)本周早些时候在CNBC的“访问中东”节目中表示，这次峰会可能不会产生什么具体成果，但会带来“几乎100%的拍照机会”，从而提升中国在最高会议上的地位和权力。

paras.en: — CNBC's Anniek Bao contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Anniek Bao 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Senators press acting U.S. Navy Secretary on Iran war costs, sailor health in confirmation hearing

paras.en: Acting U.S. Navy Secretary Hung Cao's confirmation hearing before the Senate Armed Services Committee led to some heated exchanges as he was grilled about sailors' health and the Iran war.
paras.zh: 美国代理海军部长曹洪在参议院军事委员会举行的确认听证会引发了一些激烈的交锋，因为他被问及水手的健康和伊朗战争。

paras.en: The Navy changed condition codes on munitions previously classified as expired in order to use them, Cao told senators Tuesday, as lawmakers questioned the conflict's strain on weapons stocks and naval deployments. He also said the military had increased production of key weapons.
paras.zh: 曹周二告诉参议员，海军更改了之前被归类为过期弹药的条件代码，以便使用它们，因为立法者质疑冲突对武器库存和海军部署的压力。他还表示，军方增加了关键武器的生产。

paras.en: "When I was in uniform, we only produced 125 Tomahawks a year. Right now, we're well above 60 every month," he said, adding that the military was working to increase SM-6 missile production and bring in additional ammunition manufacturers.
paras.zh: “当我穿制服时，我们每年只生产 125 枚战斧。现在，我们每个月的产量远远超过 60 枚，”他说，并补充说军方正在努力增加 SM-6 导弹产量并引进更多弹药制造商。

paras.en: Cao's confirmation hearing comes as the Republicans, who hold a majority in both the House and Senate, are coming to the end of their time in power in both houses. The Democratic Party flipped many seats in the midterm elections to win a comfortable majority in the next session starting in January. President Donald Trump's nominees for offices, and his legislative agenda, will face much tougher challenges then.
paras.zh: 曹的确认听证会召开之际，在参众两院均占多数的共和党在参众两院的执政时间即将结束。民主党在中期选举中翻转了许多席位，在 1 月份开始的下一次选举中赢得了轻松的多数席位。唐纳德·特朗普总统的公职提名人和他的立法议程届时将面临更加严峻的挑战。

paras.en: Cao said the Navy was accelerating work on unmanned surface vessels to relieve the 17 destroyers supporting the blockade of Iran's ships, in hopes of reducing the strain on the Fifth Fleet. But Senators still pointed to the war's effect on the Navy's resources.
paras.zh: 曹说，海军正在加快无人水面舰艇的研制工作，以缓解支持封锁伊朗船只的17艘驱逐舰，希望减轻第五舰队的压力。但参议员们仍然指出战争对海军资源的影响。

paras.en: "For the first time in many years, the United States has no forward-deployed carrier in the Pacific at this moment," Sen. Jack Reed (D-R.I.) noted.
paras.zh: 罗德岛州参议员杰克·里德指出：“美国目前在太平洋地区没有部署任何前沿部署的航母，这是多年来的第一次。”

paras.en: Cao acknowledged that the war was "stressing our naval resources." However, he argued that the demonstration of combined American military capabilities had "really set China back on their heels," a characterization Sen. Mazie Hirono (D-Hawaii) disputed.
paras.zh: 曹承认，这场战争“给我们的海军资源带来了压力”。然而，他认为，美国联合军事能力的展示“确实让中国望而却步”，夏威夷民主党参议员马齐·广野(Mazie Hirono)对此提出异议。

paras.en: Lawmakers also pressed Cao on the war's financial costs, with Cao appearing to agree with Sen. Elizabeth Warren's (D-Mass.) estimate of approximately $32.5 million a day in costs to maintain the blockade on Iranian ports.
paras.zh: 议员们还就战争的财务成本向曹施压，曹似乎同意参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦（马萨诸塞州民主党人）的估计，即维持对伊朗港口的封锁每天的成本约为 3250 万美元。

paras.en: The demands of prolonged deployments have raised concerns about sailors' access to food and basic supplies, as Cao told senators that the destroyer USS Gonzalez had a week of rations remaining.
paras.zh: 长期部署的要求引发了人们对水兵获得食物和基本补给的担忧，因为曹告诉参议员，驱逐舰冈萨雷斯号还剩下一周的口粮。

paras.en: "Usually, I don't like them to go below two weeks of supplies," he said, while insisting the provisions were adequate and ships had never run out of food.
paras.zh: “通常情况下，我不希望他们的供应量低于两周，”他说，同时坚称供应充足，而且船只从未耗尽食物。

paras.en: When Sen. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) asked about reports of sailors losing 45 pounds, Cao stated that the food preferences might not be to certain sailors' liking.
paras.zh: 当参议员马克·凯利（亚利桑那州民主党人）询问有关水手减重 45 磅的报道时，曹表示，某些水手的食物偏好可能不合他们的口味。

paras.en: He likened it to his children opening the refrigerator door and saying "there's nothing to eat here."
paras.zh: 他把这比作他的孩子打开冰箱门说“这里没有东西吃”。

paras.en: "Losing 45 pounds is more serious than just not liking the food. Our sailors are being asked to serve thousands of miles from home for months at a time. We have a responsibility to make sure they have what they need to do their jobs and stay healthy," Kelly posted on X.
paras.zh: “减掉 45 磅比仅仅不喜欢食物更严重。我们的水手被要求一次在离家数千英里的地方服务数月。我们有责任确保他们拥有完成工作和保持健康所需的东西，”凯利在 X 上发帖说。

paras.en: Senators also questioned Cao about eight suicide attempts across the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group during its deployment. Cao defended the Navy's mental health support, describing the incidents as "eight suicide mitigations" because personnel had intervened.
paras.zh: 参议员们还就亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰打击群在部署期间发生的八起自杀事件向曹提出质询。曹为海军的心理健康支持进行了辩护，称这些事件是“八次自杀式缓解”，因为人员进行了干预。

paras.en: Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-N.Y.) called the term "mitigations" an "insult," saying they should be called suicide attempts.
paras.zh: 纽约州民主党参议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德 (Kirsten Gillibrand) 称“缓解”一词是一种“侮辱”，并称其应被称为自杀未遂。

paras.en: The questioning followed an earlier acknowledgment by the top U.S. commander in the Middle East of mental health concerns aboard the Lincoln.
paras.zh: 此次询问之前，美国中东地区最高指挥官早些时候承认林肯号上存在心理健康问题。

paras.en: Cao pledged that the entire Department of the Navy would achieve a clean financial audit by the end of the fiscal year. The Pentagon has had nine consecutive failures to obtain a clean department-wide audit opinion, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 曹承诺，整个海军部将在本财年结束前实现廉洁的财务审计。据路透社报道，五角大楼已连续九次未能获得全部门干净的审计意见。

paras.en: "We owe the American public to tell them exactly where their money is," he said.
paras.zh: “我们有责任让美国公众准确地告诉他们他们的钱在哪里，”他说。

paras.en: If you are having thoughts of suicide, please know that you are not alone. If you are in danger of acting on suicidal thoughts, call 911. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org.
paras.zh: 如果您有自杀的念头，请知道您并不孤单。如果您有自杀念头的危险，请致电 911。如果您或您认识的人正在挣扎或陷入危机，可以寻求帮助。致电或发短信 988 或通过 988lifeline.org 聊天。

articles.title: Stock futures rise as Nvidia gains on earnings beat and solid outlook: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures climbed Wednesday morning after the S&P 500 fell for a fourth straight day. Traders also weighed Nvidia's better-than-expected earnings report.
paras.zh: 在标准普尔 500 指数连续第四天下跌后，股指期货周三上午上涨。交易员还权衡了英伟达好于预期的盈利报告。

paras.en: Nasdaq-100 futures were up 0.61%, while S&P 500 futures added 0.25%. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures traded up 25 points, close to the flatline.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 0.61%，标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.25%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 25 点，接近平盘线。

paras.en: Most Asian markets closed in positive territory after a choppy trading session.
paras.zh: 经过波动的交易时段后，大多数亚洲市场收盘上涨。

paras.en: South Korea's Kospi led gains in the region as chip heavyweights gained ground, ending 1.99% higher at 5,067.44, while Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 0.28% to close at 59,024.28,
paras.zh: 随着芯片权重股上涨，韩国综合股价指数 (Kospi) 领涨该地区，最终上涨 1.99%，收于 5,067.44 点，而日本日经 225 指数上涨 0.28%，收于 59,024.28 点。

paras.en: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index was 0.87% lower in its final hour of trade, while the CSI 300 on mainland China advanced 0.18% to 3,983.77. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 slipped 0.69%, marking a fifth straight day of losses.
paras.zh: 香港恒生指数在最后一小时下跌 0.87%，而中国内地沪深 300 指数上涨 0.18%，至 3,983.77 点。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.69%，连续第五天下跌。

paras.en: Shares of Nvidia jumped 4% in extended trading after the company's profit and revenue in the third quarter beat analysts' estimates. The company also lifted its revenue guidance for the fiscal year ending January 2028, calling for 75% growth year over year.
paras.zh: 英伟达第三季度利润和收入超过分析师预期后，该公司股价在盘后交易中上涨 4%。该公司还提高了截至 2028 年 1 月财年的收入指引，预计同比增长 75%。

paras.en: "The fact that they gave guidance is huge," said Gene Munster, managing partner at Deepwater Asset Management, on CNBC's "Closing Bell: Overtime." "That is a very bullish sign. I expect the stock to move higher based just on that alone."
paras.zh: 深水资产管理公司 (Deepwater Asset Management) 执行合伙人吉恩·蒙斯特 (Gene Munster) 在 CNBC 节目《收盘钟声：加时赛》中表示：“他们提供的指导意义重大。” “这是一个非常乐观的迹象。仅凭这一点，我预计该股就会走高。”

paras.en: Neocloud companies also rose in extended trading. CoreWeave advanced 8%, while Nebius Group gained 10%.
paras.zh: Neocloud 公司在盘后交易中也有所上涨。 CoreWeave 上涨 8%，而 Nebius Group 上涨 10%。

paras.en: During the regular trading day, the Dow dropped 1.6%. The S&P 500 slipped 1% and notched its lowest closing level since July 29, while the Nasdaq Composite shed 0.7%. During the day, the tech-heavy index touched its lowest level since April.
paras.zh: 常规交易日，道指下跌 1.6%。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1%，创下 7 月 29 日以来的最低收盘水平，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.7%。当天，以科技股为主的指数触及四月份以来的最低水平。

paras.en: Heading into Wednesday, traders are awaiting building permits and housing starts data. The Federal Open Market Committee's minutes from its October meeting will also be out in the afternoon. Federal Reserve policymakers last month decided to keep the overnight funds rate in a range of 3.75% to 4%.
paras.zh: 进入周三，交易员正在等待建筑许可和新屋开工数据。联邦公开市场委员会十月份会议纪要也将于下午发布。美联储政策制定者上个月决定将隔夜基金利率维持在3.75%至4%的范围内。

paras.en: On the earnings front, Lowe's, Target and TJ Maxx-parent TJX Cos are slated to report Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 在盈利方面，劳氏 (Lowe's)、塔吉特 (Target) 和 TJ Maxx 母公司 TJX Cos 定于周三上午公布财报。

paras.en: Later this week, investors are awaiting a blockbuster initial public offering from Anthropic. The AI giant's shares are expected to be priced above the current range between $70 and $78, multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 本周晚些时候，投资者正在等待 Anthropic 的大规模首次公开募股。多名消息人士周二告诉 CNBC 的 David Faber，这家人工智能巨头的股价预计将高于当前 70 至 78 美元的区间。

articles.title: Why the Pentagon is hunting for gallium in a mountain of red mud

paras.en: About a decade ago geologist Amitava Roy received a sample of “red mud.” Red mud looks like clay with Instagram’s Lux feature cranked up, and it’s the residue left by the most common process for making alumina, the stuff that becomes aluminum. The sample had come from a production plant in Burnside, La., not far from Baton Rouge, where Roy works at Louisiana State University (LSU).
paras.zh: 大约十年前，地质学家阿米塔瓦·罗伊收到了一份“赤泥”样本。赤泥看起来像粘土，打开了 Instagram 的 Lux 功能，它是最常见的氧化铝制造过程中留下的残留物，而氧化铝是铝的材料。该样品来自路易斯安那州伯恩赛德的一家生产工厂，距离巴吞鲁日不远，罗伊在路易斯安那州立大学 (LSU) 工作。

paras.en: Roy was curious about what red mud was made of and how its elements were arranged, and he had the means to find out. LSU is home to one of the country’s few synchrotrons: a particle accelerator whose x-rays let scientists probe the makeup of materials. Roy could shine those rays at the red mud and discover both its contents and what chemical forms they took.
paras.zh: 罗伊很好奇赤泥是由什么构成的，元素又是如何排列的，他也有办法找出答案。路易斯安那州立大学拥有美国为数不多的同步加速器之一：一台粒子加速器，科学家可以通过其 X 射线探测材料的构成。罗伊可以将这些光线照射到赤泥上，从而发现其内容物以及它们所呈现的化学形式。

paras.en: When he did, he found a lot of loosely bound gallium, a soft and silvery metal. He filed that away as part of his overall analysis of the substance. It was a scientific note but one nobody else paid much attention to—until recently. “Then I realized people are interested,” he says.
paras.zh: 当他这样做时，他发现了许多松散结合的镓，一种柔软的银色金属。他将其归档，作为对该物质进行整体分析的一部分。这是一篇科学笔记，但直到最近才引起其他人的重视。 “然后我意识到人们很感兴趣，”他说。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Those people are, these days, from the government. Gallium is essential to the war machine; gallium-based semiconductors go into everything from radar and satellite solar panels to electronic-warfare systems and missile seekers. And the military’s appetite for it keeps growing now that the country is burning through munitions and the metals inside them thanks to, you know, war.
paras.zh: 如今，这些人来自政府。镓对于战争机器至关重要；镓基半导体应用于从雷达和卫星太阳能电池板到电子战系统和导弹导引头的各个领域。由于战争，该国正在燃烧弹药及其内部的金属，因此军方对它的需求不断增长。

paras.en: There’s just one problem: “It’s almost exclusively produced in China,” Roy says.
paras.zh: 只有一个问题：“它几乎完全在中国生产，”罗伊说。

paras.en: China accounts for nearly 99 percent of the world’s gallium. The U.S. hasn’t made any of its own since the 1980s and has no stockpile to fall back on—a vulnerability that Washington has only lately begun taking seriously.
paras.zh: 中国占全球镓产量的近99%。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，美国就没有自己生产过任何此类产品，也没有可供依靠的库存——华盛顿最近才开始认真对待这一弱点。

paras.en: In 2023 Beijing put export controls on certain minerals, including gallium. Anyone sending them abroad needed a special license and had to disclose whom they were selling to. At first most exporters got those licenses without much trouble. In December 2024 China banned the sale of gallium, germanium and antimony to the U.S. outright—then, in the fall of 2025, suspended that decision as part of a trade truce that runs out in January. But even with the ban on hold, according to a report from the Center for Strategic and International Studies, “there is growing evidence that Chinese exports of gallium to the United States have not resumed in a meaningful way.”
paras.zh: 2023 年，北京对包括镓在内的某些矿物实施出口管制。任何将它们发送到国外的人都需要特殊许可证，并且必须披露它们的销售对象。起初，大多数出口商没有遇到太多麻烦就获得了这些许可证。 2024 年 12 月，中国全面禁止向美国出售镓、锗和锑，然后在 2025 年秋季，作为 1 月份到期的贸易休战协议的一部分，暂停了这一决定。但根据战略与国际研究中心的一份报告，即使禁令被搁置，“越来越多的证据表明，中国对美国的镓出口尚未以有意义的方式恢复。”

paras.en: So the U.S. is trying, belatedly, to get its own supply. Gallium is now the subject of federal contracts worth hundreds of millions of dollars, part of a larger push by the Department of Defense to secure “critical minerals” at home—one that has spurred a more general mining revival.
paras.zh: 因此，美国正在试图获得自己的供应，但姗姗来迟。镓现在是价值数亿美元的联邦合同的主题，这是国防部为确保国内“关键矿产”而采取的更大努力的一部分，这一举措刺激了更广泛的采矿业复兴。

paras.en: Unlike some critical minerals, though, gallium doesn’t require spinning up a new mine or resurrecting an old one. It’s already lying around practically in Roy’s backyard. China has been pulling gallium out of its alumina refineries for years.
paras.zh: 不过，与一些关键矿物不同的是，镓不需要建造新矿或恢复旧矿。它几乎已经躺在罗伊的后院了。多年来，中国一直在从其氧化铝精炼厂中撤出镓。

paras.en: The U.S. is trying to do the same, and it could just work: the country doesn’t need much. It uses around 22 tons of gallium each year, and by one estimate, capturing just 1 percent of the gallium that’s being trashed at alumina and zinc refineries would cover that.
paras.zh: 美国正在尝试做同样的事情，而且它可能会奏效：该国不需要太多。它每年使用约 22 吨镓，据估计，仅捕获氧化铝和锌精炼厂废弃的镓的 1% 就可以满足这一需求。

paras.en: One of the best places to get it is Gramercy, La., where Atlantic Alumina, the only operating alumina refinery in the U.S., has red mud piles weighing more than 30 million tons. The Pentagon has awarded a company called ElementUSA $30 million for a demonstration plant meant to show it can strip the mud of gallium and of scandium, which strengthens the aluminum used in military aircraft and armor. The company also plans to build an $850-million extraction facility on-site. (Neither the DOD nor ElementUSA responded to requests for comment.)
paras.zh: 获得赤泥的最佳地点之一是路易斯安那州的格拉梅西，那里的大西洋氧化铝公司（Atlantic Alumina）是美国唯一一家运营的氧化铝精炼厂，其赤泥堆的重量超过 3000 万吨。五角大楼授予一家名为 ElementUSA 的公司 3000 万美元用于建设示范工厂，旨在展示该工厂可以去除泥中的镓和钪，从而增强军用飞机和装甲中使用的铝的强度。该公司还计划在现场建造一座价值 8.5 亿美元的开采设施。 （国防部和 ElementUSA 都没有回应置评请求。）

paras.en: And the refinery itself, backed by $400 million from the DOD, is coming at the problem from the other end by catching gallium before it ever reaches the pile. In August the refinery said it expected to produce its first gallium by the end of the year and, eventually, 50 tons a year—more than twice the amount the whole country uses.
paras.zh: 而炼油厂本身在国防部 4 亿美元的支持下，正在从另一端解决问题，在镓到达堆之前将其捕获。 8 月，该炼油厂表示预计将在今年年底前生产出第一批镓，最终达到每年 50 吨的产量，是全国用量的两倍多。

paras.en: Roy, who isn’t working with ElementUSA or the refinery, is also trying to use his scientific finding to interest the government. He recently submitted a proposal to the Department of Energy and is waiting to hear back. The department has already selected five other projects to recover gallium, including one with the alumina manufacturer in Gramercy.
paras.zh: 罗伊没有与 ElementUSA 或炼油厂合作，他也试图利用他的科学发现来引起政府的兴趣。他最近向能源部提交了一份提案，正在等待回复。该部门已经选择了另外五个回收镓的项目，其中包括与格拉梅西的氧化铝制造商合作的一个项目。

paras.en: Anyone trying to separate critical minerals from industrial waste needs detailed science like the kind Roy has done. “If you want to extract something, you need to know where it is and how it is there,” he says. The how is particularly important; extraction methods differ depending on the form an element or compound takes—whether it’s locked in a complicated chemical structure or easily separated out.
paras.zh: 任何试图从工业废物中分离关键矿物的人都需要像罗伊所做的那样的详细科学。 “如果你想提取某些东西，你需要知道它在哪里以及它是如何存在的，”他说。如何做尤为重要；提取方法根据元素或化合物的形式而有所不同——无论它是锁定在复杂的化学结构中还是很容易分离出来。

paras.en: Waste-stream extraction is ElementUSA’s specialty. The company calls the approach “minerals without mines.” According to statements by Colorado School of Mines professor Elizabeth Holley, who is working with the company to extract rare earth elements from the same red mud, the work pays off twice: it squeezes more value out of things that were already mined, and it helps to reduce the caustic sludge left behind.
paras.zh: 废物流提取是 ElementUSA 的专长。该公司称这种方法为“无矿开采”。科罗拉多矿业学院教授伊丽莎白·霍利 (Elizabeth Holley) 正在与该公司合作，从同样的赤泥中提取稀土元素。根据她的说法，这项工作获得了双重回报：它从已开采的东西中榨取了更多价值，并且有助于减少留下的腐蚀性污泥。

paras.en: And there are plenty of other forgotten places where the same work could happen for gallium and other critical minerals. ElementUSA has already pinpointed more bauxite sites in Texas and elsewhere in Louisiana. “I was talking to somebody, and he goes birding in North Baton Rouge,” Roy says. One day this friend came across red mud from a long-closed facility. “All these piles are there,” he says.
paras.zh: 还有很多其他被遗忘的地方，可以对镓和其他关键矿物进行同样的工作。 ElementUSA 已经在德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州其他地方确定了更多铝土矿地点。 “我正在和某人聊天，他去北巴吞鲁日观鸟，”罗伊说。有一天，这位朋友从一处长期关闭的设施中发现了赤泥。 “所有这些堆都在那里，”他说。

paras.en: They were just waiting for someone to want them for war.
paras.zh: 他们只是在等待有人要他们参加战争。

articles.title: Why Nvidia is betting on silicon photonics to scale AI

paras.en: Maybe a company that designs around 85 percent of the graphics chips the world uses for artificial intelligence and has topped $5 trillion in market value is allowed to crow a bit. When corporations get this big, they build arcologies—self-contained, spaceship-looking headquarters. Nvidia’s monumental, midcentury-styled, vaguely pyramidal buildings loom amid a cluster of more normal office parks in Santa Clara, Calif., at the southern end of San Francisco Bay. Inside, staircases and mezzanines overlook a huge atrium, evoking, somewhat disquietingly, the prison labor camp from the Star Wars TV show Andor, if that camp had gray accent walls and swapped its electroshock floors for coffee nooks.
paras.zh: 也许一家设计了全球约 85% 用于人工智能的图形芯片且市值超过 5 万亿美元的公司可以稍微沾沾自喜。当公司发展到如此规模时，他们会建造生态建筑——独立的、看起来像宇宙飞船的总部。位于旧金山湾南端的加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，英伟达的宏伟、世纪中叶风格、隐约呈金字塔形的建筑矗立在一群较为普通的办公园区中。在里面，楼梯和夹层俯瞰着一个巨大的中庭，让人有点不安地想起星球大战电视节目安多尔的监狱劳改营，如果那个劳改营有灰色的墙壁，并将其电击地板换成咖啡角的话。

paras.en: Anyway, as in ancient Egypt, these pyramids are mostly symbolic. The real action is a car ride away, at an engineering laboratory in a location I agreed to keep secret. Here Nvidia’s technologists have splayed open a few of the things they make. One is an older rack-mounted server, a computer built into a drawer that slides into the tall, narrow racks that, arrayed together, make a data center. This one’s brains are a couple of graphics processing units, or GPUs, the type of chip that made Nvidia wealthy, plus the various guts that keep them cool and connected. Then there’s a newer version: many of the parts are housed in modules that can be swapped in and out like a gun’s ammo magazines, and instead of a row of small electric fans to keep everything at a happy temperature, it has ducts and copper tubes that carry coolant. All these things improve reliability and speed up installation and repairs; when you’re selling zillions, a few minutes here and there really add up.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，就像在古埃及一样，这些金字塔大多是象征性的。真正的行动是在驱车前往一个工程实验室，地点是我同意保密的地方。英伟达的技术专家在这里展示了他们制造的一些产品。一种是老式的机架式服务器，这是一台内置于抽屉中的计算机，可滑入又高又窄的机架中，这些机架排列在一起，形成一个数据中心。它的大脑是几个图形处理单元（GPU），正是这种芯片让英伟达变得富有，再加上各种让它们保持冷静和连接的内部结构。然后是一个更新的版本：许多零件都装在可以像枪的弹药库一样换入和换出的模块中，并且它没有使用一排小电风扇来保持所有东西都处于适宜的温度，而是具有输送冷却剂的管道和铜管。所有这些都提高了可靠性并加快了安装和维修速度；当你的销量不计其数时，这里或那里几分钟的时间加起来确实很重要。

paras.en: But the coolest thing is another device that slides into those racks—one that’s more about connectivity than computation. It turns out moving data can be a bigger bottleneck than doing the math. So Nvidia’s newest switches bring electrons and photons—two nonoverlapping magisteria in the world of computing—together in one package. It’s called co-packaged optics, and it’s proof that the vast scale of Nvidia’s Santa Clara arcology matters a lot less than the subatomic scale of electrons handing off trillions of bits to photons each second. AI needs thousands of chips to act together as one enormous computer, which works only if they talk to one another fast enough. Nvidia already sells most of those chips. If the company also controls the way they communicate, it could set the pace for the next phase of the AI boom.
paras.zh: 但最酷的事情是另一个滑入这些机架的设备——它更多的是连接性而不是计算性。事实证明，移动数据可能是比计算更大的瓶颈。因此，英伟达最新的交换机将电子和光子——计算世界中两个不重叠的领域——整合到一个封装中。它被称为“共封装光学”，它证明了英伟达圣克拉拉生态系统的巨大规模远不如电子每秒将数万亿比特传递给光子的亚原子规模重要。人工智能需要数千个芯片才能共同充当一台巨大的计算机，只有它们彼此通信速度足够快，这台计算机才能工作。英伟达已经销售了大部分芯片。如果该公司还控制了他们的沟通方式，那么它可能会为人工智能热潮的下一阶段奠定基础。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Every computer combines a math-doing part with a data part—computation and memory. That division is central to the von Neumann architecture, the basic paradigm for computers since World War II. Data move back and forth between the two in the binary language of computation, “ones” and “zeroes” represented by different voltages, all of it zipping along copper wires or vanishingly thin traces on a circuit board.
paras.zh: 每台计算机都将数学部分与数据部分（计算和内存）结合在一起。这种划分是冯诺依曼架构的核心，冯诺依曼架构是二战以来计算机的基本范式。数据以二进制计算语言在两者之间来回移动，“一”和“零”由不同的电压代表，所有数据都沿着铜线或电路板上几乎消失的细迹快速移动。

paras.en: Which is great. Copper is relatively cheap. It’s durable. It’s reliable. “The rule is simple,” says Gilad Shainer, Nvidia’s senior vice president of networking. “Use copper whenever you can.”
paras.zh: 这太棒了。铜相对便宜。它很耐用。这是可靠的。 “规则很简单，”Nvidia 网络高级副总裁 Gilad Shainer 说。 “只要有可能就使用铜。”

paras.en: But sometimes you can’t. Copper’s your pal if you’re moving electrons over short distances, like those inside a single computer, or at relatively low bandwidth, like your home ethernet’s. A large data center, though, can involve tens or even hundreds of thousands of computers working together over a space the size of a warehouse or an airport, and modern AI relies on vast quantities of data moving rapidly between all that compute and memory. “One compute processor is not enough. One memory is not enough,” says Sudip Shekhar, an electrical and computer engineer at the University of British Columbia. “So we try to have lots and lots of compute and lots and lots of memory, and we need to interconnect them.”
paras.zh: 但有时你不能。如果您要短距离移动电子（例如单台计算机内的电子），或者以相对较低的带宽（例如家庭以太网）移动电子，那么铜是您的好伙伴。然而，大型数据中心可能涉及数万甚至数十万台计算机，在仓库或机场大小的空间内协同工作，而现代人工智能依赖于在所有计算和内存之间快速移动的大量数据。 “一个计算处理器是不够的。一个内存也是不够的，”不列颠哥伦比亚大学的电气和计算机工程师 Sudip Shekhar 说。 “因此，我们尝试拥有大量的计算能力和大量的内存，并且我们需要将它们互连起来。”

paras.en: The real action is a car ride away, at an engineering lab in a location I agreed to keep secret.
paras.zh: 真正的行动是在驱车前往一个我同意保密的地点的工程实验室。

paras.en: More copper equals more problems. Electrons resist flowing together and, because they carry a charge, repel one another. To make them go, you need power. The copper acts like a filter, smearing crisp electrical pulses into a garbled mess. Noise distorts the signal. Photons, though, are more easygoing. They carry no charge and hardly even interact with one another. Shoot a laser through a thread of glass, and the light can carry information with negligible loss for several kilometers—or, with the right amplification, across oceans.
paras.zh: 更多的铜意味着更多的问题。电子无法聚集在一起，并且由于它们带有电荷，因此会相互排斥。为了让他们走，你需要力量。铜的作用就像一个过滤器，将清晰的电脉冲涂抹成混乱的乱码。噪声会使信号失真。然而，光子则更加随和。它们不带电荷，甚至彼此之间几乎不相互作用。通过一根玻璃线发射激光，光可以将信息传输到几公里之外，损失可以忽略不计，或者，通过适当的放大，可以跨越海洋。

paras.en: Except now you need a way to hand data off from electrons, the stuff of computation, to photons, the stuff of communication, and back again. The device that does that is called a transceiver. If you’re laying transoceanic fiber-optic cables or something, transceivers can be big, power-hungry technology built from boutique semiconductors such as indium phosphide. Compared with the cost of a ship unspooling fiber in the mid-Atlantic, who cares? But in a data center, stuck into rack switches and replaced every few years, they have to be cheaper and smaller. They have to be commodities. That means silicon.
paras.zh: 但现在你需要一种方法将数据从电子（计算的东西）传递到光子（通信的东西），然后再返回。执行此操作的设备称为收发器。如果您要铺设跨洋光纤电缆或其他东西，收发器可能是由磷化铟等精品半导体制成的大型、耗电技术。与在大西洋中部一艘船解绕光纤的成本相比，谁在乎呢？但在数据中心，由于安装在机架交换机中并每隔几年更换一次，因此它们必须更便宜、更小。它们必须是商品。这意味着硅。

paras.en: Inside a rack, though, copper’s still plenty good enough to connect the servers to one another, so that copper goes in a big vertical cable in the back. Racks talk to other racks through switches, and into the front of each switch you plug transceivers roughly the size and shape of a candy bar. Plugged into those are links made of fiber-optic cables.
paras.zh: 不过，在机架内部，铜缆仍然足以将服务器相互连接起来，因此铜缆可以连接到背面的一根大垂直电缆中。机架通过交换机与其他​​机架通信，并且在每个交换机的前面插入大约糖果条大小和形状的收发器。插入其中的是由光纤电缆制成的链路。

paras.en: That, too, has disadvantages—or rather the imperfect humans doing the plugging and unplugging do. Every time they put a transceiver in or take one out, it jostles the ones next to it, which are then likely to fail. “It can wiggle. It can move. It has a physical connector that can move. There’s pins and solder joints and epoxy,” says Craig Thompson, Nvidia’s vice president of interconnect products. “Our goal was to strip all that away.”
paras.zh: 这也有缺点——或者更确切地说，是不完美的人类在插拔插头时所做的。每次他们放入或取出收发器时，都会挤压旁边的收发器，从而可能会发生故障。 “它可以摆动。它可以移动。它有一个可以移动的物理连接器。有引脚、焊点和环氧树脂，”Nvidia 互连产品副总裁 Craig Thompson 说。 “我们的目标是消除所有这些。”

paras.en: Walking among the experimental racks, Shainer points to the older switches. “A human present in a data center is responsible for 5 percent of downtime,” he says. “Once you touch it ...” Shainer shakes his head. It’s a pity, really.
paras.zh: 谢纳走在实验机架中，指着老式交换机。 “数据中心内 5% 的停机时间是由人员造成的，”他说。 “一旦你碰它……”谢纳摇摇头。真的很遗憾。

paras.en: One of the key metrics for these data centers is MTBI: mean time between interruptions. Every hiccup could sideline expensive equipment, so the longer the MTBI, the better. That’s why in Nvidia’s newest version the optics move inside the device, into a single package.
paras.zh: 这些数据中心的关键指标之一是 MTBI：平均中断时间。每次出现问题都可能导致昂贵的设备停产，因此 MTBI 越长越好。这就是为什么在 Nvidia 的最新版本中，光学器件被移入设备内部，进入单个封装。
