paras.en: INSKEEP: I guess, in a way, it comes across as a show of respect. You stop with the allies before you go and talk with the adversaries.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：我想，在某种程度上，这给人一种尊重的表现。在你去与对手交谈之前，你先与盟友停下来。

paras.en: INSKEEP: So he meets with China's leader then, eventually, where you are in Shenzhen. He's going to meet the regional allies on the way. Why also meet in a single room with both President Xi and President Vladimir Putin of Russia?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：所以他最终在深圳会见了中国领导人。他将在途中会见地区盟友。为什么还要与习主席和俄罗斯总统普京在一个房间会面？

paras.en: SHIVARAM: Right. So this is going to be a pretty historic meeting. These three leaders have never met together. Trump has been saying for a while now that he wants to discuss denuclearization with Xi and Putin. But I will say it's not really a topic that China is keen to get into. Trump has also said he wants to discuss with them, you know, about the war in Iran. And on Friday, the White House told reporters that the issue of Ukraine was not going to be on the agenda in this trilateral meeting.
paras.zh: 希瓦拉姆：对。因此，这将是一次非常具有历史意义的会议。这三位领导人从未见过面。一段时间以来，特朗普一直表示他想与习近平和普京讨论无核化问题。但我要说的是，这并不是中国热衷于讨论的话题。特朗普还表示，他想与他们讨论伊朗战争。周五，白宫告诉记者，乌克兰问题不会列入本次三边会议的议程。

paras.en: That has shifted possibly slightly because when Trump was leaving the White House on Monday, he told reporters that they'll talk about his, quote, "favorite subject" of Ukraine. This is going to be interesting to watch, Steve, because how Ukraine gets discussed in this meeting and what might come out of it has Europe really concerned, has Ukraine very concerned because their president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, will not be at APEC, and recently, Trump has been more lenient towards Putin and Russia.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能略有改变，因为当特朗普周一离开白宫时，他告诉记者，他们将谈论他“最喜欢的话题”乌克兰。史蒂夫，这将会很有趣，因为乌克兰在这次会议上如何讨论以及可能产生什么结果让欧洲真正担心，乌克兰非常担心，因为他们的总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基不会参加亚太经合组织，而最近，特朗普对普京和俄罗斯更加宽容。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Wow. One more thing to ask about. Could the president, since he's meeting with so many other people, also have a meeting with Kim Jong Un of North Korea?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：哇。还有一件事要问。既然总统会见了这么多人，他是否也能与朝鲜金正恩会面呢？

paras.en: SHIVARAM: He says that that might happen. It's probably not going to happen. We're still watching to see how things develop. The White House said that they're not planning for this to happen. Logistically, it would be very complicated. But Trump, you know, kind of did this last year, too, saying that he might meet with him in Korea, and that did not end up happening.
paras.zh: SHIVARAM：他说这可能会发生。这可能不会发生。我们仍在观察事态的发展。白宫表示，他们不打算让这种情况发生。从逻辑上讲，这将非常复杂。但特朗普去年也这么做了，说他可能会在韩国与他会面，但这最终没有发生。

paras.en: INSKEEP: NPR's Deepa Shivaram. Thanks so much.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：NPR 的迪帕·希瓦拉姆 (Deepa Shivaram)。非常感谢。

paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
paras.zh: 随着空袭升级，乌克兰用无人机和导弹袭击了俄罗斯主要桥梁

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the vital Kerch Bridge linking Russia to the occupied Crimean Peninsula, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday, calling it an "unprecedented" operation as Russia reported that its forces downed a record number of Ukrainian drones for the second straight day.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——乌克兰总统泽连斯基周二表示，乌克兰无人机和导弹袭击了连接俄罗斯和被占领克里米亚半岛的重要刻赤大桥，并称这是一次“史无前例”的行动，因为俄罗斯报告称，乌克兰军队连续第二天击落的乌克兰无人机数量创历史新高。

paras.en: Zelenskyy portrayed the bridge operation as a masterstroke following a weekslong effort by Ukrainian forces to gradually wear down Russian air defenses before bombarding the prized target with a barrage of missiles and drones overnight.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基将这次桥梁行动描述为乌克兰军队在长达一周的努力中逐步削弱俄罗斯防空系统，然后在夜间用一系列导弹和无人机轰炸这一重要目标之后的一次绝妙的行动。

paras.en: Zelenskyy didn't detail the damage, but the Ukrainian General Staff said that an arch and a span of the bridge's road section collapsed, severing the road link, while the railway line was still standing but with a damaged arch.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基没有详细说明损坏情况，但乌克兰总参谋部表示，桥梁路段的一个拱门和一个跨度倒塌，切断了道路连接，而铁路线仍然存在，但拱门受损。

paras.en: Russia's Investigative Committee, the nation's top criminal investigation agency, said the bridge was attacked by drones and sustained damage but didn't elaborate.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯最高刑事调查机构俄罗斯调查委员会表示，这座桥遭到无人机袭击并遭受损坏，但没有详细说明。

paras.en: The Kerch Bridge is a crucial link in moving military and civilian supplies from Russia to Crimea and for supporting troops on the front line. The construction of the bridge, a potent symbol of Russia's illegal annexation of the peninsula in 2014, was inflammatory to Ukrainians.
paras.zh: 刻赤大桥是从俄罗斯向克里米亚运送军事和民用物资以及支援前线部队的重要纽带。这座大桥的建设是俄罗斯 2014 年非法吞并半岛的有力象征，对乌克兰人来说具有煽动性。

paras.en: "The symbol of the occupation has cracked," the Ukrainian General Staff said in a statement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总参谋部在一份声明中表示：“占领的象征已经破裂。”

paras.en: Moscow's forces, meanwhile, fired ballistic missiles and drones at Kyiv, hitting two of the Ukrainian capital's main bridges and killing at least two people.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫斯科军队向基辅发射弹道导弹和无人机，击中乌克兰首都的两座主要桥梁，造成至少两人死亡。

paras.en: A recent escalation in aerial attacks came as Russia and Ukraine await a date for the next round of U.S.-mediated talks aimed at ending the war that began with Moscow's full-scale invasion of its neighbor on Feb. 24, 2022.
paras.zh: 最近空袭升级之际，俄罗斯和乌克兰正在等待美国斡旋的下一轮会谈的日期，该会谈旨在结束因莫斯科于 2022 年 2 月 24 日全面入侵其邻国而开始的战争。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump says he plans to talk about the war in Ukraine during his highly anticipated meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in China this week.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他计划本周在中国与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行备受期待的会晤，期间讨论乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Missiles delivered the final blow in the 7-stage operation
paras.zh: 导弹在七阶段行动中给予最后一击

paras.en: The Kerch Bridge attack was the culmination of weeks of preparatory strikes over seven stages of the operation, Zelenskyy said on social media.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在社交媒体上表示，刻赤大桥袭击事件是长达数周、七个阶段的准备性打击的高潮。

paras.en: Ukrainian forces knocked out defense systems, radars, electronic warfare equipment and other designated targets before launching Monday night's final attack, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，乌克兰军队在周一晚上发动最后一次攻击之前摧毁了防御系统、雷达、电子战设备和其他指定目标。

paras.en: Domestically developed long-range drones struck the bridge's road section during the night while Ukraine's Neptune missiles and other drones aimed at the rail section, he said. Precision-guided Flamingo missiles delivered the final blow, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，国内开发的远程无人机在夜间袭击了大桥的路段，而乌克兰的海王星导弹和其他无人机则瞄准了铁路段。他说，精确制导火烈鸟导弹给予了最后一击。

paras.en: Zelenskyy and the Ukrainian military published videos showing what they said were the attacks and subsequent damage to the bridge, with part of the deck in the water and a fallen arch. The Associated Press wasn't able to verify the images.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基和乌克兰军方发布了视频，显示了他们所说的袭击事件以及随后对桥梁的损坏，部分桥面浸入水中，拱门倒塌。美联社无法核实这些图像。

paras.en: The Russian-installed governor of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, said traffic across the bridge was halted but rail traffic was restored by Tuesday afternoon. He didn't mention any damage.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯任命的克里米亚总督谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫表示，大桥上的交通已停止，但铁路交通已于周二下午恢复。他没有提到任何损坏。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that "there is no doubt that the bridge will be restored and will be even better than it was before."
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，“毫无疑问，这座桥将被修复，而且会比以前更好。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy noted that Russia has battered Ukrainian infrastructure, especially the power grid, every day. There were significant power outages Tuesday in three Ukrainian regions, he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基指出，俄罗斯每天都在攻击乌克兰的基础设施，特别是电网。他说，乌克兰三个地区周二发生严重停电。

paras.en: "We have repeatedly offered Russia steps toward de-escalation — and every proposal has been met with loud rejection," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们一再向俄罗斯提出缓和局势的步骤，但每一项提议都遭到强烈拒绝。”

paras.en: U.K. Defense Secretary Wes Streeting, meeting at NATO headquarters in Brussels with Ukraine's Western backers, said the Kerch Bridge strike was "another example of Ukrainian ingenuity and Ukraine's absolute determination to defend itself against Russian aggression."
paras.zh: 英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷在布鲁塞尔的北约总部与乌克兰的西方支持者会面时表示，刻赤大桥袭击事件“是乌克兰独创性和乌克兰抵御俄罗斯侵略的绝对决心的又一个例子”。

paras.en: The United Kingdom announced £240 million ($317 million) in air defense support for Ukraine this winter, including more than 1,000 short-range missiles and more than a dozen radars.
paras.zh: 英国宣布今年冬天向乌克兰提供2.4亿英镑（3.17亿美元）的防空支持，其中包括1000多枚短程导弹和十多个雷达。

paras.en: Russian air defenses downed 1,441 drones during a second straight night of major Ukrainian attacks, Russia's Defense Ministry said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周二表示，俄罗斯防空系统在乌克兰连续第二晚发生重大袭击事件中击落了 1,441 架无人机。

paras.en: That was a day after Russia said that it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones in the highest number of interceptions it had reported so far during the war.
paras.zh: 就在一天前，俄罗斯表示击落了 1,336 架乌克兰无人机，这是战争期间迄今为止拦截数量最多的一次。

paras.en: Ukraine also attacks industrial areas deep inside Russia
paras.zh: 乌克兰还袭击了俄罗斯深处的工业区

paras.en: Elsewhere, authorities in Bashkortostan, a Russian region in the southern Ural Mountains, said that defenses repelled a "massive" drone attack on industrial zones in the cities of Ufa and Salavat. All plants there worked as usual, officials said.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，乌拉尔山脉南部的俄罗斯地区巴什科尔托斯坦当局表示，防御力量击退了对乌法和萨拉瓦特市工业区的“大规模”无人机袭击。官员们说，那里的所有工厂都正常运转。

paras.en: However, independent news outlet Astra reported a huge fire at the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat oil refining and petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, nearly 1,300 kilometers (800 miles) east of the Ukrainian border. The major petrochemical complex has been attacked a number of times before.
paras.zh: 然而，独立新闻媒体阿斯特拉报道称，位于乌克兰边境以东近 1,300 公里（800 英里）的巴什科尔托斯坦的俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司 (Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat) 炼油和石化厂发生大火。主要石化联合体此前曾多次遭到袭击。

paras.en: In Moscow, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said that around 800 drones flew toward the Moscow region overnight. Most were downed far away, and 321 were shot down as they approached the Russian capital.
paras.zh: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁表示，夜间约有 800 架无人机飞向莫斯科地区。其中大部分在远处被击落，其中 321 架是在接近俄罗斯首都时被击落的。

paras.en: Russia hits bridges in Ukraine's capital
paras.zh: 俄罗斯撞毁乌克兰首都桥梁

paras.en: Seven Russian ballistic missiles hit two of Kyiv's main bridges during the night, Zelenskyy said. Both were closed to traffic.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，七枚俄罗斯弹道导弹在夜间击中了基辅的两座主要桥梁。两者均禁止交通。

paras.en: The Pivnichnyi and Pivdennyi bridges are key commuter routes across the Dnipro River connecting Kyiv's two banks. The left bank is largely residential with numerous apartment buildings and shopping malls. The old town and many government offices are on the right bank.
paras.zh: Pivnichnyi 和 Pivdennyi 大桥是连接基辅两岸的第聂伯河上的主要通勤路线。左岸主要是住宅区，有许多公寓楼和购物中心。老城区和许多政府机关都位于右岸。

paras.en: On Tuesday morning, long lines of traffic formed on a third bridge linking the two sides of the city.
paras.zh: 周二早上，连接城市两侧的第三座桥上排起了长队。

paras.en: Russian attacks damaged other infrastructure and started fires in four districts of the Ukrainian capital, officials said, as Moscow continued its campaign to make life difficult for Ukrainian civilians.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，俄罗斯的袭击破坏了乌克兰首都的其他基础设施，并引发了四个地区的火灾，而莫斯科仍在继续为乌克兰平民制造困难。

paras.en: The Russian Defense Ministry said Tuesday that its forces overnight hit Ukraine's military industrial facilities, energy, transport and port infrastructure, as well as vessels used for Ukrainian armed forces.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周二表示，其部队连夜袭击了乌克兰的军事工业设施、能源、运输和港口基础设施，以及乌克兰武装部队使用的船只。

paras.en: Russian forces launched a combined attack on industrial facilities in three districts of the southern Ukraine region of Zaporizhzhia, killing two people and wounding 18 others and leaving a large number of consumers in the region without power, local authorities said.
paras.zh: 地方当局称，俄罗斯军队对乌克兰南部扎波罗热地区三个地区的工业设施发动联合袭击，造成两人死亡、十八人受伤，并导致该地区大量消费者断电。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the negotiating teams of Ukraine, the United States, and European partners held a working video call Monday in which they discussed the results of recent talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, and the agenda for the next stage of negotiations, said Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰对外情报局局长鲁斯泰姆·乌梅罗夫表示，乌克兰、美国和欧洲伙伴的谈判团队周一举行了工作视频通话，讨论了最近在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比举行的会谈结果以及下一阶段谈判的议程。

paras.en: "We aligned our positions and our next joint steps," Umerov said on Telegram following the conversation.
paras.zh: 谈话结束后，乌梅罗夫在 Telegram 上表示：“我们调整了立场并确定了下一步的联合步骤。”

paras.en: Representatives of France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Poland, NATO and the European Commission joined the conversation.
paras.zh: 法国、德国、英国、意大利、波兰、北约和欧盟委员会的代表参加了对话。

paras.en: The United States was represented by envoys Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner, and Alexus Grynkewich, the commander of U.S. forces in Europe, Umerov said.
paras.zh: 乌梅罗夫说，美国的代表是特使史蒂夫·威特科夫、贾里德·库什纳和美军驻欧洲司令亚历克苏斯·格林克维奇。

articles.title: Xi said China would welcome American students for exchanges. What's the reality?
articles.author: Jennifer Pak

paras.en: Xi said China would welcome American students for exchanges. What's the reality?
paras.zh: 习近平表示，中方欢迎美国学生来华交流。事实又是怎样呢？

paras.en: President Trump and China's leader Xi Jinping are due to meet in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. At their last summit in September, Xi said he will welcome 100,000 American students for exchanges.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平将于中国深圳会面。在9月的最后一次峰会上，习近平表示，他将欢迎10万名美国学生来华交流。

paras.en: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping are due to meet in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen this week. At their last summit in September, Xi said he would welcome 100,000 American students for academic exchanges. It's a gesture meant to show that China is open, even as the two countries grow increasingly more closed off to each other. NPR's Jennifer Pak reports from Beijing.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平将于本周在中国南方城市深圳会面。在九月份的最后一次峰会上，习近平表示，他将欢迎10万名美国学生进行学术交流。这一姿态旨在表明中国是开放的，尽管两国之间的关系日益封闭。 NPR 的 Jennifer Pak 从北京报道。

paras.en: JENNIFER PAK, BYLINE: Ker Gibbs teaches business at the University of San Francisco. He first visited China in 1985 when there were few foreigners.
paras.zh: 詹妮弗·帕克连线：克尔·吉布斯在旧金山大学教授商业课程。他第一次访问中国是在1985年，当时外国人还很少。

paras.en: PAK: And he couldn't use the local currency, the renminbi. Gibbs had to get foreign exchange certificates and spend them at certain state-owned shops.
paras.zh: PAK：而且他不能使用当地货币人民币。吉布斯必须获得外汇券并在某些国有商店消费。

paras.en: GIBBS: We were really kept separate in many ways.
paras.zh: 吉布斯：我们在很多方面确实是分开的。

paras.en: PAK: That changed in the 1990s when China opened up. That's how Gibbs was sent by a U.S. consultancy to work in Shanghai. As a 20-something-year-old, he says he helped Chinese factories with things like management and inventory control.
paras.zh: PAK：随着 20 世纪 90 年代中国开放，情况发生了变化。就这样，吉布斯被一家美国咨询公司派到上海工作。他说，作为一名 20 多岁的年轻人，他在管理和库存控制等方面为中国工厂提供了帮助。

paras.en: GIBBS: And the vibe in businesses was really exciting because local management, they were curious about everything, and we were eager to teach.
paras.zh: 吉布斯：企业的氛围真的很令人兴奋，因为当地的管理层，他们对一切都感到好奇，而我们也渴望教学。

paras.en: PAK: Gibbs went on to have a 30-year career in China and even raised a family in Shanghai. He wants the next generation of China watchers to have the same experience. But he says...
paras.zh: PAK：吉布斯在中国继续了30年的职业生涯，甚至在上海组建了家庭。他希望下一代中国观察家能够有同样的经历。但他说...

paras.en: GIBBS: I have fewer reasons to be optimistic, put it that way.
paras.zh: 吉布斯：这么说吧，我没有什么理由保持乐观。

paras.en: PAK: Every summer, Gibbs brings American students to China. Biology major Daniella Mori went this year to Shanghai.
paras.zh: PAK：每年夏天，吉布斯都会带美国学生来中国。生物专业的丹妮拉·森今年去了上海。

paras.en: DANIELLA MORI: OK. The exchange was really awesome.
paras.zh: 丹妮拉·森：好的。这次交流真是太棒了。

paras.en: PAK: She says she liked hearing from company executives and adored the food. Mori is thinking of doing a master's in biotech.
paras.zh: PAK：她说她喜欢听到公司高管的意见并且喜欢这里的食物。森正在考虑攻读生物技术硕士学位。

paras.en: MORI: If I do that, China is really big on biotech.
paras.zh: 森：如果我这样做的话，中国在生物技术方面确实非常强大。

paras.en: PAK: Maybe, she says, she can come back to China and work in a lab. But biotech is an area of intense U.S.-China competition. And Gibbs says when students ask how they can launch a career in China, he has to give them a reality check.
paras.zh: PAK：她说，也许她可以回到中国并在实验室工作。但生物技术是中美竞争激烈的领域。吉布斯说，当学生询问如何在中国开展职业生涯时，他必须给他们一个现实的检验。

paras.en: GIBBS: Unfortunately, I just don't see those opportunities available to them.
paras.zh: 吉布斯：不幸的是，我看不到他们有这些机会。

paras.en: PAK: Because China's economy has matured, he says, and doesn't want as many foreign expertise. Nowadays, security is the priority. Beijing continues to warn its citizens against foreign spies and has increased the use of exit bans.
paras.zh: PAK：他说，因为中国经济已经成熟，不需要那么多外国专业知识。如今，安全是首要任务。北京继续警告公民提防外国间谍，并增加了出境禁令的使用。

paras.en: ISAAC STONE FISH: I can't recommend that people follow in my footsteps now.
paras.zh: ISAAC STONE FISH：我现在不建议人们追随我的脚步。

paras.en: PAK: Isaac Stone Fish, CEO of Strategy Risks, both studied and lived in China in the 2000s, but he doesn't recommend Americans doing the same thing now. For one, he says China has become more repressive.
paras.zh: PAK：Strategy Risks 首席执行官 Isaac Stone Fish 曾在 2000 年代在中国学习和生活，但他不建议美国人现在做同样的事情。其一，他说中国变得更加专制。

paras.en: STONE FISH: Two is the liability of being in China now from a U.S. perspective.
paras.zh: STONE FISH：第二是从美国的角度来看现在在中国的责任。

paras.en: PAK: Meaning it could jeopardize a security clearance if the student wants to work for the U.S. government. Academic exchanges are already under scrutiny. A recent U.S. federal investigation into Duke University's foreign funding has cast a shadow over its joint campus in China. Duke Kunshan student Carly Nabinger calls the probe overblown.
paras.zh: PAK：这意味着如果学生想为美国政府工作，可能会危及安全许可。学术交流已经受到审查。美国联邦最近对杜克大学的外国资助进行的调查给杜克大学在中国的联合校区蒙上了阴影。昆山杜克大学学生卡莉·纳宾格称调查言过其实。

paras.en: CARLY NABINGER: I thought it was all ridiculous from the start.
paras.zh: 卡莉·纳宾格：我从一开始就觉得这很荒谬。

paras.en: PAK: She says studying in China has been so valuable. She's also made friends who want to go to America, but the Trump administration doesn't make that possible with its restrictions on visas and deportation of immigrants.
paras.zh: PAK：她说在中国学习非常有价值。她还结识了想去美国的朋友，但特朗普政府通过限制签证和驱逐移民使这成为可能。

paras.en: NABINGER: This, like, vision of us potentially moving to my home country and building a life there is not possible anymore.
paras.zh: 纳宾格：这种我们可能搬到我的祖国并在那里建立生活的愿景已经不可能了。

paras.en: PAK: She says China's invitation for Americans to visit is good.
paras.zh: 帕克：她说中国邀请美国人来访的邀请很好。

paras.en: NEYSUN MAHBOUBI: The problem now is that there's so little trust between the U.S. and China.
paras.zh: NEYSUN MAHBOUBI：现在的问题是美国和中国之间缺乏信任。

paras.en: PAK: That's Neysun Mahboubi, a scholar of Chinese law at the University of Pennsylvania. He says because the invitation is coming from the Chinese leader...
paras.zh: PAK：这位是 Neysun Mahboubi，宾夕法尼亚大学中国法学者。他说因为邀请是来自中国领导人……

paras.en: MAHBOUBI: It will naturally be viewed through a lens of suspicion in the United States. It seems as if it is trying to advance a state goal.
paras.zh: MAHBOUBI：美国自然会通过怀疑的眼光来看待它。看起来好像是在试图推进一个国家目标。

paras.en: PAK: Mahboubi has been coming back to China regularly since 1995.
paras.zh: PAK：马布比自1995年以来就定期回到中国。

paras.en: MAHBOUBI: And I was able to meet some quite profound figures in the field of Chinese law early on in my career.
paras.zh: MAHBOUBI：在我职业生涯的早期，我就结识了中国法律领域的一些颇有影响力的人物。

paras.en: PAK: Today, he says China's research environment is more constrained, though, not entirely closed. The number of Americans studying in China is just under 2,000, while there are still a quarter of a million-plus Chinese students in the U.S., according to the Institute of International Education.
paras.zh: PAK：今天，他说中国的研究环境更加受限，但并非完全封闭。根据国际教育研究所的数据，在中国留学的美国人人数不到2000人，而在美国仍有超过25万中国学生。

paras.en: MAHBOUBI: No matter what, we all agree that China will be the preeminent competitor for the U.S. for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 马布比：无论如何，我们都同意，在可预见的未来，中国将是美国最重要的竞争对手。

paras.en: PAK: And U.S. national security is important, he says, but don't choke off all channels trying to understand China. Gibbs agrees.
paras.zh: 帕克：他说，美国国家安全很重要，但不要切断所有试图了解中国的渠道。吉布斯同意。

paras.en: GIBBS: We're a democracy, so our government, in theory, does what we tell them to do. China literacy is critical.
paras.zh: 吉布斯：我们是一个民主国家，所以从理论上讲，我们的政府会按照我们的指示去做。中国文化素养至关重要。

paras.en: PAK: And that, he says, requires more Americans here on the ground.
paras.zh: 帕克：他说，这需要更多的美国人来到现场。

articles.title: Alaska Dem Peltola defeats Sullivan, flipping 9th GOP Senate seat after 'decoy Dan' uproar

paras.en: Democrats flipped a ninth GOP-held Senate seat in the 2026 midterm elections, with former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola defeating two-term Republican Sen. Dan S. Sullivan in a state that President Donald Trump carried in 2024.
paras.zh: 民主党在 2026 年中期选举中推翻了共和党占据的第九个参议院席位，前民主党众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 在唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 总统于 2024 年赢得的州击败了两届共和党参议员丹·S·沙利文 (Dan S. Sullivan)。

paras.en: Peltola's victory gives Democrats a 56-44 majority in the U.S. Senate.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉的胜利使民主党在美国参议院以 56 比 44 获得多数席位。

paras.en: The contest emerged as one of the nation's most closely watched Senate races, with Republicans defending a seat in a state President Donald Trump carried by roughly 13 percentage points in 2024, and Democrats eyeing a rare opportunity to make inroads in traditionally Republican territory.
paras.zh: 这场竞选成为全美最受关注的参议院竞选之一，共和党人将捍卫唐纳德·特朗普总统在 2024 年以约 13 个百分点的领先优势赢得的州席位，而民主党人则将目光投向了进军传统共和党领地的难得机会。

paras.en: The controversy deepened just days before Election Day when The New York Times reported that Peltola campaign aides, attorneys and national Democratic operatives had participated in a secret effort to recruit a candidate sharing the Republican incumbent's name.
paras.zh: 就在选举日前几天，《纽约时报》报道称，佩尔托拉的竞选助手、律师和全国民主党工作人员参与了一项秘密行动，招募一名与共和党现任总统同名的候选人，这场争议进一步加深。

paras.en: According to the Times, text messages and interviews revealed a broader operation, internally dubbed the "ballot composition project," aimed at recruiting candidates who could siphon votes from Sullivan. The effort reportedly involved the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee and included discussions about establishing a new right-wing political party.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，短信和采访揭示了一项更广泛的行动，内部称为“选票组成项目”，旨在招募可以从沙利文那里窃取选票的候选人。据报道，这项努力涉及民主党参议员竞选委员会，并包括关于建立一个新的右翼政党的讨论。

paras.en: Peltola's campaign denied involvement with either Sullivan campaign, while the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC) also rejected allegations of participation. The revelations prompted Republican Gov. Michael Dunleavy to order an investigation into whether the alleged recruitment effort violated Alaska law.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉的竞选团队否认参与了沙利文的竞选活动，而民主党参议员竞选委员会（DSCC）也否认了参与的指控。这些揭露促使共和党州长迈克尔邓利维下令调查所谓的招募活动是否违反了阿拉斯加法律。

paras.en: The Cook Political Report rated the contest a toss-up, reflecting the unusually competitive environment in a state that has generally favored Republicans in federal elections.
paras.zh: 《库克政治报告》对这场竞选的评价为“难分胜负”，反映出这个在联邦选举中普遍偏向共和党的州异常的竞争环境。

paras.en: Peltola, a former state lawmaker, made history in 2022 when she became the first Alaska Native elected to Congress, winning a special election to succeed the late Republican Rep. Don Young.
paras.zh: 前州议员佩尔托拉在 2022 年创造了历史，她赢得了特别选举，接替已故共和党众议员唐·杨，成为第一位当选国会议员的阿拉斯加原住民。

paras.en: She defeated former Republican Gov. Sarah Palin in that contest before winning a full term later that year. Peltola subsequently lost her 2024 reelection bid to Republican Nick Begich III, setting the stage for her Senate campaign.
paras.zh: 她在那次竞选中击败了前共和党州长莎拉·佩林，并于当年晚些时候赢得了整个任期。佩尔托拉随后在 2024 年连任竞选中输给了共和党人尼克·贝吉奇三世，为她的参议院竞选奠定了基础。

paras.en: Sullivan, a Marine Corps veteran and former Alaska attorney general, first won his Senate seat in 2014 by defeating Democratic incumbent Mark Begich, Nick's uncle. He secured reelection in 2020 and sought a third term emphasizing his experience, national security and Alaska's energy interests.
paras.zh: 沙利文是一名海军陆战队老兵、前阿拉斯加总检察长，他于 2014 年击败尼克的叔叔、民主党现任议员马克·贝吉奇，首次赢得参议院席位。他于 2020 年获得连任，并寻求第三次连任，强调他的经验、国家安全和阿拉斯加的能源利益。

paras.en: The 2026 race also featured an unusual ballot controversy involving Dan J. Sullivan, a retired teacher who shared nearly the same name as the Republican incumbent.
paras.zh: 2026 年的竞选还引发了一场不同寻常的选票争议，涉及退休教师丹·J·沙利文 (Dan J. Sullivan)，他与共和党现任总统几乎同名。

paras.en: Alaska election officials initially moved to remove the second Sullivan from the ballot amid allegations that his candidacy was intended to confuse voters or siphon support from the senator. The candidate denied wrongdoing, and the Alaska Supreme Court ruled that he could remain on the ballot. The DOJ sued in October to mitigate any "misleading" impact of the newcomer Sullivan.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州选举官员最初采取行动，将第二个沙利文从选票中剔除，因为有人指控他的候选资格旨在迷惑选民或夺取参议员的支持。该候选人否认有不当行为，阿拉斯加最高法院裁定他可以继续参加投票。美国司法部于 10 月份提起诉讼，以减轻新人沙利文的“误导性”影响。

paras.en: The controversy added another complication to Alaska's ranked-choice voting system, which allows voters to rank candidates in order of preference.
paras.zh: 这场争议给阿拉斯加的排名选择投票系统增加了另一个复杂性，该系统允许选民按偏好顺序对候选人进行排名。

paras.en: Under the system, a candidate receiving a majority of first-choice votes wins outright. Otherwise, the lowest-performing candidate is eliminated, and ballots are redistributed according to voters' next available preferences until a winner emerges.
paras.zh: 根据该制度，获得多数第一选择票的候选人将彻底获胜。否则，表现最差的候选人将被淘汰，选票将根据选民的下一个可用偏好重新分配，直到出现获胜者。

paras.en: Peltola had previously benefited from the system during her 2022 congressional victories, when ranked-choice tabulation helped determine the outcomes of races featuring multiple Republican opponents.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉此前曾在 2022 年国会胜利期间受益于该系统，当时排名选择制表有助于确定多个共和党对手的竞选结果。

paras.en: The Alaska contest carried national significance as both parties battled over control of the Senate, with the result determining whether Republicans retained the seat or Democrats added it to their column.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加之战具有全国意义，因为两党都在争夺参议院的控制权，其结果决定了共和党是否保留该席位，或者民主党将其添加到自己的专栏中。

articles.title: Patriots-Chargers game loses primetime slot as NFL makes first flex scheduling move of 2026 season

paras.en: The Houston Texans will host the Indianapolis Colts to kick off Week 11 of the NFL slate. Week 12's lineup will look different than it did originally, as the league decided to make its first primetime shakeup on the calendar.
paras.zh: 休斯顿德州人队将主场迎战印第安纳波利斯小马队，拉开 NFL 第 11 周的比赛序幕。第 12 周的阵容将与原来有所不同，因为联盟决定在日历上进行首次黄金时段改组。

paras.en: Although the Los Angeles Chargers picked up their first win Monday night in primetime, it was not enough to keep their Week 12 matchup with the New England Patriots in the Sunday night slot. Patriots quarterback Drake Maye is expected to miss the remainder of the season after breaking his ankle this past Sunday.
paras.zh: 尽管洛杉矶闪电队在周一晚上的黄金时段取得了他们的首场胜利，但这还不足以让他们在周日晚上与新英格兰爱国者队进行第 12 周的比赛。爱国者队四分卫德雷克·梅耶在上周日脚踝骨折后预计将缺席本赛季剩余比赛。

paras.en: The Las Vegas Raiders-Cleveland Browns game is moving into the "Sunday Night Football" window for Nov. 29, the league announced on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联盟周二宣布，拉斯维加斯突袭者队与克利夫兰布朗队的比赛将移至 11 月 29 日的“周日橄榄球之夜”窗口进行。

paras.en: The game will also be the Raiders’ first primetime appearance of the 2026 season and the first of rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza’s career. Mendoza is projected to make his third career start. Four other teams began the regular season without a primetime matchup on their schedules.
paras.zh: 这场比赛也将是突袭者队在 2026 赛季首次亮相黄金时段，也是新秀四分卫费尔南多·门多萨职业生涯的首场比赛。门多萨预计将迎来他职业生涯的第三次开始。其他四支球队在常规赛开始时没有安排黄金时段的比赛。

paras.en: Mendoza, the No. 1 overall pick in April's draft, threw for 143 yards in his first career start. The defending champion Seahawks went on to win 21-13.
paras.zh: 门多萨是四月份选秀中的状元秀，在他职业生涯的第一次首发中就传出了 143 码。卫冕冠军海鹰队以21-13获胜。

paras.en: Last season, the Browns did not play any games on the national stage. They had one earlier this season, a Week 4 matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
paras.zh: 上赛季，布朗队没有在全国舞台上打任何比赛。他们在本赛季早些时候进行了一场比赛，即第四周对阵匹兹堡钢人队的比赛。

paras.en: This season's surprising Browns enter their bye week at 6-4, showcasing their ability along the way to close out close games. There are several weeks left on the NFL schedule, but the Browns have already made league history by pulling off each of their first six wins by four points or fewer.
paras.zh: 本赛季令人惊讶的布朗队以 6 胜 4 负的战绩进入告别周，一路展示了他们结束势均力敌的比赛的能力。 NFL 赛程还剩几周，但布朗队在前六场胜利中每场都以 4 分或更少的优势创造了联盟历史。

paras.en: The Patriots-Chargers game moved to the late-afternoon window, while the AFC South matchup between the Tennessee Titans and Jacksonville Jaguars shifted to 1 p.m. ET after initially being scheduled for 4:05 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 爱国者队与闪电队的比赛移至下午晚些时候，而田纳西泰坦队和杰克逊维尔美洲虎队之间的美联南区比赛则移至下午 1 点。最初安排为下午 4:05（东部时间）等。

paras.en: Nearly six years had passed since the Browns were last flexed into the Sunday night window. The last time it happened was on December 2020, when Cleveland faced the New York Giants. The Browns won that game and later clinched a playoff berth.
paras.zh: 自从布朗队上次在周日晚上的转会窗口中表现出来以来，已经过去了近六年了。上一次发生这种情况是在 2020 年 12 月，当时克利夫兰对阵纽约巨人队。布朗队赢得了那场比赛，随后锁定了季后赛席位。

articles.title: RFK Jr. faces fierce backlash after US loses measles-free status for first time in 26 years

paras.en: Health and Human Services (HHS) Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is facing mounting criticism from Democrats after the United States lost its measles elimination status for the first time in more than 25 years.
paras.zh: 在美国 25 年来首次失去消除麻疹的地位后，卫生与公众服务部 (HHS) 部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.) 面临着民主党越来越多的批评。

paras.en: The Pan American Health Organization announced Tuesday that the U.S. had lost its measles elimination designation amid a resurgence of the highly contagious virus, with more than 5,400 confirmed cases reported this year — the highest annual total in more than three decades.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织周二宣布，由于麻疹这种高传染性病毒卷土重来，美国已经失去了消除麻疹的资格，今年报告的确诊病例超过 5,400 例，这是三十多年来的最高年度病例总数。

paras.en: The virus has spread largely among unvaccinated populations, prompting criticism from Democrats who have previously scrutinized Kennedy's stance on vaccines.
paras.zh: 该病毒主要在未接种疫苗的人群中传播，引发了此前曾仔细审查肯尼迪疫苗立场的民主党人的批评。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Kennedy vowed to stop measles outbreaks and restore the country's measles elimination status, while continuing to recommend vaccination against the disease.
paras.zh: 周二，肯尼迪发誓要制止麻疹疫情，恢复该国消除麻疹的状态，同时继续建议接种疫苗来预防这种疾病。

paras.en: "We will stop measles outbreaks, protect American families, and work to regain U.S. measles elimination status," Kennedy said in a statement.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪在一份声明中说：“我们将阻止麻疹疫情，保护美国家庭，并努力恢复美国麻疹消除状态。”

paras.en: He added, "I continue to recommend MMR vaccination as the most effective way to prevent measles."
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我继续建议接种 MMR 疫苗作为预防麻疹的最有效方法。”

paras.en: Several Democrats sharply criticized Kennedy following the announcement.
paras.zh: 消息公布后，一些民主党人严厉批评肯尼迪。

paras.en: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul, whose state has reported its first measles-associated death in more than three decades, involving a child, accused Kennedy of contributing to declining vaccination rates through years of vaccine skepticism.
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 报告了三十多年来首例与麻疹相关的死亡事件，其中涉及一名儿童。她指责肯尼迪多年来对疫苗持怀疑态度，导致疫苗接种率下降。

paras.en: "RFK Jr. promised to 'Make America Healthy Again.' Now America has lost its measles-free status for the first time in 26 years," Hochul said.
paras.zh: “小罗伯特·肯尼迪承诺‘让美国再次健康’。现在美国 26 年来首次失去了无麻疹状态，”霍赫尔说。

paras.en: "A disgraceful display of incompetence from the nation's highest public health office," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“这是国家最高公共卫生办公室无能的可耻表现。”

paras.en: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro also blamed Kennedy, arguing that the loss of elimination status reflected the consequences of vaccine misinformation and skepticism.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗也指责肯尼迪，认为消除状态的丧失反映了疫苗错误信息和怀疑的后果。

paras.en: "There is a clear line from the misinformation, vaccine skepticism, and incompetence of RFK Jr. to this devastating news and very real consequences," Shapiro said.
paras.zh: 夏皮罗说：“小罗伯特·肯尼迪的错误信息、疫苗怀疑和无能与这一毁灭性消息和非常现实的后果之间存在着明确的界限。”

paras.en: "Measles is preventable. We eliminated it in this country once, and we can do it again."
paras.zh: “麻疹是可以预防的。我们曾经在这个国家消灭过麻疹，我们还可以再次做到这一点。”

paras.en: Another Democratic governor called for Kennedy's removal from office.
paras.zh: 另一位民主党州长呼吁肯尼迪下台。

paras.en: "This dangerous setback was 100% avoidable and is the result of one person: RFK Jr.," Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear said. "Remove him now."
paras.zh: 肯塔基州州长安迪·贝希尔 (Andy Beshear) 表示：“这一危险的挫折是 100% 可以避免的，而且是一个人造成的：小 RFK。” “现在把他除掉。”

paras.en: The U.S., which had maintained the measles designation since 2000, is experiencing its worst measles outbreak since 1991 and has reported more than twice as many cases as in all of 2025, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 称，自 2000 年以来一直保持麻疹指定的美国，正在经历 1991 年以来最严重的麻疹疫情，2025 年报告的病例数是 2025 年全年的两倍多。

paras.en: Measles elimination means there has been no continuous local transmission of the virus for at least 12 months. The U.S. reached the status in 2000 after years of coordinated immunization campaigns.
paras.zh: 消除麻疹意味着至少 12 个月内没有病毒持续局部传播。经过多年的协调免疫运动，美国于 2000 年达到了这一地位。

paras.en: CDC Director Dr. Erica Schwartz defended the agency's response to the ongoing outbreak, emphasizing that vaccination remains the most important tool for protecting Americans.
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心主任埃里卡·施瓦茨博士为该机构对当前疫情的反应进行了辩护，强调疫苗接种仍然是保护美国人的最重要工具。

paras.en: "The measles elimination designation is not what protects Americans. Vaccination does," Schwartz said.
paras.zh: 施瓦茨说：“麻疹消除指定并不能保护美国人。疫苗可以保护美国人。”

paras.en: She added that the CDC had invested approximately $100 million in state and local health departments to strengthen outbreak prevention and response.
paras.zh: 她补充说，疾病预防控制中心已向州和地方卫生部门投资约1亿美元，以加强疫情预防和应对。

paras.en: The agency also noted that MMR vaccination coverage among U.S. kindergartners fell from 95.2% during the 2019–2020 school year to 92.7% in 2023–2024.
paras.zh: 该机构还指出，美国幼儿园儿童的 MMR 疫苗接种覆盖率从 2019-2020 学年的 95.2% 下降至 2023-2024 年的 92.7%。

paras.en: In his statement, Kennedy cited COVID-19-era disruptions as a factor in declining routine childhood vaccination coverage, noting that several other countries, including Canada, Mexico and the United Kingdom, had also lost their measles elimination status.
paras.zh: 肯尼迪在声明中指出，COVID-19 时代的干扰是导致儿童常规疫苗接种覆盖率下降的一个因素，并指出包括加拿大、墨西哥和英国在内的其他几个国家也失去了消除麻疹的地位。

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to HHS for additional comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版已联系美国卫生与公众服务部征求更多评论。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: ‘Devastating consequences’: One Nation plan to slash Australia’s refugee program denounced
articles.author: Krishani Dhanji and Sarah Basford Canales

paras.en: One Nation has vowed to cut Australia’s refugee intake by 90% and scrap the permanent parent visa program under its latest hardline plan to slash migration.
paras.zh: 一国党誓言将根据其最新的强硬削减移民计划，将澳大利亚的难民接收量减少 90%，并取消永久父母签证计划。

paras.en: Pauline Hanson announced the policy on Tuesday, labelling it a “tough” approach to migration. It was quickly criticised by political opponents and advocacy groups who labelled the announcement a “predictable and cheap” attack on refugees.
paras.zh: 宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 周二宣布了这项政策，称其为“强硬”的移民政策。此举很快遭到政治对手和倡导团体的批评，他们称这一声明是对难民的“可预测且廉价”的攻击。

paras.en: The rightwing party said if it held power it would cut the refugee program from 20,000 places a year to 2,000 and claimed that Australia would still remain above the OECD average for places per capita.
paras.zh: 右翼政党表示，如果执政，将把难民计划从每年 20,000 个名额削减至 2,000 个，并声称澳大利亚的人均名额仍将高于经合组织的平均水平。

paras.en: “The cost [to] … the taxpayer is enormous,” Hanson told reporters. “The cost is, on average, about $500,000 a year in a lifetime of expenditure per person in the country.
paras.zh: “纳税人的成本是巨大的，”汉森告诉记者。 “该国每人一生平均每年花费约 50 万美元。

paras.en: “We’ve got to take a tough stance on this. My concern is for these people out there … that are doing it tough. You don’t bring more people into the country if they cannot fund their own bed or hospital beds.”
paras.zh: “我们必须对此采取强硬立场。我担心的是那些正在艰难度日的人。如果他们无法为自己的床位或医院床位提供资金，你就不会带更多的人进入这个国家。”

paras.en: Other nations, including the US and Canada, have tightened their migration programs, with Canada reducing its parent visa program.
paras.zh: 包括美国和加拿大在内的其他国家也收紧了移民计划，其中加拿大减少了其父母签证计划。

paras.en: Hanson said One Nation was not barring migrant parents from moving to Australia but they would have to be sponsored or they could visit their families on temporary visas.
paras.zh: 汉森表示，一国党并不禁止移民父母移居澳大利亚，但他们必须得到担保，否则他们可以持临时签证探望家人。

paras.en: “We’re not saying parents can’t come out … [but] they will actually be sponsored by the families, not the taxpayers.”
paras.zh: “我们并不是说父母不能出来......[但]他们实际上将由家庭而不是纳税人赞助。”

paras.en: The home affairs minister, Tony Burke, warned skilled workers would not fill critical jobs in hospitals and nursing homes if they could not bring their families with them.
paras.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克警告说，如果技术工人不能带着家人一起去医院和疗养院，他们就无法填补医院和疗养院的关键职位。

paras.en: “What One Nation is proposing is a complete attack on the services that Australians rely on,” Burke said.
paras.zh: 伯克说：“一国党的提议是对澳大利亚人所依赖的服务的彻底攻击。”

paras.en: Hanson claimed that her plan would save the budget more than $140bn over 10 years by slashing the refugee intake and scrapping permanent parent visas.
paras.zh: 汉森声称，她的计划将通过大幅削减难民接收人数和废除永久父母签证，在 10 年内节省超过 1400 亿美元的预算。

paras.en: Zaki Haidari, who arrived in Australia from Afghanistan as a refugee in 2013 and is now a citizen, said the discussion was retraumatising for former refugees like him.
paras.zh: 扎基·海达里 (Zaki Haidari) 于 2013 年以难民身份从阿富汗抵达澳大利亚，现已成为公民。他表示，这次讨论对像他这样的前难民来说是一次又一次的创伤。

paras.en: “Being a refugee is not a choice,” he said. “It’s between death and life.”
paras.zh: “成为难民不是一种选择，”他说。 “这是生与死之间的事。”

paras.en: Haidari, who now works as a campaigner for Amnesty International Australia, said policies like One Nation’s dashed the hopes of those waiting years in refugee camps for their turn at safety.
paras.zh: 海达里现在是澳大利亚国际特赦组织的活动家，他表示，像“一国之国”这样的政策让那些在难民营里等待数年才能获得安全的人们的希望破灭了。

paras.en: “They’re living with that hope that one day the lottery will be for them as well,” he said.
paras.zh: “他们满怀希望，希望有一天他们也能中彩票，”他说。

paras.en: Under One’s Nation’s policy, migrants from countries on the Albanese government’s “do not travel” list, including Afghanistan, Iran, Lebanon, Syria and Somalia, would still be banned from entering the country.
paras.zh: 根据“一个国家”的政策，来自阿尔巴尼亚政府“禁止旅行”名单上的国家（包括阿富汗、伊朗、黎巴嫩、叙利亚和索马里）的移民仍将被禁止进入该国。

paras.en: One Nation says analysis based on Treasury modelling, adjusted for inflation, found the lifetime cost of a humanitarian entrant was $523,000, while accepting the parents of visa holders was estimated to cost the budget $514,000 per person per year.
paras.zh: One Nation 表示，基于财政部模型并根据通货膨胀进行调整后的分析发现，人道主义入境者的终生成本为 523,000 美元，而接受签证持有者的父母估计每人每年的预算成本为 514,000 美元。

paras.en: Treasury modelling done in December 2021 found the cost was $400,000, with 90% of it borne by the federal government.
paras.zh: 2021 年 12 月进行的财政部建模发现，成本为 40 万美元，其中 90% 由联邦政府承担。

paras.en: Labor has committed to retaining the refugee intake at 20,000 a year while the Coalition has promised to halve it to 10,000.
paras.zh: 工党承诺将难民接收量维持在每年 20,000 人，而联盟党则承诺将难民接收量减半至 10,000 人。

paras.en: The foreign affairs minister, Penny Wong, accused One Nation of trying to divide the country. She said Australia had the right balance and questioned Hanson’s claim that Australia would remain above the OECD average under the minor party’s plan.
paras.zh: 外交部长黄英贤指责一国党试图分裂国家。她表示，澳大利亚取得了适当的平衡，并质疑汉森关于根据小党计划澳大利亚将保持在经合组织平均水平之上的说法。

paras.en: The OECD reports that Canada and Australia have the most generous refugee settlement programs per capita, but it only uses data for refugees resettled through the UNHCR process.
paras.zh: 经合组织报告称，加拿大和澳大利亚的人均难民安置计划最为慷慨，但仅使用通过联合国难民署程序重新安置的难民的数据。

paras.en: The intakes of other OECD countries, including Germany and the US, are made up largely of asylum seekers who cross their borders and claim protection, meaning their intake levels appear much lower under the OECD figures Hanson has used.
paras.zh: 包括德国和美国在内的其他经合组织国家的接纳人数主要由跨境寻求庇护的寻求庇护者组成，这意味着根据汉森使用的经合组织数据，他们的接纳水平似乎要低得多。

paras.en: The opposition leader, Angus Taylor, ruled out further lowering the Coalition’s policy of halving the refugee intake to 10,000, adding “some of the greatest Australians came here as refugees to this country”.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒(Angus Taylor)排除了进一步降低联盟党将难民接收人数减半至1万人的政策的可能性，并补充说“一些最伟大的澳大利亚人作为难民来到了这个国家”。

paras.en: The Greens leader, David Shoebridge, accused One Nation and the two major parties of being “engaged in a race to the bottom to turn back refugees, lock them up in offshore detention, and blame them for the cost-of-living crisis”.
paras.zh: 绿党领袖戴维·舒布里奇 (David Shoebridge) 指责一国党和两大政党“陷入逐底竞争，以遣返难民，将他们关在离岸拘留所，并将生活成本危机归咎于他们”。

paras.en: “Pauline Hanson’s attack on refugees is just the latest shameful chapter in a decades-long campaign against people seeking safe shelter,” Shoebridge said.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇说：“宝琳·汉森对难民的袭击只是长达数十年反对人们寻求安全庇护的运动中最新的可耻篇章。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre called it a “predictable and cheap attack” on refugees, and said Victorians would reject One Nation at the upcoming state election.
paras.zh: 与此同时，寻求庇护者资源中心称这是对难民的“可预测且廉价的攻击”，并表示维州人将在即将到来的州选举中拒绝“一国党”。

paras.en: The ASRC’s deputy chief executive, Jana Favero, said the public wanted leaders to bring communities together, not divide them.
paras.zh: ASRC 副首席执行官 Jana Favero 表示，公众希望领导人能够团结社区，而不是分裂社区。

paras.en: “People are sick of politicians finger-pointing and blaming our newest arrivals for problems,” Favero said. “Reducing the humanitarian intake will not make Victorians richer or safer. People want solutions, not scapegoats.”
paras.zh: 法维罗说：“人们厌倦了政客相互指责，并将问题归咎于我们新来的人。” “减少人道主义援助并不会让维州人变得更富有或更安全。人们想要的是解决方案，而不是替罪羊。”

paras.en: The Refugee Council of Australia noted the humanitarian program only accounted for about 6.6% of net overseas migration.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚难民委员会指出，人道主义计划仅占海外净移民的 6.6% 左右。

paras.en: “Cutting it would do little to affect migration levels but would have devastating consequences for people fleeing war, persecution and violence,” the council’s co-chief executive, Adama Kamara, said.
paras.zh: 该委员会联合首席执行官阿达马·卡马拉表示：“削减移民水平对影响移民水平影响不大，但会对逃离战争、迫害和暴力的人们造成毁灭性后果。”

paras.en: “Many refugees in our region already have few opportunities to find safety and face the constant risk of being returned to countries where their lives and freedom are at risk.”
paras.zh: “我们地区的许多难民已经几乎没有机会找到安全，并面临着被遣返回生命和自由受到威胁的国家的持续风险。”

articles.title: Bikie ‘not surprised’ if he used fake $20,000 souvlaki invoice to pocket thousands on Big Build site, inquiry hears
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: A Bandidos gang member says it is possible he used a fake $20,000 invoice for souvlaki to pocket thousands of dollars while employed on a Big Build site.
paras.zh: 一名 Bandidos 团伙成员表示，他在一家大型建筑工地工作期间，有可能使用一张价值 20,000 美元的烤肉卷假发票，将数千美元收入囊中。

paras.en: The former CFMEU member and bikie Joel Leavitt faced a second day of examination by the royal commission into alleged corruption across Victoria’s construction sector on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，前 CFMEU 成员兼摩托党乔尔·莱维特 (Joel Leavitt) 面临皇家委员会第二天的审查，调查涉嫌维多利亚州建筑行业的腐败行为。

paras.en: In 2023, while employed as site health and safety representatives, Leavitt and another man, Charles Farrugia, exchanged messages which were shown to the commission.
paras.zh: 2023 年，莱维特在担任现场健康和安全代表期间，与另一名男子查尔斯·法鲁贾 (Charles Farrugia) 交换了信息，并向委员会展示了这些信息。

paras.en: “Just make up a quote that hits 20K and we will get the other nine off the subbies,” Leavitt wrote. “Which will mean five each.”
paras.zh: “只要编出一个达到 20K 的报价，我们就能从替补中得到另外九个，”莱维特写道。 “这意味着每人五个。”

paras.en: The commission viewed a genuine receipt for roughly $9,000 for souvlaki catering, and another allegedly fake invoice for $20,000 which was sent by Leavitt to the site superintendent, Tim Alford, from the firm Acciona.
paras.zh: 该委员会查看了一份价值约 9,000 美元的烤肉卷餐饮的真实收据，以及另一张涉嫌伪造的 20,000 美元发票，该发票由莱维特从 Acciona 公司发送给现场主管蒂姆·奥尔福德。

paras.en: The commissioner, Chris Kourakis AC, said the evidence strongly suggested the two CFMEU health and safety representatives had organised a meal for workers to get a few souvlaki and had pocketed $5,000 each.
paras.zh: 专员 Chris Kourakis AC 表示，证据强烈表明，两名 CFMEU 健康和安全代表为工人组织了一顿饭，以获取一些烤肉串，并每人收入 5,000 美元。

paras.en: “I’ll accept that,” Leavitt said. “I’m not surprised that I could have.”
paras.zh: “我会接受这一点，”莱维特说。 “我对自己能做到这一点并不感到惊讶。”

paras.en: The commission also viewed messages between Leavitt and Alford in which the bikie appeared to direct who could and who couldn’t be hired to work on the site.
paras.zh: 该委员会还查看了莱维特和阿尔福德之间的信息，其中摩托党似乎指示谁可以、谁不能被雇用在该网站上工作。

paras.en: In one message, Alford appeared to address the arrangement, saying: “I don’t care bringing your mates on and putting them in spotting roles and finding homes. But they all need to do there jobs.”
paras.zh: 在一条消息中，阿尔福德似乎谈到了这一安排，他说：“我不在乎让你的伙伴们上场，让他们扮演定位角色并寻找住所。但他们都需要在那里做工作。”

paras.en: The counsel assisting the commission Chris Carr SC asked Leavitt if he, on behalf of the CFMEU, was dictating who could work on the site, to which he replied he couldn’t recall.
paras.zh: 协助委员会的律师 Chris Carr SC 询问 Leavitt 是否代表 CFMEU 规定了谁可以在该网站工作，Leavitt 回答说他不记得了。

paras.en: “I had my own demons at the time, so I may have dropped the ball on a few things,” Leavitt said. “That’s my answer to that question, counsellor.”
paras.zh: “当时我心里有恶魔，所以我可能在一些事情上搞砸了，”莱维特说。 “这就是我对这个问题的回答，辅导员。”

paras.en: Earlier on Wednesday, questioning returned to a $165,000 invoice paid to Leavitt’s now defunct company, JVL Consulting, by the union-aligned subcontractor BK Labour Hire in July 2025.
paras.zh: 周三早些时候，质疑又回到了 2025 年 7 月由工会联盟分包商 BK Labor Hire 向莱维特现已解散的公司 JVL Consulting 支付的 165,000 美元发票。

paras.en: When shown a copy of the invoice Leavitt was unable to recall anything about it, or even give a clear answer as to what services his former company had provided.
paras.zh: 当莱维特出示发票副本时，他无法回忆起任何相关内容，甚至无法明确回答他的前公司提供了哪些服务。

paras.en: Later on Wednesday, the BK Labour Hire director Bernard Kearney admitted he paid the invoice despite Leavitt not having done any work for the firm.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，BK Labor Hire 董事伯纳德·科尔尼 (Bernard Kearney) 承认，尽管莱维特没有为该公司做过任何工作，但他还是支付了发票。

paras.en: “I just decided to pay it and move on,” he said.
paras.zh: “我只是决定付钱并继续前进，”他说。

paras.en: Carr said there were likely only a couple of reasons why BK Labour would have paid Leavitt, including a fear of violence or to suppress some information he had on them.
paras.zh: 卡尔表示，BK 工党向莱维特支付报酬的原因可能只有几个，包括担心暴力或隐瞒他掌握的有关他们的一些信息。

paras.en: “Was it one or both of those two?” Carr asked.
paras.zh: “是这两者之一还是两者？”卡尔问道。

paras.en: BK Labour also received a succession of invoices from the senior CFMEU organiser Joe Myles totalling $256,000 over about a year.
paras.zh: BK 工党还收到了来自 CFMEU 高级组织者 Joe Myles 的一系列发票，大约一年内总计 256,000 美元。

paras.en: Carr had earlier asked why Leavitt appeared to become uncomfortable when asked about the invoice.
paras.zh: 卡尔早些时候曾问莱维特为什么在被问及发票时显得不舒服。

paras.en: Leavitt blamed his poor memory on having ADHD, as well as PTSD from being shot in May 2023.
paras.zh: 莱维特将自己糟糕的记忆力归咎于患有多动症，以及 2023 年 5 月被枪杀后患上创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD)。

paras.en: “Around that time I actually got told by gang squad that there was a contract on my life,” he said. “So it brought back some uncomfortable memories.
paras.zh: “大约在那个时候，帮派小队告诉我，我的生命中有一份合同，”他说。 “所以它带回了一些不舒服的回忆。

paras.en: “That’s why I blocked out a lot of that time.”
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我花了很多时间。”

paras.en: Kourakis warned Leavitt it was an offence to fail to answer questions put to him by the commission, something he said could ultimately be tested in a courtroom.
paras.zh: 库拉基斯警告莱维特，不回答委员会向他提出的问题是一种犯罪行为，他说这最终可能会在法庭上得到检验。

paras.en: “I’ve been shot … I’ve had drug issues … I am answering these to the best of my recollection,” Leavitt replied.
paras.zh: “我被枪杀了……我有毒品问题……我正在根据我的记忆回答这些问题，”莱维特回答道。

paras.en: “How do you think you would act if you’d ever been shot?”
paras.zh: “如果你被枪杀，你认为你会怎么做？”

paras.en: After the commission briefly adjourned for Leavitt to speak to his lawyers, the bikie returned to the stand and said JVL Consulting had provided safety advice to companies. “Maybe helping them out with their procedures and policies and stuff like that,” he said.
paras.zh: 在委员会短暂休会以便莱维特与他的律师交谈后，这位摩托党回到了证人席上，并表示 JVL Consulting 已向公司提供了安全建议。 “也许可以帮助他们解决程序和政策之类的问题，”他说。

paras.en: The commission viewed a copy of Leavitt’s bank statement at the time which fluctuated between $0 and minus $20, before the $165,000 landed in his account.
paras.zh: 委员会查看了莱维特当时的银行对账单副本，该对账单的价格在 0 美元到负 20 美元之间波动，之后 165,000 美元才存入他的账户。

paras.en: “Everyone likes money – I’m sure all youse are on good money for this,” said Leavitt, addressing the bar table.
paras.zh: “每个人都喜欢钱——我相信你们所有人都为此赚了很多钱，”莱维特在吧台上说道。

paras.en: Kourakis informed Leavitt that the commission had evidence he did not do any work for BK Labour.
paras.zh: 库拉基斯告诉莱维特，委员会有证据表明他没有为 BK 工党做过任何工作。

paras.en: He said an inference that could be made was that Leavitt was “standing over” BK Labour for the payment because he needed money.
paras.zh: 他说，可以推断出，利维特之所以“盯上”BK Labour的款项，是因为他需要钱。

paras.en: “If that’s the way you want to look at it, commissioner,” Leavitt replied.
paras.zh: “如果你想这么看的话，专员，”莱维特回答道。

paras.en: Carr asked if Leavitt knew something about BK Labour that the company would have wanted to keep quiet. “Is the conclusion the commission should draw is that you just stood over them with some sort of explicit or implied threat of violence?” he asked.
paras.zh: 卡尔询问莱维特是否了解 BK Labor 的一些公司希望保持沉默的信息。 “委员会应该得出的结论是，你只是以某种明确或暗示的暴力威胁站在他们一边？”他问道。

paras.en: Leavitt replied: “I’d like to talk to my counsel before I answer that.”
paras.zh: 莱维特回答说：“在回答这个问题之前，我想先和我的律师谈谈。”

articles.title: Apec summit live: Xi and Putin start talks; Rubio says Trump serious about meeting Kim Jong-un
articles.author: Taz Ali (now) and Kate Lamb (earlier)

paras.en: Thanks for tuning into our live blog of Apec summit currently under way in the Chinese city of Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 感谢您收看我们目前正在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会的直播博客。

paras.en: There is plenty more to come, so don’t go away, but here is a quick summary of what we know so far.
paras.zh: 还有更多内容即将推出，所以不要离开，但这里是我们迄今为止所知道的内容的快速总结。

paras.en: Chinese president Xi Jinping opened the Apec CEO summit on Wednesday with a speech calling for freer trade and greater cooperation around AI. “We should not only eliminate trade and investment barriers... but also promote inclusive and balanced development,” he said. “We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and artificial intelligence and promote a green and low-carbon transition.”
paras.zh: 中国国家主席习近平周三在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会开幕式上发表讲话，呼吁围绕人工智能实现更自由的贸易和更广泛的合作。 “我们不仅要消除贸易和投资壁垒……还要促进包容、平衡发展，”他说。 “我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，推动绿色低碳转型。”

paras.en: Russian president Vladimir Putin also addressed the summit, speaking after Ukraine destroyed the vital Kerch road bridge linking occupied Crimea to Russia in a major blow to his four-year-old war. Putin followed Xi on stage with a speech that described Western powers as “former hegemons”. He said Europe was in a “humiliating decline” and that anti-Russian sanctions imposed after his invasion of Ukraine had backfired, instead making his country stronger.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也在峰会上发表讲话，此前乌克兰摧毁了连接被占领克里米亚和俄罗斯的重要刻赤公路桥，这对他长达四年的战争造成了重大打击。普京跟随习近平上台发表讲话，将西方列强描述为“前霸主”。他表示，欧洲正处于“耻辱性的衰落”，他入侵乌克兰后实施的反俄制裁适得其反，反而使他的国家变得更加强大。

paras.en: Xi and Putin headed into a meeting after their opening addresses, according to Chinese and Russian state media.
paras.zh: 据中国和俄罗斯官方媒体报道，习近平和普京在致开幕词后开始会面。

paras.en: The much-anticipated trilateral meeting between US president Donald Trump, Xi and Putin will take place on Thursday. The three men are due to meet on the sidelines and potentially discuss Russia’s war with Ukraine and the US war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints such as trade, AI and nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 备受期待的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和普京之间的三边会议将于周四举行。这三人将在场外会面，并可能讨论俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争和美国对伊朗的战争，以及贸易、人工智能和核武器等其他热点问题。

paras.en: The meeting has drawn comparisons with the 1945 Yalta Conference between the US, Britain and the Soviet Union that formalised spheres of influence, set the stage for world order after the second world war and became shorthand for great power deals imposed on smaller countries.
paras.zh: 这次会议与 1945 年美国、英国和苏联之间的雅尔塔会议相比较，这次会议正式确定了势力范围，为第二次世界大战后的世界秩序奠定了基础，并成为强加给小国的大国交易的简称。

paras.en: It is unclear whether North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will attend the talks, but Trump has floated the possibility. On Wednesday US secretary of state Marco Rubio said the US president was willing to engage, but he did not confirm whether a meeting had been set in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚朝鲜领导人金正恩是否会参加会谈，但特朗普已经提出了这种可能性。美国国务卿卢比奥周三表示，美国总统愿意参与，但他没有证实会议是否定在深圳举行。

paras.en: Trump said on Wednesday that the US has just concluded a “very big trade deal” with the Philippines, but he did not provide any details, and Manila did not announce any agreement. “We’ve just consummated a very big trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made so far, and it is a fair deal for both countries,” Trump said during a state luncheon at the Philippine presidential palace. Trump is set to arrive in Shenzhen on Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 特朗普周三表示，美国刚刚与菲律宾达成了一项“非常大的贸易协议”，但他没有提供任何细节，马尼拉也没有宣布任何协议。特朗普在菲律宾总统府举行的国宴上表示：“我们刚刚达成了一项非常大的贸易协议，这是迄今为止我们达成的最大的贸易协议，这对两国来说都是一项公平的协议。”特朗普定于周三晚上抵达深圳。

paras.en: US president Donald Trump pictured at Ninoy Aquino airport in Manila, the Philippines, pumping his fist as he boards Air Force One for Shenzhen, China, to attend the Apec summit.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在菲律宾马尼拉尼诺·阿基诺机场登上空军一号前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会时挥舞着拳头。

paras.en: Thanks for tuning into our live blog of Apec summit currently under way in the Chinese city of Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 感谢您收看我们目前正在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会的直播博客。

paras.en: There is plenty more to come, so don’t go away, but here is a quick summary of what we know so far.
paras.zh: 还有更多内容即将推出，所以不要离开，但这里是我们迄今为止所知道的内容的快速总结。

paras.en: Chinese president Xi Jinping opened the Apec CEO summit on Wednesday with a speech calling for freer trade and greater cooperation around AI. “We should not only eliminate trade and investment barriers... but also promote inclusive and balanced development,” he said. “We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and artificial intelligence and promote a green and low-carbon transition.”
paras.zh: 中国国家主席习近平周三在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会开幕式上发表讲话，呼吁围绕人工智能实现更自由的贸易和更广泛的合作。 “我们不仅要消除贸易和投资壁垒……还要促进包容、平衡发展，”他说。 “我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，推动绿色低碳转型。”

paras.en: Russian president Vladimir Putin also addressed the summit, speaking after Ukraine destroyed the vital Kerch road bridge linking occupied Crimea to Russia in a major blow to his four-year-old war. Putin followed Xi on stage with a speech that described Western powers as “former hegemons”. He said Europe was in a “humiliating decline” and that anti-Russian sanctions imposed after his invasion of Ukraine had backfired, instead making his country stronger.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也在峰会上发表讲话，此前乌克兰摧毁了连接被占领克里米亚和俄罗斯的重要刻赤公路桥，这对他长达四年的战争造成了重大打击。普京跟随习近平上台发表讲话，将西方列强描述为“前霸主”。他表示，欧洲正处于“耻辱性的衰落”，他入侵乌克兰后实施的反俄制裁适得其反，反而使他的国家变得更加强大。

paras.en: Xi and Putin headed into a meeting after their opening addresses, according to Chinese and Russian state media.
paras.zh: 据中国和俄罗斯官方媒体报道，习近平和普京在致开幕词后开始会面。

paras.en: The much-anticipated trilateral meeting between US president Donald Trump, Xi and Putin will take place on Thursday. The three men are due to meet on the sidelines and potentially discuss Russia’s war with Ukraine and the US war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints such as trade, AI and nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 备受期待的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和普京之间的三边会议将于周四举行。这三人将在场外会面，并可能讨论俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争和美国对伊朗的战争，以及贸易、人工智能和核武器等其他热点问题。

paras.en: The meeting has drawn comparisons with the 1945 Yalta Conference between the US, Britain and the Soviet Union that formalised spheres of influence, set the stage for world order after the second world war and became shorthand for great power deals imposed on smaller countries.
paras.zh: 这次会议与 1945 年美国、英国和苏联之间的雅尔塔会议相比较，这次会议正式确定了势力范围，为第二次世界大战后的世界秩序奠定了基础，并成为强加给小国的大国交易的简称。

paras.en: It is unclear whether North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will attend the talks, but Trump has floated the possibility. On Wednesday US secretary of state Marco Rubio said the US president was willing to engage, but he did not confirm whether a meeting had been set in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚朝鲜领导人金正恩是否会参加会谈，但特朗普已经提出了这种可能性。美国国务卿卢比奥周三表示，美国总统愿意参与，但他没有证实会议是否定在深圳举行。

paras.en: Trump said on Wednesday that the US has just concluded a “very big trade deal” with the Philippines, but he did not provide any details, and Manila did not announce any agreement. “We’ve just consummated a very big trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made so far, and it is a fair deal for both countries,” Trump said during a state luncheon at the Philippine presidential palace. Trump is set to arrive in Shenzhen on Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 特朗普周三表示，美国刚刚与菲律宾达成了一项“非常大的贸易协议”，但他没有提供任何细节，马尼拉也没有宣布任何协议。特朗普在菲律宾总统府举行的国宴上表示：“我们刚刚达成了一项非常大的贸易协议，这是迄今为止我们达成的最大的贸易协议，这对两国来说都是一项公平的协议。”特朗普定于周三晚上抵达深圳。

paras.en: Donald Trump has said he doesn’t want to talk about Nvidia, the AI giant at the centre of a global espionage scandal, but AI will surely be on the agenda.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他不想谈论处于全球间谍丑闻中心的人工智能巨头英伟达，但人工智能肯定会提上议程。

paras.en: Countries have called for stronger governance and regulation of AI, as worries grow about its potential for military use and the risks posed by rogue autonomous-agent tools.
paras.zh: 由于人们越来越担心人工智能的军事用途以及流氓自主代理工具带来的风险，各国呼吁加强对人工智能的治理和监管。

paras.en: The China-US talks could build on the AI “communication channel” agreed when Trump and Xi met in Washington in September, Reuters reports.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，中美会谈可能会以特朗普和习近平 9 月在华盛顿会晤时商定的人工智能“沟通渠道”为基础。

paras.en: The next step should be to agree on what constitutes a reportable incident, who has authority to communicate, how quickly notifications must occur and how information can be verified without disclosing sensitive capabilities,” said Marina Zhang from the University of Technology Sydney.
paras.zh: 下一步应该是就什么构成应报告事件、谁有权进行沟通、必须以多快的速度发出通知以及如何在不泄露敏感能力的情况下验证信息达成一致。”悉尼科技大学的玛丽娜·张说。

paras.en: Media reports have also suggested Xi, Putin and Trump may discuss the use of AI in nuclear weapons command systems.
paras.zh: 媒体报道还暗示，习近平、普京和特朗普可能会讨论在核武器指挥系统中使用人工智能。

paras.en: Trump’s predecessor Joe Biden and Xi had agreed in 2024 that any decision to use nuclear weapons should be controlled by humans, not by AI, the White House said.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，特朗普的前任乔·拜登和习近平在 2024 年同意，任何使用核武器的决定都应由人类控制，而不是由人工智能控制。

paras.en: Taiwan’s representative Stan Shih, founder of computer manufacturer Acer, is expected to arrive in Shenzhen with a delegation this morning.
paras.zh: 台湾代表、计算机制造商宏碁创始人施振荣预计将于今天上午率团抵达深圳。

paras.en: Among the 21 Apec member economies, Taiwan’s participation is particularly sensitive, given that host country China claims the self-governing democracy as its territory.
paras.zh: 在亚太经合组织 21 个成员经济体中，台湾的参与尤其敏感，因为东道国中国声称自治民主是其领土。

paras.en: Taiwan joined Apec in 1991 under the name “Chinese Taipei” and remains a full member despite its limited diplomatic recognition. Home to TSMC, the world’s leading contract chipmaker, the island plays a crucial role in the global supply of advanced semiconductors essential to AI, a key focus of discussions at the summit.
paras.zh: 台湾于 1991 年以“中华台北”名义加入亚太经合组织，尽管其外交承认有限，但仍然是正式成员。作为全球领先的代工芯片制造商台积电的所在地，该岛在人工智能所必需的先进半导体的全球供应中发挥着至关重要的作用，这也是峰会讨论的一个重点。

paras.en: Ahead of the summit, China reiterated that Taiwan’s participation in Apec must adhere to its “one-China principle”, a position rejected by Taipei, which insists that its participation as a forum member is not subject to Beijing’s policy.
paras.zh: 峰会前，中国重申台湾参与亚太经合组织必须遵守“一个中国原则”，但台北拒绝了这一立场，坚称其作为论坛成员的参与不受北京政策的约束。

paras.en: A Tuesday poll shows that 71.8% of respondents in Taiwan supported the government’s participation in the Shenzhen summit on “equal and dignified terms.”
paras.zh: 周二的民意调查显示，71.8%的台湾受访者支持政府以“平等和有尊严的条件”参加深圳峰会。

paras.en: Taiwan could also come up in talks between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the summit on Thursday.
paras.zh: 台湾问题也可能出现在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国领导人习近平周四峰会期间的会谈中。

paras.en: Asked on Tuesday whether Taiwan had communicated with Washington ahead of Trump’s talks with Chinese and Russian leaders, Taiwan’s foreign ministry spokesperson said communication channels with the US are “running smoothly” and the ministry is closely monitoring Trump’s meetings at the summit.
paras.zh: 周二，当被问及特朗普与中国和俄罗斯领导人会谈之前台湾是否与华盛顿进行沟通时，台湾外交部发言人表示，与美国的沟通渠道“运行顺利”，台湾外交部正在密切关注特朗普在峰会上的会晤。

paras.en: Trade tensions are likely to loom over the Apec summit this year, just a year after Trump and Xi Jinping reached a tenuous truce in their trade war on the sidelines of the last Apec summit in South Korea.
paras.zh: 今年的亚太经合组织峰会可能会出现贸易紧张局势，就在特朗普和习近平在韩国上次亚太经合组织峰会期间就贸易战达成脆弱休战一年后。

paras.en: The leaders’ “priority” would be “keeping the truce alive”, especially with another Trump-Xi meeting expected at the G20 summit in Miami in December, said Lizzi Lee, a fellow at the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI), as reported by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，亚洲协会政策研究所 (ASPI) 研究员丽兹·李 (Lizzi Lee) 表示，领导人的“首要任务”将是“维持休战”，尤其是预计 12 月在迈阿密举行的 G20 峰会上将举行另一场习特会。

paras.en: Countries like Canada are also expected to be looking to broaden their trade partnerships – including with China – to reduce dependence on the United States.
paras.zh: 加拿大等国家预计也将寻求扩大贸易伙伴关系（包括与中国的贸易伙伴关系），以减少对美国的依赖。

paras.en: Trump has of course upended global trade order by imposing wide-ranging tariffs on many countries.
paras.zh: 特朗普当然对许多国家征收大范围关税，从而颠覆了全球贸易秩序。

paras.en: Kim Jong-un had plenty to gain from his three meetings with Donald Trump during the US president’s first term in office.
paras.zh: 金正恩在美国总统第一任期内与唐纳德·特朗普的三次会面中获益匪浅。

paras.en: Seven years on from their last meeting, along the heavily armed border dividing the Korean peninsula, speculation is mounting that the North Korean leader will end their estrangement at this week’s Apec summit in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 距离上次会面已过去七年，在朝鲜半岛的武装边境线上，越来越多的人猜测朝鲜领导人将在本周于深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会上结束他们的隔阂。

paras.en: But some analysts are casting doubt on the likelihood of a fourth Trump-Kim meeting in the Chinese city.
paras.zh: 但一些分析人士对在中国城市举行第四次特金会的可能性表示怀疑。

paras.en: After making rapid progress with his country’s nuclear and missile programmes and forming a loose “axis of upheaval” with Beijing and Moscow, what, they ask, would Kim have to gain from another encounter with his American counterpart?
paras.zh: 他们问，在朝鲜的核计划和导弹计划取得快速进展并与北京和莫斯科形成松散的“动乱轴心”之后，金正恩将从与美国总统的再次遭遇中获得什么？

paras.en: Apec’s Chinese hosts say they have no information on a possible bilateral, while the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, appeared to play down the prospect, saying preparations for a dialogue between Kim and Trump did not mean it would happen.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织的中国东道主表示，他们没有关于可能举行双边会谈的信息，而美国国务卿马可·卢比奥似乎淡化了这一前景，称金正恩和特朗普之间对话的准备并不意味着这种情况会发生。

paras.en: Trump, who floated the idea just before leaving Washington on Monday, has raised the prospect of a resumption of nuclear diplomacy before, yet the men have not met since their brief meeting along the DMZ in June 2019, months after they failed to agree on how US would compensate Pyongyang for dismantling its nuclear arsenal.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周一离开华盛顿之前提出了这一想法，此前曾提出过恢复核外交的前景，但自 2019 年 6 月在非军事区举行短暂会面以来，两人就没有再会面，几个月前，他们未能就美国如何补偿平壤拆除其核武库达成一致。

paras.en: Speculation that Kim would make an appearance alongside other world leaders increased, however, after a report by Russia’s Interfax news agency quoted the Kremlin as saying Vladimir Putin could meet Kim if he attended the Apec summit.
paras.zh: 然而，俄罗斯国际文传电讯社援引克里姆林宫的报道称，如果弗拉基米尔·普京出席亚太经合组织峰会，他可能会与金正恩会面，因此有关金正恩将与其他世界领导人一起亮相的猜测有所增加。

paras.en: The Kremlin “wouldn’t do that unless they were certain he was going to meet”, Sydney Seiler, a former US national intelligence officer for North Korea, now at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, told Reuters. “I’m pretty confident something’s underway.”
paras.zh: 前美国朝鲜国家情报官员、现供职于战略与国际研究中心的西德尼·塞勒 (Sydney Seiler) 告诉路透社，克里姆林宫“除非确定他会面，否则不会这样做”。 “我非常有信心某些事情正在发生。”

paras.en: Others North Korea experts were more skeptical. Kim would have nothing to gain from a trip to Shenzhen except photo opportunities, said Kim Dong-yup, a professor at Kyungnam University’s Far East Institute. “Let’s say they offer to remove sanctions. But sanctions are already not working. There’s nothing to gain for Kim. Why would he go and open himself up to potential uncertainty?”
paras.zh: 其他朝鲜专家则持更为怀疑的态度。庆南大学远东研究所教授金东烨表示，金正恩从深圳之行除了拍照机会之外没有任何收获。 “假设他们提出取消制裁。但制裁已经不起作用了。对金正恩来说没有什么好处。他为什么要让自己暴露在潜在的不确定性之下呢？”

paras.en: North Korean state media have been silent on the speculation. Official photos released this week showed a smiling Kim, accompanied by his wife and daughter, perched on an armchair in the snow at a ski resort near the North Korea-China border.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方媒体对这一猜测保持沉默。本周发布的官方照片显示，在中朝边境附近的一个滑雪胜地，微笑的金正恩在妻子和女儿的陪​​伴下，坐在雪地里的扶手椅上。

paras.en: Wearing aviator shades, a cigarette dangling from his fingers, Kim did not give the impression he was ready to resurrect his “friendship” with a weakened US president.
paras.zh: 金戴着飞行员墨镜，手指上叼着一支香烟，他并没有给人留下他准备恢复与一位衰弱的美国总统的“友谊”的印象。

paras.en: As mentioned earlier, Zelenskyy is undeniably concerned about the Apec trilateral meeting between the Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 如前所述，泽伦斯基无疑对唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京之间的亚太经合组织三边会议感到担忧。

paras.en: Ukraine’s foreign minister Andriy Sybiga said earlier this week that a meeting between US, Chinese and Russian leaders would “only encourage Putin to continue this war”.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德烈·西比加本周早些时候表示，美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人之间的会晤“只会鼓励普京继续这场战争”。

paras.en: Beijing has said the three leaders will discuss “safeguarding world peace”, but US officials say Trump is not expected to bring up Russia’s war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 北京表示，三位领导人将讨论“维护世界和平”，但美国官员表示，特朗普预计不会提及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Beijing, insisting it is a neutral party, has never denounced the Russian invasion, and has instead called for peace talks.
paras.zh: 北京坚称自己是中立方，从未谴责俄罗斯的入侵，而是呼吁和平谈判。

paras.en: “Beijing will remain respectful of Russia’s own aims in the war and balance that with growing calls from Europe to exert a little more influence in that regard,” NTU’s Loh said, as reported by Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，南洋理工大学的罗说：“北京将继续尊重俄罗斯在战争中的自身目标，并平衡欧洲日益要求在这方面发挥更大影响力的呼声。”

paras.en: Putin would probably have the most to gain from the trilateral meeting, ASPI’s Lee added.
paras.zh: ASPI 的 Lee 补充道，普京可能会从三边会议中获益最多。

paras.en: Just being at the table with Trump and Xi would elevate Russia’s standing and potentially shift the conversation toward a broader great-power bargain over European security.
paras.zh: 仅仅与特朗普和习近平坐在谈判桌上就能提升俄罗斯的地位，并有可能将对话转向更广泛的欧洲安全大国讨价还价。

paras.en: Yalta became a byword for betrayal. Will Trump, Xi and Putin enact another carve-up?
paras.zh: 雅尔塔成为背叛的代名词。特朗普、习近平和普京是否会再次瓜分？

paras.en: That is the question the Guardian’s diplomatic correspondent Patrick Wintour seeks to address in his piece about the expected, Putin, Trump and Xi, meeting at Apec on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这是《卫报》外交记者帕特里克·温图尔在其关于普京、特朗普和习近平预计将于周四在亚太经合组织会议上会面的文章中试图解决的问题。

paras.en: Some have likened the impending trilateral (pictured below) to the 1945 meeting between Stalin, Churchill and Roosevelt that that in effect carved up postwar Europe, between a communist-ruled east and a democratic, capitalist west.
paras.zh: 一些人将即将到来的三边会议（如下图所示）比作 1945 年斯大林、丘吉尔和罗斯福之间的会晤，这次会晤实际上将战后的欧洲瓜分在共产主义统治的东方和民主资本主义的西方之间。

paras.en: Among those concerned about the meeting, he writes, is Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 他写道，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）是对这次会议感到担忧的人之一。

paras.en: It is a truism in diplomacy that if you are not around the table, the risk is that you, or your values, are on the menu and about to be carved up. Many excluded from the summit in Shenzhen, principally Ukraine but also eastern Europe and Baltic countries, Taiwan and even Iran, have reason to be nervous that their sponsors might abandon them in a complex geopolitical trade-off that Putin envisions, and Trump seems to endorse.
paras.zh: 外交上有一条不言而喻的道理：如果你不在谈判桌旁，那么你或你的价值观就会出现在菜单上并即将被瓜分的风险。许多被排除在深圳峰会之外的国家，主要是乌克兰，还有东欧和波罗的海国家、台湾，甚至伊朗，都有理由担心他们的赞助商可能会在普京所设想的复杂的地缘政治权衡中放弃他们，而特朗普似乎也支持这种权衡。

paras.en: The Australian prime minister, Anthony Albanese, has arrived in Shenzhen for the Apec summit, and confirmed he will join a leaders’ “family photo” despite the presence of Russia’s Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞已抵达深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会，并确认尽管俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也在场，他仍将参加领导人的“全家福”。

paras.en: Albanese said he would respect the wishes of host country China and take part, echoing the explanation of the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney. But, Albanese said would make clear Australia’s view on Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯表示，他将尊重东道国中国的意愿并参加，这与加拿大总理马克·卡尼的解释相呼应。但是，阿尔巴内塞表示将明确澳大利亚对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的看法。

paras.en: This is a big power intervening in an illegal way to try to assert its will and underestimating the will and courage and conviction of the Ukrainian people to fight for their national sovereignty.
paras.zh: 这是一个大国以非法方式进行干预，试图维护自己的意志，低估了乌克兰人民争取国家主权的意愿、勇气和信念。

paras.en: After Tuesday’s Quad summit in Manila, Albanese talked up the cooperation of middle powers in this week’s roster of international summits.
paras.zh: 周二在马尼拉举行的四方峰会之后，阿尔巴尼斯在本周的国际峰会名单中谈到了中等强国的合作。

paras.en: Absolutely there is a role for middle power diplomacy, and we’ll see at Apec, the engagement that we’ll have with countries such as Canada and Mexico, Korea, Japan.
paras.zh: 中等强国外交绝对可以发挥作用，我们将在亚太经合组织上看到我们将与加拿大、墨西哥、韩国、日本等国家进行接触。

paras.en: They are important partners for Australia.
paras.zh: 他们是澳大利亚的重要合作伙伴。

paras.en: Albanese is due to meet China’s president Xi Jinping on Friday.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞将于周五会见中国国家主席习近平。

paras.en: Donald Trump, meanwhile, has not arrived in Shenzhen yet, writes our correspondent Rebecca Bailey, reporting from the Chinese tech hub.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们的记者丽贝卡·贝利在中国科技中心报道称，唐纳德·特朗普尚未抵达深圳。

paras.en: He was last seen at the start of talks with Philippine president Ferdinand Marcos Jr in Manila, where Reuters reported he said he was not concerned about the situation in the hotly contested South China Sea.
paras.zh: 他最后一次出现是在马尼拉与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯举行会谈时，据路透社报道，他表示他并不担心争议激烈的南海局势。

paras.en: The US alliance with the Philippines has never been better, Trump added.
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，美国与菲律宾的联盟从未如此美好。

paras.en: The US leader also touted an expansion of defence cooperation with Manila and suggested US nuclear technology could help ease the country’s energy woes.
paras.zh: 这位美国领导人还宣扬扩大与马尼拉的防务合作，并表示美国的核技术可以帮助缓解该国的能源困境。

paras.en: Speaking to the press in Manila, US secretary of state Marco Rubio has addressed speculation that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will attend the Apec summit.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在马尼拉向媒体发表讲话，回应了有关朝鲜领导人金正恩将出席亚太经合组织峰会的猜测。

paras.en: Asked how serious the idea was, Rubio said:
paras.zh: 当被问及这个想法有多认真时，卢比奥说：

paras.en: It’s serious in the sense that I think the president has never viewed meeting and talking to someone as a concession. He has often made the case – and I think rightfully so – that, how are you going to solve problems with people you have disagreements with if you don’t speak to them, if you’re not willing to engage with them?
paras.zh: 从某种意义上说，这是严肃的，因为我认为总统从未将与某人会面和交谈视为让步。他经常提出这样的观点——我认为这是正确的——如果你不与那些与你有分歧的人交谈，如果你不愿意与他们接触，你将如何解决他们的问题？

paras.en: I think there’s been this conventional thought in American foreign policy that if you meet with someone, you give them credibility; if you meet with someone, you somehow are saying that everything they’re doing is good or right. And that’s not the way the president views it, and I’m glad he doesn’t view it that way.
paras.zh: 我认为美国外交政策中有这样一种传统观念：如果你会见某人，你就给了他们可信度；如果你遇到某人，你就在说他们所做的一切都是好的或正确的。总统并不这么看，我很高兴他不这么看。

paras.en: The president views it this way – if we have a problem with North Korea, the only way we’re ever going to solve it is if we engage with them. Now, that may not be possible, and I’m not telling you that there will be a meeting tomorrow. I’m just saying that that’s – the president is willing to meet and discuss, as he did during his first term. Whether that will lead to a positive outcome, we’ll never find out if we don’t try. And it may not happen, but he’s prepared to do it. He has made that clear in the past.
paras.zh: 总统是这样认为的——如果我们与朝鲜有问题，解决问题的唯一方法就是与他们接触。现在，这可能是不可能的，我也不会告诉你明天会有一个会议。我只是说，总统愿意开会讨论，就像他在第一个任期内所做的那样。如果我们不尝试，我们永远不会知道这是否会带来积极的结果。这可能不会发生，但他已经准备好了。他过去已经明确表示过这一点。

paras.en: Presidents Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin have just begun talks, according to state media from both countries, reports our correspondent, Rebecca Bailey, from Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 据我们驻深圳记者丽贝卡·贝利报道，据两国官方媒体报道，习近平主席和普京总统刚刚开始会谈。

paras.en: Earlier Putin told the Apec summit he expected tomorrow’s much anticipated trilateral meeting with Trump and Xi to be “highly useful”.
paras.zh: 普京早些时候在亚太经合组织峰会上表示，他预计明天备受期待的特朗普和习近平三边会议将“非常有用”。

paras.en: The Russian president took to the stage after Malaysia’s prime minister Anwar Ibrahim for a punchy speech that took aim at Russia’s detractors and pitched expanded economic cooperation with Apec.
paras.zh: 在马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣之后，俄罗斯总统上台发表了强有力的讲话，针对俄罗斯的批评者，并提出扩大与亚太经合组织的经济合作。

paras.en: Western sanctions imposed on Moscow since his 2022 invasion of Ukraine have “failed” and Russia has come through “with dignity”, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，自2022年入侵乌克兰以来，西方对莫斯科实施的制裁“失败了”，俄罗斯“有尊严地”渡过了难关。

paras.en: In a contemporary world full of turbulence, amidst the fragmentation of the global economy, and at a time when military-political risks are on the rise, what is desperately needed is unity rather than division, equality rather than hegemony, partnership rather than isolation, and dialogue rather than ultimatums.
paras.zh: 在当今世界动荡不安、全球经济碎片化、军事政治风险上升的背景下，迫切需要的是团结而不是分裂、平等而不是霸权、伙伴而不是孤立、对话而不是最后通牒。

paras.en: Well, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) club has 21 members that represent more than 50% of global GDP and are home to about 2.7 billion people.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织（APEC）俱乐部有 21 个成员，占全球 GDP 的 50% 以上，拥有约 27 亿人口。

paras.en: China, Russia and the US are three of the largest members. Others include Australia, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Singapore, and Vietnam.
paras.zh: 中国、俄罗斯和美国是最大的三个成员。其他国家包括澳大利亚、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、墨西哥、新西兰、巴布亚新几内亚、新加坡和越南。

paras.en: Read below our handy short explainer on how it all started.
paras.zh: 请阅读下面我们方便的简短解释，了解这一切是如何开始的。

paras.en: The Asia Group’s George Chen is at the CEO summit and sent the Guardian some thoughts on Xi’s speech, which he said was “largely expected”, featuring technology and innovation prominently.
paras.zh: 亚洲集团的陈乔治出席了首席执行官峰会，他向《卫报》表达了对习近平讲话的一些看法，他表示这次讲话“很大程度上符合预期”，突出强调了技术和创新。

paras.en: Xi positioned China as “a force for stability and predictability in an increasingly uncertain world”, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，习近平将中国定位为“在日益不确定的世界中保持稳定和可预测性的力量”。

paras.en: While Xi never mentioned export controls, Nvidia or the United States directly in his speech, the underlying message was unmistakable: China intends to pursue a more open and cooperative approach to technology development. That message is likely to resonate with many countries in the Global South and reinforces Beijing’s effort to contrast its technology strategy with that of Washington.”
paras.zh: 尽管习近平在讲话中从未直接提及出口管制、英伟达或美国，但其背后的信息是明确无误的：中国打算在技术开发方面采取更加开放和合作的方式。这一信息可能会引起全球南方许多国家的共鸣，并加强北京将其技术战略与华盛顿进行对比的努力。”

paras.en: Xi Jinping calls for freer trade, greater cooperation on AI
paras.zh: 习近平呼吁更加自由的贸易、加强人工智能合作

paras.en: President Xi Jinping addressed the Apec CEO summit this morning. His speech called for the elimination of trade and investment barriers, as well as greater cooperation around artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 今天上午，习近平主席在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上发表讲话。他的讲话呼吁消除贸易和投资壁垒，并加强人工智能方面的合作。

paras.en: He also emphasised the importance of the World Trade Organization, and said China was expanding its imports of quality goods and services.
paras.zh: 他还强调了世界贸易组织的重要性，并表示中国正在扩大优质商品和服务的进口。

paras.en: We should not only eliminate trade and investment barriers... but also promote inclusive and balanced development.
paras.zh: 我们不仅要消除贸易和投资壁垒……还要促进包容、平衡发展。

paras.en: We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and artificial intelligence and promote a green and low-carbon transition.”
paras.zh: 我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，推动绿色低碳转型。”

paras.en: We’re back for day two of the Apec CEO Summit in China’s southern tech hub of Shenzhen. Today the summit will be addressed by APEC leaders, with President Xi Jinping set to give a keynote speech.
paras.zh: 我们回来参加在中国南方科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会的第二天。今天的峰会将由亚太经合组织领导人发表讲话，习近平主席将发表主旨演讲。

paras.en: Bilateral meetings will continue on the sidelines, although the most eye-catching – Xi and Donald Trump, and the US-China-Russia trilateral – won’t be until Thursday. Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen this morning, greeted by a red carpet, soldiers and pom pom-waving dancers dressed in fuchsia and blue. Communist party politburo member Cai Qi, often described as Xi’s right-hand man, was there to meet him.
paras.zh: 双边会议将在场外继续举行，不过最引人注目的会议 — — 习近平和唐纳德·特朗普以及美中俄三边会议 — — 要到周四才会举行。弗拉基米尔·普京今天早上抵达深圳，迎接他的是红地毯、穿着紫红色和蓝色衣服的士兵和挥舞绒球的舞者。经常被称为习近平得力助手的中共中央政治局委员蔡奇在那里会见他。

paras.en: Trump will leave Manila, where he has been attending the Asean forum, later on Wednesday. The Associated Press reports that he has expressed excitement about his own welcome ceremony: “I hear we’re going to have quite a landing,” he told reporters. “It’s going to be a beautiful thing.”
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周三晚些时候离开马尼拉，他一直在那里参加东盟论坛。据美联社报道，他对自己的欢迎仪式表示了兴奋：“我听说我们将顺利着陆，”他告诉记者。 “这将是一件美好的事情。”

paras.en: Aside from the high-level hobnobbing, delegates are “working around the clock” to agree on a joint statement for Thursday, a senior Apec official told Reuters on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织一位高级官员周二告诉路透社，除了高层交往之外，代表们还在“夜以继日地工作”，以就周四的联合声明达成一致。

paras.en: Carlos Kuriyama, director of the Apec policy support unit, said all 21 Apec members agreed on the need to ensure trade is “not only open, but also fair”.
paras.zh: APEC政策支持部门主任卡洛斯·栗山表示，所有21个APEC成员都同意需要确保贸易“不仅开放，而且公平”。

paras.en: He said they were also discussing the safe and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 他说，他们还在讨论安全和负责任地使用人工智能。

paras.en: They are working very hard to make sure that we can have a common language.”
paras.zh: 他们正在非常努力地确保我们能够拥有共同语言。”

paras.en: It’s been a big week already for diplomatic summits, with the most anticipated among them, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leader’s meeting, starting today in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 对于外交峰会来说，这已经是重要的一周，其中最受期待的是今天在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议。

paras.en: Some observers have noted that we could be about to witness a Yalta 2.0, a reference to a major 1945 wartime conference attended by Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin.
paras.zh: 一些观察家指出，我们可能即将见证雅尔塔 2.0，这是指 1945 年丘吉尔、罗斯福和斯大林出席的一次大型战时会议。

paras.en: That’s because the leaders of the US, China and Russia – namely Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin – will meet for trilateral talks at the summit to discuss the wars in Iran and Ukraine, denuclearisation, economics, tech and trade.
paras.zh: 这是因为美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人——即唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京——将在峰会上举行三边会谈，讨论伊朗和乌克兰战争、无核化、经济、科技和贸易。

paras.en: Trump has also floated the possibility of meeting North Korea’s Kim Jong-un in what would be their first meeting of his second term.
paras.zh: 特朗普还提出了与朝鲜金正恩会面的可能性，这将是他第二任期内的首次会面。

paras.en: Here is a quick recap of the latest before the event kicks off:
paras.zh: 以下是活动开始前的最新情况的快速回顾：

paras.en: China’s foreign ministry said the leaders “will exchange views in-depth on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations, which is of groundbreaking significance”.
