paras.en: "They're being squeezed in every direction because they've got their costs that are going up, but we also know that families at home are really feeling the pinch in their own hip pockets."
paras.zh: “他们在各个方面都受到挤压，因为他们的成本不断上涨，但我们也知道，国内的家庭确实感到自己的口袋拮据。”

paras.en: But business confidence in South Australia nevertheless remains higher than it does nationally, according to the survey.
paras.zh: 但调查显示，南澳大利亚州的商业信心仍然高于全国。

paras.en: "The national economy is clearly under a bit of strain, and under a bit of pressure, yet South Australia is outperforming the rest of the nation, with the exception of maybe Western Australia," SA Premier Peter Malinauskas said.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯卡斯 (Peter Malinauskas) 表示：“国民经济显然面临着一些压力，但南澳大利亚州的表现优于全国其他地区，西澳大利亚州可能除外。”

paras.en: "That doesn't change the fact that we are subject to the national economic headwinds which are clearly under strain at the moment."
paras.zh: “这并没有改变我们面临国家经济逆风的事实，而目前这些逆风显然面临着压力。”

articles.title: Ukraine cripples Crimean bridge in blow to Putin before meeting with Xi, Trump

paras.en: Ukraine cripples Crimean bridge in blow to Putin before meeting with Xi, Trump
paras.zh: 乌克兰在与习近平和特朗普会面前对普京进行打击，摧毁了克里米亚大桥

paras.en: 19-kilometre bridge over Kerch Strait has been repeated target for Ukraine
paras.zh: 刻赤海峡上19公里长的桥梁多次成为乌克兰的攻击目标

paras.en: Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the central road section of the bridge linking Russia and Crimea on Tuesday, inflicting a military and symbolic blow on Russian President Vladimir Putin two days before he is due to meet the leaders of China and the U.S.
paras.zh: 周二，乌克兰无人机和导弹摧毁了连接俄罗斯和克里米亚大桥的中央路段，对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)造成了军事和象征性打击，两天后他将与中国和美国领导人会面。

paras.en: Videos and images posted on X by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and verified by Reuters showed the bridge's main road arch had crumbled into the sea, leaving a yawning gap.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在 X 上发布并经路透社核实的视频和图片显示，大桥的主路拱门已经倒塌入海，留下了一个巨大的缺口。

paras.en: "Russia strikes our infrastructure every day, including bridges," Zelenskyy said. "We are ... reminding Russia that war will always return to where it began."
paras.zh: “俄罗斯每天都会袭击我们的基础设施，包括桥梁，”泽伦斯基说。 “我们……提醒俄罗斯，战争总会回到开始的地方。”

paras.en: The 19-kilometre bridge is a flagship project inaugurated by Putin in 2018 and a symbol of Russia's attachment to the peninsula it captured and annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
paras.zh: 这座全长 19 公里的大桥是普京于 2018 年启动的旗舰项目，也是俄罗斯对其 2014 年从乌克兰夺取并吞并的半岛的依恋的象征。

paras.en: The timing was awkward for the Kremlin leader ahead of his meeting in Shenzhen on Thursday with U.S. President Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping, where the three are expected to discuss the Ukraine war among other topics.
paras.zh: 对于克里姆林宫领导人周四在深圳与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平会面之前的时机来说，时机很尴尬，预计三人将在会上讨论乌克兰战争等话题。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the strike followed an unprecedented operation that methodically destroyed Russian air defences, radar systems and electronic warfare capabilities.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，此次袭击是在一次前所未有的行动之后进行的，该行动有条不紊地摧毁了俄罗斯的防空系统、雷达系统和电子战能力。

paras.en: Sergei Aksyonov, Crimea's Russian-installed governor, said two people were killed and road traffic had been suspended. Rail traffic partially resumed after a pause.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯任命的克里米亚州长谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫表示，两人死亡，道路交通已暂停。铁路交通在暂停后部分恢复。

paras.en: Putin's spokesman Dmitry Peskov said a repair plan would be prepared, making the bridge "even better than before."
paras.zh: 普京的发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，将制定修复计划，使这座桥“比以前更好”。

paras.en: But Russian military bloggers said repairs would be exceptionally challenging given Ukraine's capacity for further attacks.
paras.zh: 但俄罗斯军事博主表示，鉴于乌克兰发动进一步袭击的能力，修复工作将异常困难。

paras.en: Finnish military analyst Emil Kastehelmi posted on X: "The road bridge won’t be repaired during this war ... Ukraine has achieved a victory with both concrete and symbolic implications."
paras.zh: 芬兰军事分析家埃米尔·卡斯泰赫米（Emil Kastehelmi）在X上发帖称：“公路桥在这场战争中不会被修复……乌克兰取得了具有具体和象征意义的胜利。”

paras.en: The bridge over the Kerch Strait was once a key supply route for Russian forces in Ukraine, but the military now relies more heavily on a land corridor running through parts of eastern and southern Ukraine that Russia has captured since launching a full-scale war with its neighbour in 2022.
paras.zh: 刻赤海峡大桥曾经是俄罗斯军队在乌克兰的重要补给路线，但军方现在更加依赖一条穿过乌克兰东部和南部部分地区的陆地走廊，自2022年与邻国发动全面战争以来，俄罗斯已经占领了这些地区。

paras.en: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin said a government commission had met to decide on steps to assess damage, launch repairs and discuss the logistics of delivering cargo to Crimea via alternative routes.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯副总理马拉特·库斯努林表示，政府委员会已召开会议，决定评估损失、启动维修并讨论通过替代路线向克里米亚运送货物的物流措施。

paras.en: The bridge spans a channel used by commercial vessels entering and leaving the Sea of Azov, making it an important part of the region's grain export network.
paras.zh: 该桥横跨进出亚速海的商船所使用的航道，使其成为该地区粮食出口网络的重要组成部分。

paras.en: While Black Sea grain shipments have largely stalled amid escalating drone attacks, export infrastructure has suffered limited damage, meaning trade could resume quickly if security conditions improve.
paras.zh: 尽管由于无人机袭击不断升级，黑海谷物运输基本陷入停滞，但出口基础设施受到的损害有限，这意味着如果安全状况改善，贸易可能会迅速恢复。

paras.en: - Russia says Ukrainian aerial attack involved more than 1,300 drones
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯称乌克兰空袭涉及1,300多架无人机

paras.en: - Satellite limitations imposed by Musk's SpaceX pose danger for Ukraine, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: - 泽连斯基表示，马斯克旗下 SpaceX 实施的卫星限制对乌克兰构成危险

paras.en: Andrey Sizov, of consultancy Sovecon, said the bridge's collapse could "substantially delay any eventual resumption of shipping from the Sea of Azov" because debris would have to be cleared from the channel.
paras.zh: Sovecon咨询公司的安德烈·西佐夫表示，大桥倒塌可能“大大推迟亚速海航运的最终恢复”，因为必须清除航道上的碎片。

paras.en: Ukraine has attacked the bridge several times during the war. A truck bomb in October 2022 killed four people and limited the bridge's capacity for several months. In July 2023, a section of road bridge was destroyed and a couple crossing by car were killed.
paras.zh: 乌克兰在战争期间曾多次袭击这座桥。 2022 年 10 月发生的一次卡车炸弹袭击造成四人死亡，并限制了桥梁的通行能力达数月之久。 2023年7月，一段公路桥梁被毁，一对开车过路的夫妇丧生。

paras.en: The overnight attack was part of what Russian state media called Ukraine's biggest drone attack yet. Russia said it shot down 1,441 drones over 22 regions, surpassing the previous record of 1,336 set on Monday.
paras.zh: 这次夜间袭击是俄罗斯官方媒体所说的乌克兰迄今为止最大规模的无人机袭击的一部分。俄罗斯表示，其在 22 个地区击落了 1,441 架无人机，超过了周一创下的 1,336 架无人机记录。

paras.en: Air defences repelled a major drone attack on the industrial cities of Ufa and Salavat in Russia's Bashkortostan region, home to several oil refineries, state media reported, citing local officials. Ukraine said it had hit a refinery and petrochemical complex in Salavat.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体援引当地官员的消息称，防空系统击退了对俄罗斯巴什科尔托斯坦地区工业城市乌法和萨拉瓦特的大规模无人机袭击，该地区是多家炼油厂的所在地。乌克兰表示，袭击了萨拉瓦特的一座炼油厂和石化厂。

paras.en: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said that around 800 Ukrainian drones had flown towards the surrounding Moscow region, 321 of which had been brought down en route.
paras.zh: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁表示，大约800架乌克兰无人机已飞往莫斯科周边地区，其中321架在途中被击落。

paras.en: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, on screen, addresses a meeting of the Ukraine Defence Contact Group at NATO headquarters in Brussels on Tuesday. (Virginia Mayo/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周二，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在布鲁塞尔北约总部举行的乌克兰国防联络小组会议上在屏幕上发表讲话。 （弗吉尼亚梅奥/美联社）

paras.en: The scale and frequency of Ukrainian drone attacks have increased as Russia has intensified its own drone and missile campaign in a grinding war of attrition, with both sides targeting energy infrastructure and other strategic assets.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯在一场残酷的消耗战中加强了自己的无人机和导弹行动，双方都将能源基础设施和其他战略资产作为目标，乌克兰无人机袭击的规模和频率有所增加。

paras.en: Attacks have continued despite U.S.-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi last week, the first in nine months, and separate meetings between U.S. envoys and Putin and Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 尽管上周在美国斡旋下在阿布扎比举行了九个月来的首次和平谈判，而且美国特使与普京和泽伦斯基分别举行了会晤，但袭击仍在继续。

paras.en: Kyiv and Moscow agreed on a major exchange of prisoners during last week's talks but there was no significant breakthrough on broader issues, including territory. Russia holds about a fifth of Ukrainian land but the front line has remained largely static for months.
paras.zh: 基辅和莫斯科在上周的会谈中就大规模交换囚犯达成一致，但在包括领土在内的更广泛问题上没有取得重大突破。俄罗斯拥有乌克兰约五分之一的土地，但前线几个月来基本保持静止。

paras.en: In Kyiv, Reuters witnesses reported a series of loud explosions in the capital overnight.
paras.zh: 在基辅，路透社目击者称首都夜间发生了一系列巨大爆炸。

paras.en: Vitali Klitschko, Kyiv's mayor, said Russia struck the city's North and South bridges, an assertion later confirmed by Moscow, and partially damaged the metro system. The attacks caused some power and water outages and prompted transport restrictions, he said.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，俄罗斯袭击了该市的南北桥梁，莫斯科方面后来证实了这一说法，并部分损坏了地铁系统。他说，袭击导致部分地区停电和停水，并导致交通受到限制。

paras.en: Overnight Russian strikes on energy infrastructure left consumers without power in eight Ukrainian regions, Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov said.
paras.zh: 能源部副部长阿尔乔姆·涅克拉索夫表示，俄罗斯一夜之间对能源基础设施的袭击导致乌克兰八个地区的消费者断电。

paras.en: Russia said its forces had struck transport, military and energy facilities in Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Cherkasy and Dnipropetrovsk, along with port infrastructure and a cargo ship.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，其部队袭击了基辅、扎波罗热、切尔卡瑟和第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克的交通、军事和能源设施，以及港口基础设施和一艘货船。

paras.en: Reuters could not immediately independently confirm the reports. Both sides deny deliberately targeting civilians.
paras.zh: 路透社无法立即独立证实这些报道。双方均否认蓄意针对平民。

articles.title: Convicted rapist Russell Brand under investigation for claiming innocence from behind bars
articles.author: Philip Drost

paras.en: Convicted rapist Russell Brand under investigation for claiming innocence from behind bars
paras.zh: 被定罪的强奸犯拉塞尔·布兰德因在狱中声称无罪而接受调查

paras.en: The Ministry of Justice in the U.K. is investigating whether comedian and convicted rapist Russell Brand broke prison rules about public statements after his wife shared a message from Brand on his YouTube channel claiming his innocence.
paras.zh: 英国司法部正在调查喜剧演员、被定罪的强奸犯拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 的妻子在他的 YouTube 频道上分享了布兰德声称自己无罪的消息后，他的公开言论是否违反了监狱规定。

paras.en: In the U.K., prisoners are banned from making statements that could cause distress to victims. Breaking that rule could result in Brand receiving an extended sentence or losing privileges.
paras.zh: 在英国，囚犯被禁止发表可能给受害者造成痛苦的言论。违反该规则可能会导致布兰德被延长刑期或失去特权。

paras.en: Brand, 51, is currently serving a 10-and-a-half-year sentence for rape and sexual assault.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德目前因强奸和性侵犯被判 10 年半徒刑，正在服刑。

paras.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham's spokesperson called the statement "appalling," and said it is being "urgently investigated."
paras.zh: 总理安迪·伯纳姆的发言人称这一声明“令人震惊”，并表示正在“紧急调查”。

paras.en: "Prisoners are strictly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims, and speaking to the media is only permitted in exceptional circumstances," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 发言人说：“囚犯被严格禁止发表会给受害者带来痛苦的言论，只有在特殊情况下才允许接受媒体采访。”

paras.en: Brand, seen here leaving Southwark Crown Court in London earlier this month, was convicted of rape and three counts of sexual assault. (Alastair Grant/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，布兰德离开伦敦南华克刑事法庭，被判犯有强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。 （阿拉斯泰尔·格兰特/美联社）

paras.en: The spokesperson added that prisoners could not get around the rules by asking another person to read their comments.
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说，囚犯不能通过要求他人阅读他们的评论来规避规则。

paras.en: U.K. Justice Secretary Alex Norris posted about the statement from Brand on X, saying, "I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules."
paras.zh: 英国司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯 (Alex Norris) 在 X 上发布了布兰德的声明，他表示：“我希望如果发现他违反规则，将会采取行动。”

paras.en: The statement came at the 54-minute mark of the couple's weekly podcast episode, part of which was pre-recorded.
paras.zh: 该声明是在这对夫妇的每周播客节目进行到 54 分钟时发表的，其中一部分是预先录制的。

paras.en: "Russell has asked me to read something to you today," said Laura Brand, followed by the claim of innocence from her husband.
paras.zh: “拉塞尔今天让我读一些东西给你们听，”劳拉·布兰德说道，随后她的丈夫声称自己是无辜的。

paras.en: If he is found to have broken the rules, Brand could face restrictions on social visits and communication, or lose privileges such as access to time in the gym or TV. It could also result in an extension of his prison sentence.
paras.zh: 如果布兰德被发现违反规定，他可能会面临社交访问和沟通的限制，或者失去诸如在健身房或看电视的时间等特权。这也可能导致他的刑期延长。

paras.en: Laura Brand, seen here arriving at Southwark Crown Court in London earlier this month, shared Brand's statement on the couple's weekly podcast. (Kin Cheung/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 劳拉·布兰德本月早些时候抵达伦敦南华克刑事法院，在这对夫妇的每周播客上分享了布兰德的声明。 （张建/美联社）

paras.en: Brand rose to prominence in the 2000s as a comedian, broadcaster and Hollywood star, starring in movies such as Forgetting Sarah Marshall and Get Him to the Greek and working for MTV, BBC and Channel Four. He has since turned to YouTube, where he's made a name for himself as an evangelical influencer and right-wing conspiracy theorist.
paras.zh: 布兰德在 2000 年代作为一名喜剧演员、广播员和好莱坞明星而声名鹊起，主演了《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》等电影，并为 MTV、BBC 和第四频道工作。此后，他转向 YouTube，并在那里以福音派影响者和右翼阴谋论者的身份而闻名。

paras.en: Brand was accused by an additional six women of sexual misconduct last week, following his conviction.
paras.zh: 布兰德被定罪后，上周又被六名女性指控性行为不端。

paras.en: He has already been convicted of a rape dating back to 2009, as well as three sexual assaults. He was sentenced to nine years in prison for the rape, and 35 months in prison for the sexual assaults.
paras.zh: 他已被判犯有 2009 年以来的强奸罪以及三起性侵犯罪。他因强奸罪被判处 9 年监禁，因性侵犯罪被判处 35 个月监禁。

paras.en: Brand has denied the accusations, and claimed he has never had non-consensual sex.
paras.zh: 布兰德否认了这些指控，并声称他从未发生过未经同意的性行为。

articles.title: U.K. sanctions Israeli companies involved in building illegal settlements in West Bank

paras.en: U.K. sanctions Israeli companies involved in building illegal settlements in West Bank
paras.zh: 英国制裁参与在约旦河西岸修建非法定居点的以色列公司

paras.en: Britain says newly imposed sanctions to disrupt firms' access to finance, support for more construction
paras.zh: 英国表示新实施的制裁破坏了企业获得融资和支持更多建设的机会

paras.en: Britain said on Tuesday it would impose sanctions on eight Israeli construction companies involved in building settlements in the occupied West Bank, as well as on an activist group responsible for blocking aid to Gaza.
paras.zh: 英国周二表示，将对八家参与在被占领的约旦河西岸建设定居点的以色列建筑公司以及一个负责阻止对加沙援助的激进组织实施制裁。

paras.en: The firms targeted for asset freezes and director disqualifications include Har Hevron Development Company, Hemdat Shomron and S.A.G. (Velvel) Construction and Development, which build and develop homes in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 资产冻结和董事资格被取消的公司包括 Har Hevron Development Company、Hemdat Shomron 和 S.A.G. (Velvel) 建设和开发公司，在西岸建造和开发房屋。

paras.en: The government announced the sanctions package shortly before the final deadlines for the E1 tender, a settlement project that would bisect the Israeli-occupied West Bank and cut it off from East Jerusalem, fragmenting the land that Palestinians hope will form the heart of a state.
paras.zh: 政府在E1招标最后期限前不久宣布了制裁方案，该定居点项目将把以色列占领的约旦河西岸一分为二，并将其与东耶路撒冷隔离开来，使巴勒斯坦人希望成为国家中心的土地变得支离破碎。

paras.en: "Protecting the two-state solution is the North Star of this government's approach," British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said in a statement. "That is why my message on E1 is clear: Do not bid, do not build and do not profit from the destruction of the two-state solution."
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德在一份声明中表示：“保护两国解决方案是本届政府方针的北极星。” “这就是为什么我在 E1 上的信息很明确：不要投标，不要建设，不要从破坏两国解决方案中获利。”

paras.en: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said the sanctions were a "hostile act targeting private, law-abiding companies," adding that the Israeli government would consider new ways to strengthen settlements in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔表示，制裁是“针对守法私营公司的敌对行为”，并补充说以色列政府将考虑新的方法来加强约旦河西岸的定居点。

paras.en: "Israel will respond to the British government’s actions with countermeasures. A wide range of possible responses is currently under consideration. Our decisions will be announced in due course," he said in a post on X.
paras.zh: “以色列将以反制措施回应英国政府的行动。目前正在考虑各种可能的反应。我们的决定将在适当的时候宣布，”他在X上发帖称。

paras.en: Saar remains foreign minister in a caretaker government led by Benjamin Netanyahu. An Oct. 27 election stripped Netanyahu's coalition of its parliamentary majority but no winner emerged, and talks are ongoing to form a new government.
paras.zh: 萨尔在本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的看守政府中继续担任外交部长。 10 月 27 日的选举使内塔尼亚胡的联盟失去了议会多数席位，但没有出现赢家，组建新政府的谈判正在进行中。

paras.en: The Palestinian Authority welcomed the British sanctions and called for other countries to take similar action.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦权力机构对英国的制裁表示欢迎，并呼吁其他国家采取类似行动。

paras.en: The sanctions are the latest in a series of measures by Britain targeting the settlement policy and underscore Israel's growing diplomatic isolation among some traditional allies.
paras.zh: 此次制裁是英国针对定居点政策采取的一系列措施中的最新一项，并突显以色列在一些传统盟友中日益受到的外交孤立。

paras.en: Britain's relationship with Israel has deteriorated significantly over the past three years because of disagreements over the way that Israel has conducted its war against Hamas and the Israeli government's plans to expand settlements in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 由于以色列对哈马斯发动战争的方式以及以色列政府在被占领的约旦河西岸扩大定居点的计划存在分歧，英国与以色列的关系在过去三年中显着恶化。

paras.en: Israel in September threatened to close the British Consulate building in East Jerusalem in response to London’s decision to impose trade sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 9月，以色列威胁要关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆大楼，以回应伦敦决定对约旦河西岸的以色列定居点实施贸易制裁。

paras.en: British and Israeli diplomats last month reached a last-minute agreement to avoid the closure of the consulate.
paras.zh: 英国和以色列外交官上个月在最后一刻达成了避免关闭领事馆的协议。

paras.en: Britain joined several other countries including Canada in 2025 in recognizing a Palestinian state as a means of advancing the two-state solution, and in September announced plans to block imports from Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 英国于 2025 年与包括加拿大在内的其他几个国家一起承认巴勒斯坦国，作为推进两国解决方案的一种手段，并于 9 月宣布计划阻止从约旦河西岸以色列定居点的进口。

paras.en: Last year, Britain also imposed sanctions on two far-right Israeli cabinet ministers, Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, accusing them of repeatedly inciting violence against Palestinians in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 去年，英国还对两名极右翼以色列内阁部长伊塔马尔·本格维尔和贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇实施制裁，指责他们多次煽动针对约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为。

paras.en: While those measures were co-ordinated with international partners, Britain acted alone on Tuesday in sanctioning the Israeli companies, saying the move would disrupt their access to finance and support for further construction in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 虽然这些措施是与国际伙伴协调的，但英国周二单独采取行动制裁以色列公司，称此举将扰乱他们获得融资和支持西岸进一步建设的机会。

paras.en: Israeli group obstructing Gaza aid sanctioned
paras.zh: 以色列阻碍加沙援助组织受到制裁

paras.en: As part of the measures announced on Tuesday, the government also imposed sanctions on Tzav 9, an Israeli activist group that it said had regularly blocked humanitarian aid trucks delivering food, water and fuel to the Gaza Strip. The new sanctions placed include an asset freeze and director disqualification, which prevent sanctioned individuals from using corporate structures to operate or raise funds.
paras.zh: 作为周二宣布的措施的一部分，政府还对以色列激进组织 Tzav 9 实施制裁，称该组织经常拦截向加沙地带运送食品、水和燃料的人道主义援助卡车。新的制裁措施包括资产冻结和取消董事资格，防止受制裁个人利用公司结构运营或筹集资金。

paras.en: In June 2024, the U.S. State Department under the Biden administration sanctioned Tzav 9, which it described as a "violent extremist Israeli group." The European Union followed suit a month later by also imposing sanctions on the group under its Global Human Rights Sanctions Regime.
paras.zh: 2024年6月，拜登政府领导下的美国国务院制裁了Tzav 9，并将其描述为“以色列暴力极端主义组织”。一个月后，欧盟也效仿，根据其全球人权制裁制度对该组织实施了制裁。

paras.en: According to the United Nations, over 150,000 tents and 300,000 tarpaulins that humanitarian partners and donors purchased are outside Gaza, ready to go in, but are being held by the Israeli authorities, the U.K. said in its statement, adding that the Israeli authorities also continue to block timber from entering, leaving no emergency shelter kits available in Gaza.
paras.zh: 英国在声明中表示，据联合国称，人道主义合作伙伴和捐助者在加沙境外购买了超过15万顶帐篷和30万块防水油布，准备进入，但被以色列当局扣押，并补充说，以色列当局还继续阻止木材进入，导致加沙没有可用的紧急避难工具包。

paras.en: "We are suffering a lot here in Gaza because of the lack of tents and the lack of sheltering equipment that the Israelis are putting restrictions on," Mohammed Salha, general director of the Palestinian NGO Network in Gaza, told CBC News on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 加沙巴勒斯坦非政府组织网络总经理穆罕默德·萨哈周二告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，“我们在加沙遭受了很多苦难，因为以色列人限制了帐篷和庇护设备的缺乏。”

paras.en: Israel's military agency that co-ordinates aid, COGAT, says it has a proactive "winterization plan" and that supplies and medicines continue to enter Gaza.
paras.zh: 协调援助的以色列军事机构COGAT表示，它有一项积极主动的“过冬计划”，物资和药品将继续进入加沙。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia: Rights groups raise alarm over rising number of executions

paras.en: Saudi Arabia continues to execute people at an alarming rate. On Saturday, Jawad Abdullah Qureiris and Fadel Hassan al-Safwani were executed in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. Both men were convicted of terrorist offenses, according to Saudi authorities. In 2011, al-Safwani was a prominent organizer of the peaceful protests that called for civil rights and the release of detainees. Qureiris, who was a minor at the time, participated in one of these protests in the city of Qatif.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯继续以惊人的速度处决人员。周六，贾瓦德·阿卜杜拉·库雷里斯和法德尔·哈桑·萨夫瓦尼在沙特阿拉伯东部省被处决。据沙特当局称，两人均被判犯有恐怖主义罪。 2011年，萨夫瓦尼是呼吁公民权利和释放被拘留者的和平抗议活动的著名组织者。库雷里斯当时还是未成年人，参加了卡蒂夫市的其中一场抗议活动。

paras.en: The UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention called for Qureiris' release in November 2024, after finding that his detention was arbitrary. The opinion also covered four other men. Qureiris was the fourth of these five to be executed. The fifth, Yousef al-Manasif, remains at risk after Saudi Arabia's Supreme Court upheld his death sentence, according to human rights organizations.
paras.zh: 联合国任意拘留问题工作组在发现库雷里斯的拘留具有任意性质后，呼吁于 2024 年 11 月释放他。该意见还涵盖了另外四名男子。库赖里斯是这五人中第四个被处决的人。据人权组织称，第五名男子尤瑟夫·马纳西夫在沙特阿拉伯最高法院维持死刑判决后仍面临危险。

paras.en: The two executions brought the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia in 2026 to 211, according to an AFP tally reported on Monday. The news agency said that the tally includes 126 people convicted of drug trafficking and 17 people executed on terrorism-related charges. Of the 211 people, 100 were Saudi nationals, while the rest were foreign nationals, AFP said.
paras.zh: 根据法新社周一报道的统计，这两次处决使沙特阿拉伯 2026 年被处决的人数达到 211 人。该通讯社称，这一数字包括 126 名因贩毒被定罪的人以及 17 名因恐怖主义相关罪名被处决的人。法新社称，这 211 人中，有 100 人是沙特国民，其余为外国人。

paras.en: In July, Saudi authorities executed five Ethiopian migrants for nonviolent drug-related offenses, Human Rights Watch reported. In October, Saudi authorities executed two Bangladeshi nationals, according to rights organizations. Human Rights Watch separately reported the execution of another Saudi national, Hassan Zaki al-Faraj, on October 17, for alleged offenses committed when he was a minor.
paras.zh: 据人权观察报道，沙特当局于 7 月处决了五名与毒品相关的非暴力犯罪的埃塞俄比亚移民。据人权组织称，十月份，沙特当局处决了两名孟加拉国国民。人权观察组织另外报道称，另一名沙特公民哈桑·扎基·法拉吉 (Hassan Zaki al-Faraj) 于 10 月 17 日被处决，原因是他涉嫌在未成年时犯下罪行。

paras.en: "In 2025, a record high of at least 356 people were executed and executions have continued at a high rate in 2026," Ahmed Benchemsi, Human Rights Watch's MENA spokesperson, told DW. "Saudi Arabia has executed more than 2,000 people in the past decade," he confirmed.
paras.zh: 人权观察组织中东和北非地区发言人艾哈迈德·本切姆西 (Ahmed Benchemsi) 向德国之声表示：“2025 年，至少有 356 人被处决，创历史新高，而 2026 年处决率仍保持在较高水平。” “过去十年，沙特阿拉伯处决了 2000 多人，”他证实。

paras.en: According to the Death Penalty Information Center, Saudi Arabia ranks third in executions after China and Iran. However, comprehensive global data for 2026 are not yet available, and many countries treat execution numbers as state secrets. However, the ranking is consistent with earlier findings from Amnesty International, which ranked Saudi Arabia as the world's third-most prolific executioner between 2022 and 2025, behind China and Iran.
paras.zh: 根据死刑信息中心的数据，沙特阿拉伯在执行死刑方面排名第三，仅次于中国和伊朗。然而，2026年的全面全球数据尚无，许多国家将处决数字视为国家机密。然而，这一排名与国际特赦组织早先的调查结果一致，国际特赦组织将沙特阿拉伯列为 2022 年至 2025 年间世界上执行死刑数量第三多的国家，仅次于中国和伊朗。

paras.en: According to the NGO Together against the death penalty, or ECPM, the two main methods of execution in Saudi Arabia are stoning or beheading. However, in many cases, including those of Qureiris and al-Safwani, death sentences are issued as discretionary rulings, called ta'zir. Ta'zir means that neither the crime nor the punishment is defined in Islamic law, contrary to fixed punishments under the Saudi interpretation of Islamic law, or Sharia. As a result, little to no information about the execution or the fate of the bodies is provided.
paras.zh: 据非政府组织共同反对死刑（ECPM）称，沙特阿拉伯的两种主要处决方法是石刑或斩首。然而，在许多案件中，包括库雷里斯和萨夫瓦尼的案件，死刑判决都是酌情裁决，称为“ta'zir”。塔齐尔意味着伊斯兰法中没有对犯罪和惩罚进行定义，这与沙特对伊斯兰法或伊斯兰教法的解释规定的固定惩罚相反。因此，关于尸体的处决或命运的信息很少甚至没有提供。

paras.en: Is the Iran war affecting Saudi domestic repression?
paras.zh: 伊朗战争是否影响了沙特国内的镇压？

paras.en: Following the US-Israeli attacks on Iran in February, Saudi Arabia has been targeted by Iran and the Iran-aligned Houthi group in Yemen. In turn, Saudi Arabia's de facto leader, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, is faced with a profound dilemma as the attacks have killed and injured scores of people and threaten Riyadh's efforts to diversify its economy under the Vision 2030 reform plan. Several summits and international sports events had to be canceled or postponed in light of the ongoing danger.
paras.zh: 继二月份美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击后，沙特阿拉伯成为伊朗和与伊朗结盟的也门胡塞武装的目标。反过来，沙特阿拉伯事实上的领导人、王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼也面临着深刻的困境，因为袭击造成数十人死伤，并威胁到利雅得根据2030年愿景改革计划实现经济多元化的努力。鉴于持续存在的危险，一些峰会和国际体育赛事不得不取消或推迟。

paras.en: "The Saudi government has shown itself to be unable to defend its population from repeated Houthi attacks on its airports, exposing the vulnerability of the country despite world-record spending levels on defense equipment," Sarah Leah Whitson, human rights lawyer and former executive director of the US-based human rights watchdog DAWN, told DW. "Amid the war in Iran, the Saudi government has resumed its relentless pace of executions and corporal punishment sentences," she said.
paras.zh: 人权律师、美国人权监督机构 DAWN 前执行主任莎拉·莉亚·惠特森 (Sarah Leah Whitson) 向德国之声表示：“沙特政府已经表明，自己无法保护本国人民免遭胡塞武装对其机场的多次袭击，这暴露了该国的脆弱性，尽管其国防装备支出达到了世界纪录水平。” “在伊朗战争期间，沙特政府恢复了无情的处决和体罚步伐，”她说。

paras.en: This week, watchdogs reported on a Kenyan woman in Saudi Arabia who was sentenced to 100 lashes for giving birth outside marriage.
paras.zh: 本周，监管机构报道了沙特阿拉伯一名肯尼亚妇女因婚外生育而被判处 100 下鞭刑的事件。

paras.en: "The recent executions and the sentencing of a migrant domestic worker to 100 lashes for having a child out of wedlock are clear indications that the Saudi government continues to rely on brute repression to rule the country," Whitson told DW.
paras.zh: 惠特森告诉德国之声：“最近处决一名移民家庭佣工，并因未婚生子而被判处100下鞭打，这清楚地表明沙特政府继续依靠残酷镇压来统治国家。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's repression against the Shia minority
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯对什叶派少数民族的镇压

paras.en: Maryam Aldossari, acting director of the London-based human rights organization ALQST, echoes this view. "Saudi Arabian authorities have undoubtedly used the war in Iran and wider regional tensions to intensify their crackdown, most notably through their increased use of the death penalty and as a tool of political repression against the country's Shia minority," she told DW.
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的人权组织 ALQST 代理主任玛丽亚姆·阿尔多萨里 (Maryam Aldossari) 也赞同这一观点。她告诉德国之声：“毫无疑问，沙特阿拉伯当局利用伊朗战争和更广泛的地区紧张局势来加强镇压，最显着的是通过增加死刑的使用，并将其作为对该国什叶派少数群体进行政治镇压的工具。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is predominantly Sunni. The country's oil-rich Eastern Province — from which the recently executed men Jawad Abdullah Qureiris and Fadel Hassan al-Safwani hailed — is home to most of Saudi Arabia's Shia minority. Iran, on the other hand, is predominantly Shia. Saudi authorities have long viewed some forms of Shia political activism with suspicion, partly because of concerns over Iranian influence and alleged links between domestic dissent and Tehran, accusations that rights groups say have been used to justify repression of the minority.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯以逊尼派为主。该国石油资源丰富的东部省是沙特阿拉伯大多数什叶派少数民族的家园，最近被处决的贾瓦德·阿卜杜拉·库雷里斯和法德尔·哈桑·萨夫瓦尼就来自该省。另一方面，伊朗以什叶派为主。沙特当局长期以来一直对某些形式的什叶派政治活动持怀疑态度，部分原因是担心伊朗的影响力以及国内异议人士与德黑兰之间的所谓联系，人权组织称这些指控被用来为镇压少数派辩护。

paras.en: However, Neil Quilliam, associate fellow in the Middle East and North Africa Programme at the London-based think tank Chatham House, remains cautious about drawing a direct causal connection between the conflict involving Iran and developments in Saudi Arabia's human rights environment. "The kingdom has introduced social reforms over the past decade, including measures that have expanded opportunities for women, while retaining controls over political dissent and activism," he told DW.
paras.zh: 然而，总部位于伦敦的智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目副研究员尼尔·奎利亚姆对于将涉及伊朗的冲突与沙特阿拉伯人权环境的发展之间建立直接因果关系仍然持谨慎态度。他告诉德国之声：“过去十年，沙特王国推行了社会改革，包括扩大妇女机会的措施，同时保留对政治异议和激进主义的控制。”

paras.en: "What periods of regional tension can do is heighten official concern about national security," he said, adding that this reduces tolerance for any public criticism or perceived threats to social cohesion. "Whether that amounts to a change in the human rights situation is harder to demonstrate, but there is certainly a sense among some observers that space for dissent has become even more constrained, not only in Saudi Arabia, but in other Gulf states too," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“地区紧张局势会加剧官方对国家安全的担忧。”他补充说，这会降低对任何公众批评或对社会凝聚力的威胁的容忍度。 “这是否相当于人权状况的变化很难证明，但一些观察家肯定有一种感觉，异议的空间变得更加受限，不仅在沙特阿拉伯，而且在其他海湾国家也是如此，”他说。

paras.en: DW reached out to Saudi Arabia's Human Rights Commission on Monday, November, 16, 2026 but has not received an answer at the time of publication.
paras.zh: 德国之声于2026年11月16日星期一联系了沙特阿拉伯人权委员会，但截至发稿时尚未收到答复。

articles.title: EU, ASEAN pursue deeper trade ties, but hurdles remain as businesses struggle with informal barriers

paras.en: The European Union and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) could be heading for a breakthrough year in 2027, when the two sides mark 50 years of diplomatic ties.
paras.zh: 欧盟和东南亚国家联盟（东盟）可能会在 2027 年迎来突破性的一年，届时双方将庆祝建交 50 周年。

paras.en: A long-awaited trade agreement with Indonesia is expected to take effect, while a deal with the Philippines is nearing completion and negotiations with Thailand and Malaysia are making progress. By the end of next year, the EU could have trade deals in place with six Southeast Asian states, up from just two today.
paras.zh: 期待已久的与印度尼西亚的贸易协定预计将生效，而与菲律宾的贸易协定即将完成，与泰国和马来西亚的谈判正在取得进展。到明年年底，欧盟可能与六个东南亚国家达成贸易协议，而目前只有两个国家。

paras.en: The anniversary could also revive the long-standing ambition of a broader trade agreement between the EU and ASEAN.
paras.zh: 此次周年纪念活动还可能重振欧盟与东盟之间达成更广泛贸易协定的长期雄心。

paras.en: On November 17, the European Commission hosted a dialogue in Brussels to discuss trade relations with Southeast Asia, including progress on existing and pending free trade agreements (FTAs).
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日，欧盟委员会在布鲁塞尔主办对话会，讨论与东南亚的贸易关系，包括现有和悬而未决的自由贸易协定 (FTA) 的进展。

paras.en: But attention is turning to what comes next. "Finalizing FTAs is only the beginning, not the end," Chris Humphrey, executive director of the EU-ASEAN Business Council, told DW.
paras.zh: 但注意力正在转向接下来会发生什么。欧盟-东盟商业理事会执行董事克里斯·汉弗莱 (Chris Humphrey) 向德国之声表示：“自由贸易协定的敲定只是开始，而非结束。”

paras.en: FTAs can reduce tariffs and remove trade restrictions, but that is of little use if businesses don't know how to use them, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，自由贸易协定可以降低关税并取消贸易限制，但如果企业不知道如何使用它们，那就没什么用处。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, in many cases, this is where there is a failure. Communication and training are key," Humphrey said.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，在很多情况下，这就是失败的地方。沟通和培训是关键，”汉弗莱说。

paras.en: For Brussels, the priority should now be to tackle the less conspicuous obstacles to trade, he stressed.
paras.zh: 他强调，对于布鲁塞尔来说，现在的首要任务应该是解决不太明显的贸易障碍。

paras.en: Cutting customs delays, simplifying regulations, and helping smaller European businesses enter unfamiliar Southeast Asian markets will determine whether an FTA succeeds.
paras.zh: 减少海关延误、简化法规以及帮助小型欧洲企业进入陌生的东南亚市场将决定自由贸易协定是否成功。

paras.en: "European companies with little or no experience in Southeast Asia would benefit from greater on-the-ground support, particularly practical, firsthand guidance on informal business practices and the unwritten local rules," Alfred Gerstl, an associate professor at Palacky University Olomouc in the Czech Republic, told DW.
paras.zh: 捷克奥洛穆茨帕拉茨基大学副教授阿尔弗雷德·格斯特尔（Alfred Gerstl）告诉德国之声：“在东南亚经验很少或没有经验的欧洲公司将受益于更多的实地支持，特别是关于非正式商业惯例和不成文的当地规则的实用的第一手指导。”

paras.en: One option is to expand the assistance offered by European chambers of commerce, trade delegations, and EU offices in Southeast Asia. This could range from helping firms find distributors to explaining local licensing requirements and how to qualify for preferential tariffs.
paras.zh: 一种选择是扩大欧洲商会、贸易代表团和欧盟驻东南亚办事处提供的援助。这可能包括帮助公司寻找经销商、解释当地的许可要求以及如何获得优惠关税的资格。

paras.en: In Vietnam, for instance, sustained pressure from Brussels has helped improve market access for European pharmaceutical firms. In Indonesia, the EU has worked on trade facilitation while pressing Jakarta over import restrictions and halal certification requirements, said Camille Nessel, a researcher at the Universite Libre de Bruxelles.
paras.zh: 例如，在越南，来自布鲁塞尔的持续压力帮助改善了欧洲制药公司的市场准入。布鲁塞尔自由大学研究员卡米尔·内塞尔表示，在印度尼西亚，欧盟致力于贸易便利化，同时就进口限制和清真认证要求向雅加达施压。

paras.en: Regular consultations with businesses on both sides could also help Brussels spot problems before they become trade disputes.
paras.zh: 与双方企业进行定期磋商也可以帮助布鲁塞尔在问题演变为贸易争端之前发现问题。

paras.en: Trade policy has also acquired a geopolitical purpose in Brussels. "If trade policy is expected to reduce strategic dependencies, we are asking it to deliver on objectives that remain insufficiently defined, let alone demonstrating how to achieve them," Nessel told DW.
paras.zh: 贸易政策在布鲁塞尔也具有地缘政治目的。内塞尔对德国之声表示：“如果贸易政策有望减少战略依赖，那么我们要求其实现尚未充分明确的目标，更不用说展示如何实现这些目标了。”

paras.en: Diversifying trade and reducing dependencies
paras.zh: 贸易多元化并减少依赖

paras.en: The EU wants to reduce its dependence on a handful of suppliers for the minerals needed for batteries and other clean technologies, while Southeast Asian producers, particularly Indonesia, want foreign investors to help develop domestic processing industries rather than merely buy raw materials.
paras.zh: 欧盟希望减少对电池和其他清洁技术所需矿物供应商的依赖，而东南亚生产商，特别是印度尼西亚，希望外国投资者帮助发展国内加工业，而不仅仅是购买原材料。

paras.en: The EU and Indonesia have already clashed over Jakarta's restrictions on nickel exports.
paras.zh: 欧盟和印度尼西亚已经就雅加达镍出口限制发生冲突。

paras.en: European investment in processing facilities, agreements on environmental standards, and greater regulatory certainty would give both sides concrete gains, said Nessel. "The real value of an FTA is not just opening a market but giving the EU the leverage to keep it open," she added.
paras.zh: 内塞尔表示，欧洲对加工设施的投资、环境标准协议以及更大的监管确定性将为双方带来具体收益。 “自由贸易协定的真正价值不仅在于开放市场，还在于为欧盟提供保持市场开放的杠杆作用，”她补充道。

paras.en: Pasha Hsieh, Lee Kong Chian Professor of Law and Jean Monnet Chair at Singapore Management University, said Brussels should prioritize ratifying its investment protection agreements with Singapore and Vietnam.
paras.zh: 李光前法学教授兼新加坡管理大学让·莫内主席 Pasha Hsieh 表示，布鲁塞尔应优先批准与新加坡和越南的投资保护协议。

paras.en: Signed in 2018 and 2019, respectively, the agreements still require ratification by all EU member states before entering into force. "These delays underline the need to follow through on negotiated commitments," Hsieh said.
paras.zh: 这些协议分别于 2018 年和 2019 年签署，仍需所有欧盟成员国批准才能生效。谢家华说：“这些延误凸显了履行谈判承诺的必要性。”

paras.en: The issue is particularly relevant as the EU looks to develop investment protocols in other Southeast Asian states where investors have sometimes faced uncertainty over legal protections. Indonesia, for instance, has terminated numerous bilateral investment treaties, including agreements with the Netherlands and Spain.
paras.zh: 这个问题尤其重要，因为欧盟希望在其他东南亚国家制定投资协议，这些国家的投资者有时面临法律保护的不确定性。例如，印度尼西亚终止了许多双边投资条约，包括与荷兰和西班牙的协议。

paras.en: A larger question is whether the EU should continue pursuing bilateral deals with Southeast Asian countries or revive its original ambition of a region-to-region agreement with ASEAN.
paras.zh: 一个更大的问题是，欧盟是否应该继续寻求与东南亚国家达成双边协议，还是恢复其与东盟达成区域间协议的初衷。

paras.en: The EU and ASEAN launched negotiations for a region-wide FTA in 2007 but suspended them two years later amid disagreements over wide economic disparities among ASEAN members and political concerns. Technical discussions resumed in 2017, but little has come of them.
paras.zh: 欧盟和东盟于 2007 年启动了区域自由贸易协定谈判，但由于东盟成员国之间巨大的经济差距和政治担忧存在分歧，两年后暂停了谈判。技术讨论于 2017 年恢复，但收效甚微。

paras.en: ASEAN already has regional agreements with China and several other economies. Beijing upgraded its free trade agreement with ASEAN in October 2025.
paras.zh: 东盟已经与中国和其他几个经济体签订了区域协议。北京于2025年10月升级了与东盟的自由贸易协定。

paras.en: Region-to-region frameworks extend beyond trade. Humphrey, of the EU-ASEAN Business Council, called for negotiations to begin on a region-to-region Digital Trade Agreement and Investment Protection Agreement.
paras.zh: 区域间框架超出了贸易范围。欧盟-东盟商业理事会的汉弗莱呼吁开始就区域间数字贸易协定和投资保护协定进行谈判。

paras.en: The EU-Singapore Digital Trade Agreement, which entered into force in February 2026, offers a possible model for wider cooperation, he noted, adding that common approaches to customs procedures, supply-chain standards, and green technologies could create greater alignment with ASEAN members that are not yet ready for full FTAs.
paras.zh: 他指出，2026 年 2 月生效的欧盟-新加坡数字贸易协定为更广泛的合作提供了可能的模式，并补充说，海关程序、供应链标准和绿色技术的共同方法可以与尚未准备好签署全面自由贸易协定的东盟成员国建立更大的一致性。

paras.en: "European businesses have long complained of operating at a disadvantage due to the lack of a region-to-region deal. It is high time that both sides elevated their ambitions and embraced the idea of working towards such an agreement," Humphrey said.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱表示：“长期以来，欧洲企业一直抱怨由于缺乏区域间协议而处于不利经营地位。现在是双方提高雄心并接受努力达成这样一项协议的想法的时候了。”

paras.en: The 2027 anniversary would be a convenient deadline for agreeing on what comes next, but Gerstl warned against mistaking another round of diplomatic ceremony for progress.
paras.zh: 2027 年周年纪念日将是就下一步行动达成一致的最后期限，但格斯特警告说，不要将另一轮外交仪式误认为取得了进展。

paras.en: "There is a risk that attention will focus almost exclusively on the 2027 summit in Singapore and that the group photo will become the defining image of the event, only for momentum to fade in the years that follow," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“人们的注意力可能会几乎完全集中在 2027 年新加坡峰会上，合影将成为该活动的决定性形象，但这种势头在接下来的几年里会逐渐减弱。”

articles.title: Hashim Thaci's second conviction in The Hague reignites debate in Kosovo about justice and the Kosovo Specialist Chambers

paras.en: A court in The Hague on Tuesday convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of obstructing justice and attempting to influence witnesses during his recent war crimes trial and sentenced him to 17 months in prison.
paras.zh: 海牙一家法院周二判定科索沃前总统哈希姆·塔奇在最近的战争罪审判中犯有妨碍司法公正和试图影响证人罪，并判处他 17 个月监禁。

paras.en: This term will be added to his 25-year sentence for war crimes, which was handed down by the same court, the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, on September 16.
paras.zh: 这一刑期将被添加到他因战争罪而被判处的 25 年徒刑中，该刑期是由同一法院科索沃特别分庭于 9 月 16 日作出的。

paras.en: According to the indictment of the Specialist Prosecutor's Office, Thaci had provided visitors at the detention facility in The Hague with confidential information about witnesses in his war crimes trial and had instructed them on how to influence their testimony.
paras.zh: 根据特别检察官办公室的起诉书，塔奇向海牙拘留所的探访者提供了有关其战争罪审判中证人的机密信息，并指导他们如何影响他们的证词。

paras.en: Three other men — former head of the Kosovo Intelligence Agency Bashkim Smakaj, former Minister of Justice Hajredin Kuci, and Fadil Fazliu — were also convicted.
paras.zh: 另外三名男子——科索沃情报局前局长 Bashkim Smakaj、前司法部长 Hajredin Kuci 和 Fadil Fazliu——也被定罪。

paras.en: Thaci, who was the former political leader of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) during the 1998-1999 Kosovo War, is viewed by many in his home country as a hero. His war crimes conviction in September was greeted in Kosovo with anger and dismay.
paras.zh: 塔奇是 1998 年至 1999 年科索沃战争期间科索沃解放军 (KLA) 的前政治领导人，他的祖国被许多人视为英雄。科索沃9月份对他的战争罪定罪感到愤怒和沮丧。

paras.en: Thaci has vowed to appeal the war crimes conviction.
paras.zh: 塔奇发誓要对战争罪定罪提出上诉。

paras.en: His two convictions touch deep sensitivities in Kosovo society. Tuesday's ruling brings renewed attention to the war that ended 27 years ago, the role played by its former leaders, and the continuing debate over justice, individual or collective responsibility for the KLA's war to liberate Kosovo from Serbia, and trust in judicial institutions.
paras.zh: 他的两项信念触及科索沃社会的深层敏感问题。周二的裁决让人们重新关注27年前结束的战争、前领导人所扮演的角色，以及关于正义、科索沃解放军从塞尔维亚手中解放科索沃的战争中的个人或集体责任以及对司法机构的信任的持续辩论。

paras.en: The response from the government of Kosovo was swift.
paras.zh: 科索沃政府的反应迅速。

paras.en: In a statement issued on Tuesday, the government said, "Trust in justice is built not only on the decisions that are made, but also on the manner in which they are reached. Therefore, our commitment to the rule of law and our insistence on the full respect of rights and procedural guarantees are part of the same principled position: Justice must not only be done, but must also be fair, transparent, and credible."
paras.zh: 政府在周二发布的一份声明中表示，“对正义的信任不仅建立在做出决定的基础上，还建立在达成决定的方式上。因此，我们对法治的承诺以及对充分尊重权利和程序保障的坚持是同一原则立场的一部分：正义不仅必须得到伸张，而且还必须公平、透明和可信。”

paras.en: The Kosovo Specialist Chambers was established in 2015 by the parliament of Kosovo at the instigation of the European Union and the United States.
paras.zh: 科索沃特别法庭是在欧盟和美国的推动下，由科索沃议会于2015年设立的。

paras.en: The court was created to investigate serious crimes allegedly committed by members of the KLA during and after the Kosovo War.
paras.zh: 该法院的成立是为了调查科索沃解放军成员据称在科索沃战争期间和之后犯下的严重罪行。

paras.en: For security reasons, including concerns about witness intimidation, the court was located in The Hague in the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 出于安全原因，包括担心证人受到恐吓，法院设在荷兰海牙。

paras.en: After Thaci and three others were convicted of war crimes in first instance in September, Kosovo's state authorities established a working group to draft a strategy regarding the appeal proceedings before the Kosovo Specialist Chambers.
paras.zh: 塔奇和其他三人于九月一审被判犯有战争罪后，科索沃国家当局成立了一个工作组，负责起草有关科索沃特别法庭上诉程序的战略。

paras.en: The group is chaired by Foreign Minister Glauk Konjufca and includes members of Kosovo's parliament.
paras.zh: 该小组由外交部长格劳克·孔尤夫卡担任主席，成员包括科索沃议会成员。

paras.en: Prime Minister Albin Kurti has stated that the working group continues to believe that "the first-instance judgment of the Specialist Chambers is unjust, both legally and morally," and that as a result, "the government is working to secure a correction at the appeals level before the Specialist Chambers."
paras.zh: 阿尔宾·库尔蒂总理表示，工作组仍然认为“特别法庭的一审判决在法律上和道义上都是不公正的”，因此“政府正在努力确保特别法庭在上诉层面得到纠正”。

paras.en: In addition, the parliament of Kosovo is currently considering amendments to the law governing the Kosovo Specialist Chambers.
paras.zh: 此外，科索沃议会目前正在考虑修订科索沃特别法庭法律。

paras.en: The draft law, which is expected to be adopted, envisages narrowing the court's mandate in several areas, including the time period covered by its jurisdiction, limiting the maximum prison sentence to 15 years, allowing sentences to be served in Kosovo, and introducing the possibility of presidential pardons for persons convicted by final court decisions.
paras.zh: 预计将获得通过的法律草案设想缩小法院在几个领域的职权范围，包括其管辖范围，将最高刑期限制为15年，允许在科索沃服刑，并引入总统赦免法院最终判决定罪者的可能性。

paras.en: How do political analysts and legal experts view the parliament's attempt to amend the law on the Kosovo Specialist Chambers before the judicial process involving the four men convicted of war crimes has reached a final verdict?
paras.zh: 政治分析家和法律专家如何看待议会试图在涉及四名被判犯有战争罪的男子的司法程序做出最终裁决之前修改科索沃特别法庭法律的行为？

paras.en: "From an international perspective, at first glance, this initiative could even be interpreted as an attempt to interfere in the judicial process," said political analyst and university professor Artan Muhaxheri.
paras.zh: “从国际角度来看，乍一看，这一举措甚至可以被解读为试图干涉司法程序，”政治分析家、大学教授阿尔坦·穆哈西里说。

paras.en: "Precisely for this reason, it is essential that Kosovo's political spectrum and its legal experts demonstrate beyond any doubt that this measure does not conflict with Kosovo's international obligations toward the European Union," Muhaxheri told DW, adding that this is the only way to ensure that the desired outcome is achieved and that the initiative does not produce the opposite effect.
paras.zh: 穆哈赫里对德国之声表示：“正是出于这个原因，科索沃政治派别及其法律专家必须毫无疑问地证明这一措施与科索沃对欧盟的国际义务并不冲突。”他补充说，这是确保实现预期结果且该倡议不会产生相反效果的唯一途径。

paras.en: "Issues relating to jurisdiction, statutory limits on maximum sentences, and other similar matters must be argued professionally and rigorously, demonstrating that they fully guarantee judicial independence and enjoy solid support within Kosovo's legal system, the same legal system that, first and foremost, established the Specialist Chambers," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“与管辖权、最高刑期的法定限制以及其他类似事项有关的问题必须以专业和严格的方式进行辩论，以证明这些问题充分保障司法独立并在科索沃法律体系内得到坚实的支持，而科索沃法律体系首先是建立了特别法庭。”

paras.en: Ehat Miftaraj, executive director of the Kosovo Law Institute (IKD), told DW that although the Kosovo Specialist Chambers were established by the Republic of Kosovo itself, "the way the judicial process has unfolded has created the impression that judges, prosecutors and certain international actors have treated not only the accused but also Kosovo itself with distrust, prejudice, and an often condescending approach."
paras.zh: 科索沃法律研究所(IKD)执行主任埃哈特·米夫塔拉吉(Ehat Miftaraj)告诉德国之声，虽然科索沃特别法庭是科索沃共和国自己设立的，但“司法程序的展开方式给人留下了这样的印象：法官、检察官和某些国际行为者不仅对待被告，而且对待科索沃本身，也充满了不信任、偏见，而且常常采取居高临下的态度。”

paras.en: Miftaraj went on to say that reactions and objections in Kosovo to the decisions of the Specialist Chambers are also interpreted and judged in the historical and emotional context of the war and what Kosovo's citizens experienced during and after it.
paras.zh: 米夫塔拉杰接着说，科索沃对特别法庭裁决的反应和反对意见也是根据战争的历史和情感背景以及科索沃公民在战争期间和之后的经历来解释和判断的。

paras.en: "In a democratic society, every citizen, including political and institutional representatives, has the right to criticize judicial decisions," he said. "However, there is a fundamental distinction between criticism based on legal arguments and attempts to delegitimize courts or exert influence over judicial proceedings. And here, there is room for criticism of both sides."
paras.zh: “在民主社会中，每个公民，包括政治和机构代表，都有权批评司法判决，”他说。 “然而，基于法律论点的批评与试图剥夺法院合法性或对司法程序施加影响的尝试之间存在根本区别。在这里，双方都有批评的空间。”

articles.title: Tensions rise over draft climate deal at COP31

paras.en: A contentious draft deal has laid bare divisions between delegates from states participating in this year’s United Nations climate COP31 talks in Turkiye.
paras.zh: 一项有争议的协议草案暴露了参加今年在土耳其举行的联合国气候变化缔约方会议第三十一届会议各国代表之间的分歧。

paras.en: The 18-page draft “cover decision” published by summit cohost Australia on Monday includes a broad range of demands, including calls for a phaseout of fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 峰会共同主办国澳大利亚周一公布的 18 页“封面决定”草案包含了广泛的要求，包括呼吁逐步淘汰化石燃料。

paras.en: The draft, as written, could make the negotiations “untenable”, said Wopke Hoekstra, the European Union’s climate envoy, adding that “the cover decision does not go in the right direction and needs significant change”.
paras.zh: 欧盟气候特使沃普克·霍克斯特拉(Wopke Hoekstra)表示，书面草案可能会使谈判“站不住脚”，并补充说“封面决定没有朝着正确的方向发展，需要进行重大改变”。

paras.en: “It’s very easy to draw red lines at the start of the process,” said Joao Paulo Capobianco, Brazil’s environment minister, adding that deadlocks can be overcome through “an adjustment in the wording” in the draft.
paras.zh: 巴西环境部长若昂·保罗·卡波比安科表示：“在进程开始时划定红线是很容易的。”他补充说，可以通过草案中的“措辞调整”来克服僵局。

paras.en: Australian Climate Minister Chris Bowen, who is steering COP31 negotiations, acknowledged that the text included elements “that not all parties agree on”, and that there might be “at least one more draft” introduced before the end of the week.
paras.zh: 负责指导 COP31 谈判的澳大利亚气候部长克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 承认，文本中包含“并非所有各方都同意”的内容，并且可能会在本周末之前提出“至少还有一份草案”。

paras.en: The talks are scheduled to end on Friday, but climate negotiations usually run into overtime as agreements must be reached by consensus, meaning even a single country can block the entire process.
paras.zh: 谈判定于周五结束，但气候谈判通常会陷入加班，因为协议必须以协商一致方式达成，这意味着即使是一个国家也可以阻止整个进程。

paras.en: The draft text includes a call for wealthy nations to achieve net zero emissions by 2030, and wording on phasing out fossil fuels that oil-rich countries have long resisted.
paras.zh: 草案文本包括呼吁富裕国家到2030年实现净零排放，以及石油资源丰富国家长期以来抵制的逐步淘汰化石燃料的措辞。

paras.en: Consensus on the issue of net zero emissions at COP31 “might be very, very difficult”, said Michael Joseph, the environment minister of the island state of Antigua and Barbuda, adding that he “would love to see a commitment that calls on the phasing out of fossil fuels”.
paras.zh: 安提瓜和巴布达岛国环境部长迈克尔·约瑟夫表示，在 COP31 上就净零排放问题达成共识“可能非常非常困难”，并补充说他“希望看到一项呼吁逐步淘汰化石燃料的承诺”。

paras.en: “Emerging countries want to impose as many obligations as possible on developed countries. It’s tactical,” an official from a European country who requested anonymity told the AFP news agency.
paras.zh: “新兴国家希望对发达国家施加尽可能多的义务。这是战术性的，”一位要求匿名的欧洲国家官员告诉法新社。

paras.en: “These things are obviously unacceptable,” the official said, pointing to a bloc of countries whose members include Saudi Arabia and India.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“这些事情显然是不可接受的。”他指的是沙特阿拉伯和印度等成员国。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is also at the centre of another battle over the timeline for the publication of crucial reports by the UN’s climate science panel, which dozens of European, African and Pacific states want published before a crucial verification of global carbon-cutting efforts at the next COP33 conference due in 2028.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯还处于联合国气候科学小组重要报告发布时间表的另一场争论的中心，数十个欧洲、非洲和太平洋国家希望在 2028 年举行的下一次 COP33 会议上对全球碳减排努力进行重要核查之前发表这些报告。

paras.en: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) publishes a series of reports every five to seven years that provide the definitive scientific assessment of global warming and inform global policy responses to the crisis.
paras.zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 每五到七年发布一系列报告，提供对全球变暖的明确科学评估，并为全球应对危机的政策提供信息。

paras.en: The IPCC suspended its last meeting after failing to break the impasse, and a new session was set for December to resolve the issue, with Ilana Seid, chair of the Alliance of Small Island States, describing delays in publishing the IPCC’s seventh assessment report as “unjustifiable”.
paras.zh: 由于未能打破僵局，IPCC 暂停了上次会议，并定于 12 月召开新会议来解决这一问题，小岛屿国家联盟主席伊拉娜·赛义德 (Ilana Seid) 表示，推迟发布 IPCC 第七次评估报告是“不合理的”。

paras.en: The dispute has become one of the main issues being debated at COP31, which ends Friday.
paras.zh: 这一争端已成为周五结束的 COP31 上讨论的主要问题之一。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the kingdom’s delegation at COP31 defended its position on the publication timeline for the IPCC report, saying “Saudi Arabia is not seeking to delay climate science”.
paras.zh: 周二，沙特阿拉伯代表团在 COP31 上捍卫了其对 IPCC 报告发布时间表的立场，称“沙特阿拉伯并不寻求推迟气候科学”。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia “advocates publication timelines that allow sufficient scientific review, transparency and meaningful participation”, the statement said, without explicitly mentioning when Riyadh would like to see the reports published.
paras.zh: 声明称，沙特阿拉伯“主张发布时间表，以允许充分的科学审查、透明度和有意义的参与”，但没有明确提及利雅得希望何时发布这些报告。

articles.title: What’s behind the ANC’s decline in South Africa?

paras.en: African National Congress won its lowest-ever vote share in local elections this month.
paras.zh: 非洲人国民大会在本月的地方选举中赢得了有史以来最低的票数。

paras.en: Led by Nelson Mandela, the ANC swept to power when apartheid ended 32 years ago.
paras.zh: 32 年前种族隔离结束时，纳尔逊·曼德拉 (Nelson Mandela) 领导的非国大 (ANC) 横扫权力。

paras.en: But in local elections this month, South Africa’s governing party’s support slumped to its lowest level yet.
paras.zh: 但在本月的地方选举中，南非执政党的支持率跌至迄今为止的最低水平。

paras.en: So, how serious is the ANC’s political crisis and can it recover?
paras.zh: 那么，非国大的政治危机有多严重，能否恢复？

paras.en: And what are the implications for the nation?
paras.zh: 对国家有什么影响？

paras.en: Aslam Dasoo — Member of the ANC Stalwarts and Veterans group and national convenor of the Progressive Health Forum
paras.zh: 阿斯拉姆·达索 (Aslam Dasoo) — 非国大坚定和退伍军人团体成员、进步健康论坛全国召集人

paras.en: Ralph Mathekga — Political analyst and senior expert at Geopolitical Intelligence Services
paras.zh: Ralph Mathekga — 地缘政治情报服务的政治分析师和高级专家

paras.en: Lindiwe Zulu — Member of the ANC’s National Executive Committee and International Relations Subcommittee
paras.zh: Lindiwe Zulu — 非国大全国执行委员会和国际关系小组委员会成员

articles.title: US Navy chief says Iran war has put ‘strain’ on maritime forces

paras.en: United States Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao has acknowledged that the Iran war is taxing the maritime service as bipartisan senators questioned him over extended ship deployments, dwindling weapons stockpiles, and resources being shifted away from the Asia-Pacific.
paras.zh: 美国代理海军部长曹洪承认，伊朗战争正在给海事服务带来负担，两党参议员就延长舰艇部署、减少武器库存以及将资源从亚太地区转移等问题向他提出质疑。

paras.en: Testifying before the Senate Armed Services Committee on Tuesday at his confirmation hearing to lead the military branch, Cao faced sharp, bipartisan grilling over the mounting human and material costs of the US-Israel war on Iran, which is now deep into its ninth month.
paras.zh: 曹周二在参议院军事委员会的军事部门领导确认听证会上作证，他面临着两党的尖锐拷问，美以对伊朗的战争目前已进入第九个月，其人力和物力成本不断上升。

paras.en: “This war, again, I know it’s a strain on our navy,” Cao said, while insisting that joint military efforts have “really set China back on their heels”.
paras.zh: 曹说：“这场战争，我知道这又给我们的海军带来了压力。”他同时坚称，联合军事行动“确实让中国陷入了困境”。

paras.en: Cao, a retired US Navy captain and former Republican Party candidate for the Virginia Senate, has served as acting navy secretary since April 2026 after previously holding the under-secretary post.
paras.zh: 曹是美国退役海军上尉，也是弗吉尼亚州参议院的前共和党候选人，此前曾担任副部长职务，自 2026 年 4 月起担任代理海军部长。

paras.en: The candidate, backed by US President Donald Trump, is now seeking US Senate confirmation for the permanent top civilian job.
paras.zh: 这位候选人在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持下，目前正在寻求美国参议院确认其永久最高文职职位。

paras.en: The hearing comes amid burgeoning political fallout over the protracted quagmire with Iran, which recently saw a failed US House bid to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over his stewardship of the war.
paras.zh: 此次听证会正值与伊朗的旷日持久的泥潭所引发的政治影响日益严重之际，美国众议院最近因伊朗战争管理问题而弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)，但以失败告终。

paras.en: Voter frustration over the war — and its economic sting — proved decisive in the November midterm elections, which were widely seen as a repudiation of the war and ultimately cost the Republicans control of both the House and the Senate.
paras.zh: 选民对战争及其经济影响的挫败感在 11 月的中期选举中被证明是决定性的，人们普遍认为这次选举是对战争的否定，并最终导致共和党失去了对众议院和参议院的控制权。

paras.en: The Democratic-controlled 120th Congress is scheduled to be sworn in on January 3, 2027.
paras.zh: 民主党控制的第120届国会定于2027年1月3日宣誓就职。

paras.en: As the ranking Democrat on the committee, Senator Jack Reed of Rhode Island questioned Cao during the nearly two-hour hearing, saying he was candidly troubled by his performance so far.
paras.zh: 作为委员会中的民主党领袖，罗德岛州参议员杰克·里德在近两个小时的听证会上向曹提出质询，称他坦率地对曹迄今为止的表现感到不安。

paras.en: “I am concerned, frankly, about your leadership record as acting secretary,” said Reed, who called on the acting US Navy secretary to speak to Hegseth‘s ongoing and planned dismissals of numerous naval officers over the past year, pressing Cao on whether he would “defend the military leaders in the future from partisan meddling in their careers”.
paras.zh: 里德说：“坦率地说，我对你作为代理部长的领导记录感到担忧。”他呼吁代理美国海军部长就赫格斯在过去一年中持续和计划解雇多名海军军官的情况发表讲话，并向曹施压，询问他是否会“在未来保护军事领导人免受党派干预他们的职业生涯”。

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers went on to criticise the US Navy for bypassing standard congressional notification after quietly relieving the entire leadership team — the commander, executive officer and command master chief — of the nuclear-powered attack submarine USS South Dakota following an October underwater collision with the seabed.
paras.zh: 10月份南达科他号核动力攻击潜艇与海底发生水下碰撞后，民主党议员悄悄解除了南达科他号核动力攻击潜艇的整个领导团队（指挥官、执行官和司令长官）的职务，随后批评美国海军绕过了标准的国会通知。

paras.en: “We relieve commanding officers for everything from negligence to even just fraternisation or, you know, harassment,” Cao said, making the case against the US Navy’s traditional policy of publicly announcing the removal of commanders. “I want to make sure that we’re protecting their livelihood afterwards as well.”
paras.zh: 曹说：“我们会因各种原因解除指挥官的职务，从玩忽职守到只是交友，或者骚扰，”曹说，他反对美国海军公开宣布罢免指挥官的传统政策。 “我想确保我们之后也能保护他们的生计。”

paras.en: His stated intent to safeguard individuals’ careers was promptly rebuked by Reed, who maintained that privacy does not justify shielding information from congressional oversight.
paras.zh: 他所声称的保护个人职业生涯的意图立即遭到里德的斥责，他认为隐私并不能成为保护信息免受国会监督的理由。

paras.en: “The squadron commodore [of the USS South Dakota] felt that they did not live up to their honour, courage, and commitment ethos, and therefore, he relieved the commanding officer, the executive officer, and the command master chief,” Cao countered.
paras.zh: “（南达科他号）中队准将觉得他们没有辜负他们的荣誉、勇气和承诺精神，因此，他解除了指挥官、执行官和司令长官的职务，”曹反驳道。

paras.en: Cao’s record on sailor mental health comes under fire
paras.zh: 曹对水手心理健康的记录受到批评

paras.en: The US Navy chief-nominee also faced intense questioning from lawmakers about low crew morale, severe supply shortages, and mental health strains aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln following its record-breaking 265-day deployment in the Pacific Ocean, South China Sea, Indian Ocean, and North Arabian Sea.
paras.zh: 这位美国海军首席提名人还面临立法者的强烈质疑，质疑亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰在太平洋、南海、印度洋和北阿拉伯海进行了创纪录的265天部署后，船员士气低落、供应严重短缺以及心理健康紧张。

paras.en: The vessel returned to Naval Air Station North Island in San Diego, California, in early October after the USS George Washington arrived on station to relieve it. Together with the USS George HW Bush and the newly arrived USS Theodore Roosevelt, the US is temporarily massing three carrier strike groups to bolster regional maritime security and tighten the months-long naval blockade against Iran.
paras.zh: 十月初，乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰抵达加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥北岛海军航空站进行救援后，该船返回该基地。与乔治·H·W·布什号航空母舰和新抵达的西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰一起，美国正在暂时集结三个航母战斗群，以加强地区海上安全并加强对伊朗长达数月的海上封锁。

paras.en: Last week, Trump stated that further military strikes against Iran are “quite unlikely” and said the military component of the war was “effectively over” following discussions with Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. He noted, however, that the US military remains “locked and loaded” if conditions change.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普表示，对伊朗进行进一步的军事打击“不太可能”，并表示在与卡塔尔总理谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·本·贾西姆·阿勒萨尼进行讨论后，战争的军事部分“实际上已经结束”。不过，他指出，如果情况发生变化，美军仍会“上膛并上膛”。

paras.en: During Tuesday’s hearing, Senator Richard Blumenthal, a Connecticut Democrat, argued that Cao was “failing these sailors and their families”, and noted that his “confrontation with them leaves me with the clear impression that you simply don’t care”.
paras.zh: 在周二的听证会上，康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔辩称，曹“辜负了这些水手及其家人”，并指出他“与他们的对抗给我留下了明显的印象：你根本不在乎”。

paras.en: Cao pushed back, declaring that he does not control the deployment lengths of US Navy ships that have crept steadily closer to a full year at sea — up from a standard of six to eight months during the US’s so-called “war on terror”.
paras.zh: 曹反驳说，他无法控制美国海军舰艇的部署时间，这些舰艇在海上的部署时间已经从美国所谓的“反恐战争”期间的六到八个月的标准逐渐接近全年。

paras.en: “Sustained investment in our people will increase readiness, improve retention and recruitment, and enable our ability to support national objectives,” said Cao.
paras.zh: 曹说：“对我们的员工进行持续投资将提高准备程度，改善保留和招聘，并使我们有能力支持国家目标。”

paras.en: When asked about suicide attempts aboard the ships, Cao told Blumenthal that what he saw “as eight suicide attempts, I see as eight suicide mitigations”.
paras.zh: 当被问及船上的自杀企图时，曹告诉布卢门撒尔，他认为“有八次自杀企图，我认为有八次自杀缓解措施”。

paras.en: Cao faces a rare waiver hurdle for the top spot
paras.zh: 曹面临罕见的放弃第一名的障碍

paras.en: In his opening statement, Republican Senate Armed Services Committee Chair Roger Wicker expressed support for Cao’s nomination to lead the US Navy, noting that while the service faces significant challenges during a particularly volatile time, it also has major opportunities.
paras.zh: 共和党参议院军事委员会主席罗杰·威克在开幕词中表示支持曹提名领导美国海军，并指出，虽然美国海军在特别动荡的时期面临重大挑战，但也面临着重大机遇。

paras.en: Beyond fielding tough questions from lawmakers on Tuesday over the strain of the Iran war on fleet readiness, Cao still faces a complex confirmation path to become the permanent secretary of the navy, requiring a rare congressional waiver.
paras.zh: 除了周二就伊朗战争对舰队战备状态造成的压力回答立法者提出的尖锐问题之外，曹还面临着成为海军常任部长的复杂的确认路径，需要罕见的国会豁免。

paras.en: Because he left active-duty service in October 2021, he falls short of the seven-year separation period mandated by federal law to preserve civilian control of the military.
paras.zh: 由于他于 2021 年 10 月退役，因此没有达到联邦法律规定的七年离职期，以保持文官对军队的控制。

paras.en: Securing that exemption poses a steep political climb for Cao, who must clear the hurdle by meeting a 60-vote threshold, which may prove tricky in a polarised Washington.
paras.zh: 获得豁免对曹来说是一个陡峭的政治攀登，他必须通过达到 60 票的门槛来清除障碍，这在两极分化的华盛顿可能会很棘手。

paras.en: Cao will ultimately need cross-party support from Democrats or independents to avoid a filibuster, while winning over war-sceptical Republicans.
paras.zh: 曹最终将需要民主党或独立人士的跨党派支持，以避免阻挠，同时赢得对战争持怀疑态度的共和党人的支持。

articles.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
paras.zh: 特朗普抵达菲律宾开启亚洲之行

paras.en: MANILA, Philippines — President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday, where he was scheduled to meet regional partners, talk trade, and seek a break from a series of setbacks at home, ranging from a major disruption to the U.S. aviation industry to a scandal that has shaken the global AI industry.
paras.zh: 菲律宾马尼拉——唐纳德·特朗普总统周二抵达菲律宾，他计划在那里会见地区合作伙伴，讨论贸易问题，并寻求摆脱国内一系列挫折，从对美国航空业的重大破坏到震动全球人工智能行业的丑闻。

paras.en: Manila, the Philippine capital, is Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, and, according to Trump, potentially for a meeting with North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un.
paras.zh: 菲律宾首都马尼拉是特朗普为期三天的访问的第一站，随后他将前往中国与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京进行历史性的三方核会谈，据特朗普称，可能还会与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面。

paras.en: The visit marks Trump's first travel abroad since his party suffered deep losses in midterm elections. The White House and stock market alike have been rattled by the departure of Jensen Huang from Nvidia last week after admitting to an affair with an alleged Chinese government agent. Beijing has said it was not involved.
paras.zh: 此次访问是特朗普自其政党在中期选举中惨败以来首次出国访问。黄仁勋上周离开英伟达，此前他承认与一名所谓的中国政府特工有染，这让白宫和股市都感到不安。北京方面表示没有参与其中。

paras.en: As he descended the stairs from Air Force One, Trump pumped his fist. A child handed him small American and Philippine flags, which Trump waved and then swooped in big circular motions as he smiled. The U.S. president was greeted by a marching band playing "YMCA" while he walked to a waiting helicopter.
paras.zh: 当特朗普从空军一号走下楼梯时，他挥动了拳头。一个孩子递给他一些小美国和菲律宾国旗，特朗普挥舞着这些国旗，然后微笑着以大圆圈的方式猛扑过去。当美国总统走向一架等待的直升机时，演奏着“基督教青年会”的游行乐队迎接了他。

paras.en: Trump to be feted at the annual ASEAN summit
paras.zh: 特朗普将在年度东盟峰会上受到招待

paras.en: Trump's first hours in the Philippines will include all the reassuring optics from Washington's oldest treaty ally in Asia, including a cocktail reception and dinner with other world leaders, an intermission from some of the thorniest issues at home. He's being feted Tuesday night at a gala as the "guest of honor" at the annual summit of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
paras.zh: 特朗普在菲律宾的头几个小时将包括来自华盛顿在亚洲最古老的条约盟友的所有令人放心的镜头，包括与其他世界领导人的鸡尾酒会和晚宴，以及国内一些最棘手问题的间歇。周二晚上，他作为东南亚国家联盟年度峰会的“主宾”在一场盛会上受到招待。

paras.en: The ASEAN leaders have been working on a non-aggression pact with China in the contested waters of the South China Sea, a key global trade route. Confrontations have escalated in recent years, particularly between Chinese and Philippine coast guard and naval forces in disputed shoals.
paras.zh: 东盟领导人一直致力于在南海争议海域与中国签订互不侵犯条约，南海是全球重要的贸易路线。近年来，对抗不断升级，特别是中国和菲律宾海岸警卫队和海军部队在争议浅滩上的对抗。

paras.en: First on Trump's agenda Tuesday is a meeting with the leaders of the Quad nations, comprising the U.S., Australia, India, and Japan that have aimed to counter China's influence in the Asia Pacific. It will be their first meeting since Trump returned to the White House last year.
paras.zh: 特朗普周二的首要议程是与四国领导人举行会议，这些国家包括美国、澳大利亚、印度和日本，旨在对抗中国在亚太地区的影响力。这将是特朗普去年重返白宫以来他们的首次会面。

paras.en: Trump is then scheduled to sign a trade deal with Thailand, the type of agreement he has relished striking since launching a trade war last year buttressed by steep tariff threats.
paras.zh: 特朗普随后计划与泰国签署一项贸易协议，自去年在严厉的关税威胁的支持下发起贸易战以来，他一直很喜欢达成这样的协议。

paras.en: The U.S. had announced a trade framework last October in which Thailand would remove tariffs on most American goods, as well as barriers for importing U.S. autos, food products and pharmaceutical drugs, according to the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative. At the time, the Trump administration said Thailand would also spend more than $18 billion on U.S. aircraft and buy U.S. farm goods and liquefied natural gas.
paras.zh: 据美国贸易代表办公室称，美国去年10月宣布了一项贸易框架，泰国将取消对大多数美国商品的关税，以及进口美国汽车、食品和药品的壁垒。当时，特朗普政府表示，泰国还将花费超过180亿美元购买美国飞机，并购买美国农产品和液化天然气。

paras.en: The U.S. Supreme Court overturned in February the 19% tariff that Trump placed on goods from Thailand. The administration sought replacement tariffs in July by levying a 12.5% tax on imports from Thailand for not taking steps to oppose the use of forced labor.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院二月份推翻了特朗普对泰国商品征收的 19% 关税。由于没有采取措施反对使用强迫劳动，政府于 7 月寻求替代关税，对来自泰国的进口产品征收 12.5% 的税。

paras.en: Before the gala dinner Tuesday night, Trump will participate in what's billed as a "special summit" with the ASEAN leaders, where they are expected to discuss efforts to deepen trade and security ties as well as the region's longstanding conflicts, including yearslong violence in Myanmar and escalating disputes in the South China Sea, which Beijing claims virtually in its entirety.
paras.zh: 在周二晚上的晚宴之前，特朗普将参加与东盟领导人举行的所谓“特别峰会”，预计他们将在会上讨论深化贸易和安全关系的努力以及该地区长期存在的冲突，包括缅甸多年的暴力和南海不断升级的争端，北京对南海几乎拥有全部主权。

paras.en: Washington rejects China's expansive claim in the waterway, and has repeatedly stated that it's obligated to defend the Philippines if Filipino forces come under an armed attack.
paras.zh: 华盛顿拒绝中国在该航道的广泛主权主张，并多次表示，如果菲律宾军队受到武装攻击，美国有义务保卫菲律宾。

paras.en: Anti-Trump protesters are gathered in Manila
paras.zh: 反特朗普抗议者聚集在马尼拉

paras.en: About 1,500 left-wing protesters held a noisy rally in a downtown Manila square ahead of Trump's arrival, calling on Philippine leaders not to take their foreign policy cues from the U.S.
paras.zh: 在特朗普抵达之前，约 1,500 名左翼抗议者在马尼拉市中心广场举行了喧闹的集会，呼吁菲律宾领导人不要听从美国的外交政策暗示。

paras.en: They waved red flags and held up a large streamer that read, "Resist U.S. war and plunder!" They planned to burn an effigy of Trump. Riot police with shields and wooden truncheons stood nearby.
paras.zh: 他们挥舞着红旗，举着写着“抵制美国战争和掠夺！”的大横幅。他们计划焚烧特朗普的肖像。附近站着手持盾牌和木警棍的防暴警察。

paras.en: "The Philippine government should not deal with such a loser so our call to the Marcos administration is to stop being a puppet of Donald Trump and to uphold an independent foreign policy for the Philippines," protest leader Teddy Casiño told The Associated Press at the Liwasang Bonifacio square, referring to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
paras.zh: 抗议领袖泰迪·卡西诺在利瓦桑博尼法西奥广场对美联社表示：“菲律宾政府不应该与这样的失败者打交道，因此我们呼吁马科斯政府停止成为唐纳德·特朗普的傀儡，并维护菲律宾的独立外交政策。”

paras.en: Planned meetings with the Philippine president — and possibly an old friend
paras.zh: 计划与菲律宾总统（可能还有一位老朋友）会面

paras.en: On Wednesday, Trump is set to receive a red-carpet welcome and full military honors from Marcos Jr., followed by a state banquet as part of his visit to the Malacanang presidential palace. Trump and Marcos are expected to affirm their commitment to their countries' longstanding treaty alliance.
paras.zh: 周三，特朗普将受到小马科斯的红地毯欢迎和全套军事荣誉，随后将举行国宴，这是他访问马拉卡南总统府的一部分。特朗普和马科斯预计将重申对两国长期条约联盟的承诺。

paras.en: Officials are arranging a possible brief reunion in Malacanang with an old acquaintance — Imelda Marcos — if she's well enough and gets her doctors' nod.
paras.zh: 官员们正在安排可能在马拉卡南与一位老熟人伊梅尔达·马科斯进行短暂的团聚，如果她身体状况良好并得到医生的认可的话。

paras.en: Now 97 and using a wheelchair, the former jet set Philippine first lady and mother of the incumbent president partied in New York decades ago in her heyday as the controversial wife of a strongman leader, who was to be ousted in a pro-democracy 1986 "People Power" public uprising.
paras.zh: 这位现年 97 岁的前菲律宾第一夫人、现任总统的母亲，现年 97 岁，坐在轮椅上，几十年前，她在纽约参加了一场派对，当时她是一名强人领导人颇具争议的妻子，而这位强人领导人在 1986 年的民主“人民力量”公众起义中被赶下台。

paras.en: But the friendship with Trump endured, with Trump often asking Marcos Jr. and other Philippine officials: "How's Imelda?" Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 但与特朗普的友谊一直存在，特朗普经常问小马科斯和其他菲律宾官员：“伊梅尔达怎么样？”菲律宾驻华盛顿大使何塞·曼努埃尔·罗穆阿尔兹告诉美联社。

paras.en: "Personal connections are very important to him," Romualdez said.
paras.zh: “个人关系对他来说非常重要，”罗穆阿尔德斯说。

paras.en: When the Philippine leader met Trump in the White House last year, he carried a note from his mother that thanked the U.S. president for his strong backing of the Philippines. "President Trump was very happy and told Marcos, 'please say hello to your mother,'" according to Romualdez.
paras.zh: 去年，当菲律宾领导人在白宫会见特朗普时，他带着母亲的一张纸条，感谢美国总统对菲律宾的大力支持。 “特朗普总统非常高兴，并告诉马科斯，‘请向你的母亲问好，’”罗穆阿尔德斯说。

paras.en: Trump is also expected to announce a series of commercial deals and investments in the aviation, defense, energy, and technology sectors, before heading to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
paras.zh: 预计特朗普还将宣布在航空、国防、能源和技术领域的一系列商业交易和投资，然后前往中国深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会。

articles.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
paras.zh: 特朗普在习近平和普京峰会之前访问亚洲。而且，技术领导者希望黄回到英伟达

paras.en: A technology issue with United Airlines delayed departing flights yesterday evening, just as air travel was returning to normal after the Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop on Friday. President Trump said yesterday that he hopes this incident will prompt Congress to allocate more funds to upgrade the outdated air traffic control system.
paras.zh: 昨天晚上，美国联邦航空管理局下令在全国范围内停飞后，航空旅行正在恢复正常，联合航空公司的技术问题导致出发航班延误。特朗普总统昨天表示，他希望这一事件能够促使国会拨款更多资金来升级过时的空中交通管制系统。

paras.en: - 🎧 Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that the FAA will reevaluate future maintenance procedures, NPR's Joe Hernandez tells Up First. Mike McCormick, a former FAA senior executive and air traffic manager, told Hernandez that he thinks another nationwide ground stop is unlikely. McCormick says that in cases like this, the FAA sometimes imposes a maintenance moratorium, temporarily halting such work. The ground stop happened while L3Harris workers converted copper wires to a fiber optic system and installed a new router in El Dorado, Arkansas.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Joe Hernandez 告诉 Up First，交通部长 Sean Duffy 表示，FAA 将重新评估未来的维护程序。美国联邦航空局前高级管理人员兼空中交通经理迈克·麦考密克告诉埃尔南德斯，他认为不太可能再在全国范围内进行地面停留。麦考密克表示，在这种情况下，美国联邦航空局有时会暂停维护，暂时停止此类工作。地面停车发生在 L3Harris 工人将铜线转换为光纤系统并在阿肯色州埃尔多拉多安装新路由器时。

paras.en: President Trump is in Manila today to meet with allies at the ASEAN summit. Tomorrow, he travels to Shenzhen, China, for a joint summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. It's the first time those three have had a joint summit. The meeting will happen on the sidelines of the APEC summit that Xi is hosting in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统今天在马尼拉与东盟峰会上的盟友会面。明天，他将前往中国深圳，与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行联合峰会。这是三人首次举行联合峰会。这次会议将在习近平在深圳主持的亚太经合组织峰会期间举行。

paras.en: - 🎧 When leaving the White House yesterday, Trump said they would discuss his "favorite subject": Ukraine, NPR's Deepa Shivaram says. The White House had previously announced that Ukraine would not be on the agenda for the trilateral meeting. Shivaram says that Europe and Ukraine are concerned about how Ukraine may be discussed at the meeting, and what might come out of it, because President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will not be at APEC and Trump has recently been more lenient toward Putin and Russia.
paras.zh: - 🎧 昨天离开白宫时，特朗普表示他们将讨论他“最喜欢的话题”：乌克兰，NPR 的迪帕·希瓦拉姆 (Deepa Shivaram) 说。白宫此前曾宣布，乌克兰不会出现在三边会议议程上。希瓦拉姆表示，欧洲和乌克兰担心会议上如何讨论乌克兰问题以及会议可能产生什么结果，因为泽连斯基总统不会参加亚太经合组织，而特朗普最近对普京和俄罗斯更加宽容。

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation has shaken Silicon Valley, prompting calls from some tech leaders for the board to reinstate him. Trump said he agreed with them. Meanwhile, the U.S. government introduced a rule to block remote access to advanced AI chips and servers, closing a loophole that could allow adversarial governments to access American AI technology through overseas data centers. Nvidia is the world's dominant producer of AI chips.
paras.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的辞职震动了硅谷，促使一些科技领袖呼吁董事会恢复他的职位。特朗普表示他同意他们的观点。与此同时，美国政府出台了一项规则，阻止远程访问先进的人工智能芯片和服务器，堵住了敌对政府通过海外数据中心访问美国人工智能技术的漏洞。英伟达是全球领先的人工智能芯片生产商。

paras.en: - 🎧 Many prominent AI and venture capital figures have recognized Huang as a visionary whose company played a significant role in the AI boom, NPR's Shannon Bond says. An online petition supporting his reinstatement has garnered more than 160,000 signatures, but Bond says some of them may not be real. Elon Musk says he signed it. Brad Gerstner from Altimeter Capital, a key Nvidia investor, has urged the board to thoroughly investigate and keep all options open. Bond says the interim CEO and CFO will address the public for the first time following today's earnings report.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的香农·邦德 (Shannon Bond) 表示，许多著名的人工智能和风险投资人士都认为黄仁勋是一位有远见的人，他的公司在人工智能繁荣中发挥了重要作用。一份支持他复职的在线请愿书已获得超过 16 万个签名，但邦德表示其中一些签名可能不是真实的。埃隆·马斯克说他签了字。 Nvidia 的主要投资者 Altimeter Capital 的布拉德·格斯特纳 (Brad Gerstner) 敦促董事会彻底调查并保留所有选择。邦德表示，临时首席执行官和首席财务官将在今天的收益报告发布后首次向公众发表讲话。

paras.en: Prosecutors are moving to retry Lindsay Clancy for the deaths of her three children. The new trial is set for March 29, 2027. Although there was speculation about potentially reducing the charges to manslaughter or second-degree murder after her previous trial ended in a mistrial, no changes were made during Monday's court hearing. Judge William Sullivan, who presided over the first trial, will oversee the new proceedings. He denied Clancy's defense team's request to dismiss the charges based on double jeopardy. Clancy's defense argues that she shouldn't be held criminally responsible for killing her children because she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis.
paras.zh: 检察官正着手对林赛·克兰西三个孩子的死亡案进行重审。新的审判定于 2027 年 3 月 29 日进行。虽然在她的上一次审判以误审结束后，有人猜测可能会将指控减轻为过失杀人或二级谋杀，但周一的法庭听证会没有做出任何改变。主持第一次审判的威廉·沙利文法官将监督新的诉讼程序。他拒绝了克兰西辩护团队基于双重危险驳回指控的请求。克兰西的辩护律师认为，她不应该因杀害孩子而被追究刑事责任，因为她患有严重的产后精神病。

paras.en: One year ago, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to all families regardless of income, as long as adults are working, seeking work, in school, or unable to work. Many parents have found this initiative life-changing, but capacity was limited. Only 50% of the some 67,000 children ages 5 and under are enrolled in the universal childcare program. Some of the remaining families participate in other programs, such as PreK and Head Start. New Mexico officials say the program must expand to meet demand. The issues observed in New Mexico are mirrored across the nation, prompting policymakers and childcare advocates to closely monitor the state's initiative.
paras.zh: 一年前，新墨西哥州成为第一个向所有家庭提供免费托儿服务的州，无论其收入如何，只要成年人正在工作、寻找工作、在校或无法工作。许多家长发现这一举措改变了他们的生活，但能力有限。约 67,000 名 5 岁及以下儿童中，只有 50% 参加了全民托儿计划。剩下的一些家庭参加其他计划，例如学前班和启蒙计划。新墨西哥州官员表示，该计划必须扩大以满足需求。新墨西哥州观察到的问题也反映在全国各地，促使政策制定者和儿童保育倡导者密切关注该州的举措。

paras.en: - 👶 Almost half of U.S. children aged 5 and under live in licensed childcare deserts, where demand exceeds availability, according to the Center for American Progress, a left-leaning think tank.
paras.zh: - 👶 根据左倾智库美国进步中心的数据，近一半的 5 岁及以下美国儿童生活在有执照的托儿沙漠中，那里的需求超过了供应量。

paras.en: - 👶 New Mexico's program has an operating budget of nearly $600 million, but some lawmakers are concerned it could be $50 million over budget this year.
paras.zh: - 👶 新墨西哥州的计划运营预算接近 6 亿美元，但一些立法者担心今年可能会超出预算 5000 万美元。

paras.en: - 👶 New Mexico state Sen. Steve Lanier tells NPR that the steep cost of the program is why he only supports universal childcare for some people, since someone earning around $450,000 or $600,000 might not need assistance. Lanier has previously sued to end the initiative, but the lawsuit was unsuccessful.
paras.zh: - 👶 新墨西哥州参议员史蒂夫·拉尼尔 (Steve Lanier) 告诉 NPR，该计划的高昂成本是他只支持为某些人提供全民托儿服务的原因，因为收入在 45 万或 60 万美元左右的人可能不需要援助。拉尼尔此前曾提起诉讼以终止该倡议，但诉讼未成功。

paras.en: - 👶 Since the enactment of free, universal childcare in New Mexico, lower-income mothers have experienced significant gains. Their full-time employment has risen by 23%, according to a new paper from Arizona State University.
paras.zh: - 👶 自新墨西哥州实行免费、全民托儿服务以来，低收入母亲取得了显着的进步。亚利桑那州立大学的一篇新论文显示，他们的全职就业人数增加了 23%。

paras.en: Millions of shorebirds embark on epic migrations to Alaska each year to breed. They often travel thousands of miles from places like New Zealand, Asia and South America. But researchers have found a concerning trend: Nearly half of the 41 shorebird species that breed in Alaska are in decline. These birds time their journeys to coincide with peak insect availability, and climate change is throwing off their schedules. Warmer springs lead to earlier insect emergence, creating a mismatch that could leave shorebirds without enough food supply. Scientists are now racing to understand if these migratory birds can adapt to the changing Arctic landscape.
paras.zh: 每年，数以百万计的滨鸟开始史诗般的迁徙，前往阿拉斯加繁殖。他们经常从新西兰、亚洲和南美洲等地出发数千英里。但研究人员发现了一个令人担忧的趋势：在阿拉斯加繁殖的 41 种滨鸟中，近一半的数量正在减少。这些鸟类将它们的旅程安排在昆虫数量高峰期，而气候变化正在打乱它们的日程。温暖的春天导致昆虫出现得更早，造成不匹配，可能导致滨鸟没有足够的食物供应。科学家们现在正在竞相了解这些候鸟是否能够适应不断变化的北极景观。

paras.en: - British actor Robert Pattinson will be the seventh James Bond, taking his place among an iconic lineup of stars that started with Sean Connery and most recently featured Daniel Craig.
paras.zh: - 英国演员罗伯特·帕丁森将成为第七任詹姆斯·邦德，他将跻身于由肖恩·康纳利和最近的丹尼尔·克雷格主演的标志性明星阵容中。

paras.en: - The 69th annual Grammy Awards nominations were announced yesterday. British singer-songwriter RAYE leads with 11 nominations, followed by Spanish artist Rosalía with nine nods.
paras.zh: - 第 69 届格莱美奖提名昨天公布。英国创作歌手 RAYE 获得 11 项提名，位居榜首，西班牙艺术家罗莎莉亚 (Rosalía) 获得 9 项提名紧随其后。

paras.en: - Civil rights champion Dolores Huerta made history yesterday as the first non-elected individual and the first woman to lie in honor at the California State Capitol. She died of cancer last month at age 96. (via KQED)
paras.zh: - 民权斗士多洛雷斯·韦尔塔（Dolores Huerta）昨天创造了历史，成为第一个非民选个人和第一个在加州议会大厦悼念的女性。她上个月因癌症去世，享年 96 岁。（来自 KQED）

articles.title: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
paras.zh: 伊朗对美国海军第五舰队所在地巴林发动第三轮袭击

paras.en: CAIRO — Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar installation in Bahrain in the third Iranian attack in recent days on American military targets in the Persian Gulf island kingdom, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.
paras.zh: 开罗——周二，伊朗向巴林的美国雷达设施发射了无人机，这是伊朗最近几天对波斯湾岛国美国军事目标的第三次袭击，美国则向一条重要航线沿线的伊朗目标开火进行报复。

paras.en: The attacks and counterattacks interrupted a roughly two-month lull in fighting, as Iran's targeting of Bahrain brought condemnations from the region. Analysts said stalled peace negotiations and Tehran's growing economic pressures were raising the risk of a substantial escalation.
paras.zh: 这些袭击和反击打断了大约两个月的停战状态，伊朗针对巴林的袭击引起了该地区的谴责。分析人士表示，和平谈判陷入僵局以及德黑兰日益增长的经济压力正在增加局势大幅升级的风险。

paras.en: Bahrain said that its air defense systems had successfully intercepted the "treacherous Iranian aerial attacks." The U.S. military likewise said the attack inflicted no damage to U.S. equipment or injury to American personnel.
paras.zh: 巴林表示，其防空系统已成功拦截“危险的伊朗空袭”。美国军方同样表示，这次袭击没有对美国设备造成损坏，也没有对美国人员造成伤害。

paras.en: Hours later, a U.S. fighter jet carried out a strike on a missile launch site in the Strait of Hormuz belonging to Iran's paramilitary Revolutionary Guard, a U.S. official said.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员称，几小时后，一架美国战斗机对伊朗准军事革命卫队所属的霍尔木兹海峡导弹发射场进行了袭击。
