paras.en: The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity to detail sensitive military operations, said "precision munitions" were used in the strike on Qeshm Island and that the U.S. was responding to "aggression" toward U.S. personnel.
paras.zh: 这位不愿透露姓名的官员详细介绍了敏感的军事行动，他表示，对格什姆岛的袭击使用了“精确弹药”，美国正在对针对美国人员的“侵略”做出回应。

paras.en: A local official, Ahmad Nafisi, said the strike caused no damage to residential or commercial areas or infrastructure.
paras.zh: 当地官员艾哈迈德·纳菲西 (Ahmad Nafisi) 表示，罢工没有对住宅区、商业区或基础设施造成损坏。

paras.en: The U.S. military has periodically carried out what appear to be limited strikes on Qeshm Island and other Iranian targets this month. Iran's attack Tuesday was its third on American military targets in Bahrain in five days.
paras.zh: 本月，美国军方定期对格什姆岛和其他伊朗目标进行看似有限的袭击。伊朗周二的袭击是五天内对巴林美国军事目标的第三次袭击。

paras.en: Iran may be shifting its strategy amid economic pain
paras.zh: 伊朗可能在经济困境中改变战略

paras.en: Iran has been suffering under a naval blockade that the U.S. has enforced on it for months in and around the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway for the world's energy supplies where Iran and its proxies have disrupted shipping since the war began Feb. 28.
paras.zh: 几个月来，伊朗一直受到美国在霍尔木兹海峡及其周边实施的海上封锁的影响。霍尔木兹海峡是世界能源供应的重要水道，自2月28日战争爆发以来，伊朗及其代理人一直扰乱霍尔木兹海峡的航运。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump has been circumspect on his next steps for the Iran war, now in its eighth month despite an initial promise it would last only a matter of weeks. He has said new strikes are highly unlikely, but he has also sent a third aircraft carrier and thousands more troops to the Middle East — and told Vice President JD Vance that talks aren't needed at this time.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗战争的下一步行动一直持谨慎态度，尽管最初承诺伊朗战争只会持续几周，但现在已经进入第八个月。他表示，新的袭击不太可能发生，但他还向中东派遣了第三艘航空母舰和数千名士兵，并告诉副总统 JD 万斯，目前不需要谈判。

paras.en: Oil tankers moving oil through the strait under U.S. military protection have helped return oil shipments from the Gulf to roughly prewar levels. The blockade, meanwhile, is damaging Iran's economy by curbing the flow of Iranian crude to the global market.
paras.zh: 在美国军事保护下通过海峡运输石油的油轮帮助海湾地区的石油运输量恢复到战前的水平。与此同时，封锁限制了伊朗原油流向全球市场，从而损害了伊朗经济。

paras.en: Iran's attacks could signal a shift in its strategy after months during which it waited for an attack and then retaliated to target the operational capability of bases, Tehran-based security analyst Mostafa Najafi told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 德黑兰安全分析师莫斯塔法·纳杰菲告诉美联社，伊朗的袭击可能标志着其战略的转变，此前伊朗等待袭击数月，然后针对基地的作战能力进行报复。

paras.en: Bahrain hosts the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, which has already sustained damage in previous attacks by Iran since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.
paras.zh: 巴林是美国海军第五舰队的所在地，自美国和以色列于2月28日袭击伊朗以来，该舰队已经在伊朗之前的袭击中受到损害。

paras.en: Iranian leaders will now be weighing whether "breaking the blockade through escalation is less costly than accepting its continuation," Hamidreza Azizi, senior Iran analyst at the International Crisis Group think tank, wrote in an analysis posted to X.
paras.zh: 国际危机组织智库伊朗高级分析师哈米德雷扎·阿齐兹在发表于 X 的分析中写道，伊朗领导人现在将权衡“通过升级方式打破封锁是否比接受继续封锁的成本更低”。

paras.en: "In other words, the risk of renewed war no longer depends solely on whether Trump decides to attack Iran again," he said. "It also depends on whether Tehran concludes that the costs of continued restraint have become greater than the risks of escalation."
paras.zh: “换句话说，新一轮战争的风险不再仅仅取决于特朗普是否决定再次攻击伊朗，”他说。 “这还取决于德黑兰是否认为持续克制的成本已经大于升级的风险。”

paras.en: U.S. expands its Middle East naval presence
paras.zh: 美国扩大中东海军存在

paras.en: With the arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group in the region, the combined U.S. naval assets in the Persian Gulf, Arabian Sea, Red Sea, and Mediterranean now exceed the force deployed when the U.S. and Israel launched the war.
paras.zh: 随着西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群抵达该地区，美国在波斯湾、阿拉伯海、红海和地中海的海军力量总数现已超过美国和以色列发动战争时部署的兵力。

paras.en: The presence provides greater offensive firepower and missile interception capacity, according to a new analysis by Israel's Institute for National Security Studies.
paras.zh: 根据以色列国家安全研究所的最新分析，这种存在提供了更强的进攻火力和导弹拦截能力。

paras.en: The Roosevelt joins the USS George H.W. Bush and the USS George Washington aircraft carriers, as well as smaller U.S. Navy ships, which are in the region to maintain the blockade of Iranian shipping. U.S. Central Command wouldn't comment on whether it plans to keep all three carrier strike groups in the region.
paras.zh: 罗斯福号加入乔治·H·W·布什号航空母舰布什和乔治华盛顿号航空母舰以及较小的美国海军舰艇都在该地区维持对伊朗航运的封锁。美国中央司令部没有就是否计划将所有三个航母打击群留在该地区发表评论。

paras.en: Iran says it's responding to U.S. attacks
paras.zh: 伊朗表示正在回应美国的袭击

paras.en: Iran's attack on Bahrain on Tuesday came after it targeted a U.S. early warning radar facility in the country on Friday, and on Sunday fired at a radar system at an American helicopter base there. Despite claims of success, there appeared to be little or no damage done.
paras.zh: 伊朗周二对巴林发动袭击，此前伊朗周五袭击了美国在该国的预警雷达设施，周日又向美国直升机基地的雷达系统开火。尽管声称成功，但似乎没有造成任何损害。

paras.en: The attacks followed U.S. strikes on Iranian communications towers and ongoing drone surveillance operations, and Iran said it was retaliating.
paras.zh: 这些袭击是在美国袭击伊朗通讯塔和正在进行的无人机监视行动之后发生的，伊朗表示正在进行报复。

paras.en: "Continued aggression against the country's airspace, as well as the use of regional military bases and facilities for hostile acts against Iran, will not go unanswered," Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps said in a statement.
paras.zh: 伊朗革命卫队在一份声明中表示，“持续侵犯该国领空，以及利用地区军事基地和设施对伊朗进行敌对行动，将不会得不到回应。”

paras.en: Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates each condemned Iran's attack on Bahrain, calling it a violation of Bahrain's sovereignty and a threat to its security and stability.
paras.zh: 埃及、卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋均谴责伊朗对巴林的袭击，称其侵犯了巴林的主权并对其安全与稳定构成威胁。

paras.en: Negotiations to end the war have stagnated, despite intensified mediation efforts from Qatar.
paras.zh: 尽管卡塔尔加强了调解努力，但结束战争的谈判仍陷入停滞。

paras.en: In a statement, Qatar said Iran's "continued attacks" on Bahrain "undermine diplomatic efforts" and Foreign Ministry spokesman Majed Al Ansari, speaking at a news briefing in Doha, warned that any escalation in fighting posed an "extremely grave danger" to the prospects of reaching an agreement.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔在一份声明中表示，伊朗对巴林的“持续袭击”“破坏了外交努力”，外交部发言人马吉德·安萨里在多哈举行的新闻发布会上警告说，任何战斗升级都会对达成协议的前景构成“极其严重的危险”。

paras.en: Iran may be losing patience as conflict drags on
paras.zh: 随着冲突的拖延，伊朗可能会失去耐心

paras.en: The attacks are a sign that Tehran is growing impatient as its economic woes mount, said Sascha Bruchmann, a Bahrain-based defense analyst with the International Institute for Strategic Studies.
paras.zh: 国际战略研究所驻巴林国防分析师萨沙·布鲁赫曼表示，这些袭击表明德黑兰随着经济困境的加剧而变得越来越不耐烦。

paras.en: "Shooting at ships causes fear, but is not effective enough to change the strategic equation," Bruchmann told the AP. "Tehran knows it needs to do something, but I wouldn't overestimate what we saw against Bahrain this week. This is not it — yet."
paras.zh: 布鲁赫曼告诉美联社：“向船只开枪会引起恐惧，但不足以改变战略平衡。” “德黑兰知道它需要采取一些行动，但我不会高估本周对阵巴林的比赛。现在还不是这样。”

paras.en: Iranian officials have termed the current situation "no war, no peace" and vowed to end it.
paras.zh: 伊朗官员称当前局势为“没有战争，就没有和平”，并誓言要结束它。

paras.en: Tehran has said that it's open to a negotiated deal, but also signaled a readiness to escalate the conflict in the face of tightening sanctions and the blockade that are throttling Iran's economy.
paras.zh: 德黑兰表示，它对通过谈判达成协议持开放态度，但也表示，面对日益收紧的制裁和封锁限制了伊朗经济，它准备升级冲突。

paras.en: Mahdi Mohammadi, an adviser to Iran's influential parliamentary chief, posted on social media on Monday that leaders view U.S. economic pressure as an effort to create a domestic "security crisis."
paras.zh: 伊朗颇具影响力的议会主席顾问马赫迪·穆罕默迪周一在社交媒体上发帖称，领导人认为美国的经济压力是为了制造国内“安全危机”。

paras.en: Iran has continued to attack ships seeking to transit the Strait of Hormuz, which leads from the Persian Gulf toward the open seas. In Yemen, Iran-backed Houthi rebels now have solidified their control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, another critical shipping route.
paras.zh: 伊朗继续袭击试图通过霍尔木兹海峡的船只，霍尔木兹海峡从波斯湾通向公海。在也门，伊朗支持的胡塞叛军现已巩固了对另一条重要航运路线曼德海峡的控制。

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: If you're carrying credit card debt — or expecting upcoming expenses — interest can make it harder to get ahead.
paras.zh: 如果你背负着信用卡债务——或者预计即将发生的开支——利息可能会让你更难取得成功。

paras.en: The Citi Simplicity® Card gives you a clear window to reset.
paras.zh: Citi Simplicity® 卡为您提供了清晰的重置窗口。

paras.en: With no interest for 18 months on both balance transfers and purchases, you can focus on paying down what you owe or covering new expenses without interest piling up.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均无需支付 18 个月的利息，因此您可以专注于偿还欠款或支付新费用，而不会产生利息累积。

paras.en: 0% intro APR for 18 months on Balance Transfers is one of the longest interest-free periods available today.
paras.zh: 余额转账 18 个月的 0% 年利率是当今最长的免息期之一。

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0%, 18 months on Balance Transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：0%，余额转账 18 个月

paras.en: Applicants with a good to excellent credit score (670+) typically have the best odds of approval.
paras.zh: 信用评分良好至优秀（670+）的申请人通常获得批准的几率最高。

paras.en: There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5)
paras.zh: 开户后 4 个月内完成的每笔转账（最低 5 美元）需缴纳 3% 的介绍性余额转账费。此后，您的费用将为每次转账的 5%（最低 5 美元）

paras.en: That lower 3% intro fee can reduce your upfront cost compared to cards that charge 5% from the start.
paras.zh: 与一开始就收取 5% 费用的信用卡相比，3% 的介绍费较低，可以降低您的前期成本。

paras.en: If you want flexibility — whether that’s paying down debt, managing new expenses, or both — this card gives you a defined window to do it without interest.
paras.zh: 如果您想要灵活性——无论是偿还债务、管理新开支，还是两者兼而有之——这张卡为您提供了一个明确的窗口，让您可以无利息地做到这一点。

paras.en: With 18 months of 0% intro APR on both balance transfers and purchases, you can choose how to use it based on what you need most right now.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

paras.en: We're firm believers in the Golden Rule, which is why editorial opinions are ours alone and have not been previously reviewed, approved, or endorsed by included advertisers. Motley Fool Money does not cover all offers on the market. Motley Fool Money is 100% owned and operated by The Motley Fool. Our knowledgeable team of personal finance editors and analysts are employed by The Motley Fool and held to the same set of publishing standards and editorial integrity while maintaining professional separation from the analysts and editors on other Motley Fool brands.
paras.zh: 我们是黄金法则的坚定信徒，这就是为什么编辑意见仅属于我们，并且之前没有经过所包含的广告商的审查、批准或认可。 Motley Fool Money 并不涵盖市场上的所有优惠。 Motley Fool Money 由 The Motley Fool 100% 拥有和经营。我们知识渊博的个人理财编辑和分析师团队受聘于 The Motley Fool，并遵守相同的出版标准和编辑诚信，同时与其他 Motley Fool 品牌的分析师和编辑保持专业分离。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它拥有市场上最长的 0% 年利率优惠期之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.en: The Motley Fool owns shares of and recommends Visa.
paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Lane Kiffin admits to waking up every hour with recurring nightmare of LSU's loss to Texas

paras.en: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin can't stop thinking about his team's gut-wrenching loss to Texas. He can't even escape the torture of reliving the dramatic finish while he's sleeping.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州立大学主教练莱恩·基芬无法停止思考他的球队输给德克萨斯州的惨痛经历。他甚至无法逃脱在睡觉时重温戏剧性结局的折磨。

paras.en: With the Longhorns handing LSU its fourth loss of the season, the Tigers' College Football Playoff dreams officially died on Saturday night. To make matters even worse, the loss came inside Tiger Stadium in Baton Rouge in what was LSU's final home game of the season.
paras.zh: 随着长角牛队在路易斯安那州立大学遭遇本赛季第四场失利，老虎队的大学橄榄球季后赛梦想在周六晚上正式破灭。更糟糕的是，这场失利发生在巴吞鲁日老虎体育场，这是路易斯安那州立大学本赛季最后一场主场比赛。

paras.en: For many LSU fans, the terrible taste in their mouths will linger until the Tigers earn an impressive win in 2027. That may seem dramatic, but that is SEC football in southeastern Louisiana.
paras.zh: 对于许多路易斯安那州立大学球迷来说，直到老虎队在 2027 年赢得一场令人印象深刻的胜利之前，他们嘴里的可怕味道都会一直存在。这可能看起来很戏剧化，但这就是路易斯安那州东南部的 SEC 足球。

paras.en: Kiffin and the rest of his coaching staff need to be the first to forget about the 22-21 loss to Texas, as deflating as it was, given that the Tigers still have to take on Tennessee and Arkansas on the road to end the season.
paras.zh: 基芬和他的教练组的其他成员需要首先忘记以 22-21 输给德克萨斯州的比赛，尽管那场比赛令人沮丧，因为老虎队在结束赛季的路上仍然需要对阵田纳西州和阿肯色州。

paras.en: Unfortunately for Kiffin, his brain isn't allowing it.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，对于基芬来说，他的大脑不允许这样做。

paras.en: "I'll wake up literally every hour the last two nights, and I have this nightmare of the last play of the game, but I think it's a nightmare that we didn't cover somebody to lose the game, and that we lost to Texas," Kiffin told the media on Monday, nearly 48 hours after the game.
paras.zh: “过去两个晚上我几乎每个小时都会醒来，我会做一场关于比赛最后一场比赛的噩梦，但我认为这是一场噩梦，因为我们没有掩护某人输掉比赛，而且我们输给了德克萨斯州，”基芬在赛后近 48 小时后周一告诉媒体。

paras.en: "Then I wake up, and it's real. Then I go back to sleep for an hour, and it's real again."
paras.zh: “然后我醒来，一切都是真实的。然后我又睡了一个小时，一切又都是真实的了。”

paras.en: Prior to delivering his claim about having recurring nightmares about the game, Kiffin joked that the reporter who asked him a question prompting the response looked like Texas quarterback Arch Manning.
paras.zh: 在表达自己经常做关于比赛的噩梦之前，基芬开玩笑说，向他提出问题并做出回应的记者看起来就像德克萨斯州四分卫阿奇·曼宁。

paras.en: One could say Kiffin is seeing ghosts, literally, and you can't exactly blame him.
paras.zh: 人们可以说基芬确实看到了鬼魂，你不能完全责怪他。

paras.en: LSU carried a 21-13 lead into the fourth quarter before the Longhorns made it a five-point difference in the early stages of the final frame.
paras.zh: 第四节路易斯安那州立大学以 21-13 领先，长角牛队在最后一局初期将分差扩大到 5 分。

paras.en: After what was LSU's fourth punt in the fourth quarter alone, Manning and the Longhorns took over with 2:16 remaining. Texas drove the ball inside LSU's five-yard line with six seconds left on the clock before Manning found Raleek Brown on a swing pass to give the Longhorns their one-point lead with three ticks left.
paras.zh: 这是路易斯安那州立大学在第四节的第四次弃踢后，曼宁和长角牛队在比赛还剩 2 分 16 秒时接管了比赛。比赛还剩六秒时，得克萨斯队将球带入路易斯安那州立大学的五码线内，随后曼宁在一次挥杆传球中找到了拉里克·布朗，让长角牛队在还剩三秒时领先一分。

paras.en: While LSU upsetting the Volunteers in Knoxville on Saturday would soften the blow, year one for Kiffin in Baton Rouge has not met the lofty expectations. The Tigers lost at home to Alabama and Texas in back-to-back weeks, fell to Ole Miss in Week 3, and also lost a one-point game to Kentucky on the road in October.
paras.zh: 虽然路易斯安那州立大学周六在诺克斯维尔击败志愿者队会减轻打击，但基芬在巴吞鲁日的第一年并没有达到很高的期望。老虎队连续几周在主场输给了阿拉巴马州和德克萨斯州，在第三周输给了密西西比大学，并在十月份客场以一分之差输给了肯塔基州。

articles.title: Sam Hartman's ex compares him to asparagus, Lane Kiffin plays dumb & thoughts on Kirk Herbstreit

paras.en: 'Nightcaps' is a daily column that catches you up on the biggest sports, news and culture stories you may have missed while pretending to do work at your desk. It runs Monday-Friday on OutKick.com.
paras.zh: “Nightcaps”是一个每日专栏，为您提供在假装在办公桌前工作时可能错过的最大的体育、新闻和文化故事。它于周一至周五在 OutKick.com 上运行。

paras.en: Just kidding. I've never played Grand Theft Auto in my life, and I don't plan to start on Thursday. But I know some of you are really pumped about this, and I love that for you.
paras.zh: 只是在开玩笑。我这辈子从来没有玩过侠盗猎车手，而且我也不打算在周四开始玩。但我知道你们中的一些人对此非常感兴趣，我很喜欢你们。

paras.en: After all, where in real life can you steal a sports car, pick up a prostitute and go bird watching all in the same day?
paras.zh: 毕竟，现实生活中哪里能在同一天偷一辆跑车、泡妞、观鸟呢？

paras.en: Meanwhile, I'm living over here in the dark ages with Mario Kart on N64. Still the best video game ever created, and I'll die on that hill.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我和 N64 上的《马里奥赛车》一起生活在黑暗时代。仍然是有史以来最好的电子游戏，而我会死在那座山上。

paras.en: Although Duck Hunt on the original Nintendo was pretty rad, too. I remember thinking the zapper gun was the coolest thing in the world.
paras.zh: 尽管最初的任天堂游戏中的《鸭子狩猎》也相当精彩。我记得我认为电击枪是世界上最酷的东西。

paras.en: Speaking of technology, did y'all hear the power grid is going down today? Or tomorrow. Or sometime in the near future.
paras.zh: 说到科技，你们听说今天电网要停电了吗？或者明天。或者在不久的将来的某个时候。

paras.en: Pretty unfortunate for those of you who don't have a closet full of stockpiled food and a husband who knows bushcraft. And thank goodness I learned how to churn butter and make candles on my trip to Conner Prairie back in sixth grade.
paras.zh: 对于那些没有一个装满储存食物的衣柜和一个懂得丛林生存的丈夫的人来说，这是非常不幸的。谢天谢地，我在六年级的康纳草原之旅中学会了如何搅拌黄油和制作蜡烛。

paras.en: And if you're wondering if Conner Prairie is like Pioneer Village in "South Park," yes. Spitting image.
paras.zh: 如果您想知道康纳草原是否像《南方公园》中的先锋村，是的。随地吐痰的图像。

paras.en: Although if we could figure out the FAA situation before my anniversary trip to Costa Rica in January, I'd really appreciate that.
paras.zh: 不过，如果我们能在一月份哥斯达黎加周年纪念之旅之前了解联邦航空局的情况，我会非常感激。

paras.en: Anyway, better knock out these Nightcaps before everything goes dark.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，最好在一切变黑之前把这些睡帽喝掉。

paras.en: Sam Hartman gets not-so-glowing reviews from his ex-girlfriend
paras.zh: 萨姆·哈特曼 (Sam Hartman) 从他的前女友那里得到了不那么热情的评价

paras.en: I'm just kidding, I'm not subscribing to the doomsday fear mongering.
paras.zh: 我只是开玩笑，我不赞同散布世界末日恐惧的言论。

paras.en: No time for cyber attacks when we have football and reality TV to watch.
paras.zh: 当我们有足球比赛和真人秀节目可看时，就没有时间进行网络攻击。

paras.en: And speaking of both of those things, how about Sam Hartman's ex-girlfriend just casually launching the funniest insult I've ever heard?
paras.zh: 说到这两件事，萨姆·哈特曼的前女友随意发起我听过的最有趣的侮辱怎么样？

paras.en: After news broke that Sam would be featured on a dating show, Lauren Blake Boultier took it upon herself to let everyone know the Washington Commanders' backup backup backup QB has the "personality of asparagus."
paras.zh: 在山姆将出现在相亲节目中的消息传出后，劳伦·布莱克·博尔蒂埃亲自让大家知道华盛顿指挥官队的替补四分卫具有“芦笋般的个性”。

paras.en: She did elaborate on that statement, explaining, "He's good for you, but he's not exactly the most exciting thing on the menu."
paras.zh: 她确实详细阐述了这一说法，解释说：“他对你有好处，但他并不是菜单上最令人兴奋的东西。”

paras.en: Which actually makes him sound a little better. Like he's not a mean, cheating jerk or anything. He's just a little boring.
paras.zh: 这实际上让他听起来好一点。就好像他不是一个卑鄙、骗人的混蛋什么的。他只是有点无聊。

paras.en: This definitely just feels like an attention play from Lauren to insert herself into the news cycle after it was announced that Sam would be the new "Bachelor."
paras.zh: 这绝对感觉像是劳伦在宣布萨姆将成为新的“单身汉”后将自己插入新闻周期的一场引人注目的戏剧。

paras.en: And it worked! Because here I am writing about her and embedding her Instagram posts.
paras.zh: 它成功了！因为我在这里写的是她并嵌入了她的 Instagram 帖子。

paras.en: Oh, and to further prove that her complaints about Sam are actually very stupid, she went on to explain — according to TMZ — that "Sam's life revolves around football, fishing and family ... joking his idea of an adventurous weekend is trying out a different fishing spot."
paras.zh: 哦，为了进一步证明她对山姆的抱怨实际上是非常愚蠢的，据 TMZ 报道，她接着解释说，“山姆的生活围绕着足球、钓鱼和家庭……开玩笑说他想要冒险的周末就是尝试不同的钓鱼点。”

paras.en: Wow, this guy loves his family? And fishing?! The HORROR!
paras.zh: Wow, this guy loves his family?还有钓鱼？！恐怖！

paras.en: Anyway, Sam, can we book you for an interview with OutKick OutDoors?
paras.zh: 不管怎样，Sam，我们可以预约你接受OutKick OutDoors的采访吗？

paras.en: Lane Kiffin forgot he coached the Tennessee Vols
paras.zh: 莱恩·基芬忘记了他执教过田纳西沃尔队

paras.en: As a Vols fan, I want them to win every game. But if there's absolutely one game we CANNOT lose, it's this Saturday against Lane Kiffin and the LSU Tigers.
paras.zh: 作为一名沃尔斯球迷，我希望他们赢得每场比赛。但如果说有一场比赛我们绝对不能输的话，那就是本周六对阵莱恩·基芬和路易斯安那州立大学老虎队的比赛。

paras.en: As someone who was actually a student during the (very brief) Lane Kiffin era at Tennessee, there's a special disdain in my heart for that jerkface.
paras.zh: 作为一个在田纳西州（非常短暂的）莱恩·基芬时代实际上是一名学生的人，我内心对那个混蛋有一种特别的蔑视。

paras.en: If Sam Hartman is dull, healthy asparagus, then Lane Kiffin is gas station sushi. Briefly exciting, until you immediately realize what a terrible idea that was.
paras.zh: 如果萨姆·哈特曼 (Sam Hartman) 是乏味、健康的芦笋，那么莱恩·基芬 (Lane Kiffin) 就是加油站寿司。短暂地令人兴奋，直到你立即意识到这是一个多么糟糕的想法。

paras.en: Flashback to January 2010 when Lane tried to disappear under the cover of night to abandon the Vols for greener pastures at USC. The students caught onto his play, though, as we all chased him off campus with "Swiperboy" Renaldo Woolridge (UT basketball player turned rapper) live tweeting the whole thing.
paras.zh: 时间回溯到 2010 年 1 月，当时莱恩试图在夜色掩护下消失，放弃沃尔斯，前往南加州大学更绿的牧场。不过，学生们还是注意到了他的表演，因为我们都把他赶出了校园，“Swiperboy”雷纳尔多·伍尔里奇（UT 篮球运动员转为说唱歌手）在推特上直播了整个事情。

paras.en: A few days later, Swiperboy wrote a song that said, "Baby girl, I would never leave you like Kiffin."
paras.zh: 几天后，Swiperboy 写了一首歌曲，歌词是：“宝贝女孩，我永远不会像 Kiffin 一样离开你。”

paras.en: You know that I'm a youngin' / but I would never leave without telling you its comin' / No fakes, No fibs, No bluffin' / Stay wit ya for a year then leave like its nothin'?
paras.zh: 你知道我很年轻/但我永远不会在不告诉你它来了的情况下离开/没有假话，没有谎言，没有虚张声势/和你在一起一年，然后像什么都没有一样离开？

paras.en: Anyway, now that Lane's unsuccessful coaching career has followed him to a half dozen different schools since he left Knoxville, he barely remembers totally screwing over Tennessee.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，自从离开诺克斯维尔以来，莱恩不成功的教练生涯已经跟随他去了六所不同的学校，他几乎不记得完全搞砸了田纳西州。

paras.en: "It didn't even cross my mind that I used to be there."
paras.zh: “我什至没有想到我曾经在那里。”

paras.en: Brother, your son's name is literally KNOX.
paras.zh: 兄弟，你儿子的名字实际上是诺克斯。

paras.en: The good news is, LSU's loss to Texas last week ensured Lane won't be participating in this year's College Football Playoff. The bad news is he still has a chance to ruin the Vols' season.
paras.zh: 好消息是，路易斯安那州立大学上周输给德克萨斯州，确保莱恩无法参加今年的大学橄榄球季后赛。坏消息是他仍然有机会毁掉沃尔斯的赛季。

paras.en: Don't you dare let it happen, Tennessee. Don't you dare.
paras.zh: 你不敢让它发生，田纳西。你不敢。

paras.en: 📩 Email: amber.harding@outkick.com (Send your thoughts, stories, tips, rants and photos of your dog.)
paras.zh: 📩 电子邮件：amber.harding@outkick.com（发送您的想法、故事、提示、咆哮和您的狗的照片。）

paras.en: No, Kirk Herbstreit's dog shouldn't be at a steakhouse
paras.zh: 不，柯克·赫伯斯特雷特的狗不应该出现在牛排馆

paras.en: Look, I know everybody and their brother-in-law's neighbor has already weighed in on Kirk Herbstreit letting his dog, Peter, gobble a filet off a plate at a fancy steakhouse.
paras.zh: 听着，我知道每个人和他们姐夫的邻居都已经对柯克·赫伯斯特雷特让他的狗彼得在一家高档牛排馆狼吞虎咽盘中的菲力牛排发表了意见。

paras.en: But since I got several emails asking for my two cents, here it is.
paras.zh: 但由于我收到几封电子邮件索要我的两分钱，所以就在这里。

paras.en: I am not, personally, grossed out by dogs in restaurants. Maybe it's because I eat my meals in a house full of German Shepherd fur (though we do vacuum every single day and religiously change the air filters).
paras.zh: 就我个人而言，我并不因为餐馆里的狗而感到恶心。也许是因为我在一个充满德国牧羊犬毛皮的房子里吃饭（尽管我们每天都会用吸尘器吸尘并认真地更换空气过滤器）。

paras.en: So for me, the issue is not cleanliness — it's the sheer entitlement of Kirk Herbstreit.
paras.zh: 所以对我来说，问题不在于清洁——而在于 Kirk Herbstreit 的纯粹权利。

paras.en: According to the NYC Department of Health, non-service dogs are prohibited from indoor restaurant dining areas. Period. We have the same law here in Tennessee.
paras.zh: 根据纽约市卫生部的规定，非服务犬禁止进入室内餐厅用餐区。时期。我们在田纳西州也有同样的法律。

paras.en: Yet apparently, Kirk thinks those rules shouldn't apply to him because his dog is somehow more special than everyone else's.
paras.zh: 但显然，柯克认为这些规则不应该适用于他，因为他的狗在某种程度上比其他人的狗更特别。

paras.en: Some people are allergic to dogs. Some people just don't like dogs. And some people want to enjoy their $100+ date night meal without someone's golden retriever slurping up a steak off a plate in the next booth.
paras.zh: 有些人对狗过敏。有些人就是不喜欢狗。有些人想享受 100 美元以上的约会之夜大餐，但又不想被隔壁摊位的金毛猎犬吃掉盘子里的牛排。

paras.en: And y'all know I ADORE my dog — like an unreasonable amount. Sure, I take him on vacation and to open-air patios (where dogs are permitted), and I love a dog-friendly brewery. If I could take Rocky to work with me and fly him around in a private jet like Kirk does with Peter, I'd do it in a heartbeat.
paras.zh: 你们都知道我非常喜欢我的狗。当然，我带他去度假和去露天庭院（允许带狗的地方），而且我喜欢对狗友好的啤酒厂。如果我能带洛基和我一起工作，并像柯克和彼得那样乘坐私人飞机带他到处转，我会毫不犹豫地这么做。

paras.en: But treating your dogs well is not the same as imposing them on everyone around you. Or thinking you're above the law.
paras.zh: 但善待你的狗并不等同于将它们强加给你周围的每个人。或者认为你凌驾于法律之上。

paras.en: For people who are like, "Chill, it's not that serious" ...it is, actually. The ego and entitlement are off the charts with that guy.
paras.zh: 对于那些会说“冷静点，事情没那么严重”的人来说……实际上是这样。那个人的自我意识和权利都超乎寻常。

paras.en: And, someday, somebody needs to have the balls to tell Kirk NO.
paras.zh: 而且，有一天，需要有人有勇气告诉柯克不。

paras.en: And now for your weekly dose of dogs that don't eat filets off plates at high-end steakhouses.
paras.zh: 现在是每周给那些不吃高端牛排馆盘子里的菲力牛排的狗的剂量。

paras.en: Cindy F. writes: My dog Pepper did not like being told she could not go outside!
paras.zh: 辛迪·F. 写道： 我的狗佩珀不喜欢被告知她不能出去！

paras.en: One more thing: Is 'Peppa Pig' always this funny?
paras.zh: 还有一件事：“小猪佩奇”总是那么有趣吗？

paras.en: I don't have kids, so my knowledge of children's TV programming ended somewhere with "Rugrats." But I've been seeing this "Peppa Pig" scene floating around X, so I watched it.
paras.zh: 我没有孩子，所以我对儿童电视节目的了解就止于“小小兵”了。但我一直看到 X 周围飘浮着《小猪佩奇》的场景，所以我就看了。

paras.en: The execution. The attitude. 10/10, no notes.
paras.zh: 执行。态度。 10/10，没有笔记。

articles.title: ‘Squad’ member announces ‘Majority Priorities’ including reparations, abolishing ICE after blue wave

paras.en: Rep. Ayanna Pressley, D-Mass., unveiled a progressive legislative agenda for the incoming Democratic House majority Sunday, daring President Donald Trump to veto bold left-wing proposals ranging from reparations and Medicare-for-all to abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州民主党众议员阿亚娜·普莱斯利 (Ayanna Pressley) 周日为民主党众议院多数派公布了一项进步的立法议程，鼓励唐纳德·特朗普总统否决从赔偿和全民医疗保险到废除移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 等大胆的左翼提案。

paras.en: "We need to show people what Democrats can do with our majority. Reparations. Abortion justice. Medicare for All. Abolishing ICE. Childcare. Paid leave. And more," Pressley wrote on X.
paras.zh: “我们需要向人们展示民主党可以利用我们的多数派做什么。赔偿、堕胎正义、全民医疗保险、废除 ICE、儿童保育、带薪休假等等，”普雷斯利在 X 上写道。

paras.en: "If Trump wants to veto any of this, then the people will know exactly where he stands. And we won’t stop fighting until we win."
paras.zh: “如果特朗普想否决其中任何一项，那么人们就会确切地知道他的立场。而且我们不会停止战斗，直到我们获胜。”

paras.en: The post included a graphic titled, "Rep. Ayanna Pressley’s Majority Priorities," including the message: "TRUMP WANTS TO BE MR. VETO. LET'S PUT HIM TO THE TEST."
paras.zh: 该帖子包括一张标题为“众议员阿亚娜·普莱斯利的多数优先事项”的图片，其中包含这样的信息：“特朗普想成为否决先生。让我们来测试一下他。”

paras.en: Beyond the policies highlighted in her post, the 13-point platform calls for extending temporary protected status (TPS) for certain immigrants, lowering housing and everyday costs, ending what she termed "Trump’s Iran war," blocking weapons shipments, halting data centers and rooting out corruption.
paras.zh: 除了她在帖子中强调的政策之外，这个包含 13 点的纲领还呼吁延长某些移民的临时保护身份 (TPS)、降低住房和日常成本、结束她所说的“特朗普的伊朗战争”、阻止武器运输、停止数据中心和根除腐败。

paras.en: Pressley’s push comes nearly two weeks after Democrats won control of the House in the Nov. 3 midterm elections. While the party secured House and Senate majorities that will take office in January, Democrats remain well short of the two-thirds supermajority required in each chamber of Congress to override a presidential veto, setting the stage for messaging bills aimed at forcing Trump to reject progressive legislation.
paras.zh: 普莱斯利的推动是在民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中赢得众议院控制权近两周后提出的。尽管该党获得了将于一月份就职的众议院和参议院多数席位，但民主党仍远未达到国会各参众两院推翻总统否决所需的三分之二绝对多数，这为旨在迫使特朗普拒绝进步立法的信息法案奠定了基础。

paras.en: At the top of Pressley’s list is H.R. 40, the Commission to Study and Develop Reparation Proposals for African Americans Act, which Pressley reintroduced in January 2025 to examine the legacy of slavery and develop reparations proposals.
paras.zh: 普莱斯利的清单中名列前茅的是 H.R. 40，即《非裔美国人研究和制定赔偿提案委员会法案》，普莱斯利于 2025 年 1 月重新引入该法案，以审查奴隶制的遗留问题并制定赔偿提案。

paras.en: Other progressive lawmakers have pushed even further; in March 2026, Rep. Shri Thanedar, D-Mich., introduced separate legislation, H.R. 7927, to establish a federal commission to "study and distribute land reparations" to descendants of enslaved people.
paras.zh: 其他进步的立法者则走得更远。 2026 年 3 月，密歇根州民主党众议员 Shri Thanedar 提出了单独的立法 H.R. 7927，以建立一个联邦委员会，负责向被奴役者的后代“研究和分配土地赔偿”。

paras.en: The Department of Justice is involved in a lawsuit against Evanston, Illinois, for launching a reparations initiative that provides $25,000 in cash or housing-related financial assistance to eligible Black residents and descendants of Black residents. In 2019, Evanston became the first U.S. city to approve a municipal reparations plan, pledging $10 million over a decade funded by a local cannabis tax.
paras.zh: 司法部卷入了针对伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿的一项诉讼，该州发起一项赔偿计划，向符合条件的黑人居民和黑人居民的后代提供 25,000 美元的现金或与住房相关的经济援助。 2019 年，埃文斯顿成为美国第一个批准市政赔偿计划的城市，承诺在十年内由当地大麻税资助 1000 万美元。

paras.en: While progressive Democrats have long championed reparations, the issue has repeatedly drawn pushback from moderate members of the party who view it as a political liability.
paras.zh: 尽管进步的民主党人长期以来一直主张赔偿，但这个问题一再遭到党内温和派成员的抵制，他们认为这是一种政治责任。

paras.en: A DOJ official told Fox News Digital that while the agency "does not comment on the legislative priorities of members of Congress or speculate about future legislation, any legislation that allocates public benefits based on race is unconstitutional and debating such bills would be a waste of Congress’s time."
paras.zh: 司法部一名官员告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，虽然该机构“不会对国会议员的立法优先事项发表评论，也不会推测未来的立法，但任何基于种族分配公共福利的立法都是违宪的，辩论此类法案将浪费国会的时间。”

paras.en: "Our lawsuit challenging Evanston's reparations program is about the Constitution and federal civil rights law," the spokesperson said. "As alleged in our filing, the program provides housing-related financial assistance based on race, which violates the equal protection clause and the Fair Housing Act. The department's position is set out in court filings.
paras.zh: “我们对埃文斯顿赔偿计划提出质疑的诉讼涉及宪法和联邦民权法，”发言人说。 “正如我们在文件中所指控的那样，该计划根据种族提供与住房相关的经济援助，这违反了平等保护条款和《公平住房法》。该部门的立场已在法庭文件中阐明。

paras.en: "The department enforces federal civil rights laws, which protect all Americans equally regardless of race. We will continue to do so."
paras.zh: “该部门执行联邦民权法，无论种族如何，平等地保护所有美国人。我们将继续这样做。”

paras.en: Pressley's renewed call to abolish ICE drew a sharp rebuke from the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 普莱斯利再次呼吁废除 ICE，遭到特朗普政府的严厉谴责。

paras.en: A Department of Homeland Security (DHS) spokesperson told Fox News Digital Pressley should be grateful the administration has removed "dangerous criminals from her district."
paras.zh: 国土安全部（DHS）发言人告诉福克斯新闻数字新闻，普雷斯利应该感谢政府将“危险罪犯从她的地区清除”。

paras.en: "America’s brave ICE agents put their lives on the line every day to enforce U.S. law and arrest criminal illegal aliens — including gang members, rapists and murderers," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“美国勇敢的 ICE 特工每天冒着生命危险执行美国法律并逮捕犯罪的非法外国人，包括帮派成员、强奸犯和杀人犯。”

paras.en: "Representative [Pressley] should be thanking our law enforcement for removing these dangerous criminals from her district — NOT vilifying law enforcement. This type of rhetoric is contributing to a more than 1,600% increase in assaults against them as they put their lives on the line.
paras.zh: “众议员 [Pressley] 应该感谢我们的执法部门将这些危险的罪犯从她的选区中驱逐出去，而不是诽谤执法部门。这种言论导致针对他们的袭击增加了 1,600% 以上，因为他们冒着生命危险。

paras.en: "Since day one, DHS law enforcement has been delivering on President Trump’s promise to the American people to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens, including murderers, rapists, pedophiles, gang members and terrorists," the spokesperson added.
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说：“从第一天起，国土安全部执法部门就一直在兑现特朗普总统向美国人民做出的承诺，逮捕并驱逐非法移民犯罪分子，包括杀人犯、强奸犯、恋童癖者、帮派成员和恐怖分子。”

paras.en: "Nearly 60% of ICE arrests are of illegal aliens charged or convicted of a crime in the U.S. More than 3 million illegal aliens are out of the country and counting. Our message is clear: If you come to our country illegally, we will find you, we will arrest you and we will deport you."
paras.zh: “近 60% 的 ICE 逮捕都是在美国被指控或定罪的非法外国人。目前有超过 300 万非法外国人在美国境外，并且这一数字还在增加。我们的信息很明确：如果你非法进入我们的国家，我们会找到你、逮捕你并将你驱逐出境。”

paras.en: DHS also warned that anti-ICE rhetoric from elected officials has coincided with a surge in targeted violence against federal immigration officers.
paras.zh: 国土安全部还警告称，民选官员的反 ICE 言论与针对联邦移民官员的针对性暴力激增同时发生。

paras.en: "Attacks and demonization of ICE law enforcement is wrong. Because of smears like this, our ICE officers are now facing a 1,600% increase in assaults, a 3,300% increase in vehicle attacks and an 8,000% increase in death threats," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “攻击和妖魔化 ICE 执法人员是错误的。由于这样的诽谤，我们的 ICE 官员现在面临着 1,600% 的袭击增加，3,300% 的车辆袭击增加，以及 8,000% 的死亡威胁增加，”发言人说。

paras.en: Pressley and Thanedar did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital’s requests for comment.
paras.zh: 普雷斯利和塞尼达尔没有立即回应福克斯新闻数字媒体的置评请求。

articles.title: Some EU countries ‘could accept unlimited young Britons’ under youth mobility scheme
articles.author: Lisa O’Carroll and Pippa Crerar

paras.en: EU countries including Germany could accept an unlimited number of young Britons under a youth mobility scheme, according to sources.
paras.zh: 据消息人士透露，包括德国在内的欧盟国家可以根据青年流动计划接受无限数量的英国年轻人。

paras.en: Fresh details on how a scheme might work have emerged with EU leaders and the UK expected to settle on a quota of about 100,000 a year being allowed to work, travel or study in each others territories from 2028.
paras.zh: 欧盟领导人已经公布了有关该计划如何运作的新细节，英国预计从 2028 年起每年允许在彼此领土上工作、旅行或学习的配额约为 10 万人。

paras.en: The UK has insisted on a quota of EU citizens entering the UK under the scheme to guard against mass migration, but some countries have said they will not follow suit on the other side of the Channel and would be open to taking unlimited numbers.
paras.zh: 英国坚持根据该计划对进入英国的欧盟公民实行配额，以防止大规模移民，但一些国家表示，他们不会在英吉利海峡的另一边效仿，并愿意接受无限数量的配额。

paras.en: The quota is expected to be worked out on a country-by-country basis with smaller countries such as Malta and Luxembourg seeking a system that will not be based on a per-capita quota per EU member state.
paras.zh: 该配额预计将按国家具体情况制定，马耳他和卢森堡等较小国家寻求一种不基于每个欧盟成员国人均配额的制度。

paras.en: The youth mobility scheme for under-30s is expected to be sealed in principle as the EU-UK summit in Brussels on Friday.
paras.zh: 预计 30 岁以下青年流动计划将于周五在布鲁塞尔举行的欧盟-英国峰会上原则上敲定。

paras.en: In what looks like a win for Andy Burnham, however, several diplomats have said the tricky question of EU students paying the same fees as their UK counterparts if studying at a UK university under the scheme would be postponed for six months.
paras.zh: 然而，几位外交官表示，如果根据该计划在英国大学学习，欧盟学生与英国学生支付相同费用的棘手问题将被推迟六个月，这对安迪·伯纳姆来说似乎是一场胜利。

paras.en: This is to allow linkage with the Made in Europe legislation that will not reach its final stages until possibly April next year in a vote in the European parliament. The legislation is designed to give priority to EU supply chains in the car and other industries.
paras.zh: 这是为了与欧洲制造立法相联系，该立法可能要到明年四月欧洲议会的投票才能进入最后阶段。该立法旨在优先考虑汽车和其他行业的欧盟供应链。

paras.en: By linking the two issues the UK can get assurances that the final detail of the deal on mobility cannot be signed off unless it has been included in the Made in Europe legislation.
paras.zh: 通过将这两个问题联系起来，英国可以获得保证，除非将流动性协议的最终细节纳入“欧洲制造”立法中，否则无法签署。

paras.en: It is also understand that the majority of the 12-page draft joint statement has been agreed, with negotiations expected to continue to the wire and perhaps even during the summit between Burnham, the European Council leader, António Costa, and the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, which starts at 10am on Friday.
paras.zh: 另据了解，12页的联合声明草案的大部分内容已达成一致，谈判预计将继续进行，甚至可能在伯纳姆、欧洲理事会领导人安东尼奥·科斯塔和欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩于周五上午10点开始的峰会期间进行。

paras.en: The details came as Burnham has said there is “no rush” to decide on the UK’s longer term relationship with the EU, as he came under pressure from his own party to press the brakes on the pace of the rethink.
paras.zh: 这些细节公布之际，伯纳姆表示“不急于”决定英国与欧盟的长期关系，因为他面临着来自自己政党的压力，要求其放缓重新思考的步伐。

paras.en: The prime minister said he would “take stock” of the wider relationship after Friday’s summit in Brussels at which he also hopes to secure agreements on food and farming and emissions trading.
paras.zh: 总理表示，周五在布鲁塞尔举行峰会后，他将“评估”更广泛的关系，他还希望在峰会上就粮食和农业以及排放交易达成协议。

paras.en: In an interview with Sky News, Burnham admitted that he would now not set out the full options for a closer EU relationship until December – but denied he was “stepping back” from his previous commitments to pursue ties.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在接受天空新闻采访时承认，他现在不会在 12 月之前制定更紧密的欧盟关系的完整选择，但否认他会“放弃”之前追求关系的承诺。

paras.en: The prime minister had been expected to give a speech or deliver a statement setting out options for a closer relationship early next week, probably Monday, and to argue that it would be in the UK’s long-term interest.
paras.zh: 预计首相将在下周初（可能是周一）发表讲话或发表声明，列出建立更密切关系的选择，并辩称这符合英国的长期利益。

paras.en: While he may still address MPs, he is now likely to focus on the details of the deal secured at the summit, delaying his bigger plans to around the same time as his 10-year plan for the country, No 10 sources said, adding that the two were linked.
paras.zh: 《No 10》消息人士称，虽然他仍可能向国会议员发表讲话，但他现在可能会关注峰会上达成的协议的细节，将更大的计划推迟到与国家十年计划大致相同的时间，并补充说两者是相关的。

paras.en: No 10 insiders told the Guardian that Burnham wants to “frame the conversation, not go straight to the endgame” before testing public opinion, with even some Remain-minded MPs acknowledging there is more work to be done.
paras.zh: No 10内部人士告诉《卫报》，伯纳姆希望在测试公众舆论之前“构建对话，而不是直接进入结局”，甚至一些持留欧派议员也承认还有更多工作要做。

paras.en: These will include discussions with European counterparts to establish what the EU is willing to negotiate and whether it might be possible to get a better bespoke deal, or what the terms of rejoining the single market or customs union might be.
paras.zh: 其中将包括与欧洲同行进行讨论，以确定欧盟愿意谈判的内容以及是否有可能达成更好的定制协议，或者重新加入单一市场或关税同盟的条款可能是什么。

paras.en: Since Burnham announced in September that he would look again at the UK’s membership of EU, he has reiterated that the existing deal is not good enough, and that he would set out plans for a longer-term relationship this autumn.
paras.zh: 自伯纳姆9月份宣布将重新考虑英国加入欧盟以来，他重申现有协议不够好，并表示他将在今年秋季制定长期关系计划。

paras.en: In addition to the customs union or single market, these could include trading relationships along the lines that Norway, Switzerland or Canada have with the EU, reversing Brexit in its entirety, or no change at all.
paras.zh: 除了关税同盟或单一市场之外，这些措施还可能包括挪威、瑞士或加拿大与欧盟的贸易关系，彻底扭转英国脱欧，或者根本不改变。

paras.en: But after revealing his personal preference would be to fully rejoin the bloc, Burnham has encountered some resistance, including from within the cabinet, with some MPs with Leave-voting seats anxious about reopening the debate.
paras.zh: 但在透露自己的个人偏好是完全重新加入欧盟后，伯纳姆遇到了一些阻力，包括来自内阁内部的阻力，一些持有脱欧席位的议员担心重新展开辩论。

paras.en: Senior government figures say that Burnham wants a mandate to start negotiations with the EU in Labour’s next election manifesto, but that any subsequent referendum would be confirmatory after MPs had endorsed a deal.
paras.zh: 政府高级人士表示，伯纳姆希望在工党下一次选举宣言中授权启动与欧盟的谈判，但在议员们批准协议后，随后的任何公投都将是确认性的。

paras.en: In his interview, Burnham said: “All I’m going to do is look at what options might be available. And so that people can see the pros and cons, we’ll set those out in due course. There’s no rush to do that. The British public will be in charge of whatever comes next.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在接受采访时表示：“我要做的就是看看可能有哪些选择。为了让人们看到利弊，我们会在适当的时候列出这些选择。不急于这样做。英国公众将负责接下来发生的一切。”

paras.en: “We’ll see how [Friday’s summit] goes. And then we will consider whether there are options to further the relationship with the EU. I’ll set that out later this year alongside the 10-year plan.”
paras.zh: “我们将看看（周五的峰会）进展如何。然后我们将考虑是否有进一步发展与欧盟关系的选择。我将在今年晚些时候将其与十年计划一起列出。”

paras.en: The prime minister denied that he was “jumping the gun” or “making any assumptions” about where the UK would end up – but pointed to polling which shows the public wants closer ties with the bloc.
paras.zh: 首相否认他对英国的最终走向“操之过急”或“做出任何假设”，但他指出民意调查显示公众希望与欧盟建立更紧密的关系。

paras.en: Some Labour MPs, however, are concerned about the impact of freedom of movement in particular, as the debate around immigration in the UK has grown with the rise of Reform UK.
paras.zh: 然而，一些工党议员尤其担心迁徙自由的影响，因为随着英国改革运动的兴起，有关英国移民的争论日益激烈。

paras.en: “I won’t get ahead of public opinion. I will listen to what the public feel is the right long term solution,” Burnham added.
paras.zh: “我不会领先于公众舆论。我会倾听公众认为正确的长期解决方案，”伯纳姆补充道。

paras.en: While much of the deal expected to be agreed in Brussels on Friday is over the line, there are still tensions over the level of the cap on the youth mobility scheme cap, as well as over tuition fees.
paras.zh: 尽管预计周五在布鲁塞尔达成的大部分协议已经完成，但青年流动计划上限以及学费方面仍然存在紧张局势。

paras.en: Officials are also expected to discuss the agenda for the next round of the reset, which could include another attempt for the UK to join the EU’s €50bn (£40bn) safe defence fund, collaboration on law enforcement and borders, and mutual recognition of qualifications.
paras.zh: 预计官员们还将讨论下一轮重置的议程，其中可能包括英国再次尝试加入欧盟500亿欧元（400亿英镑）的安全防御基金、执法和边境合作以及相互承认资格。

articles.title: Australia sanctions individuals and company involved in illegal West Bank settlements
articles.author: Guardian staff

paras.en: Australia has announced another tranche of sanctions on those involved in illegal settlement expansion and human rights abuses against Palestinians in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚宣布对那些参与非法扩建定居点和侵犯约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦人人权的人实施另一批制裁。

paras.en: The sanctions prohibit Australians and Australian businesses from trading with or providing financial or other support to three individuals and four organisations.
paras.zh: 制裁禁止澳大利亚人和澳大利亚企业与三名个人和四个组织进行交易或向其提供财务或其他支持。

paras.en: In a statement, the foreign affairs minister, Penny Wong, said it was the first time Australian sanctions had targeted a construction company involved in the building of settlements. The statement did not name the company.
paras.zh: 外交部长黄英贤在一份声明中表示，这是澳大利亚首次针对参与定居点建设的建筑公司实施制裁。声明没有透露该公司的名称。

paras.en: “We are taking these actions because the rapid expansion of settlements and settler violence are extinguishing the possibility of a two-state solution,” Wong’s statement said.
paras.zh: 黄的声明说：“我们采取这些行动是因为定居点的迅速扩张和定居者的暴力正在消除两国解决方案的可能性。”

paras.en: “This includes the E1 settlement where demolitions and the displacement of Palestinians have occurred in recent weeks. Israeli settlements in the West Bank are illegal under international law.”
paras.zh: “这包括最近几周发生的 E1 定居点拆毁和巴勒斯坦人流离失所的情况。根据国际法，以色列在西岸的定居点是非法的。”

paras.en: Wong said the sanctioned individuals and organisations had “actively participated in the planning, coordination and establishment of new settlements, including raising funds, recruitment of volunteers and providing support to violent settlers”.
paras.zh: 黄说，受制裁的个人和组织“积极参与新定居点的规划、协调和建立，包括筹集资金、招募志愿者以及为暴力定居者提供支持”。

paras.en: Speaking on ABC radio on Wednesday morning, Wong said Australia had been coordinating with the UK on the sanctions.
paras.zh: 周三上午，黄在美国广播公司电台发表讲话时表示，澳大利亚一直在与英国就制裁事宜进行协调。

paras.en: “We thought it was very important to work with the United Kingdom to have a coordinated set of sanctions ahead of those decisions.
paras.zh: “我们认为在做出这些决定之前与英国合作制定一套协调一致的制裁措施非常重要。

paras.en: “We urge Israel to desist from proceeding with this settlement, which renders likely unviable the prospect of a Palestinian state.”
paras.zh: “我们敦促以色列停止推进这一解决方案，这可能导致巴勒斯坦国的前景变得不可行。”

paras.en: Wong said she had spoken to her Israeli counterpart, Gideon Sa’ar, on Tuesday night when she “outlined” Australia’s position.
paras.zh: 黄说，她在周二晚上与以色列外长吉迪恩·萨尔进行了交谈，当时她“概述了”澳大利亚的立场。

paras.en: “We’ve made clear we will continue to take action in respect of those involved in the settlement enterprise. The settlement enterprise is violent.”
paras.zh: “我们已经明确表示，我们将继续对涉及结算企业的人员采取行动。结算企业是暴力的。”

paras.en: When asked whether Wong was concerned Israel would respond to Australia sanctions with countermeasures, the minister said it had in the past.
paras.zh: 当被问及黄是否担心以色列会采取反制措施回应澳大利亚制裁时，部长表示过去曾担心过。

paras.en: “We’ve seen the Israeli government take action against Australia, including asking our diplomats to leave Ramallah. We’ve also seen the caretaker prime minister, Netanyahu, be very public in his criticism of Australia.
paras.zh: “我们看到以色列政府对澳大利亚采取行动，包括要求我们的外交官离开拉马拉。我们还看到看守总理内塔尼亚胡非常公开地批评澳大利亚。

paras.en: “So obviously, there is a reaction to Australia acting, but we think this is the right thing to do.”
paras.zh: “很明显，人们对澳大利亚的行动做出了反应，但我们认为这是正确的做法。”

paras.en: The statement warned Australian businesses they must not bid for construction tenders for illegal settlement developments.
paras.zh: 该声明警告澳大利亚企业不得参与非法定居点开发的建筑招标。

paras.en: Individuals breaching sanctions can attract a penalty of up to 10 years’ imprisonment and a fine of up to $910,000 or three times the value of the relevant transaction.
paras.zh: 违反制裁的个人可被处以最高 10 年监禁和最高 91 万美元或相关交易价值三倍的罚款。

paras.en: Businesses can be fined up to $3.64m or three times the value of the relevant transaction.
paras.zh: 企业可被处以最高 364 万美元或相关交易价值三倍的罚款。

articles.title: Palestinian woman shot dead by Israeli settlers near Jericho, witnesses say
articles.author: Lorenzo Tondo and Sufian Taha in Jerusalem

paras.en: A 72-year-old Palestinian woman has been shot dead in an overnight attack by Israeli settlers in a village near Jericho where settlers have recently moved in after taking over several Palestinian homes.
paras.zh: 一名 72 岁的巴勒斯坦妇女在以色列定居者连夜袭击杰里科附近的一个村庄时被枪杀，定居者在占领了几处巴勒斯坦房屋后最近搬进了该村庄。

paras.en: Fadha Wadha was standing outside her home in al-Duyuk al-Tahta in the occupied West Bank when she was struck in the head by a bullet as Israeli settlers fired towards Palestinian houses, according to testimonies from residents. Several other Palestinians, including her son, were wounded by gunfire.
paras.zh: 根据居民的证词，当以色列定居者向巴勒斯坦房屋开枪时，法达·瓦达 (Fadha Wadha) 站在被占领的约旦河西岸杜尤克塔赫塔 (al-Duyuk al-Tahta) 的家门外，头部被子弹击中。其他几名巴勒斯坦人，包括她的儿子，都被枪击受伤。

paras.en: Abu Younis, a cousin of Wadha’s husband, told the Guardian that the violence had begun when a group of settlers attacked a young boy they accused of entering a courtyard seized from its Palestinian residents.
paras.zh: 瓦达丈夫的表弟阿布·尤尼斯告诉《卫报》，暴力事件是在一群定居者袭击一名小男孩时开始的，他们指控这名小男孩进入从巴勒斯坦居民手中夺取的庭院。

paras.en: Dozens of Israeli settlers, some of them armed, moved into eight buildings in al-Duyuk al-Tahta two weeks ago with the backing of the settler organisation Nachala and a regional council representing illegal settlements in the central West Bank.
paras.zh: 两周前，在定居者组织 Nachala 和代表西岸中部非法定居点的地区委员会的支持下，数十名以色列定居者（其中一些人携带武器）搬进了杜尤克塔赫塔的八栋建筑。

paras.en: “A vehicle carrying settlers chased him,” Younis said. “There were about 15 settlers in several vehicles. They began firing indiscriminately, killing the woman.”
paras.zh: “一辆载着定居者的车辆追赶他，”尤尼斯说。 “几辆车里大约有 15 名定居者。他们开始不分青红皂白地开枪，杀死了这名妇女。”

paras.en: Witnesses said Palestinian residents began to throw stones to defend themselves, as more settlers arrived at the scene, shooting at civilians and injuring six men.
paras.zh: 目击者称，随着更多定居者抵达现场，巴勒斯坦居民开始投掷石块自卫，向平民开枪，造成六人受伤。

paras.en: Wadha’s son, Arafat Fidhat, was wounded after he rushed to the scene after learning that his mother had been shot. His wife, Naama Fidhat, told Reuters he was in shock when he accidentally collided with a parked car belonging to one of the settlers.
paras.zh: 瓦达的儿子阿拉法特·菲达特在得知母亲被枪杀后赶到现场后受伤。他的妻子纳马·菲达特 (Naama Fidhat) 告诉路透社，当他不小心与其中一名定居者停放的一辆汽车相撞时，他感到非常震惊。

paras.en: Witnesses said the vehicle was empty at the time, but that settlers responded by opening fire, wounding Arafat in the torso.
paras.zh: 目击者称，当时车上是空的，但定居者开枪回应，打伤了阿拉法特的躯干。

paras.en: Naama Fidhat said her husband was being taken to a hospital in Ramallah when Israeli soldiers stopped the ambulance and arrested him. She said Israeli soldiers also arrested their son, Wadha’s grandson, early the following morning.
paras.zh: 纳马·菲达特说，她的丈夫被送往拉马拉的一家医院，以色列士兵拦住了救护车并逮捕了他。她说，第二天一早，以色列士兵还逮捕了他们的儿子，瓦达的孙子。

paras.en: “What did we do? We didn’t do anything,” she said. “This is our house, they were the ones who came with weapons … we were unarmed, we were sleeping.”
paras.zh: “我们做了什么？我们什么也没做，”她说。 “这是我们的房子，他们是带着武器来的……我们手无寸铁，我们正在睡觉。”

paras.en: The Israeli military said a group of Palestinians in a car “accelerated their vehicle toward an Israeli vehicle and rammed it”. It said the Palestinians exited the vehicle and attacked the Israelis, who opened fire at the Palestinians. “There are Israeli and Palestinian casualties in the incident,” the military said.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，一群巴勒斯坦人驾驶一辆汽车“加速冲向一辆以色列车辆并撞向它”。报道称，巴勒斯坦人下车袭击以色列人，以色列人向巴勒斯坦人开枪。军方表示：“事件中有以色列和巴勒斯坦人伤亡。”

paras.en: The arrival of the Israeli settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta had raised fears among Palestinian residents who have faced repeated attacks in the area.
paras.zh: 以色列定居者抵达杜尤克塔赫塔引起了巴勒斯坦居民的恐惧，他们在该地区多次遭受袭击。

paras.en: The Binyamin regional council, which covers 47 illegal settlements, claimed the properties in the village had been bought from Palestinians, but Jericho’s governor, Hussein Hamayel, disputed the claim, saying the land belonged to the state and could not legally be sold.
paras.zh: 管辖 47 个非法定居点的本亚明地区委员会声称该村的房产是从巴勒斯坦人手中购买的，但杰里科省长侯赛因·哈马耶勒对此说法提出异议，称这些土地属于国家所有，不能合法出售。

paras.en: Human rights activists said settlers had assaulted and robbed two Israeli activists and shot a Palestinian man in the leg during the takeover earlier this month.
paras.zh: 人权活动人士表示，在本月早些时候的接管过程中，定居者袭击并抢劫了两名以色列活动人士，并向一名巴勒斯坦男子的腿部开枪。

paras.en: “Since the settlers moved into the area on 4 November our lives have been turned upside down,” Younis told the Guardian. “We used to live peacefully and safely on our farms, but since the settlers arrived, our lives have become a living hell. I own 53 dunams [5.3 hectares] of farmland with greenhouses, but we are no longer allowed to access them. We have suffered devastating financial losses, and now people are being killed as well.”
