articles.title: NTN Employees Volunteer at Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America recently held a Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. On Oct. 27, 12 NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving. Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags for distribution to families throughout the community. Team members followed a “trick-or-treat”-style shopping process, collecting and packing items at various food stations. Items included cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司最近在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。 10 月 27 日，12 名 NTN 员工自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并支持当地家庭。志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，分发给整个社区的家庭。团队成员遵循“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物流程，在各个食品站收集和包装物品。商品包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕粉和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees helped pantry staff organize and store five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers would have needed up to a month. The NTN team completed the same work in just a few hours.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工帮助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，储藏室的正式员工和志愿者最多需要一个月的时间。 NTN团队在短短几个小时内完成了同样的工作。

paras.en: “Helping to address food insecurity is an important part of NTN’s commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen,” said Tom Mohrdieck, president and CEO of NTN Bearing Corporation of America. “This volunteer event directly supports NTN’s global Sustainable Development Goal of Zero Hunger while allowing our employees to make a meaningful difference for families in our community. Knowing that the food bags assembled will help nearly 900 families celebrate Thanksgiving made this an especially impactful event for our team. NTN is grateful for the opportunity to support the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry and the vital services it provides throughout the year.”
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司总裁兼首席执行官 Tom Mohrdieck 表示：“帮助解决粮食不安全问题是 NTN 致力于成为负责任的企业公民的重要组成部分。” “这次志愿者活动直接支持 NTN 的全球零饥饿可持续发展目标，同时让我们的员工为社区家庭做出有意义的改变。我们知道组装的食品袋将帮助近 900 个家庭庆祝感恩节，这对我们的团队来说是一次特别有影响力的活动。NTN 非常感谢有机会支持埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室及其全年提供的重要服务。”

paras.en: Community Engagement Program Supports Local Organizations
paras.zh: 社区参与计划支持当地组织

paras.en: NTN launched its Community Spirit & Engagement Program in January 2023. The program reflects the company’s commitment to responsible, ethical operations and supporting communities where it operates.
paras.zh: NTN 于 2023 年 1 月启动了社区精神和参与计划。该计划反映了公司对负责任、道德运营和支持其运营所在社区的承诺。

paras.en: Its goals include contributing time and resources to charitable organizations and encouraging employees to participate in their communities. The program also seeks to build partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: 其目标包括为慈善组织贡献时间和资源，并鼓励员工参与社区活动。该计划还寻求与其他团体和组织建立伙伴关系。

paras.en: Food Pantry Serves 1,100 Families Monthly
paras.zh: 食品储藏室每月为 1,100 个家庭提供服务

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity. The pantry serves approximately 1,100 families monthly through a client-choice model. This approach allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a convenient, dignified manner.
paras.zh: 埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务。该食品储藏室每月通过客户选择模式为大约 1,100 个家庭提供服务。这种方法使家庭能够以方便、有尊严的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。

paras.en: Through partnerships with community organizations, donors and volunteers, the pantry helps local families access resources throughout the year. The pantry expects to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags from the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: 通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室全年帮助当地家庭获取资源。该食品储藏室预计将在这个节日期间向近 900 个家庭分发感恩节食品袋。

articles.title: The 45-Day Rule: How Parts Stores Stop Financing Their Customers
articles.author: Bob Morgan

paras.en: Every parts store has an account like this. The shop buys a lot. The owner is a good guy. He pays — eventually. Meanwhile he’s 50 to 90 days out and asking for another special order “by Thursday.”
paras.zh: 每个配件店都有一个这样的帐户。店里买的很多。店主是个好人。他最终付出了代价。与此同时，他有 50 到 90 天的时间，并要求“在周四之前”再下一份特别订单。

paras.en: Here’s the hard truth I learned after about 15 years running stores on Long Island: volume you don’t collect isn’t volume. It’s a loan you never approved. Most stores aren’t short on sales. They’re short on cash because they’re quietly running a bank for their customers, with the special-order desk as the loan window.
paras.zh: 这是我在长岛经营商店大约 15 年之后学到的残酷事实：你不收集的数量就不是数量。这是一笔您从未批准过的贷款。大多数商店都不缺销售。他们缺乏现金，因为他们悄悄地为客户经营一家银行，以特殊订单柜台作为贷款窗口。

paras.en: The fix isn’t a collections agency or a nasty letter. It’s one rule, written down and used every single time.
paras.zh: 解决办法不是催收机构或令人讨厌的信件。这是一条规则，写下来并每次都使用。

paras.en: If an account is 45 or more days past due and they want a special order, the special waits until the money is in the building.
paras.zh: 如果账户逾期 45 天或以上，并且他们想要特殊订单，则特殊订单会等到钱到达大楼后才进行。

paras.en: That’s it. Shelf stock can still go out for cash. The relationship stays intact. But you stop ordering non-returnable, hard-to-restock parts for an account that hasn’t paid for the last batch.
paras.zh: 就是这样。货架库存仍然可以换取现金。关系保持完好。但您会停止为上一批尚未付款的帐户订购不可退货、难以补货的零件。

paras.en: Why special orders? A stocked part sold on account is a receivable. A special order for a slow-paying account is a receivable plus freight, a restocking fee and a part you may end up owning if the job falls through. That’s where slow accounts do the most damage, so that’s where the line goes.
paras.zh: 为什么要特殊订单？赊销的库存零件是应收账款。慢付款帐户的特殊订单是应收账款加上运费、补货费以及如果工作失败您最终可能拥有的部分。这就是缓慢的帐户造成最大损害的地方，所以这就是线路的所在。

paras.en: Before the rule works, everyone at the counter has to agree on what “45 days” means. I count days past the due date, not days since the invoice. A Net 30 invoice dated June 12 is due July 12. On September 2, it’s 52 days past due — over the line.
paras.zh: 在规则生效之前，柜台上的每个人都必须就“45 天”的含义达成一致。我计算的是到期日之后的天数，而不是发票后的天数。日期为 6 月 12 日的 Net 30 发票应于 7 月 12 日到期。到 9 月 2 日，已逾期 52 天。

paras.en: If you’d rather age from the invoice date, fine. Pick one method, write it on the rule and never switch mid-argument. If your company already has a hold policy, use its number. The discipline matters more than the exact day.
paras.zh: 如果您希望从发票日期算起，没问题。选择一种方法，将其写在规则上，并且永远不要在争论中途改变。如果您的公司已有保留政策，请使用其号码。纪律比具体的日子更重要。

paras.en: The 45-day rule works because nobody gets surprised by it. The steps before it do the heavy lifting:
paras.zh: 45 天的规则之所以有效，是因为没有人对此感到惊讶。完成繁重工作之前的步骤：

paras.en: - Day 30 — a reminder, not a threat. “Invoice 1844 is at 30. Card or check on the next stop?”
paras.zh: - 第 30 天——提醒，而不是威胁。 “发票 1844 是 30。下一站刷卡还是支票？”

paras.en: - Day 35–40 — a human call. Not another statement they’re already ignoring. A person, by name, on the phone.
paras.zh: - 第 35-40 天 — 人工召唤。这不是他们已经忽视的另一个声明。一个人，叫出名字，正在打电话。

paras.en: - Day 45 — credit hold for new specials. Shelf can still be cash. Specials wait.
paras.zh: - 第 45 天 — 新特价商品的积分保留。货架上还是可以现金的。特价等。

paras.en: - Day 60 — hard hold. No “just this once” unless a manager puts the amount and the date in writing.
paras.zh: - 第 60 天 — 坚守。除非经理以书面形式注明金额和日期，否则不能“仅此一次”。

paras.en: Most accounts never reach day 45 once the day-30 and day-35 touches actually happen. The rule is the backstop, not the first move.
paras.zh: 一旦第 30 天和第 35 天的接触实际发生，大多数帐户永远不会到达第 45 天。规则是后盾，而不是第一步。

paras.en: Give your counter people the exact words. Nobody should improvise a credit conversation with a regular at the register. At day 45:
paras.zh: 向柜台人员提供准确的词语。任何人都不应该在收银台与常客即兴进行信用对话。第 45 天：

paras.en: “I can keep selling you what’s here if we’re cash. I can’t put another special in motion until 1844 is clear. I need you current so I can keep saying yes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们有现金，我可以继续向你出售这里的商品。在 1844 年明确之前，我无法推出另一个特价商品。我需要你提供最新信息，这样我才能继续答应。”

paras.en: “I like working with you. I can’t keep shipping on a 60-day balance. Let’s pick an amount for this week and a date for the rest. Until that starts, we’re cash.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢和你一起工作。我无法在 60 天的余额中继续发货。让我们选择本周的金额和其余的日期。在那之前，我们都是现金。”

paras.en: Those lines don’t threaten and don’t apologize. They state the rule and offer a path back. “I need you current so I can keep saying yes” puts you and the customer on the same side.
paras.zh: 这些台词既不构成威胁，也不构成道歉。他们陈述规则并提供返回路径。 “我需要你保持最新状态，这样我才能一直说“是””让你和客户站在同一边。

paras.en: The most common way the rule breaks: “I’m not paying until you fix that core credit.” Freeze the one disputed line and research it. The rest of the balance is still due. Don’t let a $40 question hold up a $4,000 balance.
paras.zh: 最常见的违反规则的方式是：“在你修复核心信用之前，我不会付款。”冻结一条有争议的线路并进行研究。其余余额仍需支付。不要让 40 美元的问题占用 4,000 美元的余额。

paras.en: And if yelling breaks the rule, you’ve just taught every shop in town that yelling works. The rule has to hold for your biggest account, too.
paras.zh: 如果大喊大叫违反了规则，那么你就已经告诉镇上的每一家商店大喊大叫是有效的。该规则也必须适用于您最大的帐户。

paras.en: A rule nobody checks turns into a suggestion. Once a week — I do it in a short Monday meeting — pull your aging and look at three things:
paras.zh: 无人检查的规则变成了建议。每周一次——我在周一的一次简短会议上进行——拉动你的衰老，看看三件事：

paras.en: - Total dollars 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的总金额。

paras.en: - A name and a next-call date next to every one of those accounts.
paras.zh: - 每个帐户旁边都有姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Any special order that went out to a 45+ account, and who approved it.
paras.zh: - 发送至 45+ 帐户的任何特殊订单以及谁批准的。

paras.en: A simple example (invented numbers): a store has $6,940 at 45+ days past due across two accounts. A fleet account on that list calls for a special. The counter person checks the list and uses the day-45 line. The special gets placed the afternoon the check clears. No fight, no exception, and the store isn’t fronting more parts to a customer who already owes $4,200.
paras.zh: 一个简单的例子（虚构的数字）：一家商店的两个帐户逾期 45 天以上，有 6,940 美元。该名单上的车队帐户需要特殊服务。柜台人员检查清单并使用第 45 天的线路。特价商品将在支票兑现的下午进行。没有打架，没有例外，商店也不会向已经欠下 4,200 美元的顾客提供更多零件。

paras.en: - Export or write down your current aging.
paras.zh: - 导出或写下您当前的年龄。

paras.en: - Highlight everything 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 突出显示逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的所有内容。

paras.en: - Put a name and a next-call date on every one.
paras.zh: - 在每个人身上写上姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Write the special-order rule on a sticky note at the counter where everyone can see it.
paras.zh: - 将特殊订单规则写在柜台的便利贴上，让每个人都能看到。

paras.en: You can like the shop. You can need the volume. You still collect. The 45-day rule is how a parts store stops financing its customers and gets back to selling them parts.
paras.zh: 你可以喜欢这家商店。您可能需要音量。你还是收藏吧。 45 天规则规定了零部件商店如何停止向客户提供融资并重新向他们销售零部件。

articles.title: APA’s Gatsby Gala Brings Roaring ’20s Glamour to AAPEX
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) brought a touch of Roaring ’20s glamour to this year’s AWDA and AAPEX festivities with its annual industry cocktail party. This year’s party, The Gatsby Gala, was held November 3, 2026, at 1923 Prohibition Bar in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) 举办的年度行业鸡尾酒会为今年的 AWDA 和 AAPEX 庆祝活动增添了一丝咆哮的 20 年代魅力。今年的派对“盖茨比晚会”于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在拉斯维加斯 1923 Prohibition 酒吧举行。

paras.en: Guests stepped back in time for an evening of drinks, networking, and old-school elegance. Adding to the occasion, APA staff dressed in 1920s-inspired attire, helping bring the spirit of the Jazz Age to life at the Prohibition-era venue.
paras.zh: 客人们回到过去，度过了一个畅饮、社交和老式优雅的夜晚。为庆祝这一盛事，APA 工作人员身着 1920 年代风格的服装，帮助在禁酒令时代的场馆将爵士乐时代的精神带入生活。

paras.en: “One of the best parts of AWDA and AAPEX is the opportunity to bring people together outside of the day-to-day business. The Gatsby Gala gave us a chance to celebrate the relationships that make this industry special while enjoying a memorable evening with our shareholders, members and supplier partners,” said Steve Tucker, president of Automotive Parts Associates.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Associates 总裁 Steve Tucker 表示：“AWDA 和 AAPEX 最好的部分之一就是有机会将日常业务之外的人们聚集在一起。Gatsby Gala 让我们有机会庆祝使这个行业与众不同的关系，同时与我们的股东、会员和供应商合作伙伴一起度过一个难忘的夜晚。”

paras.en: The evening brought together APA shareholders, TruStar members, NEXUS representatives, and industry supplier partners for an opportunity to connect with fellow aftermarket professionals, strengthen existing relationships, and enjoy a night away from the busy trade show floor.
paras.zh: 当晚，APA 股东、TruStar 会员、NEXUS 代表和行业供应商合作伙伴齐聚一堂，有机会与售后市场专业人士建立联系、加强现有关系，并享受远离繁忙贸易展览场地的夜晚。

paras.en: The Gatsby Gala carried on APA/TruStar’s tradition of hosting an annual gathering during one of the busiest weeks in the automotive aftermarket. Beyond the party, APA also held a dinner for its Board of Directors on Saturday night and met with more than 70 supplier partners during AWDA and on the AAPEX show floor.
paras.zh: Gatsby Gala 延续了 APA/TruStar 在汽车售后市场最繁忙的几周举办年度聚会的传统。除了派对之外，APA 还在周六晚为其董事会举办了晚宴，并在 AWDA 期间和 AAPEX 展厅与 70 多家供应商合作伙伴会面。

articles.title: Which animal farts the most?
articles.author: Clarissa Brincat

paras.en: Flatology, the study of flatulence, sounds more like a joke than a serious scientific discipline. But studying farts actually helps biologists understand an animal's diet and digestion.
paras.zh: 扁平学（Flatology）是对胀气的研究，听起来更像是一个笑话，而不是一门严肃的科学学科。但研究屁实际上可以帮助生物学家了解动物的饮食和消化。

paras.en: We know that a host of creatures — from whales, to snakes, to sloths — pass gas. But do we know which animal is the top tooter? Experts told Live Science the answer is blowing in the wind.
paras.zh: 我们知道许多生物——从鲸鱼、蛇到树懒——都会排出气体。但我们知道哪种动物是顶级动物吗？专家告诉《生活科学》，答案正在风中飘扬。

paras.en: "Getting quantitative measurements for farts per animal is pretty difficult," Nick Caruso, a data scientist and co-author of '"Does It Fart?: The Definitive Field Guide to Animal Flatulence'' (Quercus Publishing, 2017), told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “对每只动物的放屁进行定量测量非常困难，”数据科学家、《放屁吗？：动物胀气权威指南》（Quercus Publishing，2017）一书的合著者尼克·卡鲁索（Nick Caruso）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: What we can do is hypothesize using the data we do have. Expelled gas is made partially of methane, so comparing methane emissions produced by different species may provide a clue. However, this method does have limitations, experts pointed out.
paras.zh: 我们能做的就是利用我们现有的数据进行假设。排出的气体部分由甲烷组成，因此比较不同物种产生的甲烷排放量可能会提供线索。不过，专家指出，这种方法确实有局限性。

paras.en: Researchers measure the methane animals produce by placing them inside respiration chambers, then inserting a capsule into the stomach that releases a tracer gas while strapping them with a harness that samples their breath. Alternatively, they capture their breath at stations where they feed or are milked.
paras.zh: 研究人员将动物放入呼吸室内，然后将一个胶囊插入胃中，释放示踪气体，同时用带子对它们进行呼吸采样，从而测量动物产生的甲烷。或者，它们在喂食或挤奶的地方呼吸。

paras.en: Research points to livestock, especially cows, as major methane emitters. A recent report puts their total methane emissions at 117 teragrams per year. (One teragram is equal to 1 billion kilograms, or 2.2 billion pounds.) A buildup of cow-generated methane gas even caused a dairy shed in Germany to explode. However, contrary to what many people believe, the "overwhelming majority" of methane emissions from livestock is released through burping, not flatulence, Ermias Kebreab, a professor of animal science at the University of California, Davis, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究指出牲畜，尤其是奶牛，是主要的甲烷排放者。最近的一份报告显示，他们每年的甲烷排放总量为 117 太克。 （一太克相当于 10 亿公斤，即 22 亿磅。）奶牛产生的甲烷气体的累积甚至导致德国的一个奶牛棚发生爆炸。然而，与许多人的看法相反，加州大学戴维斯分校动物科学教授埃米亚斯·科布雷布在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，牲畜排放的“绝大多数”甲烷是通过打嗝而不是肠胃气胀释放的。

paras.en: The reason comes down to where in the gut the gas is made. Herbivores can't break down plant material on their own; they rely on microbes in their guts to ferment it, and that fermentation releases gases such as methane and carbon dioxide, Dr. Marcus Clauss, head of research and co-director of the Clinic for Zoo Animals, Exotic Pets and Wildlife at the University of Zurich, told Live Science in an email. Some of this gas is absorbed into the bloodstream and exhaled. The rest tends to leave by the nearest exit — animals that ferment their food toward the front of the digestive tract mostly burp it out, while those that ferment it toward the back mostly pass it as wind, Clauss explained.
paras.zh: 原因在于气体是在肠道中产生的。食草动物无法自行分解植物材料；苏黎世大学动物园动物、外来宠物和野生动物诊所的研究负责人兼联席主任马库斯·克劳斯博士在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，它们依靠肠道中的微生物进行发酵，而发酵会释放甲烷和二氧化碳等气体。其中一些气体被吸收到血液中并呼出。其余的则倾向于从最近的出口离开——克劳斯解释说，将食物发酵到消化道前部的动物大多将食物打嗝出来，而那些将食物发酵到消化道后部的动物则大多以风的形式排出。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Cows and other ruminants (such as buffalo, sheep, goats and camels) ferment their food in a chamber called the rumen, located near the front of the digestive system, so most of the methane they produce is through belching, Matthew Hayek, an associate professor of environmental studies at New York University, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 纽约大学环境研究副教授马修·哈耶克（Matthew Hayek）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，牛和其他反刍动物（如水牛、绵羊、山羊和骆驼）在位于消化系统前部的称为瘤胃的室中发酵食物，因此它们产生的大部分甲烷是通过打嗝产生的。

paras.en: So if it's not cows, which animal is the top farter based on their methane emissions? The best candidates are hindgut fermenters — herbivores that digest plant matter in the large intestine (the hindgut). Meat eaters, by contrast, typically produce far less methane than herbivores do, Clauss said.
paras.zh: 那么，如果不是奶牛，那么根据甲烷排放量来看，哪一种动物的放屁速度最高呢？最好的候选者是后肠发酵动物——在大肠（后肠）中消化植物物质的食草动物。克劳斯说，相比之下，肉食动物产生的甲烷通常比食草动物少得多。

paras.en: One possible contender are termites, which break down wood and grass in their hindguts. Their global population is estimated to be around 27 quadrillion (that's 15 zeros) individuals, and they collectively emit 10 teragrams of methane per year.
paras.zh: 一种可能的竞争者是白蚁，它们用后肠分解木头和草。它们的全球人口估计约为 27 千万亿（即 15 个零），每年总共排放 10 太克甲烷。

paras.en: But, per individual, the title might go to horses. According to a 2019 report from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, horses have the highest methane emissions among hindgut fermenters — around 40 pounds (18 kg) of methane per horse each year.
paras.zh: 但是，就个人而言，这个头衔可能会属于马。根据政府间气候变化专门委员会 2019 年的一份报告，马的后肠发酵罐中甲烷排放量最高，每匹马每年排放约 40 磅（18 公斤）甲烷。

paras.en: However, Clauss is skeptical. "The ranking of horse as highest is only because it has been measured," he told Live Science in an email. "But there are so many hindgut fermenters not measured, like rhino ... Who knows?"
paras.zh: 然而，克劳斯对此表示怀疑。 “马的排名最高只是因为它已经被测量过，”他在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “但是有很多后肠发酵罐没有被测量，比如犀牛……谁知道呢？”

paras.en: If we consider methane emissions per unit of bodyweight, the nutria (Myocastor coypus) — an herbivorous, semiaquatic rodent — would have higher methane emissions than the horse, Clauss said.
paras.zh: 克劳斯说，如果我们考虑每单位体重的甲烷排放量，海狸鼠（Myocastor coypus）——一种草食性半水生啮齿动物——的甲烷排放量将比马更高。

paras.en: Clauss also questioned the accuracy of using methane emissions data as an indicator of flatulence. "There is some methane in flatulence, but most likely the majority of methane produced by an animal is exhaled, i.e. it goes via blood to the lungs," he said.
paras.zh: 克劳斯还质疑使用甲烷排放数据作为肠胃胀气指标的准确性。 “胀气中含有一些甲烷，但动物产生的大部分甲烷很可能是呼出的，即它通过血液进入肺部，”他说。

paras.en: So until scientists figure out how to measure animal farts, any ranking remains speculative. For now, scientists have developed ways to track intestinal gas in people, including swallowable electronic capsules that measure gases inside the gut and clip-on underwear sensors that detect hydrogen in farts.
paras.zh: 因此，在科学家弄清楚如何测量动物放屁之前，任何排名都仍然是推测性的。目前，科学家们已经开发出追踪人体肠道气体的方法，包括测量肠道内气体的可吞咽电子胶囊和检测屁中氢气的夹式内衣传感器。

paras.en: Does animal flatulence contribute to climate change?
paras.zh: 动物胀气会导致气候变化吗？

paras.en: Methane is a particularly potent greenhouse gas when released into the atmosphere, and the quantities that large herds of cows and other ruminants emit through burping are enough to contribute to climate change. Indeed, scientists are experimenting with ways to reduce methane emissions from cattle — for example, by adding seaweed to their diet.
paras.zh: 甲烷在释放到大气中时是一种特别有效的温室气体，大群牛和其他反刍动物通过打嗝排放的甲烷量足以导致气候变化。事实上，科学家们正在尝试减少牛的甲烷排放的方法，例如在牛的饮食中添加海藻。

paras.en: But animal flatulence is not a major contributor to global methane increases, Hayek said.
paras.zh: 但哈耶克说，动物肠胃胀气并不是全球甲烷增加的主要原因。

paras.en: Even methane emissions from termite flatulence, while large, do not have an impact, Stefan Arndt, a professor of physiological and ecosystem ecology at the University of Melbourne in Australia, told Live Science in an email. "A large proportion of that methane is then consumed by methanotrophic bacteria in the soil," he said. These bacteria use methane as an energy source, thereby reducing the net methane emissions from termites substantially.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚墨尔本大学生理学和生态系统生态学教授斯特凡·阿恩特 (Stefan Arndt) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，即使是白蚁胀气产生的甲烷排放量虽然很大，但也不会产生影响。 “其中很大一部分甲烷被土壤中的甲烷氧化细菌消耗，”他说。这些细菌使用甲烷作为能源，从而大大减少白蚁的甲烷净排放量。

paras.en: "Their emissions are part of the natural cycle of methane that has always been there for millennia," Arndt added. "The increasing methane concentrations in the atmosphere that are leading to climate change are caused by humans."
paras.zh: 阿恩特补充道：“它们的排放是甲烷自然循环的一部分，这种循环已经存在了数千年。” “导致气候变化的大气中甲烷浓度不断增加是由人类造成的。”

paras.en: Clarissa Brincat is a freelance writer specializing in health and medical research. After completing an MSc in chemistry, she realized she would rather write about science than do it. She learned how to edit scientific papers in a stint as a chemistry copyeditor, before moving on to a medical writer role at a healthcare company. Writing for doctors and experts has its rewards, but Clarissa wanted to communicate with a wider audience, which naturally led her to freelance health and science writing. Her work has also appeared in Medscape, HealthCentral and Medical News Today.
paras.zh: 克拉丽莎·布林卡特 (Clarissa Brincat) 是一位自由撰稿人，专门从事健康和医学研究。在获得化学硕士学位后，她意识到自己更愿意写科学而不是去做科学。在担任化学文案编辑期间，她学会了如何编辑科学论文，然后在一家医疗保健公司担任医学撰稿人。为医生和专家写作有其回报，但克拉丽莎希望与更广泛的受众交流，这自然导致她成为自由健康和科学写作。她的作品还出现在 Medscape、HealthCentral 和 Medical News Today 上。

articles.title: 'Flames soon engulfed us': Artemis II astronaut describes the historic mission's riskiest moment
articles.author: John Larsen

paras.en: After nine days in space, the four crewmembers of NASA's Artemis II mission looked out their capsule window on April 10, 2026, and saw the bright-blue Earth below them. The crew had traveled more than 250,000 miles (400,000 kilometers) from our planet — farther from Earth than any humans had ever gone — and now, home was just a few hundred miles straight down.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 10 日，在太空停留 9 天后，美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的四名宇航员向太空舱窗口望去，看到了下方亮蓝色的地球。船员们已经离开我们的星球超过 250,000 英里（400,000 公里）——距离地球比任何人类去过的距离都要远——而现在，家就在直线下方几百英里处。

paras.en: Only one milestone remained: splashdown, a fast and fiery plunge into the Pacific Ocean that would mark the end of humanity's first crewed mission to the moon in more than 50 years.Mission specialist Jeremy Hansen, the lone Canadian Space Agency astronaut on the crew, had every reason to be confident that the team's Orion crew capsule would hold up just fine. But this was Hansen's first time in space, and his first time dropping through the sky like a fireball at 24,600 mph (39,600 kmh).
paras.zh: 剩下的只有一个里程碑：溅落，快速而猛烈地坠入太平洋，这将标志着人类 50 多年来首次载人登月任务的结束。任务专家杰里米·汉森（Jeremy Hansen）是机组人员中唯一的加拿大航天局宇航员，他有充分的理由相信该团队的猎户座载人舱将完好无损。但这是汉森第一次进入太空，也是他第一次像火球一样以 24,600 英里/小时（39,600 公里/小时）的速度从空中坠落。

paras.en: It wasn't that he was afraid for himself, Hansen explains in "Earthrise: Inside Artemis II, the Groundbreaking Human Mission into Deep Space" (Hanover Square Press, 2026), which he co-wrote with John Larsen). Rather, he knew that his wife Catherine and three children would be among the millions of Earthlings watching the most dangerous moment of his mission from below.
paras.zh: 汉森在他与约翰·拉森合着的《地出：阿耳忒弥斯二号内部，突破性的人类深空任务》（汉诺威广场出版社，2026 年）中解释道，这并不是说他为自己担心。相反，他知道他的妻子凯瑟琳和三个孩子将成为数百万地球人中的一员，他们正在从下面观看他的任务中最危险的时刻。

paras.en: In this excerpt from the book, Hansen describes the thrilling intensity of splashdown and the euphoria of knowing that he and his crewmates were going to make it back safely — and make history.
paras.zh: 在这本书的摘录中，汉森描述了溅落的惊心动魄的强度，以及知道他和他的船员将安全返回并创造历史时的欣喜。

paras.en: Immediately after jettisoning the European Service Module, and exactly half an hour before we were due to splashdown, Mission Control initiated the crew module raise burn. This nineteen-second burn was the first and only burn using the small thrusters built into our Orion capsule. It slightly shallowed our entry trajectory to put us right in the sweet spot while also providing some added distance from the service module, as we'd be hitting the atmosphere in near succession. It, too, went flawlessly. I tightened my straps; it was time for the fireworks.
paras.zh: 在抛弃欧洲服务舱后，就在我们预定溅落的前半小时，任务控制中心立即启动了乘员舱升空燃烧。这次十九秒的燃烧是第一次也是唯一一次使用我们猎户座太空舱内置的小型推进器进行的燃烧。它稍微缩短了我们的进入轨迹，使我们处于最佳位置，同时也增加了与服务模块的距离，因为我们将几乎连续地进入大气层。它也进行得很完美。我拉紧了带子；放烟花的时间到了。

paras.en: A re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere is absolutely on the short list of the most incredible experiences of my life. We slammed into it at 7:53 p.m., thundering down at over 10 kilometres [6.2 miles] per second. Per second.
paras.zh: 重返地球大气层绝对是我一生中最不可思议的经历之一。我们于晚上 7 点 53 分撞上了它，以每秒 10 公里（6.2 英里）以上的速度轰鸣而下。每秒。

paras.en: The thrusters fired almost constantly to stabilize the capsule: loud thuds, as if Thor himself were hammering on our spacecraft, as the G-forces quickly began to build, aggressively scrubbing off the velocity we had added to our rocket nine days earlier. Within seconds, we saw plasma forming outside our windows, and the heat at the base of our capsule grew so intense that flames soon engulfed us. It started red and transformed into a bright, bluish-green, pulsating light. It was breathtaking, the bright colors igniting our senses.
paras.zh: 推进器几乎不断地发射以稳定太空舱：发出巨大的撞击声，就好像雷神本人在敲击我们的航天器一样，同时重力迅速开始增强，积极地消除了我们九天前添加到火箭中的速度。几秒钟之内，我们看到窗外形成了等离子体，太空舱底部的热量变得如此强烈，以至于火焰很快吞没了我们。它开始是红色的，然后变成明亮的蓝绿色脉动光。令人叹为观止，明亮的色彩点燃了我们的感官。

paras.en: It was insane to think about what we were doing. We all knew how this worked; we all knew the science. But deep inside, I also recognized that astronauts must have a screw loose to do this. Nobody in their right mind would strap themselves inside a metal canister that itself was sitting inside a giant fireball. But there was no other way down, and I had accepted the realities of this journey long in advance.
paras.zh: 想想我们在做什么真是疯狂。我们都知道这是如何运作的；我们都知道科学。 But deep inside, I also recognized that astronauts must have a screw loose to do this. Nobody in their right mind would strap themselves inside a metal canister that itself was sitting inside a giant fireball.但没有其他出路，我早就接受了这段旅程的现实。

paras.en: Although I was at peace, I felt guilty for the stress I was putting on my family. I had talked to them openly about the mission's risks, and this was the highest-risk moment. I tried to send my love telepathically, telling them it was going great.
paras.zh: 虽然我很平静，但我为自己给家人带来的压力感到内疚。我公开地与他们谈论了这次任务的风险，而这是风险最高的时​​刻。我尝试用心灵感应的方式表达我的爱，告诉他们一切进展顺利。

paras.en: As we continued our freefall, it looked like a thousand camera flashes were exploding inside Integrity. I lowered the sun visor on my helmet. There were only centimeters of heatshield and aluminum separating me from the more than 2500°C heat outside. Almost instantly, the heat inside our cramped home also began to rise, an increase that engineers refer to as "thermally benign." All I know is that I couldn't feel it, blissfully wrapped in my thermally controlled garments.
paras.zh: 当我们继续自由落体时，看起来有一千个相机闪光灯在诚信号内部爆炸。我放下头盔上的遮阳板。只有几厘米的隔热罩和铝将我与外面超过 2500°C 的高温隔开。几乎同时，我们狭小的家里的热量也开始上升，工程师将这种上升称为“热良性”。我只知道我感觉不到它，幸福地包裹在我的热控服装中。

paras.en: As we continued to fall, the G-forces built up to nearly four times the pressure we feel on Earth. I wasn't too worried, having endured more than five minutes of the same G-force, or more, in the NASA centrifuge trainer. I had half-expected the freefall back to Earth to seem short, but it was a long six minutes before the flames finally ceased and we re-established communications with Mission Control.
paras.zh: 当我们继续下落时，重力增加到我们在地球上感受到的压力的近四倍。我并不太担心，因为我在美国宇航局离心机训练器中承受了超过五分钟的相同重力，甚至更多。我本来以为自由落体返回地球的时间会很短，但在火焰最终熄灭并且我们与任务控制中心重新建立联系之前，花了六分钟的时间。

paras.en: It had already been a wild ride, but I also knew another crazy part — parachute deployment and the actual splashdown — lay ahead. My adrenalin kept pumping.
paras.zh: 这已经是一次疯狂的旅程，但我也知道另一个疯狂的部分——降落伞展开和实际的溅落——就在前方。我的肾上腺素持续激增。

paras.en: "Integrity, Houston. Comms check, post-blackout," we heard from Mission Control. It was music to our ears. It was exactly 8:00 p.m.
paras.zh: “休斯顿，正直。通讯检查，停电后。”我们从任务控制中心听到。这对我们来说就是音乐。时间正好是晚上 8:00。

paras.en: "Houston, Integrity," Reid [Wiseman, mission commander], replied. "We have you loud and clear."
paras.zh: “休斯顿，正直号，”里德（怀斯曼，任务指挥官）回答道。 “我们让你声音响亮、清晰。”

paras.en: This is when people the world over clapped, hugged, and, in some cases, cried. For the folks at NASA, it was clear that all had gone well during the descent — a small fleet of NASA and Air Force planes had captured it on high-resolution cameras. But, for me, it wasn't over yet. I wouldn't truly feel safe until our three main parachutes successfully deployed. If they didn't, we'd be a chunk of metal slamming into the ocean at incredibly high speed, and the chances of surviving that would be somewhere between minimal and non-existent.
paras.zh: 每当这时，全世界的人们都会鼓掌、拥抱，有时甚至哭泣。对于美国宇航局的工作人员来说，很明显，下降过程中一切都很顺利——美国宇航局和空军的一小队飞机用高分辨率摄像机捕捉到了这一过程。但是，对我来说，一切还没有结束。在我们的三个主降落伞成功展开之前，我不会真正感到安全。如果他们不这样做，我们就会成为一块以令人难以置信的高速撞入海洋的金属，而生存的机会将微乎其微甚至不存在。

paras.en: I've watched many of my close friends return from space, and I find the minutes after surviving the re-entry heat until the parachutes deploy to be the hardest part to watch. When I see a capsule plunge through the clouds with no chutes, I always worry they might not appear at all. That's completely terrifying.
paras.zh: 我看过我的许多亲密朋友从太空返回，我发现从重返大气层的高温中幸存下来直到降落伞展开的几分钟是最难观看的部分。当我看到一个没有降落伞的太空舱冲入云层时，我总是担心它们可能根本不会出现。这真是太可怕了。

paras.en: I thought of Catherine and the kids, sending them a "don't worry, gang" message in my mind. Catherine later told me that she had a very bad feeling about the heatshield, so when we emerged from blackout, she began crying and didn't even focus on the parachutes.
paras.zh: 我想起了凯瑟琳和孩子们，在我的脑海里向他们发送了“别担心，帮派”的信息。凯瑟琳后来告诉我，她对隔热罩有一种非常不好的感觉，所以当我们从停电中醒来时，她开始哭泣，甚至没有关注降落伞。

paras.en: Three minutes later, at an altitude of 7,100 metres, timed explosions released small chutes that pulled off the cover for two larger chutes, called drogues because they are intended to slow our acceleration to a speed that would allow our main parachutes to open without ripping. They did their job perfectly, but it was wild inside the capsule, jerking us back and forth like a ride at the fair.
paras.zh: 三分钟后，在 7,100 米的高度，定时爆炸释放了一些小降落伞，拉开了两个较大降落伞的盖子，这些降落伞被称为锥套，因为它们的目的是减慢我们的加速度，使我们的主降落伞能够在不撕裂的情况下打开。他们完美地完成了自己的工作，但太空舱内却很疯狂，让我们来回颠簸，就像在集市上兜风一样。

paras.en: One minute later, at only 1,500 metres above the ocean, the drogue chutes cut loose, and, for a few moments, we felt like we were falling backward. Then, in succession, the three main parachutes began deploying, blossoming slowly so they wouldn't tear apart. The rate of our fall slowed as the red-and-white nylon canopies, each 35 metres in diameter, filled with air. The thrusters kept firing, aiming the capsule's base directly toward the point of impact.
paras.zh: 一分钟后，在距海面仅 1,500 米的地方，锥套降落伞松开，有那么一会儿，我们感觉自己正在向后坠落。然后，三个主降落伞相继开始展开，缓慢地展开，以免撕裂。当直径 35 米的红白尼龙檐篷充满空气时，我们坠落的速度减慢了。推进器持续发射，将太空舱底部直接瞄准撞击点。

paras.en: - 'We're not a competitor to fusion. We are fusion': Inside the race to harness unlimited solar power in space
paras.zh: - “我们不是核聚变的竞争对手。我们正在融合”：在太空中利用无限太阳能的竞赛

paras.en: - 'Everything we know about space travel is going to change within a decade': The fusion breakthrough that could unlock a path to the stars
paras.zh: -“我们所知道的关于太空旅行的一切都将在十年内发生变化”：聚变突破可以开启通往恒星的道路

paras.en: - 'We only expect to encounter that once every 130 years': A huge new crater on the moon could mean a giant leap for lunar science
paras.zh: - “我们预计每 130 年才会遇到一次”：月球上的一个巨大的新陨石坑可能意味着月球科学的巨大飞跃

paras.en: "Integrity, we see three good-looking parachutes," we heard from our CAPCOM. Within seconds, our splashdown speed had reduced to 27 kilometres per hour.
paras.zh: “老实说，我们看到了三个好看的降落伞，”我们从 CAPCOM 那里听到。几秒钟之内，我们的溅落速度就降至每小时 27 公里。

paras.en: That's it, I said to myself. I'm pretty sure we can survive whatever else could be thrown at us now.
paras.zh: 就是这样，我对自己说。我很确定我们现在可以经受住任何可能发生的事情。

paras.en: Christina [Koch, mission specialist] seemed to agree. We grabbed one another's hands in a moment of celebration.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜（科赫，任务专家）似乎同意这一点。我们握着彼此的手庆祝了一番。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: The dramatic, high-stakes account of Artemis II, the first human journey into deep space in fifty years, told from the perspective of astronaut Jeremy Hansen ... A riveting and intimate account of the iconic achievement of Artemis II, Earthrise—written by author John Larsen and based on extensive interviews he conducted with Hansen—is a testament to what can be achieved with unity, teamwork, and a bold belief in humanity’s ability to reach for the stars.
paras.zh: 宇航员杰里米·汉森 (Jeremy Hansen) 的视角讲述了阿尔忒弥斯二号 (Artemis II) 的戏剧性且高风险的故事，这是五十年来人类首次进入深空的旅程。作者约翰·拉森 (John Larsen) 根据他对汉森进行的广泛采访，对阿尔忒弥斯二号 (Artemis II) 的标志性成就《地出》进行了引人入胜且亲密的描述，证明了团结、团队合作以及对人类到达星星能力的大胆信念可以取得的成就。

paras.en: John Larsen is a former executive-level military public affairs officer who served with the Royal Canadian Air Force during combat operations in Europe. Based in Calgary, AB, he is a business advisor, entrepreneur, writer, and university instructor. He holds graduate degrees in Communications and in Creative Non-Fiction Writing. Earthrise is his second book.
paras.zh: 约翰·拉森 (John Larsen) 是一名前行政级军事公​​共事务官员，曾在欧洲作战行动期间在加拿大皇家空军服役。他居住在艾伯塔省卡尔加里，是一名商业顾问、企业家、作家和大学讲师。他拥有传播学和非小说类创意写作研究生学位。 《地出》是他的第二本书。

articles.title: Giant cloud of fish sperm glows green along Canadian island’s coast
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada [48.95586624, -125.42994277]
paras.zh: 它在哪里？加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华岛 [48.95586624, -125.42994277]

paras.en: What's in the photo? A green cloud of milt (fish sperm) and eggs during a Pacific herring spawning event
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？太平洋鲱鱼产卵期间的绿色鱼精（鱼精）和卵云

paras.en: Which satellite took the photo? Landsat 9
paras.zh: 哪颗卫星拍到了这张照片？陆地卫星 9

paras.en: This surprising satellite snap shows a giant underwater plume of fish sperm that seems to glow green beneath the waves. The colorful cloud appeared during a spawning event at a reproductive "sweet spot" along Canada's western coastline.
paras.zh: 这张令人惊讶的卫星照片显示了巨大的水下鱼类精子羽流，它们似乎在波浪下发出绿光。这朵彩色云出现在加拿大西海岸线繁殖“最佳地点”的产卵活动期间。

paras.en: The striking sight was spotted in Barkley Sound, along a section of the southern coast of Vancouver Island in British Columbia, roughly 45 miles (70 kilometers) north of the U.S. border. The bright-green cloud is the most concentrated between Salmon Beach — the triangular town in the center of the image — and the smaller Forbes Island, which is also "glowing" along its northern coast.
paras.zh: 这一惊人的景象是在不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华岛南海岸的巴克利湾发现的，距离美国边境以北约 45 英里（70 公里）。亮绿色的云最集中在鲑鱼海滩（图像中心的三角形城镇）和较小的福布斯岛之间，福布斯岛也沿着其北部海岸“发光”。

paras.en: The green cloud is around 4 miles (7 km) from end to end and is made of milt — a fluid containing sperm made by fish, mollusks and other aquatic animals — that was released during a Pacific herring (Clupea pallasii) spawning event. Like many other fish species, Pacific herring reproduce by congregating in large groups. The females lay eggs, which stick to kelp, sea grasses and rocky surfaces, before the males release their milt, which disperses over the area and fertilizes the eggs.
paras.zh: 这片绿色的云从一端到另一端长约 4 英里（7 公里），由鱼白组成，鱼白是一种含有鱼类、软体动物和其他水生动物产生的精子的液体，是在太平洋鲱鱼 (Clupea pallasii) 产卵活动期间释放的。与许多其他鱼类一样，太平洋鲱鱼通过大群聚集来繁殖。雌性产下卵，卵粘附在海带、海草和岩石表面上，然后雄性释放出精液，精液分散在该区域并使卵受精。

paras.en: Pacific herring, which grow to around 10 inches (25 centimeters) long, often congregate in this spot off Vancouver Island in late winter or early spring, gathering for several weeks before releasing their gametes, or sex cells, according to NASA's Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局地球观测站称，太平洋鲱鱼长约 10 英寸（25 厘米）长，经常在冬末或早春聚集在温哥华岛附近的这个地方，聚集数周后释放配子或性细胞。

paras.en: "The herring spawn is a really fabulous time to be out here," local resident Ryan Cutler, who used a drone to capture close-up photos of this year's spawning event (see below), told CBC News. "It's a really, really spectacular time to be around."
paras.zh: 当地居民瑞安·卡特勒 (Ryan Cutler) 使用无人机拍摄了今年鲱鱼产卵事件的特写照片（见下文），他告诉 CBC 新闻，“鲱鱼产卵真是一个美妙的时刻。” “这真是一个非常非常美妙的时刻。”

paras.en: Spawning events can last anywhere between a few hours and several days, and scientists are increasingly turning to satellite images to help monitor these occurrences, according to the Earth Observatory. In this case, the milt cloud was visible for around 48 hours.
paras.zh: 据地球观测站称，产卵事件可能持续几个小时到几天，科学家们越来越多地利用卫星图像来帮助监测这些事件。在这种情况下，鱼白云的可见时间约为 48 小时。

paras.en: While the milky substance appears a striking green in these images, it is actually white. It appears green only because it is closer to the surface than the surrounding seafloor, meaning that less reflected light is absorbed by the water. This is also why shallow patches of water often appear turquoise when viewed from above.
paras.zh: 虽然乳状物质在这些图像中呈现出引人注目的绿色，但实际上它是白色的。它呈现绿色只是因为它比周围的海底更接近表面，这意味着水吸收的反射光较少。这也是为什么从上方观察时，浅水区通常呈现绿松石色。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The coastline alongside Salmon Beach is perfect for herring to spawn because it strikes the perfect balance between a number of important factors. "Herrings prefer spawning locations that are more protected, have rocky substrate, and allow them to select areas with reduced salinity," Jessica Moffatt, a biologist with Vancouver Island's Island Marine Aquatic Working Group, told the Earth Observatory. "Barkley Sound hits the 'sweet spot' in many of these regards."
paras.zh: 鲑鱼海滩沿岸的海岸线非常适合鲱鱼产卵，因为它在许多重要因素之间达到了完美的平衡。温哥华岛岛屿海洋水生工作组的生物学家杰西卡·莫法特告诉地球观测站：“鲱鱼更喜欢受到更多保护、有岩石基质的产卵地点，并允许它们选择盐度较低的区域。” “巴克利湾在许多方面都达到了‘最佳点’。”

paras.en: The Pacific herring is an important species in this region; it is a primary food source for Chinook salmon (Oncorhynchus tshawytscha), which give Salmon Beach its name. The herring are also hunted by local First Nation groups, according to CBC News.
paras.zh: 太平洋鲱鱼是该地区的重要物种；它是奇努克鲑鱼（Oncorhynchus tshawytscha）的主要食物来源，鲑鱼海滩因此得名。据加拿大广播公司新闻报道，当地原住民团体也捕猎鲱鱼。

paras.en: During the spawning events, a wide range of other predatory marine life — including large fish, whales and sea lions — are drawn to the area to feast on the herring, according to the Earth Observatory. And on land, eagles, wolves and bears are more likely to appear during the mass reproduction event.
paras.zh: 据地球观测站称，在产卵期间，包括大型鱼类、鲸鱼和海狮在内的多种其他掠食性海洋生物都会被吸引到该地区享用鲱鱼。而在陆地上，鹰、狼和熊更有可能在大规模繁殖事件中出现。

paras.en: Coincidentally, this exact patch of ocean was the site of one of the weirdest oceanographic events ever seen. In 2020, around 4 miles (7 km) off the coast of Ucluelet (located just along the coastline to the left in the photo), scientists detected a rogue wave that appeared in the open ocean seemingly from nowhere. The massive wave reached the height of a four-story building, making it the most extreme version of this phenomenon ever seen.
paras.zh: 巧合的是，这片海洋正是有史以来最奇怪的海洋事件之一的发生地。 2020 年，在距离尤克卢利特海岸约 4 英里（7 公里）处（位于照片左侧的海岸线），科学家们检测到公海中似乎不知从何而来的一股凶猛波浪。巨大的波浪达到了四层楼的高度，使其成为有史以来这种现象最极端的版本。

paras.en: Farther offshore, around 150 miles (240 km) south of Vancouver Island, researchers also detected a surprise swarm of more than 2,000 underwater earthquakes in a single day in March 2024, hinting that a section of the seafloor was ripping apart.
paras.zh: 在离岸更远的地方，即温哥华岛以南约 150 英里（240 公里）处，研究人员还意外地在 2024 年 3 月的一天内检测到了 2,000 多次水下地震，这表明海底的一部分正在撕裂。

paras.en: A recent satellite photo captured a series of clouds sculpted by von Kármán vortices from a volcano on South Korea's Jeju Island. A giant multicolor plume, ejected by China's Yangtze River, is also visible in the image.
paras.zh: 最近的一张卫星照片捕捉到了韩国济州岛一座火山的冯·卡门涡旋塑造的一系列云层。图像中还可以看到中国长江喷射出的巨大的彩色羽流。

paras.en: A recent satellite photo captured a gleaming halo of phytoplankton encircling the remote Chatham Islands. The stunning sight is the result of a hidden underwater structure, which has also helped kill hundreds of cetaceans.
paras.zh: 最近的一张卫星照片捕捉到了围绕偏远查塔姆群岛的浮游植物闪闪发光的光环。这一令人惊叹的景象是隐藏的水下结构造成的，它也导致数百只鲸目动物死亡。

paras.en: A recent satellite photo captured a stunning scene of sediment swirling across the West Florida Shelf after an extreme cold snap that covered large parts of the eastern U.S. in snow.
paras.zh: 最近的一张卫星照片捕捉到了美国东部大部分地区被雪覆盖的极端寒流过后，沉积物在西佛罗里达大陆架上旋转的惊人景象。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: These London Apartments Look Straight Out of the Stone Age. Could They Be the Future of Sustainable Architecture?

paras.en: From low-carbon concrete to mass timber to green steel, architects across the globe are employing cutting-edge technology to revolutionize eco-friendly building design. But the team behind a new north London apartment complex argues the industry’s path forward may lie in the ways of the past.
paras.zh: 从低碳混凝土到大体积木材再到绿色钢材，全球建筑师正在采用尖端技术来彻底改变生态友好型建筑设计。但伦敦北部一座新公寓大楼背后的团队认为，该行业的前进道路可能仍停留在过去的道路上。

paras.en: With a hulking, pink exoskeleton decorated with Celtic patterns, Petra Heights, a trio of apartment towers ranging from six to 10 stories, looks straight out of the Stone Age. That’s fitting, as the development’s load-bearing structures and decorative cladding are one and the same: stacks of raw, unchiseled stone.
paras.zh: 佩特拉高地 (Petra Heights) 是由六层到十层不等的三座公寓楼组成，有着巨大的粉红色外骨骼，装饰着凯尔特图案，看起来就像是直接从石器时代走出来的。这是很合适的，因为该开发项目的承重结构和装饰覆层都是一样的：一堆未经凿刻的原始石头。

paras.en: “All of the weight of the building is coming down the stone, and all the wind load is carried by the stone,” the project’s engineer, Steve Webb, co-founder of engineering firm Webb Yates, tells Dezeen’s Jennifer Hahn. Altogether, the complex houses a ground-floor storefront, two rooftop gardens and 22 apartments.
paras.zh: “建筑物的所有重量都落在石头上，所有的风荷载都由石头承担，”该项目的工程师、工程公司 Webb Yates 的联合创始人史蒂夫·韦伯 (Steve Webb) 告诉 Dezeen 的詹妮弗·哈恩 (Jennifer Hahn)。该综合体共有一个底层店面、两个屋顶花园和 22 套公寓。

paras.en: Petra Heights is part of an ongoing collaboration between architecture firm Groupwork, headed by Amin Taha, and Webb Yates to popularize stone as a viable alternative to steel and cement, which together represent 16 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions.
paras.zh: Petra Heights 是由 Amin Taha 领导的建筑公司 Groupwork 和 Webb Yates 之间持续合作的一部分，旨在推广石材作为钢铁和水泥的可行替代品，这两种材料合计占全球温室气体排放量的 16%。

paras.en: The stone frame—made of pink basalt from Sicily and larvikite from Norway—produces fewer carbon emissions than traditional steel-and-concrete models. With a stone external frame and a concrete internal frame, the Petra Heights project produced around 30 percent less carbon emissions than a fully steel or concrete alternative, the Guardian’s Oliver Wainwright reports. Those savings could rise to 95 percent with domestically-mined stone, per Dezeen.
paras.zh: 石框架由西西里岛的粉红色玄武岩和挪威的幼岩制成，比传统的钢和混凝土模型产生的碳排放量更少。据《卫报》的奥利弗·温赖特 (Oliver Wainwright) 报道，佩特拉高地项目采用石材外部框架和混凝土内部框架，比全钢或混凝土替代方案减少了约 30% 的碳排放。根据 Dezeen 的说法，使用国内开采的石材可以节省 95% 的成本。

paras.en: The two men began looking into stone 15 years ago after running into roadblocks while collaborating on a steel frame. A conservation officer pointed them towards stone. Skeptical, they asked a stonemason about the feasibility of building with the material, the Architect's Newspaper’s Richard Martin reports.
paras.zh: 15 年前，两人在合作建造钢框架时遇到障碍后开始研究石头。一名保护官员将他们指向石头。据《建筑师报》的理查德·马丁报道，他们持怀疑态度，向石匠询问了用这种材料建造的可行性。

paras.en: “Are you completely stupid?” Webb recalls the mason saying, according to the Architect’s Newspaper. “Just look around London—it’s been all stone for the last one thousand years. It’s still standing. Of course you can build in stone.”
paras.zh: “你彻底傻了吗？”据《建筑师报》报道，韦伯回忆起石匠的话。 “看看伦敦周围——在过去的一千年里，它一直都是石头。它仍然矗立着。当然，你可以用石头建造。”

paras.en: Since then, they have continually pushed the edge of what stone and wood can do. In 2021, the pair’s six-story 15 Clerkenwell Close, featuring a load-bearing stone structure, was shortlisted for the Stirling Prize, the United Kingdom’s most prestigious architecture award. Petra Heights is their biggest concept yet.
paras.zh: 从那时起，他们不断突破石头和木材的极限。 2021 年，两人设计的六层 15 Clerkenwell Close 建筑以承重石结构为特色，入围英国最负盛名的建筑奖项斯特林奖。佩特拉高地是他们迄今为止最大的概念。

paras.en: To demonstrate the strength and flexibility of stone, Webb Yates, in collaboration with the Stonemasonry Company, designed Stone Space Frame, a nearly 15-foot-tall electricity pylon prototype which requires steel only for tension.
paras.zh: 为了展示石头的强度和灵活性，Webb Yates 与 Stonemasonry Company 合作设计了 Stone Space Frame，这是一个近 15 英尺高的电力塔原型，仅需要钢材来承受张力。

paras.en: The project used 1,000 tons of rock to form nearly 600 stone columns and lintels. It also features the world’s first fully stone elevator shaft. With no steel reinforcement or secondary structure, Petra Heights is the largest load-bearing stone structure since the great stone cathedrals, the project’s website boasts. And Webb and Ahan aren’t stopping there.
paras.zh: 该工程使用了1000吨岩石，形成了近600根石柱和门楣。它还拥有世界上第一个全石制电梯井。该项目的网站称，佩特拉高地没有钢筋或二级结构，是自伟大的石头大教堂以来最大的承重石头结构。韦伯和阿汉并没有就此止步。

paras.en: “If we build another one, it can be taller, higher, stronger,” Webb tells Dezeen. In 2020, the duo released a concept for a 30-story office block with a stone exoskeleton.
paras.zh: “如果我们建造另一座，它可以更高、更高、更强，”韦伯告诉 Dezeen。 2020 年，两人发布了一个带有石头外骨骼的 30 层办公楼的概念。

paras.en: Currently, Groupwork is working on another stone-bearing mixed-use development in east London. Combined with dowel-laminated timber walls and floors, photovoltaic panels and a canal water source heat pump, the structure will generate 135 percent of its energy needs, making it “carbon negative” by selling energy back to the grid.
paras.zh: 目前，Groupwork 正在伦敦东部开发另一个石材混合用途开发项目。结合销钉层压木墙和地板、光伏板和运河水源热泵，该结构将满足其 135% 的能源需求，通过将能源卖回电网，使其成为“负碳”。

paras.en: Webb’s next venture is a 650-foot stone skyscraper sans the usual concrete core and columns. It will feature heavy, dark granite at the base and lighter, thinner limestone towards the top, optimizing the different load-bearing features of the two stones.
paras.zh: 韦伯的下一个项目是一座 650 英尺高的石头摩天大楼，没有通常的混凝土核心和柱子。其底部采用厚重的深色花岗岩，顶部采用较轻、较薄的石灰石，优化了两种石头的不同承重特征。

paras.en: “The impact of removing the concrete core from high rises has a big carbon benefit,” Webb tells Dezeen. But he says the next big push of load-bearing stone structures may be even better focused on smaller buildings, particularly as the United Kingdom pushes to deliver on its promise to build 1.5 million new homes before 2029. “Get rid of all the brickwork, get rid of all the concrete cores from concrete medium rise housing, [that] will put a big dent in the carbon footprint of the million homes," he adds.
paras.zh: 韦伯告诉德泽恩：“从高层建筑中拆除混凝土核心筒会产生巨大的碳效益。”但他表示，承重石结构的下一个重大推动可能会更好地集中在小型建筑上，特别是在英国努力兑现其在 2029 年之前建造 150 万套新房屋的承诺的情况下。“拆除所有砖砌结构，拆除混凝土中层住宅中的所有混凝土核心筒，[这]将大大减少数百万房屋的碳足迹，”他补充道。

paras.en: The two firms have even made a potential model, a “stone demonstrator house” that uses pre-tensioned stone beams and columns; stone floor slabs; and a self-supporting stone facade. The prototype reduces carbon emissions by 70 percent from a reinforced concrete frame and 90 percent from a steel one.
paras.zh: 两家公司甚至制作了一个潜在的模型，即使用预应力石梁和石柱的“石质示范屋”；石材楼板；和一个自支撑的石材立面。该原型机的碳排放量比钢筋混凝土框架减少了 70%，比钢框架减少了 90%。

paras.en: Webb says these stone designs are more than just climate friendly. They provide a wellspring of creative potential for designers and builders. “It’s a massive opportunity for architects to change it up—a reason to make a new style,” he tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 韦伯说，这些石材设计不仅仅是气候友好的。它们为设计师和建筑商提供了创造潜力的源泉。 “这对建筑师来说是一个改变它的巨大机会——一个创造新风格的理由，”他告诉卫报。

articles.title: Europe's Hera Spacecraft Has Begun Its Close-Up Investigation of the Asteroid System NASA Intentionally Hit in 2022

paras.en: The European Space Agency (ESA) has started its close-up investigation of an asteroid system smashed by NASA in 2022.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局 (ESA) 已开始对 NASA 于 2022 年粉碎的小行星系统进行近距离调查。

paras.en: ESA’s Hera spacecraft reached the Didymos binary asteroid system on November 4, more than two years after it launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida. The mission will examine the aftermath of NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) collision, helping scientists better understand how the technique could one day be used to protect Earth from incoming space rocks.
paras.zh: 欧空局的赫拉航天器于 11 月 4 日抵达迪迪莫斯双小行星系统，距其从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射两年多后。该任务将检查美国宇航局双小行星重定向测试（DART）碰撞的后果，帮助科学家更好地了解该技术有一天如何用于保护地球免受太空岩石的侵害。

paras.en: The asteroid Didymos is roughly 2,560 feet in diameter and has a companion moonlet called Dimorphos, which is about 495 feet in diameter. They form a binary asteroid system, a pair of asteroids that are gravitationally bound, orbiting each other around a shared center of mass.
paras.zh: 小行星 Didymos 直径约为 2,560 英尺，它有一个名为 Dimorphos 的伴生卫星，直径约为 495 英尺。它们形成了一个双小行星系统，一对受引力束缚的小行星，围绕共同的质心相互绕转。

paras.en: In September 2022, the golf-cart-size DART spacecraft intentionally struck the smaller celestial body in the world’s first demonstration of asteroid deflection technology. The mission not only successfully collided with Dimorphos, shortening its orbit around its big sibling by 33 minutes; it also altered the asteroid pair’s route around the sun. Now, Hera is returning to the crash scene to follow up on that work.
paras.zh: 2022 年 9 月，高尔夫球车大小的 DART 航天器有意撞击了较小的天体，这是世界上首次小行星偏转技术演示。此次任务不仅成功与 Dimorphos 相撞，将其绕其大兄弟的轨道缩短了 33 分钟；它还改变了这对小行星绕太阳运行的路线。现在，赫拉正在返回坠机现场跟进这项工作。

paras.en: “Hera wants to be the detective, like Inspector Colombo, going back to the crash scene,” Patrick Michel, a planetary scientist at the French National Center for Scientific Research and Hera’s principal investigator, tells Meghan Bartels for Space.com.
paras.zh: “赫拉想成为侦探，就像科伦坡督察一样，回到坠机现场，”法国国家科学研究中心的行星科学家、赫拉的首席研究员帕特里克·米歇尔告诉 Space.com 的梅根·巴特尔斯。

paras.en: The spacecraft, which is about the size of a small car, performed its first arrival maneuver on October 15, and ESA released Hera’s first close-up photo of the asteroid duo on November 5. The picture, snapped about 37 miles from the rocky pair, prominently features Didymos, with the smaller Dimorphos mostly hidden in the larger asteroid’s shadow.
paras.zh: 这艘航天器大约有一辆小型汽车大小，于 10 月 15 日进行了首次抵达机动，欧空局于 11 月 5 日发布了赫拉 (Hera) 首张这对小行星的特写照片。这张照片拍摄于距离这对岩石约 37 英里的地方，突出显示了 Didymos，较小的 Dimorphos 大部分隐藏在较大小行星的阴影中。

paras.en: While looking at this image, “the first thing we said was wow!” Michel says in a statement. “This is the other side of Didymos from the one that DART’s camera showed us shortly before impact, so this feels like looking at a whole new world.”
paras.zh: 当看到这张图片时，“我们首先说的是哇！”米歇尔在一份声明中说道。 “这是 Didymos 的另一面，与 DART 相机在撞击前不久向我们展示的那面不同，所以感觉就像看到了一个全新的世界。”

paras.en: On November 12, ESA released another image of the asteroid system, this time taken from about 35 miles away. It shows one side of Didymos and a sliver of Dimorphos peeking out from behind the larger rock, on the upper left. This photo reveals various features on the bigger asteroid’s surface, including large boulders, smooth areas and a sharp ridge at the equator.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日，欧空局发布了另一张小行星系统的图像，这次是在大约 35 英里之外拍摄的。它显示了迪迪莫斯的一侧和一条迪莫福斯从左上角较大的岩石后面探出头来。这张照片揭示了较大小行星表面的各种特征，包括大巨石、光滑区域和赤道处的尖锐山脊。

paras.en: Scientists want to understand which of these and other characteristics were present long ago and which might be consequences of the DART impact.
paras.zh: 科学家们想要了解这些特征和其他特征中哪些是很久以前就存在的，哪些可能是 DART 撞击的后果。

paras.en: “Since we expect a lot of impact-ejected material to have made it across the approximately one kilometer of space from Dimorphos to Didymos, it may be that some of these characteristics originate from this transport of material, and we have exciting work ahead of us to sort it out,” says Michael Küppers, a planetary scientist and Hera mission scientist at ESA, in the earlier statement. “We look forward to seeing much more of both bodies and systemically mapping all the changes we identify.”
paras.zh: 欧空局行星科学家兼赫拉任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯 (Michael Küppers) 在早些时候的声明中表示：“由于我们预计大量撞击喷射物质会穿过从 Dimorphos 到 Didymos 大约一公里的空间，因此其中一些特征可能源于这种物质传输，我们需要开展令人兴奋的工作来解决这个问题。” “我们期待看到更多的尸体，并系统地绘制我们发现的所有变化。”

paras.en: Hera should now be within about 20 miles of the asteroid duo, per Space.com, and then move even closer in December. Then, early next year, the spacecraft will deploy two shoebox-size CubeSats. These nanosatellites, equipped with radar and spectral instruments, will fly in and examine the surfaces and inner structures of the asteroids. One of the devices, called Juventas, will attempt to land on Dimorphos to capture more information about the asteroid’s surface material and gravity field.
paras.zh: 根据 Space.com 的数据，赫拉现在应该距离这对小行星约 20 英里，然后在 12 月会更近。然后，明年初，该航天器将部署两个鞋盒大小的立方体卫星。这些配备雷达和光谱仪器的纳米卫星将飞入小行星并检查其表面和内部结构。其中一台名为 Juventas 的设备将尝试降落在 Dimorphos 上，以捕获有关小行星表面物质和重力场的更多信息。

paras.en: The DART and Hera missions were intentionally designed to go together, with the first performing the deflection and the second collecting precise measurements of the outcome.
paras.zh: DART 和 Hera 任务被有意设计为协同工作，第一个任务执行偏转，第二个任务收集结果的精确测量结果。

paras.en: These studies will not just help experts develop techniques for planetary defense in case an object one day poses a danger to Earth; they’ll also advance our understanding of asteroids in general.
paras.zh: 这些研究不仅可以帮助专家开发行星防御技术，以防有一天某个物体对地球构成危险；还可以帮助专家开发行星防御技术。它们还将增进我们对小行星的总体了解。

paras.en: “Planetary defense and science are sort of two sides of the same coin,” says Jessica Sunshine, a planetary scientist at the University of Maryland who was on the DART team but is not involved in the Hera mission, to Bartels for Science News. On the science side, she adds, “we’re trying to figure out not so much how did we break the thing, but how was it put together in the first place.”
paras.zh: “行星防御和科学是同一枚硬币的两面，”马里兰大学行星科学家杰西卡·桑夏恩 (Jessica Sunshine) 向《科学新闻》巴特尔斯说道，她曾是 DART 团队成员，但未参与赫拉任务。她补充道，在科学方面，“我们并不是想弄清楚我们是如何破坏这个东西的，而是想弄清楚它最初是如何组装在一起的。”

paras.en: One question she and other researchers hope Hera will help answer relates to the system’s stabilization post-impact. Previously, Dimorphos always showed the same face to Didymos as it circled its companion, like the moon does with Earth. Researchers suspect DART changed that, and they want to see how it’ll reset, per Science News. Additionally, they want to better understand how exposure to charged particles affects an asteroid’s surface. The debris kicked up on Dimorphos by DART can help them examine fresh rock that was previously protected from those particles.
paras.zh: 她和其他研究人员希望赫拉能够帮助回答一个问题，该问题与系统在撞击后的稳定性有关。此前，当 Dimorphos 围绕其同伴旋转时，Dimorphos 总是向 Didymos 展示相同的面孔，就像月球围绕地球一样。据《科学新闻》报道，研究人员怀疑 DART 改变了这一点，他们想看看它将如何重置。此外，他们希望更好地了解带电粒子的暴露如何影响小行星的表面。 DART 在 Dimorphos 上激起的碎片可以帮助他们检查之前不受这些颗粒影响的新鲜岩石。

paras.en: Detailed images of both asteroids will be unveiled on November 25, according to the earlier statement.
paras.zh: 根据早些时候的声明，这两颗小行星的详细图像将于 11 月 25 日公布。

paras.en: “For us, it’s like a new world,” Michel tells Space.com. “The new image won’t have anything to do with the previous one, so that’s really exciting.”
paras.zh: “对我们来说，这就像一个新世界，”米歇尔告诉 Space.com。 “新图像与之前的图像没有任何关系，所以这真的很令人兴奋。”

articles.title: More Than a Billion Years' Worth of Rock Layers Are Missing From Earth's Geologic Record. Scientists Say They May Finally Know Why

paras.en: Rock layers record the Earth’s history, typically piling up from oldest at the bottom to youngest at the top. But a giant, mysterious gap exists in many of the globe’s landmasses. It’s well-documented in North America, northern Europe and northern China, where in some places more than one billion years of our planet’s geologic record is nowhere to be found.
paras.zh: 岩层记录了地球的历史，通常从最古老的底部到最年轻的顶部堆积起来。但全球许多陆地上都存在着巨大而神秘的鸿沟。在北美、北欧和中国北部都有详细的记录，但在这些地方，地球上超过十亿年的地质记录却无处可寻。

paras.en: Now, scientists say they may have figured out what caused the so-called Great Unconformity.
paras.zh: 现在，科学家们表示，他们可能已经弄清楚了所谓的大不整合现象的原因。

paras.en: Computer simulations hint the missing rock layers, which should be older than roughly 540 million years old, were uplifted by movements of Earth’s viscous mantle layer and eroded away by giant ice sheets before the continents sank back down again. The findings, published November 4 in the journal Nature, help validate some of the possible explanations about the Great Unconformity, possibly solving the 150-year-old mystery.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟暗示，缺失的岩石层的年龄应该超过大约 5.4 亿年，它们因地球粘性地幔层的运动而抬升，并在大陆再次下沉之前被巨大的冰盖侵蚀。该研究结果于 11 月 4 日发表在《自然》杂志上，有助于验证有关大不整合面的一些可能解释，并有可能解开这个 150 年来的谜团。

paras.en: “Imagine a book where a huge section in the middle has been ripped out. The Great Unconformity is that gap in Earth’s story, with the narrative jumping from the early chapters straight to a much later part of the story,” says study co-author Santosh Dhungana, an Earth scientist at the University of Wollongong in Australia, in a statement. “Our research suggests these pages weren’t lost by chance.”
paras.zh: “想象一下，一本书的中间很大一部分被撕掉了。大不整合就是地球故事中的一个空白，叙事从前面的章节直接跳到故事的后面部分，”该研究的合著者、澳大利亚卧龙岗大学的地球科学家桑托什·杜加纳（Santosh Dhungana）在一份声明中说。 “我们的研究表明这些页面并不是偶然丢失的。”

paras.en: Many scientists suspect that during the planet’s theorized Snowball Earth period, when the entire planet may have been frozen some 635 million to 720 million years ago, moving ice scraped away the missing rock layers. But if ice sheets covered the globe, they should have eroded the Great Unconformity everywhere, which isn’t the case, reports Ars Technica’s Jacek Krywko.
paras.zh: 许多科学家怀疑，在地球理论上的雪球地球时期，整个地球可能在大约 6.35 亿至 7.2 亿年前就被冻结了，移动的冰刮掉了缺失的岩层。但 Ars Technica 的 Jacek Krywko 报道称，如果冰盖覆盖了全球，它们应该会侵蚀所有地方的大不整合面，但事实并非如此。

paras.en: Some researchers have also hypothesized that mantle movements, which alter the planet’s surface, could be to blame. In the viscous mantle, hotter material rises and cooler material falls, pushing and pulling Earth’s outer layer, called the crust. However, this concept of mantle-driven dynamic topography “hadn’t been quantitatively tested,” study co-author Nicolas Flament, a geoscientist at the University of Wollongong, tells Ars Technica.
paras.zh: 一些研究人员还假设，改变地球表面的地幔运动可能是罪魁祸首。在粘性地幔中，较热的物质上升，较冷的物质下降，推动和拉动地球的外层（称为地壳）。然而，该研究的合著者、伍伦贡大学地球科学家 Nicolas Flament 告诉 Ars Technica，这种地幔驱动的动态地形概念“尚未经过定量测试”。

paras.en: So, he and Dhungana used computer models to simulate these mantle movements, called convection, over the past billion years. Their six models “consistently showed that mantle convection caused ancient continental blocks Laurentia (which now makes up much of North America), Baltica (parts of northern Europe) and North China to be lifted up from around a billion years ago to 540 million years ago,” the authors write for the Conversation. Over the past 540 million years, however, these continental chunks have sunk.
paras.zh: 因此，他和 Dhungana 使用计算机模型来模拟过去十亿年来的地幔运动（称为对流）。他们的六个模型“一致表明，地幔对流导致古代大陆块劳伦西亚（现在构成北美的大部分地区）、波罗的海（北欧的部分地区）和华北从大约 10 亿年前上升到 5.4 亿年前，”作者在《对话》中写道。然而，在过去的 5.4 亿年里，这些大陆块已经下沉。

paras.en: The era of continental uplift overlaps with the Snowball Earth period, and giant moving ice sheets erode landscapes more efficiently than rivers. The scientists speculate that the frozen masses would have ground their way down the slopes of raised landscapes, wiping away millions of years’ worth of rock accumulation.
paras.zh: 大陆隆升时代与雪球地球时代重叠，巨大的移动冰盖比河流更有效地侵蚀地貌。科学家们推测，冰冻的物质会沿着凸起地貌的斜坡磨碎，抹掉数百万年的岩石积累。

paras.en: What’s more, the Great Unconformity intrigues scientists interested in life’s history because it wiped the rock record just before the Cambrian explosion around 530 million years ago, when all sorts of animals suddenly evolved.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，大不整合面引起了对生命历史感兴趣的科学家的兴趣，因为它在大约 5.3 亿年前的寒武纪大爆发之前抹去了岩石记录，当时各种动物突然进化。

paras.en: The geologic processes that took place during the Great Unconformity may have created the foundation for this famous evolutionary event, Shanan Peters, a geoscientist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who did not participate in the study, tells Live Science’s Stephanie Pappas. By exposing older crystalline rocks, for example, the erosion may have triggered a greater release of certain elements, such as potassium, iron, manganese and carbon, into the oceans, allowing marine life to invent shells. That, in turn, may have put more oxygen into Earth’s atmosphere, Peters adds.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校地球科学家沙南·彼得斯 (Shanan Peters) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯，大不整合期间发生的地质过程可能为这一著名的进化事件奠定了基础。例如，通过暴露较古老的结晶岩，侵蚀可能会引发某些元素（例如钾、铁、锰和碳）更多地释放到海洋中，从而使海洋生物能够发明贝壳。彼得斯补充道，这反过来又可能向地球大气层排放了更多的氧气。

paras.en: “Sometimes what is missing can tell us more about the story of Earth than what we can see,” Flament says in the statement.
paras.zh: 弗拉门特在声明中表示：“有时，缺失的东西可以告诉我们更多关于地球的故事，而不是我们所能看到的。”

And if you’re a student, you can try Uber One for free for four weeks to make sure the service is a fit. After that, the service is half off at only $5 per month. No Uber Eats coupon code necessary. Just verify your student status to get the four weeks for free and $5 per month after.
paras.zh: 作为一名学生通常意味着预算紧张、漫长的夜晚和有限的厨房空间（和烹饪知识）。投资 Uber One 账户可能是个好主意——每月只需 10 美元，您在 Uber 乘车、Uber 杂货和送餐服务上平均可以节省 30 美元。您不必担心膳食计划或昂贵的外卖账单。通过 Uber One 折扣和促销，您可以以较低的成本获得一周的多餐。如果您是学生，可以免费试用 Uber One 四个星期，以确保该服务适合您。此后，该服务可享受半价优惠，每月仅需 5 美元。无需 Uber Eats 优食优惠券代码。只需验证您的学生身份，即可免费获得四个星期的服务，之后每月获得 5 美元。

paras.en: Get Your Groceries Delivered with Uber Eats
paras.zh: 通过 Uber Eats 优食送餐

paras.en: If you’re not in the mood to eat out, stay in and get groceries delivered with Uber Eats. Uber Eats partners with hundreds of grocery stores near you—including your favorite supermarkets—for same-day delivery in as little as 25 minutes. Using your location, Uber Eats offers fast delivery from drugstores, grocery chains, and local stores, so whether you need toilet paper or a gallon of milk, Uber Eats delivers.
paras.zh: 如果您没有心情外出就餐，可以呆在家里，享受 Uber Eats 优食送餐服务。 Uber Eats 优食与您附近的数百家杂货店（包括您最喜欢的超市）合作，可在短短 25 分钟内提供当日送达服务。 Uber Eats 优食可利用您的位置，从药店、杂货连锁店和当地商店提供快速送货服务，因此无论您需要卫生纸还是一加仑牛奶，Uber Eats 优食都能送货。

paras.en: Get Your Starbucks Delivered With Uber Eats
paras.zh: 通过 Uber Eats 优食为您的星巴克送餐

paras.en: If you’re like me and need about 40 oz. of coffee to get through the day, you know how important it is to have caffeine at a moment’s notice. With Uber Eats’ vast network, you can now get your Starbucks delivered. Starbucks delivery with Uber Eats couldn’t be easier. There are hundreds of Starbucks locations across the country, with both delivery and pickup available through the convenient app. Enter your zip code to see the nearest matching pickup location. Whether you’re catering for a big meeting or just want a quick breakfast.
paras.zh: 如果你像我一样需要大约 40 盎司。喝咖啡度过一天，您知道立即摄入咖啡因是多么重要。借助 Uber Eats 优食庞大的网络，您现在可以享受星巴克送餐服务。星巴克通过 Uber Eats 优食送餐再简单不过了。全国有数百家星巴克门店，通过便捷的应用程序可以提供送货和取货服务。输入您的邮政编码以查看最近的匹配取货地点。无论您是要举办大型会议还是只想吃一顿快餐。

paras.en: Discover Uber Eats Business for Your Workplace
paras.zh: 探索适合您工作场所的 Uber Eats 优食业务

paras.en: If you’re an employer looking for an easy way to feed your workforce, consider Uber Eats. With Uber Eats catering, employees can enjoy the food they love while you keep costs and policies in check. Uber Eats for Business offers flexible meal programs for office lunches, late nights, and hybrid teams, all managed conveniently from one platform. Employees order what they want through Uber Eats, while your business gets clear visibility into spending and usage. Plus, where available, Uber One can help lower delivery costs on eligible orders.
paras.zh: 如果您是雇主，正在寻找一种简单的方式来养活员工，请考虑 Uber Eats 优食。借助 Uber Eats 优食餐饮，员工可以享受他们喜爱的食物，同时您可以控制成本和政策。 Uber Eats for Business 为办公室午餐、深夜和混合团队提供灵活的膳食计划，所有这些都可以通过一个平台轻松管理。员工通过 Uber Eats 优食订购他们想要的东西，而您的企业则可以清楚地了解支出和使用情况。此外，在适用的情况下，Uber One 还可以帮助降低符合条件的订单的配送成本。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats regularly offers first-order discounts for new customers, often a percentage off or a capped dollar amount (like $15–$25 off) on your first delivery.
paras.zh: 是的，Uber Eats 优食会定期为新客户提供首单折扣，通常会在首次送货时提供百分比折扣或上限金额（例如 15 至 25 美元折扣）。

paras.en: In the app, go to your account menu, select "Promotions" (or "Add promo/gift card" at checkout), enter the code, and it should apply automatically if valid and still active.
paras.zh: 在应用程序中，转到您的帐户菜单，选择“促销”（或结账时“添加促销/礼品卡”），输入代码，如果有效且仍然有效，它应该会自动应用。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats has expanded beyond restaurants to include grocery, convenience, and retail delivery, and many promo codes apply across these categories
paras.zh: 是的，Uber Eats 优食已从餐厅扩展到杂货店、便利店和零售配送，并且许多促销代码适用于这些类别

paras.en: No. Uber Eats and Uber rides promo codes/credits are generally separate, though Uber One membership benefits apply across both rides and Eats.
paras.zh: 不会。Uber Eats 优食和 Uber 乘车促销代码/积分通常是分开的，但 Uber One 会员福利适用于乘车和乘车服务。

articles.title: Chewy Promo Codes: 25% Off November 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Florida-based online retailer Chewy has been around for less than 15 years but has quickly become a popular source for everything pet-related. Chewy carries supplies for farm animals, reptiles, fish, and more, with over 3,500 brands, including food, medicine, and toys. My cat is constantly throwing up (same) and requires Hill’s Sensitive Skin and Stomach, which costs roughly as much as my car insurance every month. I use WIRED’s Chewy promo codes to save money so I can spring for the 50-cent instant ramen while she remains vomit-free. Browse our roundup of verified coupons to score 50% off pet food and toys, $20 off your first purchase, free shipping deals, and more 2026 promotions.
paras.zh: 总部位于佛罗里达州的在线零售商 Chewy 成立还不到 15 年，但很快就成为与宠物相关的所有商品的热门来源。 Chewy 提供农场动物、爬行动物、鱼类等用品，品牌超过 3,500 个，包括食品、药品和玩具。我的猫经常呕吐（同样），需要希尔的敏感皮肤和胃部护理，其费用大约相当于我每个月的汽车保险费用。我使用《连线》杂志的 Chewy 促销代码来省钱，这样我就可以在她不呕吐的情况下享用 50 美分的方便面。浏览我们经过验证的优惠券汇总，享受宠物食品和玩具 50% 折扣、首次购买 20 美元折扣、免费送货优惠以及更多 2026 年促销活动。

paras.en: If you’ve been wondering whether Chewy is right for you, now's the time to try. First-time users can get a $20 eGift card when they place a first order at Chewy over $49 and use code WELCOME. And if you’ve never placed an order with their pharmacy, use Chewy coupon code RX20 at checkout to save 20% on prescription essentials like Simparica Trio, NexGard Plus, Heartgard, and more pet medications.
paras.zh: 如果您一直想知道 Chewy 是否适合您，现在是时候尝试一下了。首次用户在 Chewy 首次订购超过 49 美元并使用代码 WELCOME 即可获得一张 20 美元的电子礼品卡。如果您从未在他们的药房下过订单，请在结帐时使用 Chewy 优惠券代码 RX20 购买 Simparica Trio、NexGard Plus、Heartgard 和更多宠物药物等处方必需品可节省 20%。

paras.en: If you’re a returning customer, don’t fret. Chewy has rotating deals on a myriad of pet essentials and supplies, like flea guard, treats, litter, toys, and more. With this Chewy promo code, you can get almost half off, with $20 off orders of $49 or more with Chewy coupon code GIFT20OFF. This is a rare coupon that is only for existing customers who are signed in with their account. Plus, you can get an extra $5 off the first order made through the Chewy app with promo code. You’ll just need to download the app and enter the code in the box on the checkout screen for $5 off.
paras.zh: 如果您是回头客，请不要担心。 Chewy 轮换出售各种宠物必需品和用品，例如跳蚤防护剂、零食、垃圾、玩具等。使用 Chewy 促销代码，您可以享受几乎一半的折扣，使用 Chewy 优惠券代码 GIFT20OFF 订单满 49 美元或以上可享受 20 美元折扣。这是一张罕见的优惠券，仅适用于使用其帐户登录的现有客户。此外，您还可以使用促销代码通过 Chewy 应用程序下的第一笔订单额外获得 5 美元优惠。您只需下载应用程序并在结帐屏幕上的框中输入代码即可享受 5 美元的折扣。

paras.en: Don’t forget about your fur babies when holiday shopping this winter! Get pet essentials, toys, and more for less this holiday season with a 25% off Chewy promo code EARLY25. This means discounts off bestsellers like Natural Balance Rewards Minis with Real Salmon Dog Treats, which have a limit of 5 items per order, with a limit of 3 orders per customer, through November 23. Plus, you can also get 15% off eligible items with Chewy promo code EARLY15, which includes bestsellers like Blue Buffalo True Chews dog treats.
paras.zh: 今年冬天假期购物时，别忘了你的毛宝宝！使用 Chewy 促销代码 EARLY25 享受 25% 折扣，在这个假期以更低的价格购买宠物必需品、玩具等。这意味着截至 11 月 23 日，Natural Balance Rewards Minis with Real Salmon Dog Treats 等畅销商品可享受折扣，每笔订单限购 5 件商品，每位顾客限购 3 份订单。此外，您还可以使用 Chewy 促销代码 EARLY15 获得符合条件的商品 15% 的折扣，其中包括 Blue Buffalo True Chews 狗粮等畅销商品。

paras.en: New customers can also get free 1-3-day delivery (with real-time tracking) on first-time orders over $35, which seriously helps cut down the convenience cost of getting your 40-lb litter box to your third-floor apartment without having to lug it on the L train yourself (speaking from experience, don’t endure what I’ve had to). Get the convenience without paying for it with Chewy coupons for free delivery on all items.
paras.zh: 新客户还可以在首次订单超过 35 美元时享受 1-3 天的免费送货服务（实时跟踪），这极大地帮助降低了将 40 磅垃圾箱运送到三楼公寓的便利成本，而无需自己将其拖上 L 火车（根据经验，不要忍受我不得不忍受的事情）。使用 Chewy 优惠券免费送货，无需付费即可享受便利。

paras.en: Save 50% With Chewy Coupons and Pet Food Deals
paras.zh: 使用耐嚼优惠券和宠物食品优惠节省 50%

paras.en: Already a devoted pet parent/Chewy member? While the best Chewy promo codes are often reserved for first-time customers, existing customers can score daily deals like buy 3, get 1 free offers on toys. Make sure to stay tuned here. While our top Chewy promo codes unlock over 20% off, there’s more to look forward to. Expect discount codes still to come, like 50% off premium dog and cat food, up to 40% off flea and tick medications for fall, and free shipping on $35, an easy price to hit when you’re grabbing pet essentials (not to mention I’ll spend any amount to avoid lugging around boxes of concrete clay litter in the pits of hell, a.k.a. the subway).
paras.zh: 已经是忠实的宠物家长/Chewy 会员？虽然最好的 Chewy 促销代码通常是为首次购买的客户保留的，但现有客户可以获得每日优惠，例如玩具买 3 送 1 免费优惠。请务必关注这里。虽然我们的顶级 Chewy 促销代码可享受超过 20% 的折扣，但还有更多值得期待的内容。预计还会有折扣码，比如高级狗粮和猫粮 50% 折扣，秋季跳蚤和蜱虫药物最高 40% 折扣，35 美元免运费，当你购买宠物必需品时，这是一个很容易买到的价格（更不用说我会花很多钱来避免在地狱坑（又名地铁）里拖着一箱箱混凝土粘土垃圾）。

paras.en: Get 50% Off Your First Chewy Autoship Order
paras.zh: 首次订购 Chewy Autoship 即可享受 50% 折扣

paras.en: Are there any equestrians here tonight? If so, you’re in luck. You can enjoy 40% off horse joint health supplements with the Chewy promo code EQSUP. Interestingly, some deals are automatic and don’t require a code or effort. When you set up an autoship subscription for certain products, you’ll receive 35% off your first order and discounts of up to 50% on select pet food brands, plus an extra 5% off all future shipments. Chewy allows combining autoship with other deals or category discounts listed on the “Today’s Deals” page. It’s flexible: you can pause, skip, or cancel any autoship at any time without being locked into a subscription. You can also adjust the delivery frequency—from weekly to monthly or more. Additionally, autoship orders on pharmacy items, including prescription medications, come with extra discounts.
paras.zh: 今晚这里有马术爱好者吗？如果是这样，那么你很幸运。使用 Chewy 促销代码 EQSUP，您可以享受马关节健康补充剂 40% 的折扣。有趣的是，有些交易是自动进行的，不需要代码或努力。当您为某些产品设置自动发货订阅时，您的首笔订单将享受 35% 的折扣，特定宠物食品品牌的折扣高达 50%，未来所有发货还可享受 5% 的额外折扣。 Chewy 允许将自动发货与“今日优惠”页面上列出的其他优惠或类别折扣结合起来。它很灵活：您可以随时暂停、跳过或取消任何自动发货，而无需锁定订阅。您还可以调整交付频率——从每周到每月或更长时间。此外，药品（包括处方药）的自动发货订单还可享受额外折扣。

paras.en: Save on our Favorite Chewy Tech Products
paras.zh: 节省我们最喜欢的耐嚼科技产品

paras.en: I’m sort of the cat tech guru around here, and I’ve tested a myriad of the best pet tech, including automatic feeders and automatic litter boxes. I have some very strong opinions about which are worth the money (or not). I’m currently using—erm, my cats are using—the Litter-Robot 4 automatic litter box, and although it’s pricey, this box has changed my life. Gone are the days of foul smells, scooping, and pouring litter. This little machine does all the dirty work for you so you can spend more time on cuddles. I also own the LEVOIT Core Pet Care Air Purifier, which has been a game changer for me living in a cramped apartment with two giant cats—it really helps dissipate any smells, pet hair, or pesky dander. Overall, my house feels cleaner because of this small powerhouse machine. When I transition from WFH, I’m going to invest in this inexpensive camera, the INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 Degree Wi-Fi Security Pet Camera, to keep an eye on the goings-on and shenanigans while I’m at work.
paras.zh: 我是这里的猫技术专家，我测试了无数最好的宠物技术，包括自动喂食器和自动猫砂盆。对于哪些值得（或不值得），我有一些非常强烈的意见。我目前正在使用——呃，我的猫正在使用——Litter-Robot 4 自动猫砂盆，虽然价格昂贵，但这个盒子改变了我的生活。恶臭、铲起和倾倒垃圾的日子已经一去不复返了。这台小机器会为您完成所有脏活，这样您就可以花更多时间拥抱。我还拥有 LEVOIT Core 宠物护理空气净化器，对于我住在一间有两只大猫的狭窄公寓里来说，它改变了游戏规则——它确实有助于消除任何气味、宠物毛发或讨厌的皮屑。总的来说，因为有了这台小型动力机器，我的房子感觉更干净了。当我从 WFH 转型时，我将投资购买这款便宜的摄像机，即 INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 度 Wi-Fi 安全宠物摄像机，以便在我工作时密切关注发生的事情和恶作剧。

paras.en: If you haven’t ordered from Chewy before, now’s a great time to give it a try and see if it’s a good fit for you or your furry friend. Right now, when you place an order over $49, you’ll get a $25 eGift card. This means that when you buy anything over $49, from dog toys to cat litter to bird food, you’ll be rewarded with an eGift card to use on future purchases and cut down costs. (Some restrictions apply.)
paras.zh: 如果您以前没有从 Chewy 订购过，现在是尝试一下的好时机，看看它是否适合您或您毛茸茸的朋友。现在，当您下订单超过 49 美元时，您将获得一张 25 美元的电子礼品卡。这意味着，当您购买超过 49 美元的任何商品（从狗玩具到猫砂再到鸟食）时，您将获得一张电子礼品卡，可用于将来的购买并降低成本。 （有一些限制。）

paras.en: If you’re not a new Chewy customer, don’t worry. You can still snag great deals! Returning Chewy customers can still get rewards for their purchases. Right now, when you spend $100 at Chewy, you’ll get a $30 e-gift card. While browsing, be sure to check out Chewy’s autoship deals for even more stackable savings, including half off Purina Pro Plan Veterinary Diet supplements and chews. Be sure to check out the whole page of autoship savings and deals, with heavy discounts of up to half off Churu treats, oral care chews, brushes, and even more pet essentials.
paras.zh: 如果您不是 Chewy 的新客户，请不要担心。您仍然可以抢到超值优惠！ Chewy 的回头客仍然可以获得购买奖励。现在，当您在 Chewy 消费 100 美元时，您将获得一张 30 美元的电子礼品卡。浏览时，请务必查看 Chewy 的自动送货优惠，以获得更多可叠加的优惠，包括 Purina Pro Plan 兽医饮食补充剂和咀嚼物半价优惠。请务必查看整页的自动送货优惠和优惠，其中 Churu 零食、口腔护理咀嚼物、刷子以及更多宠物必需品可享受高达半价的大幅折扣。

paras.en: If you are like me and find yourself needing to restock on (heavy) essentials like kibble, canned food, and litter every few weeks, it’s a good idea to become a Chewy+ member, where you’ll get discounts on tons of items, autoship savings, rewards, and free delivery. With Chewy+, you not only get free, fast shipping with no minimums, but you’ll also get 5% back in rewards on purchases, exclusive offers, double rewards, discounts, free items, and more. Chewy also gives you a 30-day trial period so you can decide if Chewy+ is right for you. After that, it’ll be $79 per year. When you earn rewards, they will be added to your Chewy+ rewards balance, which shows in your member details and at checkout for redemption. Join Chewy+ today so you can make the most of your Chewy membership with newly added and changing offers like free access to Chewy services for your pet, extra rewards, or special pricing.
paras.zh: 如果你像我一样，发现自己每隔几周就需要补充一些（重的）必需品，比如粗磨食品、罐头食品和垃圾，那么成为 Chewy+ 会员是个好主意，在这里你将获得大量物品的折扣、自动送货节省、奖励和免费送货。使用 Chewy+，您不仅可以获得无最低限额的免费、快速送货服务，而且还可以获得 5% 的购买奖励、独家优惠、双倍奖励、折扣、免费物品等。 Chewy 还为您提供 30 天的试用期，以便您可以决定 Chewy+ 是否适合您。之后，每年费用为 79 美元。当您获得奖励时，它们将被添加到您的 Chewy+ 奖励余额中，该余额会显示在您的会员详细信息中以及在结帐兑换时显示。立即加入 Chewy+，这样您就可以通过新增和更改的优惠充分利用您的 Chewy 会员资格，例如为您的宠物免费使用 Chewy 服务、额外奖励或特价。

paras.en: Chewy dog deals are one of the best ways for dog owners to save big at Chewy. Under the “daily deals” tab, you can find deep discounts on pet essentials, from toys to treats, organized by category. (Think of it like a clearance bin, but for pets!) Right now, when you buy three toys or treats, you’ll get the fourth free. Be sure to review the details of the Chewy dog deals, as only certain top-rated toys and treats qualify.
paras.zh: Chewy 狗优惠是狗主人在 Chewy 省大钱的最佳方式之一。在“每日优惠”选项卡下，您可以找到按类别整理的宠物必需品的大幅折扣，从玩具到零食。 （可以把它想象成一个清仓箱，但用于宠物！）现在，当您购买三个玩具或零食时，您将免费获得第四个。请务必查看耐嚼狗优惠的详细信息，因为只有某些顶级玩具和零食才有资格。

paras.en: Does your doggo deserve treats? Of course they do! Right now, you can save $1 on soft, chewy Milk-Bone Peanut Buttery Cups with Jif Peanut Butter & Real Bacon using the Chewy promo code MILKBONE, until December 31 at 5:59 a.m. ET. These soft, chewy treats make the perfect accompaniment when giving meds or serve as a high-value treat during training. Note that there’s a limit of 1 item per order and 1 order per customer.
paras.zh: 你的狗狗值得被对待吗？他们当然知道！现在，您可以使用 Chewy 促销代码 MILKBONE 购买柔软耐嚼的奶骨花生酱杯（含 Jif 花生酱和真正的培根），以节省 1 美元，直至 12 月 31 日上午 5:59（美国东部时间）。这些柔软、耐嚼的零食是服药时的完美搭配，或在训练期间作为高价值零食。请注意，每个订单最多只能购买 1 件商品，每个客户最多只能购买 1 个订单。

paras.en: Get 50% Off Flea, Tick, and Heartworm Medication for Pets
